byChoice.en: Persistent facial edema does not mean treatment failure in the first hours; it is not the acute response marker.
byChoice.zh: 最初数小时面部水肿持续存在并不代表治疗失败；它不是急性反应指标。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes using the parameter tied to the immediate goal: BP and neurologic signs for preeclampsia response, respirations/reflexes/urine output for magnesium safety.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果时，要使用与即时目标相关的指标：用 BP 和神经系统体征判断子痫前期反应，用呼吸、反射和尿量判断硫酸镁安全性。

glossary.defZh: 硫酸镁水平过高导致反射消失、呼吸抑制、意识改变等危险表现。
反映肾灌注和药物清除能力的重要监测指标。
干预后病情朝预期方向改善的证据。

title.en: Postpartum readmission for headache and elevated blood pressure
title.zh: 产后因头痛和血压升高再次入院

summary.en: A 29-year-old primipara calls on postpartum day 4 with a severe headache, visual spots, new facial edema, and repeated home BP of 162/108 after an uncomplicated term vaginal birth and normotensive prenatal course.
summary.zh: 一名 29 岁初产妇在产后第 4 天来电，主诉严重头痛、眼前有斑点、新出现面部水肿，家庭血压反复为 162/108。她此前足月顺产且孕期血压正常。

content.en: G1P1, delivered a healthy 3,400-g infant vaginally at 39 weeks 2 days. Prenatal BP values were below 130/80, urine protein screens were negative, and there is no history of chronic hypertension, renal disease, autoimmune disease, or gestational hypertension. Discharged postpartum day 1 with BP 118/74, expected lochia rubra, firm fundus, no edema, and instructions to call for headache, vision changes, or BP above 140/90 on the home cuff. Breastfeeding. Medications: prenatal vitamins, ibuprofen 600 mg every 6 hours as needed, docusate sodium.
content.zh: G1P1，孕 39 周 2 天经阴道分娩一名健康 3,400 g 婴儿。孕期 BP 均低于 130/80，尿蛋白筛查阴性，无慢性高血压、肾病、自身免疫病或妊娠期高血压史。产后第 1 天出院，BP 118/74，恶露红色量符合预期，宫底坚硬，无水肿；被告知如出现头痛、视力改变或家庭血压超过 140/90 应来电。正在哺乳。用药：产前维生素、布洛芬 600 mg 每 6 小时按需、十二烷基磺基琥珀酸钠。

title.zh: 分娩住院基线实验室结果

content.en: Hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL; hematocrit 35%; platelets 238 ×10³/µL; AST 22 U/L; ALT 18 U/L; creatinine 0.7 mg/dL; uric acid 4.1 mg/dL; LDH 162 U/L; urinalysis negative for protein.
content.zh: 血红蛋白 11.8 g/dL；血细胞比容 35%；血小板 238 ×10³/µL；AST 22 U/L；ALT 18 U/L；肌酐 0.7 mg/dL；尿酸 4.1 mg/dL；LDH 162 U/L；尿检蛋白阴性。

title.en: Stage 1 - Triage call and ED arrival
title.zh: 第 1 阶段——分诊电话和到达急诊

content.en: At 10:15 AM, the patient reports severe frontal headache 8/10 unrelieved by ibuprofen, intermittent visual spots, new facial/periorbital puffiness, and home BP 162/108 twice, five minutes apart. She denies chest pain, shortness of breath, epigastric/RUQ pain, nausea, vomiting, seizure activity, focal weakness, and confusion. Lochia is light serosa and she is voiding without difficulty.
content.zh: 10:15 AM，患者报告严重额部头痛 8/10，布洛芬后未缓解；间歇性眼前有斑点；新出现面部/眼周浮肿；家庭 BP 两次均为 162/108，间隔 5 分钟。她否认胸痛、气短、上腹/右上腹痛、恶心、呕吐、癫痫发作、局灶无力和意识混乱。恶露为少量浆液性，排尿无困难。

content.en: Vitals: T 37.1 C, HR 96, BP 168/112, RR 18, SpO2 99% on room air. Repeat BP five minutes later: 164/110. Headache 9/10 with photophobia. Alert and oriented x4. Pupils equal and reactive; cranial nerves grossly intact; grip strength equal. DTRs 3+ at biceps and patella bilaterally with two beats of ankle clonus. Lungs clear; heart regular. Fundus firm just above symphysis pubis. Lower extremities 1+ pitting edema. Clean-catch urine dipstick: 3+ protein. 18-gauge IV placed and Foley inserted with 150 mL clear yellow urine initially. Stat CBC, CMP, LDH, uric acid, coagulation studies, and urine protein-to-creatinine ratio sent.
content.zh: 生命体征：T 37.1 C，HR 96，BP 168/112，RR 18，室内空气 SpO2 99%。5 分钟后复测 BP 164/110。头痛 9/10，畏光。清醒，定向力正常。瞳孔等大等圆且对光反应存在；颅神经大致完整；握力对称。双侧肱二头肌和髌腱反射 3+，踝阵挛 2 次。肺清，心律规则。宫底坚硬，位于耻骨联合上方。双下肢 1+ 凹陷性水肿。清洁中段尿试纸：蛋白 3+。已置入 18G IV，并插入 Foley，初始尿量 150 mL，清亮黄色。已送急查 CBC、CMP、LDH、尿酸、凝血检查和尿蛋白/肌酐比值。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段——启动急性治疗

content.en: Orders: magnesium sulfate 4 g IV loading dose over 20 minutes, then 2 g/hr continuous infusion for seizure prophylaxis; immediate-release nifedipine 10 mg PO now for acute BP reduction; repeat BP every 5 minutes for 20 minutes, then every 15 minutes; seizure precautions with padded side rails, suction at bedside, dimmed lighting, and minimized stimulation. Magnesium starts by pump at 11:40 AM; nifedipine 10 mg PO is given at 11:45 AM. BP after nifedipine: 158/104 at 11:50, 152/98 at 11:55, 148/96 at noon, 146/94 at 12:15. Urine output first hour: 60 mL. Headache improves to 6/10; occasional spots persist; DTRs remain 3+ with clonus.
content.zh: 医嘱：硫酸镁 4 g IV 负荷剂量 20 分钟内输注，随后 2 g/hr 连续输注用于癫痫预防；速释硝苯地平 10 mg PO 立即用于急性降压；前 20 分钟每 5 分钟复测 BP，之后每 15 分钟；癫痫预防措施包括床栏加垫、床旁备吸引、调暗灯光和减少刺激。11:40 AM 用输液泵开始硫酸镁；11:45 AM 给予硝苯地平 10 mg PO。硝苯地平后 BP：11:50 为 158/104，11:55 为 152/98，12:00 为 148/96，12:15 为 146/94。第一小时尿量 60 mL。头痛改善至 6/10；偶有视觉斑点；深腱反射仍为 3+ 并有阵挛。

content.en: Hemoglobin 12.0 g/dL; hematocrit 36%; platelets 195 ×10³/µL; AST 34 U/L; ALT 28 U/L; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; uric acid 6.8 mg/dL; LDH 198 U/L; INR 1.0; fibrinogen 380 mg/dL; urine protein-to-creatinine ratio 0.42.
content.zh: 血红蛋白 12.0 g/dL；血细胞比容 36%；血小板 195 ×10³/µL；AST 34 U/L；ALT 28 U/L；肌酐 0.9 mg/dL；尿酸 6.8 mg/dL；LDH 198 U/L；INR 1.0；纤维蛋白原 380 mg/dL；尿蛋白/肌酐比值 0.42。

content.en: The patient asks whether she can continue breastfeeding while receiving nifedipine and magnesium. She can usually continue breastfeeding while receiving these medications, but lactation support may be needed because illness, hospitalization, and magnesium therapy can delay lactation or make feeding more difficult.
content.zh: 患者询问接受硝苯地平和硫酸镁时是否可以继续哺乳。通常可在接受这些药物时继续哺乳，但可能需要哺乳支持，因为疾病、住院和硫酸镁治疗可能延迟泌乳或增加喂养困难。

title.zh: 第 3 阶段——复评和稳定

content.en: At 1:00 PM BP is 142/90. At 1:30 PM BP is 138/88; headache is 4/10; visual spots have resolved; facial edema is unchanged; DTRs are 2+ with no clonus; RR 16/min; patient is alert. Urine output second hour is 45 mL. Magnesium continues at 2 g/hr. Later BP: 140/86 at 2:00 PM and 136/84 at 2:30 PM. Provider plan: continue magnesium for 24 hours from the loading dose, start nifedipine ER 30 mg every 12 hours for maintenance BP control, and repeat HELLP panel in 6 hours.
content.zh: 1:00 PM BP 142/90。1:30 PM BP 138/88；头痛 4/10；视觉斑点消失；面部水肿无变化；深腱反射 2+，无阵挛；RR 16 次/分；患者清醒。第二小时尿量 45 mL。硫酸镁继续以 2 g/hr 输注。随后 BP：2:00 PM 为 140/86，2:30 PM 为 136/84。医嘱计划：从负荷剂量开始继续硫酸镁 24 小时，开始硝苯地平 ER 30 mg 每 12 小时用于维持血压控制，并 6 小时后复查 HELLP 相关检查。

content.en: The patient asks when she can go home and whether this can happen again. Her mother feels guilty for telling her the symptoms were normal and asks what warning signs she should watch for after discharge.
content.zh: 患者询问什么时候可以回家，以及这种情况是否会再次发生。她的母亲因曾告诉她这些症状正常而感到内疚，并询问出院后应观察哪些警示征象。

stem.en: During the postpartum triage call, highlight the findings that form the urgent preeclampsia-with-severe-features cluster requiring immediate emergency evaluation.
stem.zh: 在产后分诊电话中，请高亮显示构成子痫前期伴重度特征、需要立即急诊评估的紧急发现组合。

segments.en: Severe frontal headache rated 8/10 unrelieved by ibuprofen.
segments.zh: 严重额部头痛，8/10，服用布洛芬后未缓解。

segments.en: Intermittent scotomata described as seeing spots.
segments.zh: 间歇性暗点，描述为“看到斑点”。

segments.en: New facial and periorbital edema that is markedly different from yesterday.
segments.zh: 新出现的面部和眼周水肿，与前一天明显不同。

segments.en: Home BP is 162/108 on two readings five minutes apart.
segments.zh: 家庭血压两次测量均为 162/108，两次间隔 5 分钟。

segments.en: Lochia has transitioned to light serosa.
segments.zh: 恶露已转为少量浆液性恶露。

segments.en: Voiding without difficulty with estimated adequate urine output.
segments.zh: 排尿无困难，估计尿量充足。

segments.en: Denies chest pain and shortness of breath.
segments.zh: 否认胸痛和气短。

segments.en: Reports poor sleep related to newborn care.
segments.zh: 因照顾新生儿而睡眠不足。

correct.en: The severe headache unrelieved by analgesic, visual scotomata, new facial/periorbital edema, and repeated BP of 162/108 on postpartum day 4 are an urgent severe-feature cluster. Expected lochia, adequate voiding, no chest pain, and poor sleep do not make the cluster less urgent.
correct.zh: 未被止痛药缓解的严重头痛、视觉暗点、新出现的面部/眼周水肿，以及产后第 4 天反复测得 BP 162/108，构成重度特征的紧急组合。恶露符合预期、排尿充足、无胸痛和睡眠不足，不能降低这一组合的紧急性。

byChoice.en: A severe headache that does not respond to ibuprofen is a central nervous system warning sign in this context.
byChoice.zh: 布洛芬不能缓解的严重头痛，在此情境下是中枢神经系统警示征象。

byChoice.en: Scotomata are visual symptoms that increase concern for severe preeclampsia and seizure risk.
byChoice.zh: 暗点属于视觉症状，会增加对子痫前期重症及癫痫发作风险的担忧。

byChoice.en: New facial and periorbital edema is concerning when paired with severe BP and CNS symptoms.
byChoice.zh: 当新出现的面部和眼周水肿与重度血压和中枢神经症状同时出现时，具有警示意义。

byChoice.en: A BP of 162/108 includes a systolic value in the severe range and requires emergent evaluation in this symptom cluster.
byChoice.zh: BP 162/108 的收缩压已达重度范围，在这一症状组合下需要紧急评估。

byChoice.en: Light serosa is an expected postpartum lochia transition and does not explain the neurologic and BP findings.
byChoice.zh: 少量浆液性恶露是产后预期变化，不能解释神经系统和血压异常。

byChoice.en: Adequate voiding is reassuring for output, but it does not remove the need for emergency evaluation of severe BP and CNS symptoms.
byChoice.zh: 排尿充足对尿量有一定安慰意义，但不能取消对重度血压和中枢神经症状进行急诊评估的需要。

byChoice.en: Absence of chest pain is not enough to downgrade urgency when severe BP and CNS symptoms are present.
byChoice.zh: 在已有重度血压和中枢神经症状时，没有胸痛不足以降低紧急程度。

byChoice.en: Sleep deprivation is common postpartum, but it should not be used to dismiss a severe headache with visual symptoms and severe BP.
byChoice.zh: 产后睡眠不足很常见，但不能用来解释或忽视伴视觉症状和重度血压的严重头痛。

testTakingStrategy.en: In postpartum questions, do not normalize a headache when it is severe, unrelieved, paired with visual changes, or paired with severe-range BP.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到产后题目时，只要头痛严重、不能缓解、伴视觉改变或伴重度范围血压，就不要把它当作正常产后不适。

glossary.defZh: 视野中出现斑点、闪光或缺损，可提示子痫前期的神经系统受累。
通常指收缩压 ≥160 mm Hg 或舒张压 ≥110 mm Hg。
分娩后出现的高血压相关综合征，可伴头痛、视觉症状、蛋白尿或其他器官受累。

stem.en: At ED arrival, classify each cue according to how it should affect the nurse's interpretation before lab results are available.
stem.zh: 患者到达急诊时，在实验室结果尚未返回前，请判断每项线索对护士解释病情的意义。

rows.en: BP 168/112, repeated as 164/110 five minutes later
Headache 9/10 with intermittent visual spots
rows.zh: 头痛 9/10，伴间歇性视觉斑点

rows.en: DTRs 3+ with two beats of ankle clonus
rows.zh: 深腱反射 3+，踝阵挛 2 次

rows.en: Urine dipstick 3+ protein
rows.zh: 尿试纸蛋白 3+

rows.en: HELLP laboratory panel is still pending
rows.zh: HELLP 相关实验室检查仍未返回

columns.zh: 重度特征或需立即处理的线索

columns.en: Supportive but not required for immediate treatment
columns.zh: 有支持意义但不是立即处理的必要条件

correct.en: The repeated severe-range BP, CNS symptoms, and hyperreflexia with clonus are enough to classify the presentation as preeclampsia with severe features and begin urgent treatment. Proteinuria supports the diagnosis, but severe BP and CNS findings drive immediate action. Pending labs are drawn concurrently and should not delay treatment.
correct.zh: 反复重度范围 BP、中枢神经症状以及伴阵挛的反射亢进，足以将此表现判断为子痫前期伴重度特征并启动紧急治疗。蛋白尿支持诊断，但立即行动由重度 BP 和中枢神经发现驱动。实验室检查应同时进行，不能因此延误治疗。

byChoice.en: Both readings meet severe-range criteria because the systolic value is at least 160 and the diastolic value is at least 110.
byChoice.zh: 两次读数均符合重度范围，因为收缩压至少 160，舒张压至少 110。

byChoice.en: Severe headache and visual symptoms are CNS warning signs and raise concern for impending eclampsia.
byChoice.zh: 严重头痛和视觉症状是中枢神经系统警示征象，提示子痫风险升高。

byChoice.en: Hyperreflexia with clonus indicates CNS irritability and supports seizure-risk management.
byChoice.zh: 反射亢进伴阵挛提示中枢神经兴奋性增加，支持进行癫痫发作风险处理。

byChoice.en: Proteinuria supports preeclampsia, but severe-range BP with CNS symptoms already requires urgent action.
byChoice.zh: 蛋白尿支持子痫前期，但重度范围 BP 加中枢神经症状本身已需要紧急处理。

byChoice.en: Waiting for the HELLP panel would create an unsafe delay; labs are evaluated while treatment begins.
byChoice.zh: 等待 HELLP 检查结果会造成不安全延误；应在开始治疗的同时评估实验室结果。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a severe BP threshold and neurologic symptoms are present, act on the instability first; confirmatory labs should not become a prerequisite for safety treatment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当出现重度血压阈值和神经系统症状时，先处理不稳定状态；确认性实验室检查不应成为安全治疗的前提。

glossary.defZh: 快速牵拉肌腱后出现的重复性不自主收缩，提示神经肌肉兴奋性增加。
以溶血、肝酶升高和血小板减少为特征的妊娠相关严重并发症。
尿中蛋白异常增多，可支持子痫前期诊断。

stem.en: Use the Stage 2 assessment and laboratory results to complete the diagnostic reasoning statement.
stem.zh: 根据第 2 阶段评估和实验室结果，完成诊断推理陈述。

clozeStem.en: HELLP syndrome is less likely because {{hellp_evidence}}, and postpartum hypertension without severe features is less likely because {{severity_evidence}}.
clozeStem.zh: HELLP 综合征可能性较低，因为 {{hellp_evidence}}；产后高血压不伴重度特征可能性较低，因为 {{severity_evidence}}。

options.en: urine protein-to-creatinine ratio is 0.42
options.zh: 尿蛋白/肌酐比值为 0.42

options.en: platelets, AST/ALT, and LDH are not showing the HELLP triad
options.zh: 血小板、AST/ALT 和 LDH 未显示 HELLP 三联征

options.en: uric acid is elevated
options.zh: 尿酸升高

options.en: the patient denies right upper quadrant pain
options.zh: 患者否认右上腹痛

options.en: severe-range BP is paired with headache, scotomata, hyperreflexia, and clonus
options.zh: 重度范围 BP 伴头痛、暗点、反射亢进和阵挛

options.en: the prenatal course was normotensive
options.zh: 孕期血压一直正常

correct.en: Stage 2 supports postpartum preeclampsia with severe features: severe-range BP, CNS symptoms, hyperreflexia with clonus, and proteinuria are present. HELLP is not supported because platelets, transaminases, and LDH are not showing the defining pattern. Hypertension without severe features is excluded by the severe BP and neurologic findings.
correct.zh: 第 2 阶段支持产后子痫前期伴重度特征：存在重度范围 BP、中枢神经症状、反射亢进伴阵挛以及蛋白尿。血小板、转氨酶和 LDH 未显示 HELLP 的特征模式，因此不支持 HELLP。重度 BP 和神经系统发现排除了“不伴重度特征”的高血压分类。

byChoice.en: HELLP requires the hemolysis/liver-enzyme/platelet pattern; this case instead has normal platelets, near-normal transaminases, and normal LDH.
byChoice.zh: HELLP 需要溶血、肝酶升高和血小板减少的模式；本病例血小板正常，转氨酶接近正常，LDH 正常。

byChoice.en: The severe-range BP plus neurologic symptoms and clonus makes the severe-feature classification, not a mild postpartum hypertension classification.
byChoice.zh: 重度范围 BP 加神经系统症状和阵挛，决定了重度特征分类，而不是轻度产后高血压分类。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use abnormal defining criteria, not tempting associated findings, to separate competing diagnoses.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分竞争诊断时，要抓定义性异常标准，而不是被诱人的相关发现带偏。

glossary.defZh: AST 和 ALT 等肝细胞损伤指标。
可在溶血或组织损伤时升高；HELLP 评估中常用。
根据当前资料最优先采用、指导下一步处理的诊断。

stem.en: The patient asks, 'Will the magnesium bring my blood pressure down?' Which response by the nurse is best?
stem.zh: 患者问：“镁剂会把我的血压降下来吗？”护士哪项回答最佳？

options.en: Magnesium sulfate helps prevent seizures; the immediate-release nifedipine is the medication ordered to lower the blood pressure quickly.
options.zh: 硫酸镁用于帮助预防癫痫发作；医嘱中的速释硝苯地平才是用于快速降低血压的药物。

options.en: Because you are breastfeeding, both magnesium sulfate and nifedipine should be withheld until lactation consults.
options.zh: 因为你正在哺乳，应先停用硫酸镁和硝苯地平，等哺乳顾问评估后再说。

options.en: The extended-release nifedipine capsule would work just as well for this acute severe BP reading.
options.zh: 缓释硝苯地平胶囊对这次急性重度血压读数同样有效。

options.en: Magnesium sulfate is the main antihypertensive, so nifedipine can wait until the loading dose is complete.
options.zh: 硫酸镁是主要降压药，所以硝苯地平可以等负荷剂量结束后再给。

correct.en: Magnesium sulfate is used for seizure prophylaxis in preeclampsia with severe features; it is not the acute antihypertensive. Immediate-release nifedipine is ordered for rapid BP reduction, while extended-release nifedipine is for maintenance control later.
correct.zh: 硫酸镁用于子痫前期伴重度特征的癫痫发作预防；它不是急性降压药。速释硝苯地平的医嘱目的是快速降低 BP，而缓释硝苯地平用于后续维持控制。

byChoice.en: This repeats the unsafe misconception that magnesium is an antihypertensive and would delay BP treatment.
byChoice.zh: 这重复了“硫酸镁是降压药”的不安全误解，会延误血压治疗。

byChoice.en: Breastfeeding does not justify withholding urgently indicated seizure prophylaxis and antihypertensive therapy; lactation support can occur alongside treatment.
byChoice.zh: 哺乳并不能成为停用紧急所需癫痫预防和降压治疗的理由；哺乳支持可以与治疗同时进行。

byChoice.en: Extended-release nifedipine is not interchangeable with immediate-release nifedipine for acute severe BP reduction.
byChoice.zh: 在急性重度 BP 降压中，缓释硝苯地平不能替代速释硝苯地平。

byChoice.en: This accurately separates seizure prophylaxis from BP control and reinforces the immediate-release nifedipine order.
byChoice.zh: 这准确区分了癫痫预防和血压控制，并强调速释硝苯地平医嘱。

testTakingStrategy.en: Match each medication to its purpose before deciding whether it can be delayed or substituted.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 判断药物能否延迟或替代前，先把每种药物与其治疗目的对应起来。

glossary.defZh: 在子痫前期重症中用于预防或治疗癫痫发作的高警示药物。
药物释放较快，适用于需要较快起效的情境。
用于降低血压的药物。

stem.en: At 11:40 AM, the nurse is initiating treatment for confirmed severe-range BP and seizure risk. Which actions should the nurse include now? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 11:40 AM，护士正在为已确认的重度范围 BP 和癫痫发作风险启动治疗。护士现在应包括哪些措施？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Implement seizure precautions, including padded side rails, suction at bedside, dim lighting, and minimized stimulation.
options.zh: 实施癫痫预防措施，包括床栏加垫、床旁备吸引、调暗灯光并减少刺激。

options.en: Monitor BP every 5 minutes for the first 20 minutes, then as ordered.
options.zh: 前 20 分钟每 5 分钟监测 BP，之后按医嘱监测。

options.en: Run the magnesium by gravity tubing to save time if the pump is not immediately nearby.
options.zh: 如果输液泵不在旁边，为节省时间用重力输液管滴注硫酸镁。

options.en: Start the magnesium sulfate loading dose by infusion pump as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱用输液泵开始硫酸镁负荷剂量。

options.en: Wait until the magnesium loading dose is complete before giving nifedipine.
options.zh: 等硫酸镁负荷剂量完成后再给予硝苯地平。

options.en: Administer the immediate-release nifedipine 10 mg PO as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱给予速释硝苯地平 10 mg PO。

correct.en: These are concurrent priorities: start magnesium safely by pump for seizure prophylaxis, give immediate-release nifedipine for acute BP reduction, create a low-stimulation seizure-safe environment, and perform close serial BP monitoring. The nurse should not force a sequence that delays either medication or safety precautions.
correct.zh: 这些是同时进行的优先措施：用输液泵安全启动硫酸镁以预防癫痫，给予速释硝苯地平进行急性降压，建立低刺激且防癫痫的环境，并密切连续监测 BP。护士不应人为设置顺序而延误任一药物或安全措施。

byChoice.en: Gravity tubing is unsafe for a high-alert magnesium infusion because accurate rate control is essential.
byChoice.zh: 硫酸镁为高警示输注药物，必须精确控制速率，用重力滴注不安全。

byChoice.en: The antihypertensive should be given promptly; it should not wait for completion of the magnesium loading dose.
byChoice.zh: 降压药应及时给予；不应等硫酸镁负荷剂量结束后再给。

byChoice.en: Frequent BP monitoring evaluates response and detects persistent severe hypertension or hypotension after treatment.
byChoice.zh: 频繁 BP 监测可评估疗效，并发现治疗后持续重度高血压或低血压。

byChoice.en: Waiting for the magnesium load to finish would delay acute BP treatment during the highest-risk window.
byChoice.zh: 等待硫酸镁负荷完成会在最高风险窗口延误急性降压治疗。

byChoice.en: Seizure precautions reduce injury risk during the period of high CNS irritability.
byChoice.zh: 在中枢神经兴奋性高的时期，癫痫预防措施可降低受伤风险。

byChoice.en: Magnesium is a high-alert infusion and should be administered by pump at the ordered loading rate.
byChoice.zh: 硫酸镁是高警示输注药物，应按医嘱负荷速率用输液泵给药。

testTakingStrategy.en: When interventions protect against different immediate risks, decide whether they are concurrent rather than forcing an ordered-response mindset.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多项干预分别针对不同的即时风险时，要判断它们是否应并行，而不是强行套用排序思维。

glossary.defZh: 降低癫痫发作时受伤和误吸风险的环境与设备准备。
用于精确控制静脉输液速率的设备。
按短间隔重复测量血压以评估趋势和治疗反应。

stem.en: At 1:30 PM, classify each reassessment finding as evidence of improvement/absence of toxicity, a finding requiring continued vigilance, or a finding that is not an acute treatment-response marker.
stem.zh: 1:30 PM，请将每项复评发现归类为改善/无中毒证据、需要继续警惕的发现，或不是急性治疗反应指标的发现。

rows.en: BP has decreased to 138/88
rows.zh: BP 已降至 138/88

rows.en: Visual spots have resolved and headache is now 4/10
rows.zh: 视觉斑点已消失，头痛现为 4/10

rows.en: DTRs are 2+ with no clonus
rows.zh: 深腱反射 2+，无阵挛

rows.en: Respiratory rate is 16/min and the patient is alert
rows.zh: 呼吸频率 16 次/分，患者清醒

rows.en: Urine output is 45 mL in the second hour
rows.zh: 第二小时尿量为 45 mL

rows.en: Facial edema is unchanged
rows.zh: 面部水肿无变化

correct.en: BP below the severe range, improved headache/visual symptoms, normalized reflexes without clonus, and stable respirations/mentation indicate treatment response and no current magnesium toxicity. Urine output of 45 mL/hr is above the usual minimum for magnesium clearance but still requires close hourly monitoring. Facial edema often resolves over days and is not the acute marker of response.
correct.zh: BP 低于重度范围、头痛/视觉症状改善、反射恢复且无阵挛、呼吸和意识稳定，提示治疗有效且目前无镁中毒。45 mL/小时的尿量高于通常用于镁清除的最低值，但仍需每小时密切监测。面部水肿常需数天缓解，不是急性治疗反应指标。

byChoice.en: The immediate BP goal is to move out of the severe range while avoiding hypotension.
byChoice.zh: 即时 BP 目标是脱离重度范围，同时避免低血压。

byChoice.en: Resolution of visual symptoms and a lower headache score suggest decreasing CNS irritability.
byChoice.zh: 视觉症状消失且头痛评分降低，提示中枢神经兴奋性下降。

byChoice.en: DTRs that remain present and clonus that resolves support improvement and do not suggest magnesium toxicity.
byChoice.zh: 深腱反射仍存在且阵挛消失，支持病情改善，并不提示镁中毒。

byChoice.en: Stable respirations and alert mentation are key safety checks during magnesium therapy.
byChoice.zh: 呼吸稳定和意识清醒是硫酸镁治疗期间的关键安全检查。

byChoice.en: Urine output is adequate for now but must be trended because magnesium is renally cleared and oliguria increases toxicity risk.
byChoice.zh: 目前尿量尚可，但必须持续观察趋势，因为镁经肾脏清除，少尿会增加中毒风险。

byChoice.en: Persistent facial edema does not mean treatment failure in the first hours; it is not the acute response marker.
byChoice.zh: 最初数小时面部水肿持续存在并不代表治疗失败；它不是急性反应指标。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes using the parameter tied to the immediate goal: BP and neurologic signs for preeclampsia response, respirations/reflexes/urine output for magnesium safety.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果时，要使用与即时目标相关的指标：用 BP 和神经系统体征判断子痫前期反应，用呼吸、反射和尿量判断硫酸镁安全性。

glossary.defZh: 硫酸镁水平过高导致反射消失、呼吸抑制、意识改变等危险表现。
反映肾灌注和药物清除能力的重要监测指标。
干预后病情朝预期方向改善的证据。

note: Campaign 17 A/B producer implementation; full parent preimage frozen; independent review pending

title.en: Prerenal acute kidney injury with hyperkalemia in acute-on-chronic kidney disease
title.zh: 慢性肾病基础上发生肾前性急性肾损伤并高钾血症

summary.en: A 65-year-old man with stage 3a CKD, type 2 diabetes treated with metformin, hypertension treated with lisinopril, and intermittent ibuprofen use is transferred from a skilled nursing facility after 72 hours of profuse vomiting and watery diarrhea during a confirmed norovirus outbreak. He has minimal oral intake, increasing confusion, and near-absent urine output.
summary.zh: 65 岁男性，既往 3a 期慢性肾病、2 型糖尿病（服用二甲双胍）、高血压（服用赖诺普利），并间断使用布洛芬。在熟练护理机构确认诺如病毒暴发期间，他出现 72 小时大量呕吐和水样腹泻后转入急诊。患者口服摄入极少，意识混乱加重，并几乎无尿。

content.en: Baseline creatinine 1.4 mg/dL three months ago with eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73 m². Home medications: metformin 1000 mg twice daily, lisinopril 20 mg daily, and ibuprofen as needed; facility MAR confirms ibuprofen 400 mg two days ago. On arrival he is dry, fatigued, oriented to person only, repeatedly asking where he is, with cracked lips, tacky mucous membranes, diffuse abdominal cramping, nausea, and no urination for several hours. Orders include peripheral IV access, 500 mL normal saline bolus, continuous cardiac monitoring, 12-lead ECG, BMP, CBC, urinalysis with microscopy, point-of-care glucose, bladder scan, and holding metformin and lisinopril pending renal review.
content.zh: 三个月前基线肌酐 1.4 mg/dL，eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73 m²。居家用药：二甲双胍 1000 mg 每日两次、赖诺普利 20 mg 每日一次、布洛芬按需；机构 MAR 证实两天前给予布洛芬 400 mg。入院时患者干燥、疲乏，仅对人物定向，反复询问自己在哪里，嘴唇干裂、黏膜发黏，弥漫性腹部绞痛、恶心，数小时未排尿。医嘱包括建立外周 IV、0.9% 氯化钠 500 mL bolus、连续心电监测、12 导联 ECG、BMP、CBC、尿常规显微镜检查、床旁血糖、膀胱扫描，并在肾功能复评前暂停二甲双胍和赖诺普利。

content.en: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 112 regular, BP 88/54, RR 20, SpO₂ 96% room air. Weight 82 kg; facility weight one week ago 86 kg. Drowsy but arousable, follows simple commands, drifts off when not stimulated. Poor skin turgor with sternal tenting >3 seconds; dry mucous membranes; capillary refill 4 seconds; flat neck veins even supine. Lungs clear bilaterally. No peripheral edema. Extremities cool with weak but palpable pulses. Bladder scan: 40 mL. ECG: sinus tachycardia with peaked, narrow-based T waves in V2-V4 and II-III; PR 0.18 seconds, QRS 0.10 seconds; no ST elevation or depression.
content.zh: T 99 °F (37.2 °C)，HR 112 次/分且规则，BP 88/54，RR 20，室内空气 SpO₂ 96%。体重 82 kg；一周前机构体重 86 kg。嗜睡但呼唤可醒，能执行简单指令，未刺激时会入睡。皮肤弹性差，胸骨处皮肤回弹 >3 秒；黏膜干燥；毛细血管再充盈 4 秒；即使仰卧颈静脉也扁平。双肺清。无外周水肿。四肢偏凉，脉搏弱但可触及。膀胱扫描：40 mL。ECG：窦性心动过速，V2-V4 和 II-III 导联高尖窄基底 T 波；PR 0.18 秒，QRS 0.10 秒；无 ST 段抬高或压低。

content.en: Na 134 mEq/L, K 6.1 mEq/L, Cl 96 mEq/L, HCO₃ 18 mEq/L, BUN 68 mg/dL, creatinine 4.2 mg/dL, BUN:Cr 16.2:1, glucose 188 mg/dL, calcium 8.4 mg/dL, phosphorus 5.1 mg/dL, magnesium 1.6 mg/dL. CBC: WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL, Hgb 13.8 g/dL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. VBG: pH 7.30, pCO₂ 32 mmHg, lactate 2.8 mmol/L. UA: specific gravity 1.032, urine sodium 8 mEq/L, no protein, no blood, no casts, trace ketones. Provider-documented FENa: 0.4%.
content.zh: Na 134 mEq/L，K 6.1 mEq/L，Cl 96 mEq/L，HCO₃ 18 mEq/L，BUN 68 mg/dL，肌酐 4.2 mg/dL，BUN/Cr 16.2:1，血糖 188 mg/dL，钙 8.4 mg/dL，磷 5.1 mg/dL，镁 1.6 mg/dL。CBC：WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL，Hgb 13.8 g/dL，血小板 210 ×10³/µL。VBG：pH 7.30，pCO₂ 32 mmHg，乳酸 2.8 mmol/L。尿检：尿比重 1.032，尿钠 8 mEq/L，无蛋白、无血、无管型，微量酮体。医嘱方记录 FENa：0.4%。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：到达后 0 至 2 小时

title.en: Initial fluid response and medication review
title.zh: 初始补液反应和用药复查

content.en: The first 500 mL normal saline bolus runs over 30 minutes. A second 500 mL bolus and then normal saline at 150 mL/hr are ordered. Foley catheter insertion returns 30 mL dark concentrated urine. Over the next 90 minutes, urine output totals 18 mL, about 0.15 mL/kg/hr. Repeat vitals: HR 106, BP 92/58, RR 18, SpO₂ 97%. Peaked T waves persist. Home medications reviewed: metformin, lisinopril, and PRN ibuprofen. Metformin and lisinopril are held, but ibuprofen is not addressed in the orders.
content.zh: 第一袋 0.9% 氯化钠 500 mL bolus 在 30 分钟内输入。随后医嘱第二袋 500 mL bolus，再以 150 mL/hr 持续输注。置入 Foley 导尿管后引流出 30 mL 深色浓缩尿。接下来 90 分钟总尿量 18 mL，约 0.15 mL/kg/hr。复测生命体征：HR 106，BP 92/58，RR 18，SpO₂ 97%。高尖 T 波持续存在。复查居家用药：二甲双胍、赖诺普利和 PRN 布洛芬。二甲双胍和赖诺普利已暂停，但医嘱未处理布洛芬。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段：到达后 2 至 6 小时

content.en: At hour 4: K 6.4 mEq/L, creatinine 4.5 mg/dL, BUN 72 mg/dL, HCO₃ 16 mEq/L, lactate 3.2 mmol/L, glucose 162 mg/dL. ECG: PR 0.24 seconds and QRS 0.12 seconds with persistent peaked T waves. The client is more lethargic, opens eyes briefly to direct verbal stimulation, and reports finger tingling and calf cramping. Urine output over the preceding 4 hours totals 45 mL, about 0.14 mL/kg/hr. Total IV fluid received is about 1,500 mL. Provider orders critical hyperkalemia protocol: calcium gluconate 1 g IV at protocol rate, followed by regular insulin 10 units IV with 25 g dextrose, sodium bicarbonate 50 mEq IV over 30 minutes, and sodium polystyrene sulfonate 30 g orally. The client is actively nauseated. Nephrology consult and strict hourly urine measurement are ordered.
content.zh: 第 4 小时：K 6.4 mEq/L，肌酐 4.5 mg/dL，BUN 72 mg/dL，HCO₃ 16 mEq/L，乳酸 3.2 mmol/L，血糖 162 mg/dL。ECG：PR 0.24 秒，QRS 0.12 秒，仍有高尖 T 波。患者更加嗜睡，直接言语刺激时短暂睁眼，并诉手指麻木和小腿抽筋。此前 4 小时尿量共 45 mL，约 0.14 mL/kg/hr。累计已接受 IV 液体约 1,500 mL。医嘱方开立危急高钾方案：葡萄糖酸钙 1 g IV 按方案速度给予，随后普通胰岛素 10 units IV 合并 25 g 葡萄糖，碳酸氢钠 50 mEq IV 30 分钟内输入，以及聚苯乙烯磺酸钠 30 g 口服。患者正在明显恶心。医嘱肾内科会诊，并严格每小时测量尿量。

title.zh: 第 3 阶段：到达后 6 至 14 小时

content.en: Calcium gluconate was administered at hour 4.5; insulin and dextrose were administered at hour 5. By hour 8: K 5.4 mEq/L, creatinine 4.3 mg/dL, BUN 70 mg/dL, HCO₃ 19 mEq/L, lactate 2.0 mmol/L, glucose 134 mg/dL. ECG: PR 0.18 seconds, QRS 0.10 seconds, peaked T waves diminished. Urine output from hours 6-10 improves to 35 mL/hr, about 0.43 mL/kg/hr. The client is oriented to person and place, BP 104/66, HR 92. Nephrology recommends continued isotonic fluids, urine output target >0.5 mL/kg/hr, BMP every 6 hours, holding all nephrotoxic medications, and reassessing for renal replacement therapy if urine output fails to improve or potassium rises again. By hour 14: urine output 48 mL/hr (0.59 mL/kg/hr), K 4.9 mEq/L, creatinine 3.8 mg/dL, BP 112/70, HR 84, alert and oriented x3, tolerating small sips of clear liquids.
content.zh: 葡萄糖酸钙于第 4.5 小时给予；胰岛素和葡萄糖于第 5 小时给予。到第 8 小时：K 5.4 mEq/L，肌酐 4.3 mg/dL，BUN 70 mg/dL，HCO₃ 19 mEq/L，乳酸 2.0 mmol/L，血糖 134 mg/dL。ECG：PR 0.18 秒，QRS 0.10 秒，高尖 T 波减轻。第 6 至 10 小时尿量改善至 35 mL/hr，约 0.43 mL/kg/hr。患者对人物和地点定向，BP 104/66，HR 92。肾内科建议继续等渗液体、尿量目标 >0.5 mL/kg/hr、每 6 小时复查 BMP、暂停所有肾毒性药物；若尿量未继续改善或血钾再升高，则重新评估肾脏替代治疗。到第 14 小时：尿量 48 mL/hr（0.59 mL/kg/hr），K 4.9 mEq/L，肌酐 3.8 mg/dL，BP 112/70，HR 84，清醒且定向力完整，可少量啜饮清流质。

stem.en: For each admission finding, classify the most clinically relevant meaning in this client.
stem.zh: 请将每项入院评估结果归类为对该患者最有临床意义的含义。

rows.en: Urine specific gravity 1.032
Urine sodium 8 mEq/L
rows.zh: 尿钠 8 mEq/L

rows.en: FENa 0.4%
rows.zh: 钠排泄分数 FENa 0.4%

rows.en: Creatinine 4.2 mg/dL, baseline 1.4 mg/dL
rows.zh: 肌酐 4.2 mg/dL，基线 1.4 mg/dL

rows.en: BP 88/54 with HR 112
Dry mucous membranes, poor skin turgor, flat neck veins
rows.zh: 黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差、颈静脉扁平

rows.en: Potassium 6.1 mEq/L with peaked T waves
rows.zh: 钾 6.1 mEq/L，并有高尖 T 波

rows.en: Clear lung sounds with no crackles
rows.zh: 双肺清，无湿啰音

rows.en: Bladder scan 40 mL
rows.zh: 膀胱扫描 40 mL

rows.en: BUN-to-creatinine ratio 16.2:1
rows.zh: BUN/肌酐比值 16.2:1

columns.en: Not the strongest prerenal cue here
columns.zh: 不是本病例最强的肾前性线索

columns.en: Supports prerenal AKI from volume depletion
columns.zh: 支持容量不足导致的肾前性 AKI

columns.en: Rules out or argues against another cause
columns.zh: 排除或不支持其他病因

correct.en: The strongest prerenal pattern is the cluster of severe volume depletion plus kidneys that are still conserving sodium and water: concentrated urine, urine sodium 8 mEq/L, FENa 0.4%, acute creatinine rise, hypotension, tachycardia, dry mucous membranes, poor turgor, flat neck veins, and cool extremities. Potassium 6.1 mEq/L with peaked T waves is a separate immediate danger: hyperkalemia with myocardial irritability. Clear lungs support the absence of fluid overload, and a 40 mL bladder scan argues against urinary retention. The BUN-to-creatinine ratio is elevated but not the strongest cue in this scaffold, so the nurse should not over-weight it over the urine sodium, FENa, concentrated urine, and clinical dehydration.
correct.zh: 最强的肾前性模式是：严重容量不足，同时肾脏仍在保钠保水，包括尿液浓缩、尿钠 8 mEq/L、FENa 0.4%、肌酐急升、低血压、心动过速、黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差、颈静脉扁平以及肢端偏凉。钾 6.1 mEq/L 合并高尖 T 波则是另一个立即危险：高钾血症导致心肌电活动不稳定。双肺清支持没有液体过负荷，膀胱扫描 40 mL 不支持尿潴留。BUN/肌酐比值虽升高，但在此病例中不是最强线索，护士不应把它看得比尿钠、FENa、尿液浓缩和临床脱水表现更重要。

byChoice.en: A specific gravity of 1.032 means the urine is concentrated, which fits prerenal sodium and water conservation.
byChoice.zh: 尿比重 1.032 表示尿液浓缩，符合肾前性状态下保钠保水的反应。

byChoice.en: Urine sodium 8 mEq/L is very low, showing avid renal sodium retention during decreased perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 尿钠 8 mEq/L 很低，说明肾灌注下降时肾脏积极保留钠。

byChoice.en: FENa below 1% supports prerenal physiology when interpreted with the rest of the case.
byChoice.zh: FENa 低于 1%，结合病例其他资料，支持肾前性生理状态。

byChoice.en: A creatinine rise from 1.4 to 4.2 mg/dL shows acute kidney injury superimposed on CKD.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐从 1.4 升至 4.2 mg/dL，提示慢性肾病基础上的急性肾损伤。

byChoice.en: Hypotension with tachycardia is a perfusion cue consistent with dehydration from GI losses.
byChoice.zh: 低血压伴心动过速是灌注不足线索，符合胃肠道丢失导致的脱水。

byChoice.en: Dry mucous membranes, poor turgor, and flat neck veins are volume-depletion findings.
byChoice.zh: 黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差和颈静脉扁平都是容量不足表现。

byChoice.en: Peaked T waves in a client with potassium 6.1 mEq/L indicate hyperkalemia-related cardiac risk, not simply dehydration.
byChoice.zh: 钾 6.1 mEq/L 合并高尖 T 波提示高钾相关心脏风险，而不只是脱水。

byChoice.en: Clear lungs do not diagnose AKI, but they argue against pulmonary fluid overload while fluids are being considered.
byChoice.zh: 双肺清不能诊断 AKI，但在考虑补液时有助于排除肺部液体过负荷。

byChoice.en: A bladder scan of only 40 mL argues against urinary retention as the cause of oliguria.
byChoice.zh: 膀胱扫描仅 40 mL，不支持尿潴留是少尿原因。

byChoice.en: The ratio is not the decisive cue here; relying on it alone would miss the stronger urine and volume-status evidence.
byChoice.zh: 该比值不是本题决定性线索；单靠它会忽略更强的尿液指标和容量状态证据。

testTakingStrategy.en: Cluster cues before naming the problem: volume-loss history plus concentrated, low-sodium urine points to prerenal AKI, while ECG changes with high potassium create the immediate danger.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 先把线索组合起来再判断问题：容量丢失病史加上尿液浓缩、尿钠低，指向肾前性 AKI；高钾合并 ECG 改变则构成立即危险。

glossary.defZh: 由于肾脏灌注不足导致的急性肾损伤，肾小管早期仍可保钠和浓缩尿液。
评估肾脏排钠比例的指标，低值常支持肾前性状态。
高钾血症早期可见的 ECG 改变，提示心肌电活动受影响。

stem.en: At Stage 1, which medication-related nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第 1 阶段，哪些与用药相关的护理措施是适当的？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Continue holding lisinopril during this hypovolemic AKI episode.
options.zh: 在本次低容量性 AKI 期间继续暂停赖诺普利。

options.en: Teach the patient and family not to use over-the-counter NSAIDs during recovery unless the provider approves.
options.zh: 教育患者和家属：恢复期间除非医嘱允许，不要自行使用非处方 NSAID。

options.en: Monitor the lactate and acidosis while recognizing hypoperfusion can also contribute.
options.zh: 监测乳酸和酸中毒，同时认识到低灌注也可能造成这些异常。

options.en: Continue holding metformin while renal function is acutely impaired.
options.zh: 在肾功能急性受损期间继续暂停二甲双胍。

options.en: Give metformin because the admission glucose is 188 mg/dL.
options.zh: 因入院血糖 188 mg/dL，应给予二甲双胍。

options.en: Clarify that ibuprofen is explicitly held and documented as contraindicated during the AKI episode.
options.zh: 与医嘱方确认布洛芬在本次 AKI 期间明确暂停，并记录为禁用。

correct.en: Metformin, lisinopril, and ibuprofen all matter in this AKI episode. Metformin should be held because reduced renal clearance can increase accumulation and lactic acidosis risk; the elevated lactate needs monitoring, though hypoperfusion is also a plausible contributor. Lisinopril should be held because ACE inhibition can reduce the efferent arteriolar tone that helps preserve glomerular filtration pressure during hypovolemia. Ibuprofen should be explicitly held and documented because NSAIDs can impair prostaglandin-mediated afferent arteriolar dilation and may be inadvertently restarted if not addressed. Teaching should include avoiding OTC NSAIDs during recovery unless approved.
correct.zh: 在本次 AKI 中，二甲双胍、赖诺普利和布洛芬都很重要。二甲双胍应暂停，因为肾清除下降可增加药物蓄积和乳酸性酸中毒风险；乳酸升高需要监测，但低灌注本身也可能造成乳酸升高。赖诺普利应暂停，因为 ACE 抑制会降低出球小动脉张力，而这种张力在低容量时有助于维持肾小球滤过压力。布洛芬应明确暂停并记录，因为 NSAID 可影响前列腺素介导的入球小动脉扩张；若不处理，可能被误重新使用。宣教应包括恢复期除非医嘱允许，不自行使用 OTC NSAID。

byChoice.en: OTC NSAID teaching prevents recurrence or worsening of the renal insult after discharge or during recovery.
byChoice.zh: 非处方 NSAID 宣教可防止出院后或恢复期间再次或加重肾损伤。

byChoice.en: Metformin is not used to acutely correct this glucose, and giving it during AKI increases safety risk.
byChoice.zh: 二甲双胍不是用来急性纠正该血糖的药物，在 AKI 期间给予会增加安全风险。

byChoice.en: Holding metformin is appropriate during AKI because impaired clearance increases accumulation and lactic acidosis risk.
byChoice.zh: AKI 期间暂停二甲双胍是适当的，因为清除下降会增加蓄积和乳酸性酸中毒风险。

byChoice.en: Lactate and acidosis need monitoring, but the nurse should not assume metformin is the only cause because hypoperfusion can also raise lactate.
byChoice.zh: 需要监测乳酸和酸中毒，但护士不应认定只有二甲双胍导致，因为低灌注也会升高乳酸。

byChoice.en: The ibuprofen omission requires clarification so the medication is not restarted during AKI.
byChoice.zh: 布洛芬遗漏需要澄清，以免在 AKI 期间被重新使用。

byChoice.en: Holding lisinopril is appropriate because ACE inhibition can worsen filtration pressure during severe volume depletion.
byChoice.zh: 暂停赖诺普利是适当的，因为严重容量不足时 ACE 抑制可能进一步降低滤过压力。

testTakingStrategy.en: When AKI is present, screen every home and OTC medication for renal clearance or renal perfusion effects; do not stop at the drugs already addressed in the orders.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 出现 AKI 时，要逐一筛查所有居家药和 OTC 药是否影响肾清除或肾灌注；不要只看医嘱已经提到的药。

glossary.defZh: 常用降糖药；肾功能急性受损时需评估蓄积和乳酸性酸中毒风险。
可影响出球小动脉张力，在低容量 AKI 中可能降低滤过压力。
如布洛芬，可影响前列腺素介导的肾血流调节。
核对并处理患者实际使用的处方药、非处方药和补充剂。

stem.en: At Stage 2, which problem is the nurse's highest immediate priority?
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段，护士最优先立即处理的问题是什么？

options.en: Creatinine rising from 4.2 to 4.5 mg/dL
options.zh: 肌酐从 4.2 升至 4.5 mg/dL

options.en: Nausea that makes oral medications difficult to retain
options.zh: 恶心导致口服药难以保留

options.en: Oliguria with urine output 0.14 mL/kg/hr
options.zh: 少尿，尿量 0.14 mL/kg/hr

options.en: Worsening hyperkalemia with PR prolongation and QRS widening
options.zh: 高钾血症恶化，伴 PR 延长和 QRS 增宽

correct.en: The potassium has risen to 6.4 mEq/L and the ECG has progressed from peaked T waves to PR prolongation and QRS widening. That pattern signals advancing hyperkalemia-related conduction toxicity and can deteriorate to a lethal rhythm. Oliguria and rising creatinine are serious, but they do not create the same minute-to-minute cardiac arrest risk. The nurse should prepare for emergent membrane stabilization with calcium gluconate while the renal problem continues to be managed.
correct.zh: 钾升至 6.4 mEq/L，ECG 从高尖 T 波进展为 PR 延长和 QRS 增宽。这表示高钾相关传导毒性正在进展，可能恶化为致命心律。少尿和肌酐升高也严重，但不像这种 ECG 改变一样具有分钟级心脏骤停风险。护士应准备立即使用葡萄糖酸钙稳定心肌膜，同时继续处理肾脏问题。

byChoice.en: This is the immediate life threat because ECG conduction changes show hyperkalemia is affecting the myocardium.
byChoice.zh: 这是立即危及生命的问题，因为 ECG 传导改变显示高钾已影响心肌。

byChoice.en: Nausea affects medication safety, especially oral SPS, but it is secondary to unstable hyperkalemia with ECG changes.
byChoice.zh: 恶心影响用药安全，尤其是口服 SPS，但次于伴 ECG 改变的不稳定高钾血症。

byChoice.en: The creatinine trend confirms worsening AKI, but creatinine itself is not the immediate cause of cardiac arrest.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐趋势证实 AKI 恶化，但肌酐本身不是立即导致心脏骤停的因素。

byChoice.en: Oliguria is serious and requires strict monitoring and renal management, but it is not the most immediate arrhythmia threat.
byChoice.zh: 少尿严重，需要严格监测和肾脏处理，但不是最立即的心律失常威胁。

testTakingStrategy.en: In prioritization questions, an electrolyte abnormality with ECG conduction changes usually outranks slower organ-function trends because it can cause sudden death.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 优先级题中，电解质异常若已出现 ECG 传导改变，通常优先于较慢的器官功能趋势，因为它可导致猝死。

glossary.defZh: 血钾升高，可导致肌无力和危及生命的心律失常。
房室传导变慢的 ECG 表现，可见于高钾进展。
心室传导变慢的 ECG 表现，高钾时提示危险加重。

stem.en: Complete the nurse's clinical reasoning about the Stage 2 hyperkalemia protocol.
stem.zh: 完成护士对第 2 阶段高钾血症处理方案的临床推理。

clozeStem.en: Because the client has hyperkalemia with ECG conduction changes, the nurse should give {{1}} first. The next rapid potassium-shifting treatment is {{2}}. The oral sodium polystyrene sulfonate order should be {{3}} because {{4}}. After insulin is administered, the nurse should {{5}}.
clozeStem.zh: 由于该患者高钾血症并出现 ECG 传导改变，护士应首先给予 {{1}}。接下来快速转移钾入细胞的治疗是 {{2}}。口服聚苯乙烯磺酸钠医嘱应 {{3}}，因为 {{4}}。给予胰岛素后，护士应 {{5}}。

options.en: oral sodium polystyrene sulfonate
options.zh: 口服聚苯乙烯磺酸钠

options.en: calcium gluconate at the ordered/protocol rate
options.zh: 按医嘱/方案速度给予葡萄糖酸钙

options.en: regular insulin before any calcium
options.zh: 先给予普通胰岛素，不先给钙剂

options.en: continuing lisinopril to improve renal perfusion
options.zh: 继续赖诺普利以改善肾灌注

options.en: waiting for creatinine to improve before treating potassium
options.zh: 等待肌酐改善后再处理血钾

options.en: regular insulin with dextrose per protocol
options.zh: 按方案给予普通胰岛素合并葡萄糖

options.en: given immediately despite vomiting
options.zh: 即使呕吐也立即给予

options.en: used as the only urgent intervention
options.zh: 作为唯一紧急干预

options.en: questioned and clarified
options.zh: 提出疑问并澄清

options.en: binders stabilize the myocardium faster than calcium
options.zh: 钾结合剂比钙剂更快稳定心肌

options.en: the client is actively nauseated and vomiting, making oral administration unsafe and unlikely to be retained
options.zh: 患者正在恶心呕吐，口服不安全且很可能无法保留

options.en: the potassium is already normal
options.zh: 血钾已经正常

options.en: restart metformin to prevent hypoglycemia
options.zh: 重新使用二甲双胍以预防低血糖

options.en: recheck blood glucose at protocol intervals and keep dextrose available
options.zh: 按方案时间复查血糖，并备好葡萄糖

options.en: stop ECG monitoring once the insulin is given
options.zh: 给予胰岛素后停止 ECG 监测

correct.en: With hyperkalemia and ECG conduction changes, calcium gluconate is first because it stabilizes the cardiac membrane quickly but does not lower serum potassium. Insulin with dextrose follows to shift potassium intracellularly. Sodium bicarbonate may also be used because it is ordered in this acidotic client, but oral SPS should be questioned because active nausea and vomiting make oral administration unsafe and unreliable. Insulin can cause delayed hypoglycemia even when dextrose is given, so glucose monitoring must continue after administration.
correct.zh: 高钾血症合并 ECG 传导改变时，葡萄糖酸钙应首先使用，因为它能迅速稳定心肌膜，但不会降低血清钾。随后按方案给予胰岛素合并葡萄糖，使钾转入细胞。由于该患者有酸中毒，医嘱中的碳酸氢钠也可使用；但口服 SPS 应提出疑问，因为患者正在恶心呕吐，口服既不安全也不可靠。即使给予了葡萄糖，胰岛素仍可导致延迟性低血糖，因此用药后必须继续监测血糖。

byChoice.en: Calcium is the first step for ECG toxicity because it stabilizes the myocardium while potassium-lowering measures begin to work.
byChoice.zh: 出现 ECG 毒性时钙剂是第一步，因为它在降钾措施起效前稳定心肌。

byChoice.en: Insulin with dextrose is the rapid potassium-shifting therapy after membrane stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 胰岛素合并葡萄糖是在稳定心肌膜后快速转移钾的治疗。

byChoice.en: The oral SPS order should be clarified rather than administered unchanged to a vomiting client.
byChoice.zh: 面对呕吐患者，不应照原样给予口服 SPS，而应澄清医嘱。

byChoice.en: Vomiting creates aspiration risk and makes retention of the oral medication unlikely.
byChoice.zh: 呕吐会增加误吸风险，也使口服药很可能无法保留。

byChoice.en: Post-insulin glucose monitoring is required because the insulin effect can outlast the dextrose bolus.
byChoice.zh: 胰岛素作用可持续超过葡萄糖推注，因此需要用药后监测血糖。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate hyperkalemia care into three jobs: stabilize the membrane first, shift potassium next, and remove potassium when safe and feasible.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 把高钾处理分成三件事：先稳定心肌膜，再把钾转入细胞，最后在安全可行时排钾。

glossary.defZh: 用于高钾伴 ECG 改变时稳定心肌膜的药物，本身不降低血钾。
在高钾处理中可促进钾进入细胞，需监测低血糖。
一种肠道钾结合剂；恶心呕吐患者口服给药需谨慎并澄清。

stem.en: At Stage 2, which nursing actions should be included in the immediate bedside response? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段，哪些护理措施应纳入床旁立即处置？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Use fall/safety precautions because the client is lethargic and confused.
options.zh: 因患者嗜睡、意识混乱，采取跌倒/安全预防措施。

options.en: Have regular insulin, dextrose, and a glucometer ready at the bedside.
options.zh: 在床旁备好普通胰岛素、葡萄糖和血糖仪。

options.en: Set reminders for post-insulin blood glucose checks according to protocol.
options.zh: 按方案设置胰岛素后复查血糖提醒。

options.en: Assess the peripheral IV for patency and infiltration before and during calcium gluconate administration.
options.zh: 给予葡萄糖酸钙前及过程中评估外周 IV 是否通畅及有无渗漏。

options.en: Administer calcium gluconate at the ordered/protocol rate while observing continuous ECG monitoring.
options.zh: 按医嘱/方案速度给予葡萄糖酸钙，并观察连续 ECG 监测。

options.en: Continue strict intake and output with hourly urine measurements from the Foley catheter.
options.zh: 继续严格出入量记录，并通过 Foley 导尿管每小时测量尿量。

correct.en: The immediate response is coordinated rather than purely linear. The nurse gives calcium gluconate at the ordered/protocol rate through a patent IV while monitoring ECG response and the IV site, prepares insulin/dextrose and glucose monitoring, continues hourly urine output measurement, and protects the confused client from injury. Rapid uncontrolled calcium administration is unsafe, and oral SPS should not be given unchanged to a client who is actively nauseated and vomiting.
correct.zh: 立即处置是协同进行的，而不是完全线性步骤。护士应通过通畅 IV 按医嘱/方案速度给予葡萄糖酸钙，同时监测 ECG 反应和 IV 部位；准备胰岛素/葡萄糖和血糖监测；继续每小时记录尿量；并保护意识混乱患者避免受伤。失控地快速给予钙剂不安全；对正在恶心呕吐的患者，不应照原样给予口服 SPS。

byChoice.en: The ordered/protocol rate balances urgency with safety, and ECG monitoring evaluates conduction response.
byChoice.zh: 按医嘱/方案速度给药可在紧急性和安全性之间取得平衡，ECG 监测可评估传导反应。

byChoice.en: Altered mental status requires injury prevention while emergency therapies are being delivered.
byChoice.zh: 意识状态改变时，在执行紧急治疗的同时必须预防受伤。

byChoice.en: Hypoglycemia can occur after insulin, so timed glucose checks are part of safe implementation.
byChoice.zh: 胰岛素后可能出现低血糖，因此定时查血糖是安全执行的一部分。

byChoice.en: Hourly urine output tracks renal perfusion response and helps identify worsening AKI.
byChoice.zh: 每小时尿量可追踪肾灌注反应，并帮助识别 AKI 是否恶化。

byChoice.en: Calcium can injure tissue if it extravasates, so IV patency and site monitoring are essential.
byChoice.zh: 钙剂外渗可造成组织损伤，因此必须确认 IV 通畅并监测穿刺部位。

byChoice.en: Insulin/dextrose should be ready because potassium-shifting therapy must follow membrane stabilization promptly.
byChoice.zh: 应备好胰岛素/葡萄糖，因为稳定心肌膜后需迅速进行转钾治疗。

testTakingStrategy.en: For emergency medication questions, look for the nursing safeguards attached to the drug: route/site assessment, monitoring, predictable adverse effects, and patient safety.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到紧急用药题，要找与药物相关的护理安全措施：给药途径/部位评估、监测、可预见不良反应以及患者安全。

glossary.defZh: 药液漏出血管进入周围组织，某些药物可造成组织损伤。
持续观察心律和传导变化，用于高危心律失常风险患者。
准确记录摄入和排出，尤其用于肾功能和容量状态评估。

stem.en: At Stage 3, classify each finding as evidence of improvement, a reason for continued close monitoring, or both.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段，请判断每项结果是改善证据、需要继续严密监测的原因，还是两者兼有。

rows.en: Potassium decreased from 6.4 to 5.4 and then 4.9 mEq/L
rows.zh: 血钾从 6.4 降至 5.4，随后 4.9 mEq/L

rows.en: PR interval normalized to 0.18 seconds and QRS narrowed to 0.10 seconds
rows.zh: PR 间期恢复至 0.18 秒，QRS 缩窄至 0.10 秒

rows.en: Urine output improved to 48 mL/hr, about 0.59 mL/kg/hr
rows.zh: 尿量改善至 48 mL/hr，约 0.59 mL/kg/hr

rows.en: Creatinine decreased to 3.8 mg/dL but baseline is 1.4 mg/dL
rows.zh: 肌酐降至 3.8 mg/dL，但基线为 1.4 mg/dL

rows.en: Blood pressure improved to 112/70 and heart rate to 84
rows.zh: 血压改善至 112/70，心率 84

rows.en: Mental status improved to alert and oriented x3
rows.zh: 意识状态改善为清醒且定向力完整

rows.en: Potassium may rebound as insulin shifting effect wears off
rows.zh: 胰岛素转钾作用减弱后，血钾可能反弹

rows.en: Vomiting or diarrhea could recur
rows.zh: 呕吐或腹泻可能复发

correct.en: The patient is improving because potassium, ECG conduction, urine output, creatinine, hemodynamics, lactate, and mental status are moving in the right direction. The nurse must still monitor closely because potassium can rebound after insulin shifts wear off, the creatinine remains far above baseline, urine output must stay above the perfusion target, and recurrent GI losses could restart the prerenal cycle. Outcome evaluation depends on trajectory and durability, not one isolated better number.
correct.zh: 患者正在改善，因为血钾、ECG 传导、尿量、肌酐、血流动力学、乳酸和意识状态均朝正确方向变化。但护士仍必须严密监测，因为胰岛素转钾作用减弱后血钾可能反弹，肌酐仍远高于基线，尿量必须持续达到灌注目标，且胃肠道丢失复发可能重新启动肾前性循环。结局评估看趋势和持续性，而不是单个暂时改善的数值。

byChoice.en: The potassium trend is improved, but 4.9 is still high-normal and rebound is possible.
byChoice.zh: 血钾趋势改善，但 4.9 仍接近正常上限，存在反弹可能。

byChoice.en: Normalized PR and QRS intervals show cardiac toxicity is resolving, but ECG monitoring should continue until potassium is stable.
byChoice.zh: PR 和 QRS 恢复正常提示心脏毒性缓解，但血钾稳定前仍需 ECG 监测。

byChoice.en: Urine output above 0.5 mL/kg/hr supports recovery of renal perfusion, but hourly trends must continue.
byChoice.zh: 尿量超过 0.5 mL/kg/hr 支持肾灌注恢复，但仍需继续观察每小时趋势。

byChoice.en: Creatinine is decreasing, but it remains much higher than baseline, so AKI is not resolved.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐正在下降，但仍明显高于基线，因此 AKI 尚未解决。

byChoice.en: Improved blood pressure and heart rate support better perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 血压和心率改善支持灌注改善。

byChoice.en: Improved orientation suggests better cerebral perfusion and metabolic status.
byChoice.zh: 定向力改善提示脑灌注和代谢状态改善。

byChoice.en: Insulin shifts potassium into cells temporarily; it does not remove total body potassium.
byChoice.zh: 胰岛素只是暂时把钾转入细胞，并不清除体内总钾负荷。

byChoice.en: Recurrent vomiting or diarrhea can recreate volume depletion and worsen AKI again.
byChoice.zh: 呕吐或腹泻复发会再次造成容量不足，使 AKI 再次恶化。

testTakingStrategy.en: For outcome evaluation, compare trends against baseline and ask whether the improvement is sustained or only temporary.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估结局时，要把趋势与基线比较，并判断改善是持续的还是暂时的。

glossary.defZh: 暂时转钾治疗后，血钾再次升高的风险。
尿量明显减少，成人常以低于 0.5 mL/kg/hr 作为重要警示阈值。
包括透析等用于替代部分肾功能的治疗。

title.en: Prerenal acute kidney injury with hyperkalemia in acute-on-chronic kidney disease
title.zh: 慢性肾病基础上发生肾前性急性肾损伤并高钾血症

summary.en: A 65-year-old man with stage 3a CKD, type 2 diabetes treated with metformin, hypertension treated with lisinopril, and intermittent ibuprofen use is transferred from a skilled nursing facility after 72 hours of profuse vomiting and watery diarrhea during a confirmed norovirus outbreak. He has minimal oral intake, increasing confusion, and near-absent urine output.
summary.zh: 65 岁男性，既往 3a 期慢性肾病、2 型糖尿病（服用二甲双胍）、高血压（服用赖诺普利），并间断使用布洛芬。在熟练护理机构确认诺如病毒暴发期间，他出现 72 小时大量呕吐和水样腹泻后转入急诊。患者口服摄入极少，意识混乱加重，并几乎无尿。

content.en: Baseline creatinine 1.4 mg/dL three months ago with eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73 m². Home medications: metformin 1000 mg twice daily, lisinopril 20 mg daily, and ibuprofen as needed; facility MAR confirms ibuprofen 400 mg two days ago. On arrival he is dry, fatigued, oriented to person only, repeatedly asking where he is, with cracked lips, tacky mucous membranes, diffuse abdominal cramping, nausea, and no urination for several hours. Orders include peripheral IV access, 500 mL normal saline bolus, continuous cardiac monitoring, 12-lead ECG, BMP, CBC, urinalysis with microscopy, point-of-care glucose, bladder scan, and holding metformin and lisinopril pending renal review.
content.zh: 三个月前基线肌酐 1.4 mg/dL，eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73 m²。居家用药：二甲双胍 1000 mg 每日两次、赖诺普利 20 mg 每日一次、布洛芬按需；机构 MAR 证实两天前给予布洛芬 400 mg。入院时患者干燥、疲乏，仅对人物定向，反复询问自己在哪里，嘴唇干裂、黏膜发黏，弥漫性腹部绞痛、恶心，数小时未排尿。医嘱包括建立外周 IV、0.9% 氯化钠 500 mL bolus、连续心电监测、12 导联 ECG、BMP、CBC、尿常规显微镜检查、床旁血糖、膀胱扫描，并在肾功能复评前暂停二甲双胍和赖诺普利。

content.en: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 112 regular, BP 88/54, RR 20, SpO₂ 96% room air. Weight 82 kg; facility weight one week ago 86 kg. Drowsy but arousable, follows simple commands, drifts off when not stimulated. Poor skin turgor with sternal tenting >3 seconds; dry mucous membranes; capillary refill 4 seconds; flat neck veins even supine. Lungs clear bilaterally. No peripheral edema. Extremities cool with weak but palpable pulses. Bladder scan: 40 mL. ECG: sinus tachycardia with peaked, narrow-based T waves in V2-V4 and II-III; PR 0.18 seconds, QRS 0.10 seconds; no ST elevation or depression.
content.zh: T 99 °F (37.2 °C)，HR 112 次/分且规则，BP 88/54，RR 20，室内空气 SpO₂ 96%。体重 82 kg；一周前机构体重 86 kg。嗜睡但呼唤可醒，能执行简单指令，未刺激时会入睡。皮肤弹性差，胸骨处皮肤回弹 >3 秒；黏膜干燥；毛细血管再充盈 4 秒；即使仰卧颈静脉也扁平。双肺清。无外周水肿。四肢偏凉，脉搏弱但可触及。膀胱扫描：40 mL。ECG：窦性心动过速，V2-V4 和 II-III 导联高尖窄基底 T 波；PR 0.18 秒，QRS 0.10 秒；无 ST 段抬高或压低。

content.en: Na 134 mEq/L, K 6.1 mEq/L, Cl 96 mEq/L, HCO₃ 18 mEq/L, BUN 68 mg/dL, creatinine 4.2 mg/dL, BUN:Cr 16.2:1, glucose 188 mg/dL, calcium 8.4 mg/dL, phosphorus 5.1 mg/dL, magnesium 1.6 mg/dL. CBC: WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL, Hgb 13.8 g/dL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. VBG: pH 7.30, pCO₂ 32 mmHg, lactate 2.8 mmol/L. UA: specific gravity 1.032, urine sodium 8 mEq/L, no protein, no blood, no casts, trace ketones. Provider-documented FENa: 0.4%.
content.zh: Na 134 mEq/L，K 6.1 mEq/L，Cl 96 mEq/L，HCO₃ 18 mEq/L，BUN 68 mg/dL，肌酐 4.2 mg/dL，BUN/Cr 16.2:1，血糖 188 mg/dL，钙 8.4 mg/dL，磷 5.1 mg/dL，镁 1.6 mg/dL。CBC：WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL，Hgb 13.8 g/dL，血小板 210 ×10³/µL。VBG：pH 7.30，pCO₂ 32 mmHg，乳酸 2.8 mmol/L。尿检：尿比重 1.032，尿钠 8 mEq/L，无蛋白、无血、无管型，微量酮体。医嘱方记录 FENa：0.4%。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：到达后 0 至 2 小时

title.en: Initial fluid response and medication review
title.zh: 初始补液反应和用药复查

content.en: The first 500 mL normal saline bolus runs over 30 minutes. A second 500 mL bolus and then normal saline at 150 mL/hr are ordered. Foley catheter insertion returns 30 mL dark concentrated urine. Over the next 90 minutes, urine output totals 18 mL, about 0.15 mL/kg/hr. Repeat vitals: HR 106, BP 92/58, RR 18, SpO₂ 97%. Peaked T waves persist. Home medications reviewed: metformin, lisinopril, and PRN ibuprofen. Metformin and lisinopril are held, but ibuprofen is not addressed in the orders.
content.zh: 第一袋 0.9% 氯化钠 500 mL bolus 在 30 分钟内输入。随后医嘱第二袋 500 mL bolus，再以 150 mL/hr 持续输注。置入 Foley 导尿管后引流出 30 mL 深色浓缩尿。接下来 90 分钟总尿量 18 mL，约 0.15 mL/kg/hr。复测生命体征：HR 106，BP 92/58，RR 18，SpO₂ 97%。高尖 T 波持续存在。复查居家用药：二甲双胍、赖诺普利和 PRN 布洛芬。二甲双胍和赖诺普利已暂停，但医嘱未处理布洛芬。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段：到达后 2 至 6 小时

content.en: At hour 4: K 6.4 mEq/L, creatinine 4.5 mg/dL, BUN 72 mg/dL, HCO₃ 16 mEq/L, lactate 3.2 mmol/L, glucose 162 mg/dL. ECG: PR 0.24 seconds and QRS 0.12 seconds with persistent peaked T waves. The client is more lethargic, opens eyes briefly to direct verbal stimulation, and reports finger tingling and calf cramping. Urine output over the preceding 4 hours totals 45 mL, about 0.14 mL/kg/hr. Total IV fluid received is about 1,500 mL. Provider orders critical hyperkalemia protocol: calcium gluconate 1 g IV at protocol rate, regular insulin 10 units IV with 25 g dextrose, sodium bicarbonate 50 mEq IV over 30 minutes, and sodium polystyrene sulfonate 30 g orally. The client is actively nauseated. Nephrology consult and strict hourly urine measurement are ordered.
content.zh: 第 4 小时：K 6.4 mEq/L，肌酐 4.5 mg/dL，BUN 72 mg/dL，HCO₃ 16 mEq/L，乳酸 3.2 mmol/L，血糖 162 mg/dL。ECG：PR 0.24 秒，QRS 0.12 秒，仍有高尖 T 波。患者更加嗜睡，直接言语刺激时短暂睁眼，并诉手指麻木和小腿抽筋。此前 4 小时尿量共 45 mL，约 0.14 mL/kg/hr。累计已接受 IV 液体约 1,500 mL。医嘱方开立危急高钾方案：葡萄糖酸钙 1 g IV 按方案速度给予，普通胰岛素 10 units IV 合并 25 g 葡萄糖，碳酸氢钠 50 mEq IV 30 分钟内输入，以及聚苯乙烯磺酸钠 30 g 口服。患者正在明显恶心。医嘱肾内科会诊，并严格每小时测量尿量。

title.zh: 第 3 阶段：到达后 6 至 14 小时

content.en: Calcium gluconate was administered at hour 4.5; insulin and dextrose were administered at hour 5. By hour 8: K 5.4 mEq/L, creatinine 4.3 mg/dL, BUN 70 mg/dL, HCO₃ 19 mEq/L, lactate 2.0 mmol/L, glucose 134 mg/dL. ECG: PR 0.18 seconds, QRS 0.10 seconds, peaked T waves diminished. Urine output from hours 6-10 improves to 35 mL/hr, about 0.43 mL/kg/hr. The client is oriented to person and place, BP 104/66, HR 92. Nephrology recommends continued isotonic fluids, urine output target >0.5 mL/kg/hr, BMP every 6 hours, holding all nephrotoxic medications, and reassessing for renal replacement therapy if urine output fails to improve or potassium rises again. By hour 14: urine output 48 mL/hr (0.59 mL/kg/hr), K 4.9 mEq/L, creatinine 3.8 mg/dL, BP 112/70, HR 84, alert and oriented x3, tolerating small sips of clear liquids.
content.zh: 葡萄糖酸钙于第 4.5 小时给予；胰岛素和葡萄糖于第 5 小时给予。到第 8 小时：K 5.4 mEq/L，肌酐 4.3 mg/dL，BUN 70 mg/dL，HCO₃ 19 mEq/L，乳酸 2.0 mmol/L，血糖 134 mg/dL。ECG：PR 0.18 秒，QRS 0.10 秒，高尖 T 波减轻。第 6 至 10 小时尿量改善至 35 mL/hr，约 0.43 mL/kg/hr。患者对人物和地点定向，BP 104/66，HR 92。肾内科建议继续等渗液体、尿量目标 >0.5 mL/kg/hr、每 6 小时复查 BMP、暂停所有肾毒性药物；若尿量未继续改善或血钾再升高，则重新评估肾脏替代治疗。到第 14 小时：尿量 48 mL/hr（0.59 mL/kg/hr），K 4.9 mEq/L，肌酐 3.8 mg/dL，BP 112/70，HR 84，清醒且定向力完整，可少量啜饮清流质。

stem.en: For each admission finding, classify the most clinically relevant meaning in this client.
stem.zh: 请将每项入院评估结果归类为对该患者最有临床意义的含义。

rows.en: Urine specific gravity 1.032
Urine sodium 8 mEq/L
rows.zh: 尿钠 8 mEq/L

rows.en: FENa 0.4%
rows.zh: 钠排泄分数 FENa 0.4%

rows.en: Creatinine 4.2 mg/dL, baseline 1.4 mg/dL
rows.zh: 肌酐 4.2 mg/dL，基线 1.4 mg/dL

rows.en: BP 88/54 with HR 112
Dry mucous membranes, poor skin turgor, flat neck veins
rows.zh: 黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差、颈静脉扁平

rows.en: Potassium 6.1 mEq/L with peaked T waves
rows.zh: 钾 6.1 mEq/L，并有高尖 T 波

rows.en: Clear lung sounds with no crackles
rows.zh: 双肺清，无湿啰音

rows.en: Bladder scan 40 mL
rows.zh: 膀胱扫描 40 mL

rows.en: BUN-to-creatinine ratio 16.2:1
rows.zh: BUN/肌酐比值 16.2:1

columns.en: Not the strongest prerenal cue here
columns.zh: 不是本病例最强的肾前性线索

columns.en: Supports prerenal AKI from volume depletion
columns.zh: 支持容量不足导致的肾前性 AKI

columns.en: Rules out or argues against another cause
columns.zh: 排除或不支持其他病因

correct.en: The strongest prerenal pattern is the cluster of severe volume depletion plus kidneys that are still conserving sodium and water: concentrated urine, urine sodium 8 mEq/L, FENa 0.4%, acute creatinine rise, hypotension, tachycardia, dry mucous membranes, poor turgor, flat neck veins, and cool extremities. Potassium 6.1 mEq/L with peaked T waves is a separate immediate danger: hyperkalemia with myocardial irritability. Clear lungs support the absence of fluid overload, and a 40 mL bladder scan argues against urinary retention. The BUN-to-creatinine ratio is elevated but not the strongest cue in this scaffold, so the nurse should not over-weight it over the urine sodium, FENa, concentrated urine, and clinical dehydration.
correct.zh: 最强的肾前性模式是：严重容量不足，同时肾脏仍在保钠保水，包括尿液浓缩、尿钠 8 mEq/L、FENa 0.4%、肌酐急升、低血压、心动过速、黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差、颈静脉扁平以及肢端偏凉。钾 6.1 mEq/L 合并高尖 T 波则是另一个立即危险：高钾血症导致心肌电活动不稳定。双肺清支持没有液体过负荷，膀胱扫描 40 mL 不支持尿潴留。BUN/肌酐比值虽升高，但在此病例中不是最强线索，护士不应把它看得比尿钠、FENa、尿液浓缩和临床脱水表现更重要。

byChoice.en: A specific gravity of 1.032 means the urine is concentrated, which fits prerenal sodium and water conservation.
byChoice.zh: 尿比重 1.032 表示尿液浓缩，符合肾前性状态下保钠保水的反应。

byChoice.en: Urine sodium 8 mEq/L is very low, showing avid renal sodium retention during decreased perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 尿钠 8 mEq/L 很低，说明肾灌注下降时肾脏积极保留钠。

byChoice.en: FENa below 1% supports prerenal physiology when interpreted with the rest of the case.
byChoice.zh: FENa 低于 1%，结合病例其他资料，支持肾前性生理状态。

byChoice.en: A creatinine rise from 1.4 to 4.2 mg/dL shows acute kidney injury superimposed on CKD.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐从 1.4 升至 4.2 mg/dL，提示慢性肾病基础上的急性肾损伤。

byChoice.en: Hypotension with tachycardia is a perfusion cue consistent with dehydration from GI losses.
byChoice.zh: 低血压伴心动过速是灌注不足线索，符合胃肠道丢失导致的脱水。

byChoice.en: Dry mucous membranes, poor turgor, and flat neck veins are volume-depletion findings.
byChoice.zh: 黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差和颈静脉扁平都是容量不足表现。

byChoice.en: Peaked T waves in a client with potassium 6.1 mEq/L indicate hyperkalemia-related cardiac risk, not simply dehydration.
byChoice.zh: 钾 6.1 mEq/L 合并高尖 T 波提示高钾相关心脏风险，而不只是脱水。

byChoice.en: Clear lungs do not diagnose AKI, but they argue against pulmonary fluid overload while fluids are being considered.
byChoice.zh: 双肺清不能诊断 AKI，但在考虑补液时有助于排除肺部液体过负荷。

byChoice.en: A bladder scan of only 40 mL argues against urinary retention as the cause of oliguria.
byChoice.zh: 膀胱扫描仅 40 mL，不支持尿潴留是少尿原因。

byChoice.en: The ratio is not the decisive cue here; relying on it alone would miss the stronger urine and volume-status evidence.
byChoice.zh: 该比值不是本题决定性线索；单靠它会忽略更强的尿液指标和容量状态证据。

testTakingStrategy.en: Cluster cues before naming the problem: volume-loss history plus concentrated, low-sodium urine points to prerenal AKI, while ECG changes with high potassium create the immediate danger.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 先把线索组合起来再判断问题：容量丢失病史加上尿液浓缩、尿钠低，指向肾前性 AKI；高钾合并 ECG 改变则构成立即危险。

glossary.defZh: 由于肾脏灌注不足导致的急性肾损伤，肾小管早期仍可保钠和浓缩尿液。
评估肾脏排钠比例的指标，低值常支持肾前性状态。
高钾血症早期可见的 ECG 改变，提示心肌电活动受影响。

stem.en: At Stage 1, which medication-related nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第 1 阶段，哪些与用药相关的护理措施是适当的？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Continue holding lisinopril during this hypovolemic AKI episode.
options.zh: 在本次低容量性 AKI 期间继续暂停赖诺普利。

options.en: Teach the patient and family not to use over-the-counter NSAIDs during recovery unless the provider approves.
options.zh: 教育患者和家属：恢复期间除非医嘱允许，不要自行使用非处方 NSAID。

options.en: Monitor the lactate and acidosis while recognizing hypoperfusion can also contribute.
options.zh: 监测乳酸和酸中毒，同时认识到低灌注也可能造成这些异常。

options.en: Continue holding metformin while renal function is acutely impaired.
options.zh: 在肾功能急性受损期间继续暂停二甲双胍。

options.en: Give metformin because the admission glucose is 188 mg/dL.
options.zh: 因入院血糖 188 mg/dL，应给予二甲双胍。

options.en: Clarify that ibuprofen is explicitly held and documented as contraindicated during the AKI episode.
options.zh: 与医嘱方确认布洛芬在本次 AKI 期间明确暂停，并记录为禁用。

correct.en: Metformin, lisinopril, and ibuprofen all matter in this AKI episode. Metformin should be held because reduced renal clearance can increase accumulation and lactic acidosis risk; the elevated lactate needs monitoring, though hypoperfusion is also a plausible contributor. Lisinopril should be held because ACE inhibition can reduce the efferent arteriolar tone that helps preserve glomerular filtration pressure during hypovolemia. Ibuprofen should be explicitly held and documented because NSAIDs can impair prostaglandin-mediated afferent arteriolar dilation and may be inadvertently restarted if not addressed. Teaching should include avoiding OTC NSAIDs during recovery unless approved.
correct.zh: 在本次 AKI 中，二甲双胍、赖诺普利和布洛芬都很重要。二甲双胍应暂停，因为肾清除下降可增加药物蓄积和乳酸性酸中毒风险；乳酸升高需要监测，但低灌注本身也可能造成乳酸升高。赖诺普利应暂停，因为 ACE 抑制会降低出球小动脉张力，而这种张力在低容量时有助于维持肾小球滤过压力。布洛芬应明确暂停并记录，因为 NSAID 可影响前列腺素介导的入球小动脉扩张；若不处理，可能被误重新使用。宣教应包括恢复期除非医嘱允许，不自行使用 OTC NSAID。

byChoice.en: OTC NSAID teaching prevents recurrence or worsening of the renal insult after discharge or during recovery.
byChoice.zh: 非处方 NSAID 宣教可防止出院后或恢复期间再次或加重肾损伤。

byChoice.en: Metformin is not used to acutely correct this glucose, and giving it during AKI increases safety risk.
byChoice.zh: 二甲双胍不是用来急性纠正该血糖的药物，在 AKI 期间给予会增加安全风险。

byChoice.en: Holding metformin is appropriate during AKI because impaired clearance increases accumulation and lactic acidosis risk.
byChoice.zh: AKI 期间暂停二甲双胍是适当的，因为清除下降会增加蓄积和乳酸性酸中毒风险。

byChoice.en: Lactate and acidosis need monitoring, but the nurse should not assume metformin is the only cause because hypoperfusion can also raise lactate.
byChoice.zh: 需要监测乳酸和酸中毒，但护士不应认定只有二甲双胍导致，因为低灌注也会升高乳酸。

byChoice.en: The ibuprofen omission requires clarification so the medication is not restarted during AKI.
byChoice.zh: 布洛芬遗漏需要澄清，以免在 AKI 期间被重新使用。

byChoice.en: Holding lisinopril is appropriate because ACE inhibition can worsen filtration pressure during severe volume depletion.
byChoice.zh: 暂停赖诺普利是适当的，因为严重容量不足时 ACE 抑制可能进一步降低滤过压力。

testTakingStrategy.en: When AKI is present, screen every home and OTC medication for renal clearance or renal perfusion effects; do not stop at the drugs already addressed in the orders.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 出现 AKI 时，要逐一筛查所有居家药和 OTC 药是否影响肾清除或肾灌注；不要只看医嘱已经提到的药。

glossary.defZh: 常用降糖药；肾功能急性受损时需评估蓄积和乳酸性酸中毒风险。
可影响出球小动脉张力，在低容量 AKI 中可能降低滤过压力。
如布洛芬，可影响前列腺素介导的肾血流调节。
核对并处理患者实际使用的处方药、非处方药和补充剂。

stem.en: At Stage 2, which problem is the nurse's highest immediate priority?
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段，护士最优先立即处理的问题是什么？

options.en: Creatinine rising from 4.2 to 4.5 mg/dL
options.zh: 肌酐从 4.2 升至 4.5 mg/dL

options.en: Nausea that makes oral medications difficult to retain
options.zh: 恶心导致口服药难以保留

options.en: Oliguria with urine output 0.14 mL/kg/hr
options.zh: 少尿，尿量 0.14 mL/kg/hr

options.en: Worsening hyperkalemia with PR prolongation and QRS widening
options.zh: 高钾血症恶化，伴 PR 延长和 QRS 增宽

correct.en: The potassium has risen to 6.4 mEq/L and the ECG has progressed from peaked T waves to PR prolongation and QRS widening. That pattern signals advancing hyperkalemia-related conduction toxicity and can deteriorate to a lethal rhythm. Oliguria and rising creatinine are serious, but they do not create the same minute-to-minute cardiac arrest risk. The nurse should prepare for emergent membrane stabilization with calcium gluconate while the renal problem continues to be managed.
correct.zh: 钾升至 6.4 mEq/L，ECG 从高尖 T 波进展为 PR 延长和 QRS 增宽。这表示高钾相关传导毒性正在进展，可能恶化为致命心律。少尿和肌酐升高也严重，但不像这种 ECG 改变一样具有分钟级心脏骤停风险。护士应准备立即使用葡萄糖酸钙稳定心肌膜，同时继续处理肾脏问题。

byChoice.en: This is the immediate life threat because ECG conduction changes show hyperkalemia is affecting the myocardium.
byChoice.zh: 这是立即危及生命的问题，因为 ECG 传导改变显示高钾已影响心肌。

byChoice.en: Nausea affects medication safety, especially oral SPS, but it is secondary to unstable hyperkalemia with ECG changes.
byChoice.zh: 恶心影响用药安全，尤其是口服 SPS，但次于伴 ECG 改变的不稳定高钾血症。

byChoice.en: The creatinine trend confirms worsening AKI, but creatinine itself is not the immediate cause of cardiac arrest.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐趋势证实 AKI 恶化，但肌酐本身不是立即导致心脏骤停的因素。

byChoice.en: Oliguria is serious and requires strict monitoring and renal management, but it is not the most immediate arrhythmia threat.
byChoice.zh: 少尿严重，需要严格监测和肾脏处理，但不是最立即的心律失常威胁。

testTakingStrategy.en: In prioritization questions, an electrolyte abnormality with ECG conduction changes usually outranks slower organ-function trends because it can cause sudden death.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 优先级题中，电解质异常若已出现 ECG 传导改变，通常优先于较慢的器官功能趋势，因为它可导致猝死。

glossary.defZh: 血钾升高，可导致肌无力和危及生命的心律失常。
房室传导变慢的 ECG 表现，可见于高钾进展。
心室传导变慢的 ECG 表现，高钾时提示危险加重。

stem.en: Complete the nurse's clinical reasoning about the Stage 2 hyperkalemia protocol.
stem.zh: 完成护士对第 2 阶段高钾血症处理方案的临床推理。

clozeStem.en: Because the client has hyperkalemia with ECG conduction changes, the nurse should give {{1}} first. The next rapid potassium-shifting treatment is {{2}}. The oral sodium polystyrene sulfonate order should be {{3}} because {{4}}. After insulin is administered, the nurse should {{5}}.
clozeStem.zh: 由于该患者高钾血症并出现 ECG 传导改变，护士应首先给予 {{1}}。接下来快速转移钾入细胞的治疗是 {{2}}。口服聚苯乙烯磺酸钠医嘱应 {{3}}，因为 {{4}}。给予胰岛素后，护士应 {{5}}。

options.en: oral sodium polystyrene sulfonate
options.zh: 口服聚苯乙烯磺酸钠

options.en: calcium gluconate at the ordered/protocol rate
options.zh: 按医嘱/方案速度给予葡萄糖酸钙

options.en: regular insulin before any calcium
options.zh: 先给予普通胰岛素，不先给钙剂

options.en: continuing lisinopril to improve renal perfusion
options.zh: 继续赖诺普利以改善肾灌注

options.en: waiting for creatinine to improve before treating potassium
options.zh: 等待肌酐改善后再处理血钾

options.en: regular insulin with dextrose per protocol
options.zh: 按方案给予普通胰岛素合并葡萄糖

options.en: given immediately despite impaired alertness
options.zh: 即使清醒程度下降也立即给予

options.en: used as the only urgent intervention
options.zh: 作为唯一紧急干预

options.en: questioned and clarified
options.zh: 提出疑问并澄清

options.en: binders stabilize the myocardium faster than calcium
options.zh: 钾结合剂比钙剂更快稳定心肌

options.en: active nausea and depressed consciousness make oral administration unreliable and increase aspiration risk
options.zh: 明显恶心和意识水平下降使口服给药不可靠，并增加误吸风险

options.en: the potassium is already normal
options.zh: 血钾已经正常

options.en: restart metformin to prevent hypoglycemia
options.zh: 重新使用二甲双胍以预防低血糖

options.en: recheck blood glucose at protocol intervals and keep dextrose available
options.zh: 按方案时间复查血糖，并备好葡萄糖

options.en: stop ECG monitoring once the insulin is given
options.zh: 给予胰岛素后停止 ECG 监测

correct.en: With hyperkalemia and ECG conduction changes, calcium gluconate is first because it stabilizes the cardiac membrane quickly but does not lower serum potassium. Insulin with dextrose follows to shift potassium intracellularly. Sodium bicarbonate may also be used because it is ordered in this acidotic client, but oral SPS should be questioned because active nausea and depressed consciousness make oral administration unsafe and unreliable. Insulin can cause delayed hypoglycemia even when dextrose is given, so glucose monitoring must continue after administration.
correct.zh: 高钾血症合并 ECG 传导改变时，葡萄糖酸钙应首先使用，因为它能迅速稳定心肌膜，但不会降低血清钾。随后按方案给予胰岛素合并葡萄糖，使钾转入细胞。由于该患者有酸中毒，医嘱中的碳酸氢钠也可使用；但口服 SPS 应提出疑问，因为患者明显恶心且意识水平下降，口服既不安全也不可靠。即使给予了葡萄糖，胰岛素仍可导致延迟性低血糖，因此用药后必须继续监测血糖。

byChoice.en: Calcium is the first step for ECG toxicity because it stabilizes the myocardium while potassium-lowering measures begin to work.
byChoice.zh: 出现 ECG 毒性时钙剂是第一步，因为它在降钾措施起效前稳定心肌。

byChoice.en: Insulin with dextrose is the rapid potassium-shifting therapy after membrane stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 胰岛素合并葡萄糖是在稳定心肌膜后快速转移钾的治疗。

byChoice.en: Clarify the oral SPS order because the client's depressed consciousness makes safe swallowing uncertain; SPS is not an emergency substitute for rapid treatment.
byChoice.zh: 患者意识水平下降，安全吞咽能力不确定，应澄清口服SPS医嘱；SPS不能替代紧急快速治疗。

byChoice.en: The documented nausea and depressed consciousness justify reassessing oral safety.
byChoice.zh: 已记录的恶心和意识水平下降足以支持重新评估口服安全性，

byChoice.en: Post-insulin glucose monitoring is required because the insulin effect can outlast the dextrose bolus.
byChoice.zh: 胰岛素作用可持续超过葡萄糖推注，因此需要用药后监测血糖。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate hyperkalemia care into three jobs: stabilize the membrane first, shift potassium next, and remove potassium when safe and feasible.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 把高钾处理分成三件事：先稳定心肌膜，再把钾转入细胞，最后在安全可行时排钾。

glossary.defZh: 用于高钾伴 ECG 改变时稳定心肌膜的药物，本身不降低血钾。
在高钾处理中可促进钾进入细胞，需监测低血糖。
一种肠道钾结合剂；恶心呕吐患者口服给药需谨慎并澄清。

stem.en: At Stage 2, classify each proposed bedside action as indicated or unsafe.
stem.zh: 在第 2 阶段，将每项拟议床旁措施分类为有指征或不安全。

correct.en: The immediate response is coordinated rather than purely linear. The nurse gives calcium gluconate at the ordered/protocol rate through a patent IV while monitoring ECG response and the IV site, prepares insulin/dextrose and glucose monitoring, continues hourly urine output measurement, and protects the confused client from injury. Rapid uncontrolled calcium administration is unsafe.
correct.zh: 立即处置是协同进行的，而不是完全线性步骤。护士应通过通畅 IV 按医嘱/方案速度给予葡萄糖酸钙，同时监测 ECG 反应和 IV 部位；准备胰岛素/葡萄糖和血糖监测；继续每小时记录尿量；并保护意识混乱患者避免受伤。失控地快速给予钙剂不安全。

byChoice.en: The ordered/protocol rate balances urgency with safety, and ECG monitoring evaluates conduction response.
byChoice.zh: 按医嘱/方案速度给药可在紧急性和安全性之间取得平衡，ECG 监测可评估传导反应。

byChoice.en: Altered mental status requires injury prevention while emergency therapies are being delivered.
byChoice.zh: 意识状态改变时，在执行紧急治疗的同时必须预防受伤。

byChoice.en: Hypoglycemia can occur after insulin, so timed glucose checks are part of safe implementation.
byChoice.zh: 胰岛素后可能出现低血糖，因此定时查血糖是安全执行的一部分。

byChoice.en: Hourly urine output tracks renal perfusion response and helps identify worsening AKI.
byChoice.zh: 每小时尿量可追踪肾灌注反应，并帮助识别 AKI 是否恶化。

byChoice.en: Calcium can injure tissue if it extravasates, so IV patency and site monitoring are essential.
byChoice.zh: 钙剂外渗可造成组织损伤，因此必须确认 IV 通畅并监测穿刺部位。

byChoice.en: Insulin/dextrose should be ready because potassium-shifting therapy must follow membrane stabilization promptly.
byChoice.zh: 应备好胰岛素/葡萄糖，因为稳定心肌膜后需迅速进行转钾治疗。

byChoice.en: Rapid uncontrolled calcium administration is unsafe; use the prescribed rate with ECG and IV-site monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 失控地快速给予钙剂不安全，应按医嘱速度并监测心电图和静脉部位。

testTakingStrategy.en: For emergency medication questions, look for the nursing safeguards attached to the drug: route/site assessment, monitoring, predictable adverse effects, and patient safety.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到紧急用药题，要找与药物相关的护理安全措施：给药途径/部位评估、监测、可预见不良反应以及患者安全。

glossary.defZh: 药液漏出血管进入周围组织，某些药物可造成组织损伤。
持续观察心律和传导变化，用于高危心律失常风险患者。
准确记录摄入和排出，尤其用于肾功能和容量状态评估。

rows.en: Use fall/safety precautions because the client is lethargic and confused.
rows.zh: 因患者嗜睡、意识混乱，采取跌倒/安全预防措施。

rows.en: Have regular insulin, dextrose, and a glucometer ready at the bedside.
rows.zh: 在床旁备好普通胰岛素、葡萄糖和血糖仪。

rows.en: Set reminders for post-insulin blood glucose checks according to protocol.
rows.zh: 按方案设置胰岛素后复查血糖提醒。

rows.en: Assess the peripheral IV for patency and infiltration before and during calcium gluconate administration.
rows.zh: 给予葡萄糖酸钙前及过程中评估外周 IV 是否通畅及有无渗漏。

rows.en: Administer calcium gluconate at the ordered/protocol rate while observing continuous ECG monitoring.
rows.zh: 按医嘱/方案速度给予葡萄糖酸钙，并观察连续 ECG 监测。

rows.en: Continue strict intake and output with hourly urine measurements from the Foley catheter.
rows.zh: 继续严格出入量记录，并通过 Foley 导尿管每小时测量尿量。

rows.en: Push calcium gluconate as rapidly as possible instead of using the prescribed rate.
rows.zh: 不按医嘱速度，而是尽可能快速推注葡萄糖酸钙。

stem.en: At Stage 3, classify each finding or ongoing risk as evidence of improvement, a reason for continued close monitoring, or both.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段，请判断每项结果或持续风险是改善证据、需要继续严密监测的原因，还是两者兼有。

rows.en: Potassium decreased from 6.4 to 5.4 and then 4.9 mEq/L
rows.zh: 血钾从 6.4 降至 5.4，随后 4.9 mEq/L

rows.en: PR interval normalized to 0.18 seconds and QRS narrowed to 0.10 seconds
rows.zh: PR 间期恢复至 0.18 秒，QRS 缩窄至 0.10 秒

rows.en: Urine output improved to 48 mL/hr, about 0.59 mL/kg/hr
rows.zh: 尿量改善至 48 mL/hr，约 0.59 mL/kg/hr

rows.en: Creatinine decreased to 3.8 mg/dL but baseline is 1.4 mg/dL
rows.zh: 肌酐降至 3.8 mg/dL，但基线为 1.4 mg/dL

rows.en: Blood pressure improved to 112/70 and heart rate to 84
rows.zh: 血压改善至 112/70，心率 84

rows.en: Mental status improved to alert and oriented x3
rows.zh: 意识状态改善为清醒且定向力完整

rows.en: Potassium may rebound as insulin shifting effect wears off
rows.zh: 胰岛素转钾作用减弱后，血钾可能反弹

rows.en: Vomiting or diarrhea could recur
rows.zh: 呕吐或腹泻可能复发

correct.en: The patient is improving because potassium, ECG conduction, urine output, creatinine, hemodynamics and mental status are moving in the right direction. The nurse must still monitor closely because potassium can rebound after insulin shifts wear off, the creatinine remains far above baseline, urine output must stay above the perfusion target, and recurrent GI losses could restart the prerenal cycle. Outcome evaluation depends on trajectory and durability, not one isolated better number.
correct.zh: 患者正在改善，因为血钾、ECG 传导、尿量、肌酐、血流动力学和意识状态均朝正确方向变化。但护士仍必须严密监测，因为胰岛素转钾作用减弱后血钾可能反弹，肌酐仍远高于基线，尿量必须持续达到灌注目标，且胃肠道丢失复发可能重新启动肾前性循环。结局评估看趋势和持续性，而不是单个暂时改善的数值。

byChoice.en: The potassium trend is improved, but 4.9 is still high-normal and rebound is possible.
byChoice.zh: 血钾趋势改善，但 4.9 仍接近正常上限，存在反弹可能。

byChoice.en: Normalized PR and QRS intervals show cardiac toxicity is resolving, but ECG monitoring should continue until potassium is stable.
byChoice.zh: PR 和 QRS 恢复正常提示心脏毒性缓解，但血钾稳定前仍需 ECG 监测。

byChoice.en: Urine output above 0.5 mL/kg/hr supports recovery of renal perfusion, but hourly trends must continue.
byChoice.zh: 尿量超过 0.5 mL/kg/hr 支持肾灌注恢复，但仍需继续观察每小时趋势。

byChoice.en: Creatinine is decreasing, but it remains much higher than baseline, so AKI is not resolved.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐正在下降，但仍明显高于基线，因此 AKI 尚未解决。

byChoice.en: Blood pressure and heart rate improve, but the ongoing renal injury and prescribed reassessment require continued hemodynamic monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 血压和心率改善，但肾损伤仍在且医嘱要求复评，因此仍需监测血流动力学。

byChoice.en: Orientation improves, but recovery must remain sustained while renal and electrolyte abnormalities are monitored.
byChoice.zh: 定向力改善，但在监测肾功能和电解质异常期间仍需确认改善能够持续。

byChoice.en: Insulin shifts potassium into cells temporarily; it does not remove total body potassium.
byChoice.zh: 胰岛素只是暂时把钾转入细胞，并不清除体内总钾负荷。

byChoice.en: Recurrent vomiting or diarrhea can recreate volume depletion and worsen AKI again.
byChoice.zh: 呕吐或腹泻复发会再次造成容量不足，使 AKI 再次恶化。

testTakingStrategy.en: For outcome evaluation, compare trends against baseline and ask whether the improvement is sustained or only temporary.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估结局时，要把趋势与基线比较，并判断改善是持续的还是暂时的。

glossary.defZh: 暂时转钾治疗后，血钾再次升高的风险。
尿量明显减少，成人常以低于 0.5 mL/kg/hr 作为重要警示阈值。
包括透析等用于替代部分肾功能的治疗。

note: Campaign 17 A/B producer implementation; full parent preimage frozen; independent review pending

title.en: Caregiver role strain in home management of moderate Alzheimer's dementia
title.zh: 中度阿尔茨海默病居家照护中的照护者角色压力

summary.en: Margaret Tierney is a 78-year-old woman with moderate Alzheimer's dementia who lives with her daughter Diane, her sole caregiver. Diane requested home-health support after two months of worsening nighttime wandering and confusion, stating she cannot continue alone. The case unfolds across an initial home visit, later same-visit disclosures, and a five-day follow-up.
summary.zh: Margaret Tierney，78岁，中度阿尔茨海默病，与女儿 Diane 同住；Diane 是唯一照护者。因过去两个月夜间走失和意识混乱加重，Diane 请求居家护理支持，并表示自己无法再独自承担。病例按初次居家访视、同次访视后续透露信息和5天后复诊逐步展开。

title.zh: 初次居家护理访视记录

content.en:
Background: Margaret has a 3-year history of Alzheimer's dementia and is followed by a memory-care clinic. Medical history includes hypertension treated with amlodipine 5 mg daily and lisinopril 10 mg daily, osteoarthritis of both knees, and remote left hip fracture repair 5 years ago. She has not been seen by the memory-care clinic in 9 months because Diane could not get time off work.

Initial presentation at 10:00 AM Tuesday: Diane appears fatigued with dark circles, took a half-day off work, and must leave by noon. A neighbor will stay with Margaret from noon until Diane returns from work, but this is an informal favor. Diane reports Margaret was up 4 times last night and tried to go outside at 2 AM. Diane has been placing a chair against Margaret's bedroom door at night because she cannot stay awake. Diane has slept less than 4 consecutive hours for weeks, lost 12 lb in 2 months, called in sick to work 3 times last month, and says she promised her father she would never place Margaret in a home.

Margaret is seated in a recliner wearing a urine-stained housecoat with a faint urine odor. A half-eaten bowl of oatmeal is on the side table. Diane reports Margaret has refused more meals and lost about 8 lb over 3 months. Pill bottles are on the kitchen counter with tops off two bottles. A Wednesday-slot pill organizer is open, but today is Tuesday.
content.zh:
背景：Margaret 有3年阿尔茨海默病史，由记忆门诊随访。病史包括高血压（每日氨氯地平5 mg、赖诺普利10 mg）、双膝骨关节炎，以及5年前左髋骨折修复。因 Diane 无法请假，Margaret 已9个月未到记忆门诊复诊。

周二上午10:00初次表现：Diane 看起来疲惫、有黑眼圈，请了半天假，必须在中午前离开。中午后邻居会陪 Margaret 到 Diane 下班回来，但这只是非正式帮忙。Diane 报告 Margaret 昨晚醒来4次，凌晨2点试图外出。因为自己无法保持清醒，Diane 夜间把椅子抵在 Margaret 卧室门口。Diane 数周来连续睡眠不足4小时，2个月内减重12磅，上个月请病假3次，并说曾答应父亲绝不把 Margaret 送进机构。

Margaret 坐在躺椅上，穿着有尿渍且有淡淡尿味的家居服。边桌上有半碗燕麦。Diane 报告 Margaret 更常拒食，3个月内约减重8磅。厨房台面上有药瓶，其中两个瓶盖打开。星期三药格处于打开状态，但今天是星期二。

content.en:
Margaret: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 76 regular, BP 148/88, RR 16, SpO₂ 97% room air. Weight 58 kg; weight 9 months ago was 61.6 kg. Alert, oriented only to first name; does not know date, season, or address. Follows one-step commands but not two-step commands. Speech fluent with word-finding pauses and occasional confabulation. Calls the nurse by her late husband's name twice. Skin intact with no bruising, lacerations, or pressure areas. Bilateral knee crepitus with mild swelling. Gait slow and wide-based with a slight forward lean; ambulates short distances independently. Grip strength symmetric and adequate. Oral mucosa slightly dry. Abdomen soft and non-tender. Perineal skin intact but mildly erythematous from urine contact. Diane reports urinary incontinence 2-3 times daily, pull-up briefs during the day, and no fecal incontinence.

Diane: Hands tremble slightly when opening pill bottles. Reports headaches almost daily, difficulty concentrating at work, and feeling angry then guilty when Margaret repeats questions. Denies thoughts of harming herself or Margaret. Has not seen her own primary care provider in over a year. Has not attended a caregiver support group and does not know what respite care is.

Home: Single-story ranch. Bathroom grab bars and hallway night-lights are present. Front door has a standard deadbolt Margaret can unlock. Stove knobs are not covered or disabled. Throw rugs are in the kitchen and hallway. Cleaning supplies are unlocked under the kitchen sink. A wooden chair is propped under the bedroom doorknob.

Labs from primary care office 1 week ago: sodium 141 mEq/L, potassium 4.2 mEq/L, BUN 24 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, fasting glucose 102 mg/dL, albumin 3.1 g/dL, prealbumin 14 mg/dL, TSH 2.8 mIU/L, hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL, hematocrit 35%, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. Urinalysis: trace leukocytes, no nitrites, specific gravity 1.028.
content.zh:
Margaret：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 76次/分且规则，BP 148/88，RR 16次/分，室内空气下SpO₂ 97%。体重58 kg；9个月前体重61.6 kg。清醒，仅能说出自己的名字；不知道日期、季节或地址。能执行一步指令，不能执行两步指令。言语流利但有找词困难和偶发虚构。两次把护士称为已故丈夫的名字。皮肤完整，无瘀斑、裂伤或压迫部位损伤。双膝骨擦感伴轻度肿胀。步态缓慢、基底较宽、轻度前倾；可在家中短距离独立行走。握力对称且足够。口腔黏膜轻度干燥。腹部柔软、无压痛。会阴皮肤完整但因尿液接触轻度发红。Diane 报告每天尿失禁2–3次，白天穿拉拉裤，无大便失禁。

Diane：打开药瓶时双手轻微颤抖。报告几乎每天头痛，工作时难以集中注意力，当 Margaret 重复提问时会先愤怒后内疚。否认有伤害自己或 Margaret 的想法。已超过1年未看自己的初级保健医生。未参加过照护者支持小组，也不知道喘息服务是什么。

家庭环境：单层牧场式住宅。浴室有扶手，走廊有夜灯。前门是普通插销锁，Margaret 能打开。炉灶旋钮未加盖也未停用。厨房和走廊有小地毯。清洁用品未上锁，放在厨房水槽下方。卧室门把手下抵着一把木椅。

1周前初级保健诊所化验：钠141 mEq/L，钾4.2 mEq/L，BUN 24 mg/dL，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，空腹血糖102 mg/dL，白蛋白3.1 g/dL，前白蛋白14 mg/dL，TSH 2.8 mIU/L，血红蛋白11.8 g/dL，红细胞压积35%，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，血小板210 ×10³/µL。尿检：白细胞微量，亚硝酸盐阴性，比重1.028。

title.zh: 激动 episode 与照护者反应

content.en: While the nurse assesses the home, Margaret stands without warning, walks toward the kitchen, and turns on a stove burner. Diane rushes to turn it off and says Margaret thinks she is making coffee; last week Margaret left a burner on for 20 minutes before Diane noticed. Margaret becomes mildly agitated when redirected, pulls her arm from Diane's grasp, and says loudly, 'Don't touch me! I want my coffee!' Diane raises her voice: 'Mom, stop it! You can't use the stove!' Margaret paces, wrings her hands, and repeats, 'Where is Frank? I want Frank.' Diane sits at the kitchen table, puts her head in her hands, and says quietly, 'I can't do this anymore. I'm failing her.' Diane does not strike, shove, or physically restrain Margaret; her frustration is verbal and self-directed. Margaret's vital signs during agitation are HR 92, BP 156/94, RR 20. She calms after about 10 minutes when the nurse offers decaffeinated tea and speaks slowly and calmly. After calming: HR 78, BP 144/86, RR 16.
