title.en: Acute variceal hemorrhage in decompensated alcohol-related cirrhosis
title.zh: 失代偿性酒精相关肝硬化中的急性静脉曲张出血

summary.en: A 55-year-old man with alcohol-related cirrhosis, portal hypertension, known esophageal varices, ascites, and intermittent hepatic encephalopathy presents with large-volume bright red hematemesis, hypotension, tachycardia, and evidence of impaired hepatic synthetic function.
summary.zh: 一名55岁男性，有酒精相关肝硬化、门静脉高压、已知食管静脉曲张、腹水和间歇性肝性脑病。现因大量鲜红色呕血、低血压、心动过速以及肝脏合成功能受损表现来诊。

content.en: Known Child-Pugh B alcohol-related cirrhosis. Prior screening EGD showed grade II esophageal varices 18 months ago. He has ascites managed with furosemide and spironolactone, mild intermittent hepatic encephalopathy treated with lactulose, no anticoagulants, no NSAIDs, and no beta-blocker because baseline systolic pressures were in the low 90s.
content.zh: 已知Child-Pugh B级酒精相关肝硬化。18个月前筛查胃镜显示II级食管静脉曲张。腹水使用呋塞米和螺内酯管理，轻度间歇性肝性脑病使用乳果糖治疗；未使用抗凝药或NSAID，也未因基础收缩压在90 mmHg出头而使用β受体阻滞剂。

content.en: Large-volume bright red hematemesis occurred about 45 minutes before arrival, with another episode during transport. Vitals: T 36.8 C, HR 118, BP 88/54, RR 20, SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. He is pale and diaphoretic with dried blood around the mouth. Abdomen is distended with fluid wave and shifting dullness. Caput medusae, spider angiomata, scleral icterus, and 2+ lower-extremity edema are present. He is alert and oriented with no asterixis.
content.zh: 到院前约45分钟出现大量鲜红色呕血，途中再次呕血。生命体征：T 36.8 C，HR 118，BP 88/54，RR 20，鼻导管2 L/min下SpO2 96%。患者苍白、出汗，口周有干血迹。腹部膨隆，有液波震颤和移动性浊音。可见海蛇头样静脉曲张、蜘蛛痣、巩膜黄染和双下肢2+水肿。患者清醒定向，无扑翼样震颤。

content.en: Hgb 8.1 g/dL, Hct 24.3%, platelets 72 ×10³/µL, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, Na 131 mEq/L, K 3.6 mEq/L, BUN 32 mg/dL, creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (baseline 1.0), total bilirubin 3.8 mg/dL, albumin 2.4 g/dL, INR 1.9, lactate 3.4 mmol/L, ammonia 62 µmol/L. Type and screen sent; crossmatch ordered for 4 units PRBC.
content.zh: Hgb 8.1 g/dL，Hct 24.3%，血小板72 ×10³/µL，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，Na 131 mEq/L，K 3.6 mEq/L，BUN 32 mg/dL，肌酐1.3 mg/dL（基础1.0），总胆红素3.8 mg/dL，白蛋白2.4 g/dL，INR 1.9，乳酸3.4 mmol/L，氨62 µmol/L。已送血型筛查；已申请4单位红细胞交叉配血。

content.en: Two 16-gauge IVs are placed. A 500 mL normal saline bolus is started. Orders include octreotide 50 mcg IV bolus then 50 mcg/hr infusion, ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily, pantoprazole infusion, NPO status, NG tube placement, and emergent GI consult. NG tube returns bright red blood with clots. After the bolus, HR 112, BP 92/58, and the patient vomits another 200 mL bright red blood. Point-of-care Hgb is 7.2 g/dL, lactate rises to 4.1 mmol/L, and urine output is 25 mL in the first hour. The provider orders 1 unit PRBC with target Hgb 7-8 g/dL.
content.zh: 置入两条16G外周静脉通路，开始500 mL生理盐水快速输注。医嘱包括奥曲肽50 mcg静推后以50 mcg/hr泵入、头孢曲松1 g IV每日一次、泮托拉唑泵入、禁食、置入胃管和急诊消化科会诊。胃管引出鲜红色血液和小血块。补液后HR 112，BP 92/58，患者再次呕出约200 mL鲜红色血液。床旁Hgb 7.2 g/dL，乳酸升至4.1 mmol/L，第1小时尿量25 mL。医嘱输注1单位红细胞，目标Hgb 7-8 g/dL。

title.en: Stage 2: 90 minutes to 4 hours after arrival
title.zh: 第2阶段：到院后90分钟至4小时

title.en: Stage 2: 90 minutes to 4 hours after arrival
title.zh: 第2阶段：到院后90分钟至4小时

content.en: Emergent EGD under airway protection shows three columns of large distal esophageal varices with active spurting from one varix and a red wale sign on another. Six bands are placed and hemostasis is achieved. In the ICU, HR 96, BP 104/62, RR 16, SpO2 98% on 2 L. Post-transfusion Hgb is 7.8 g/dL, lactate 2.6 mmol/L, urine output 40 mL/hr. He is drowsy but arousable and oriented. No further hematemesis. Small melena is noted. Four-hour labs show creatinine 1.5 mg/dL, INR 2.0, platelets 68 ×10³/µL, and ammonia 78 µmol/L.
content.zh: 气道保护下急诊胃镜显示远端食管三列大型静脉曲张，其中一处活动性喷射出血，另一处有红色征；置入6个套扎环后止血成功。入ICU时HR 96，BP 104/62，RR 16，2 L吸氧下SpO2 98%。输血后Hgb 7.8 g/dL，乳酸2.6 mmol/L，尿量40 mL/hr。患者嗜睡但可唤醒且定向，无再次呕血，可见少量黑便。4小时化验显示肌酐1.5 mg/dL，INR 2.0，血小板68 ×10³/µL，氨78 µmol/L。

content.en: Overnight, the patient becomes confused and somnolent, opens eyes to voice, follows simple commands, believes he is at home, and develops asterixis. Vitals: HR 82, BP 108/66, RR 14, SpO2 97% room air, T 37.9 C. Hgb 7.6 g/dL is stable with no further hematemesis. Labs: creatinine 1.8 mg/dL, urine output 15 mL/hr, ammonia 124 µmol/L, lactate 1.8 mmol/L. Diagnostic paracentesis shows ascitic WBC 620 cells/µL with 78% neutrophils, absolute neutrophil count 484 cells/µL, and SAAG 1.3 g/dL. Orders include lactulose every 2 hours titrated to 3-4 bowel movements/day, rifaximin every 12 hours, holding diuretics, and urgent SBP evaluation/treatment reassessment.
content.zh: 夜间患者出现意识混乱和嗜睡，对声音睁眼，可执行简单指令，但认为自己在家，并出现扑翼样震颤。生命体征：HR 82，BP 108/66，RR 14，室内空气SpO2 97%，T 37.9 C。Hgb 7.6 g/dL稳定，无再次呕血。化验：肌酐1.8 mg/dL，尿量15 mL/hr，氨124 µmol/L，乳酸1.8 mmol/L。诊断性腹腔穿刺显示腹水WBC 620 cells/µL，其中78%为中性粒细胞，绝对中性粒细胞计数484 cells/µL，SAAG 1.3 g/dL。医嘱包括乳果糖每2小时一次并滴定至每日3-4次排便、利福昔明每12小时一次、暂停利尿剂，以及紧急评估/重新评估SBP治疗。

stem.en: Highlight the findings that support the pattern of acute variceal hemorrhage in a decompensated cirrhotic patient.
stem.zh: 请标出支持失代偿性肝硬化患者发生急性静脉曲张出血这一临床模式的发现。

segments.en: Large-volume bright red hematemesis about 45 minutes before arrival.
segments.zh: 到院前约45分钟出现大量鲜红色呕血。

segments.en: Second smaller episode of hematemesis occurred during transport.
segments.zh: 来院途中再次出现少量呕血。

segments.en: HR 118 beats/min.
segments.zh: 心率118次/分。

segments.en: BP 88/54 mmHg.
segments.zh: 血压88/54 mmHg。

segments.en: Pale, diaphoretic appearance with capillary refill of 3 seconds.
segments.zh: 面色苍白、出汗，毛细血管再充盈时间3秒。

segments.en: SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula.
segments.zh: 鼻导管2 L/min吸氧下SpO2为96%。

segments.en: Clear breath sounds bilaterally.
segments.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰。

segments.en: Moderate-to-large ascites with fluid wave and shifting dullness.
segments.zh: 中到大量腹水，有液波震颤和移动性浊音。

segments.en: Caput medusae on the anterior abdominal wall.
segments.zh: 腹前壁可见海蛇头样静脉曲张。

segments.en: Spider angiomata on the upper chest.
segments.zh: 上胸部可见蜘蛛痣。

segments.en: Scleral icterus.
segments.zh: 巩膜黄染。

segments.en: No asterixis and coherent speech.
segments.zh: 无扑翼样震颤，讲话连贯。

segments.en: INR 1.9.
segments.zh: INR 1.9。

segments.en: Platelets 72 ×10³/µL.
segments.zh: 血小板72 ×10³/µL。

segments.en: Albumin 2.4 g/dL.
segments.zh: 白蛋白2.4 g/dL。

segments.en: Glucose 102 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 血糖102 mg/dL。

correct.en: The emergency pattern is massive hematemesis with shock physiology, plus clear evidence of portal hypertension and impaired hepatic synthetic function. Normal oxygenation, clear lungs, normal glucose, and absence of asterixis are useful baselines but do not explain the acute hemorrhage.
correct.zh: 本题的紧急模式是大量呕血伴休克生理表现，同时存在门静脉高压和肝脏合成功能受损的证据。氧合尚可、双肺清晰、血糖正常以及暂时无扑翼样震颤有助于建立基线，但不能解释当前急性出血。

byChoice.en: Large-volume bright red hematemesis about 45 minutes before arrival. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 到院前约45分钟出现大量鲜红色呕血。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Second smaller episode of hematemesis occurred during transport. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 来院途中再次出现少量呕血。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: HR 118 beats/min. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 心率118次/分。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: BP 88/54 mmHg. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 血压88/54 mmHg。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Pale, diaphoretic appearance with capillary refill of 3 seconds. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 面色苍白、出汗，毛细血管再充盈时间3秒。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 鼻导管2 L/min吸氧下SpO2为96%。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

byChoice.en: Clear breath sounds bilaterally. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

byChoice.en: Moderate-to-large ascites with fluid wave and shifting dullness. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 中到大量腹水，有液波震颤和移动性浊音。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Caput medusae on the anterior abdominal wall. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 腹前壁可见海蛇头样静脉曲张。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Spider angiomata on the upper chest. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 上胸部可见蜘蛛痣。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Scleral icterus. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 巩膜黄染。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: No asterixis and coherent speech. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 无扑翼样震颤，讲话连贯。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

byChoice.en: INR 1.9. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: INR 1.9。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Platelets 72 ×10³/µL. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 血小板72 ×10³/µL。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Albumin 2.4 g/dL. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 白蛋白2.4 g/dL。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Glucose 102 mg/dL. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 血糖102 mg/dL。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: Cluster cues instead of reacting to one lab. In cirrhosis, hematemesis plus portal-hypertension stigmata and poor hemostatic reserve points to variceal hemorrhage.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 要把线索组合起来看，不要只盯着单个化验值。肝硬化患者出现呕血，再加门静脉高压体征和止血储备差，应优先想到静脉曲张出血。

glossary.defZh: 门静脉高压导致食管或胃静脉曲张破裂出血。
门静脉系统压力升高，可导致腹水、食管静脉曲张和腹壁静脉曲张。
腹壁浅静脉扩张，是门静脉高压的体征之一。
肝脏合成凝血因子和白蛋白的能力下降，可表现为INR升高和低白蛋白。

stem.en: Complete the clinical judgment statement about the Stage 1 trend.
stem.zh: 请补全关于第1阶段病情趋势的临床判断。

clozeStem.en: The Stage 1 findings indicate {{1}} because the patient has {{2}} and {{3}} despite initial crystalloid resuscitation.
clozeStem.zh: 第1阶段的发现提示 {{1}}，因为患者在初步晶体液复苏后仍有 {{2}} 和 {{3}}。

options.en: expected anxiety after seeing blood
options.zh: 看到出血后的预期焦虑反应

options.en: ongoing hemorrhagic shock with inadequate tissue perfusion
options.zh: 持续性失血性休克并组织灌注不足

options.en: stable recovery after the fluid bolus
options.zh: 补液后已稳定恢复

options.en: a lactate rise from 3.4 to 4.1 mmol/L
options.zh: 乳酸从3.4升至4.1 mmol/L

options.en: a normal glucose of 102 mg/dL
options.zh: 血糖102 mg/dL正常

options.en: clear bilateral breath sounds
options.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰

options.en: only 25 mL urine output in the first hour
options.zh: 第1小时尿量仅25 mL

options.en: hemoglobin now above the target range
options.zh: 血红蛋白已高于目标范围

options.en: oxygen saturation of 97% on nasal cannula
options.zh: 鼻导管吸氧下SpO2为97%

correct.en: The marginal BP response, persistent tachycardia, repeat hematemesis, rising lactate, and oliguria show that perfusion remains inadequate. A hemoglobin of 7.2 g/dL in this context supports single-unit PRBC transfusion to the stated restrictive target, not liberal transfusion.
correct.zh: 血压仅轻微改善、心动过速持续、再次呕血、乳酸升高以及少尿，说明灌注仍不足。在这种情况下血红蛋白7.2 g/dL支持按限制性目标输注1单位红细胞，而不是宽松输血。

byChoice.en: Ongoing hemorrhagic shock is correct because perfusion markers are worsening despite the initial bolus. Anxiety or stable recovery would not explain rising lactate and oliguria.
byChoice.zh: 持续性失血性休克正确，因为初步补液后灌注指标仍在恶化。单纯焦虑或稳定恢复不能解释乳酸升高和少尿。

byChoice.en: The rising lactate is the key perfusion cue. Normal glucose and clear lungs are useful but do not show worsening tissue oxygen debt.
byChoice.zh: 乳酸升高是关键的灌注线索。血糖正常和双肺清晰有参考价值，但不能说明组织缺氧债加重。

byChoice.en: Urine output of 25 mL in the first hour indicates renal hypoperfusion. Oxygenation is not the failing parameter, and the hemoglobin is near the restrictive transfusion threshold rather than above target.
byChoice.zh: 第1小时尿量25 mL提示肾灌注不足。氧合不是当前失败的指标；血红蛋白接近限制性输血阈值，而不是高于目标范围。

testTakingStrategy.en: For shock questions, trend perfusion markers together: mental status, urine output, lactate, HR/BP response, and ongoing losses.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 休克题要把灌注指标放在一起看：意识状态、尿量、乳酸、心率/血压反应以及是否仍在丢失血容量。

glossary.defZh: 组织缺氧或灌注不足时可升高的代谢指标。
尿量减少，常提示肾灌注不足或肾功能受损。
只在较低血红蛋白阈值或有临床需要时输血，以避免过度容量负荷。

stem.en: Which bleeding source should guide the nurse's priority hypothesis and anticipated plan of care before endoscopic confirmation?
stem.zh: 在内镜确认前，护士应以哪一种出血来源作为优先假设并据此预期护理计划？

options.en: Mallory-Weiss tear from forceful retching
options.zh: 剧烈干呕导致的贲门黏膜撕裂

options.en: Lower gastrointestinal bleeding from hemorrhoids
options.zh: 痔疮导致的下消化道出血

options.en: Esophageal variceal hemorrhage related to portal hypertension
options.zh: 门静脉高压相关的食管静脉曲张出血

options.en: Peptic ulcer bleeding from NSAID use
options.zh: NSAID使用导致的消化性溃疡出血

correct.en: Known cirrhosis, portal hypertension, documented esophageal varices, large-volume hematemesis, ascites, caput medusae, and coagulopathy all point to variceal hemorrhage. The nurse should anticipate variceal-specific therapy while endoscopy is being arranged.
correct.zh: 已知肝硬化、门静脉高压、既往食管静脉曲张、大量呕血、腹水、海蛇头样静脉曲张和凝血异常共同指向静脉曲张出血。安排内镜的同时，护士应预期静脉曲张出血的特异性治疗。

byChoice.en: Hemorrhoids cause lower GI bleeding, not large-volume bright red hematemesis.
byChoice.zh: 痔疮导致下消化道出血，不会造成大量鲜红色呕血。

byChoice.en: Peptic ulcer disease remains possible in upper GI bleeding, but this patient denies NSAID use and has a stronger variceal risk pattern.
byChoice.zh: 上消化道出血仍可能来自消化性溃疡，但患者否认NSAID使用，且静脉曲张风险模式更强。

byChoice.en: This is the best hypothesis because the patient has known portal hypertension and prior esophageal varices with massive hematemesis.
byChoice.zh: 这是最佳假设，因为患者有已知门静脉高压和既往食管静脉曲张，并出现大量呕血。

byChoice.en: A Mallory-Weiss tear usually follows forceful retching and is not the priority hypothesis when known varices and portal hypertension are present.
byChoice.zh: 贲门黏膜撕裂通常发生在剧烈干呕后；在已知静脉曲张和门静脉高压存在时，不是优先假设。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use the history that changes management. Prior varices plus cirrhosis turns hematemesis into a presumed variceal bleed until proven otherwise.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 抓住会改变处理方向的病史。既往静脉曲张加肝硬化，使呕血在证实前应按疑似静脉曲张出血处理。

glossary.defZh: 门静脉高压导致食管静脉扩张，破裂时可发生危及生命的呕血。
胃或十二指肠黏膜破损，可导致上消化道出血。
呕吐或干呕后胃食管交界处黏膜撕裂导致出血。

stem.en: The provider orders 1 unit PRBC with a target hemoglobin of 7-8 g/dL. Which concurrent interventions should the nurse implement or anticipate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 医嘱输注1单位浓缩红细胞，目标血红蛋白7-8 g/dL。护士应执行或预期哪些同步干预？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Maintain NPO status and prepare for emergent EGD with band ligation.
options.zh: 维持禁食，准备急诊胃镜及套扎止血。

options.en: Transfuse additional PRBCs until hemoglobin reaches 10 g/dL.
options.zh: 继续输注红细胞直到血红蛋白达到10 g/dL。

options.en: Administer ceftriaxone prophylaxis as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱给予头孢曲松预防性抗感染。

options.en: Position with head of bed elevated and maintain airway readiness.
options.zh: 抬高床头并保持气道准备。

options.en: Give fresh frozen plasma solely to normalize the INR before endoscopy.
options.zh: 仅为在内镜前纠正INR而输注新鲜冰冻血浆。

options.en: Continue the octreotide infusion as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱继续奥曲肽静脉泵入。

correct.en: Octreotide, ceftriaxone, endoscopy readiness, NPO status, and airway protection are concurrent priorities in suspected variceal hemorrhage. The case protocol sets a restrictive PRBC target; routine liberal transfusion or large-volume plasma just to normalize cirrhosis-related INR can worsen volume/portal-pressure problems and delay definitive hemostasis.
correct.zh: 疑似静脉曲张出血时，奥曲肽、头孢曲松、内镜准备、禁食和气道保护是同步优先事项。本病例方案设定限制性红细胞输血目标；常规宽松输血或仅为纠正肝硬化相关INR而大量输注血浆，可能加重容量/门静脉压力问题并延误最终止血。

byChoice.en: Ceftriaxone is ordered for infection/SBP prophylaxis in a cirrhotic patient with GI hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 肝硬化合并消化道出血时，头孢曲松用于感染/SBP预防。

byChoice.en: A hemoglobin target of 10 g/dL is too liberal for this protocol and may increase portal pressure and rebleeding risk.
byChoice.zh: 把血红蛋白目标定到10 g/dL对本方案过于宽松，可能升高门静脉压力并增加再出血风险。

byChoice.en: Active hematemesis creates aspiration risk; positioning and airway readiness are nursing priorities.
byChoice.zh: 活动性呕血有误吸风险；体位和气道准备是护理优先事项。

byChoice.en: Octreotide reduces splanchnic blood flow and is used as a bridge to and after endoscopic therapy.
byChoice.zh: 奥曲肽可减少内脏血流，是内镜治疗前后用于降低静脉曲张出血风险的药物。

byChoice.en: Endoscopic band ligation is the definitive hemostatic intervention for active esophageal variceal bleeding, so NPO and preparation are appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 内镜套扎是活动性食管静脉曲张出血的关键止血措施，因此禁食和准备内镜是正确的。

byChoice.en: Chronic cirrhosis-related INR elevation is not an automatic reason to delay endoscopy for plasma correction; plasma adds volume and can worsen portal-pressure physiology.
byChoice.zh: 慢性肝硬化导致的INR升高并不自动要求为输血浆而推迟内镜；血浆会增加容量，可能加重门静脉压力问题。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several actions are ordered for an unstable bleed, separate concurrent stabilizing actions from harmful attempts to normalize every lab value.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不稳定出血题中有多项医嘱时，要区分同步稳定病情的措施和“纠正每个异常化验值”的有害做法。

glossary.defZh: 可降低内脏血流和门静脉压力的药物，常用于静脉曲张出血。
用橡皮圈结扎出血静脉曲张以达到止血。
含凝血因子的血液制品；不应仅因肝硬化INR升高而常规用于内镜前纠正。

stem.en: For each immediate post-banding nursing action or interpretation, indicate whether it is appropriate now.
stem.zh: 对于内镜套扎后的每项护理行动或判断，请判断当前是否适当。

rows.en: Continue the octreotide infusion per protocol.
rows.zh: 按方案继续奥曲肽泵入。

rows.en: Monitor for true rebleeding: new hematemesis, hemodynamic decline, or falling serial hemoglobin.
rows.zh: 监测真正再出血迹象：再次呕血、血流动力学恶化或连续血红蛋白下降。

rows.en: Treat the small amount of melena alone as proof of active rebleeding.
rows.zh: 仅凭少量黑便就认定为活动性再出血。

rows.en: Stop ceftriaxone because endoscopic hemostasis was achieved.
rows.zh: 因内镜止血成功而停止头孢曲松。

rows.en: Monitor mental status, ammonia trend, urine output, and creatinine.
rows.zh: 监测意识状态、氨水平趋势、尿量和肌酐。

rows.en: Transfuse more PRBCs now because hemoglobin is 7.8 g/dL.
rows.zh: 因血红蛋白7.8 g/dL立即继续输注红细胞。

correct.en: After banding, the hemorrhage markers are improving, but early rebleeding, infection, hepatic encephalopathy, and renal injury remain major risks. Melena alone can reflect digested earlier blood when hemoglobin and hemodynamics are stable.
correct.zh: 套扎后出血指标改善，但早期再出血、感染、肝性脑病和肾损伤仍是主要风险。在血红蛋白和血流动力学稳定时，单独黑便可来自先前出血的消化血液。

byChoice.en: Continuing octreotide is appropriate because vasoactive therapy is commonly continued after hemostasis to reduce early rebleeding risk.
byChoice.zh: 继续奥曲肽适当，因为止血后通常继续血管活性治疗以降低早期再出血风险。

byChoice.en: These are the correct indicators of recurrent bleeding and should be monitored closely.
byChoice.zh: 这些是真正再出血的正确指标，应密切监测。

byChoice.en: Melena alone is not proof of new bleeding when it follows large hematemesis and the hemoglobin and vital signs are stable.
byChoice.zh: 大量呕血后出现黑便，若血红蛋白和生命体征稳定，单独黑便不能证明新出血。

byChoice.en: Antibiotic prophylaxis is not stopped simply because banding controlled the bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 不能仅因套扎控制出血就停止预防性抗生素。

byChoice.en: Rising ammonia and creatinine after the bleed make encephalopathy and renal injury important surveillance targets.
byChoice.zh: 出血后氨和肌酐升高，使肝性脑病和肾损伤成为重要监测目标。

byChoice.en: Hemoglobin 7.8 g/dL is within the stated restrictive target, so more PRBCs are not indicated based on this value alone.
byChoice.zh: 血红蛋白7.8 g/dL在本方案限制性目标范围内，不能仅凭此数值继续输血。

testTakingStrategy.en: After an intervention, evaluate trajectory: what improved, what remains risky, and what finding is expected from earlier events.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 干预后要评估趋势：哪些改善了、哪些仍有风险、哪些发现可由先前事件解释。

glossary.defZh: 已控制的出血再次发生，可表现为新呕血、血压下降、心率上升或血红蛋白下降。
消化后的血液使粪便呈黑色柏油样，可来自先前上消化道出血。
晚期肝病中有效循环血量下降和肾血流改变导致肾功能恶化的过程。

stem.en: At Stage 3, which conclusions or nursing actions are supported by the current data? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段，根据当前资料支持哪些结论或护理行动？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Notify the provider that ascitic PMN count meets the SBP diagnostic threshold and anticipate antibiotic reassessment.
options.zh: 通知医护团队腹水PMN计数达到SBP诊断阈值，并预期重新评估抗生素方案。

options.en: Recognize hepatic encephalopathy and administer lactulose/rifaximin as ordered.
options.zh: 识别肝性脑病，并按医嘱给予乳果糖/利福昔明。

options.en: Continue serial neurological assessments, including orientation, level of consciousness, and asterixis.
options.zh: 继续连续神经系统评估，包括定向力、意识水平和扑翼样震颤。

options.en: Attribute the confusion to residual procedural sedation and defer lactulose until the next routine assessment.
options.zh: 将意识混乱归因于操作后残余镇静，推迟乳果糖至下一次常规评估。

options.en: Closely monitor urine output and creatinine because SBP with AKI raises concern for hepatorenal syndrome.
options.zh: 密切监测尿量和肌酐，因为SBP合并AKI提示肝肾综合征风险。

options.en: Give additional PRBCs to raise hemoglobin above 8 g/dL because the patient looks worse.
options.zh: 因患者看起来更差而追加输注红细胞，使血红蛋白超过8 g/dL。

correct.en: The hemorrhage appears controlled, but the patient has new hepatic encephalopathy, SBP by ascitic PMN count, and worsening renal function. The nursing priority shifts to treating encephalopathy, communicating SBP results, and tracking neurologic and renal trajectories.
correct.zh: 出血似乎已控制，但患者出现新的肝性脑病、腹水PMN计数符合SBP，以及肾功能恶化。护理重点转向治疗脑病、报告SBP结果，并追踪神经和肾功能趋势。

byChoice.en: Confusion, somnolence, asterixis, and ammonia 124 µmol/L support hepatic encephalopathy; lactulose and rifaximin are the ordered therapies.
byChoice.zh: 意识混乱、嗜睡、扑翼样震颤和氨124 µmol/L支持肝性脑病；乳果糖和利福昔明是医嘱治疗。

byChoice.en: Serial neurological assessment shows whether encephalopathy is improving or progressing despite therapy.
byChoice.zh: 连续神经系统评估可判断脑病在治疗后是改善还是进展。

byChoice.en: The stable hemoglobin of 7.6 g/dL and absence of new hematemesis argue against rebleeding; transfusion above target would not treat the current problem.
byChoice.zh: 血红蛋白7.6 g/dL稳定且无再次呕血，不支持再出血；超目标输血不能治疗当前问题。

byChoice.en: Creatinine is rising and urine output is falling in the setting of SBP, which raises concern for hepatorenal syndrome physiology.
byChoice.zh: 在SBP背景下肌酐上升且尿量下降，提示肝肾综合征相关风险。

byChoice.en: The decline occurs more than 12 hours after sedation, after the patient had been oriented, and includes new asterixis and marked hyperammonemia; deferring treatment is unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 意识下降发生在镇静12小时以上之后，且患者曾清醒定向，同时出现新的扑翼样震颤和明显高氨血症；推迟治疗不安全。

byChoice.en: Ascitic PMN 484 cells/µL exceeds the case threshold of 250 cells/µL, so SBP must be communicated and treatment reassessed.
byChoice.zh: 腹水PMN 484 cells/µL超过本病例250 cells/µL阈值，必须报告SBP并重新评估治疗。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a patient worsens after the initial emergency is controlled, ask whether the new data show a complication rather than failure of the first treatment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 初始急症控制后患者恶化时，要判断新资料是否提示并发症，而不是简单认为第一次治疗失败。

glossary.defZh: 肝功能衰竭或门体分流导致毒素积聚，引起意识和神经功能改变。
无明确腹腔感染源的腹水感染，肝硬化腹水患者风险较高。
手腕伸展时出现的不规则扑翼样抖动，常见于肝性脑病。
晚期肝病和门静脉高压背景下发生的功能性肾衰竭。

title.en: Acute variceal hemorrhage in decompensated alcohol-related cirrhosis
title.zh: 失代偿性酒精相关肝硬化中的急性静脉曲张出血

summary.en: A 55-year-old man with alcohol-related cirrhosis, portal hypertension, known esophageal varices, ascites, and intermittent hepatic encephalopathy presents with large-volume bright red hematemesis, hypotension, tachycardia, and evidence of impaired hepatic synthetic function.
summary.zh: 一名55岁男性，有酒精相关肝硬化、门静脉高压、已知食管静脉曲张、腹水和间歇性肝性脑病。现因大量鲜红色呕血、低血压、心动过速以及肝脏合成功能受损表现来诊。

content.en: Known Child-Pugh B alcohol-related cirrhosis. Prior screening EGD showed grade II esophageal varices 18 months ago. He has ascites managed with furosemide and spironolactone, mild intermittent hepatic encephalopathy treated with lactulose, no anticoagulants, no NSAIDs, and no beta-blocker because baseline systolic pressures were in the low 90s.
content.zh: 已知Child-Pugh B级酒精相关肝硬化。18个月前筛查胃镜显示II级食管静脉曲张。腹水使用呋塞米和螺内酯管理，轻度间歇性肝性脑病使用乳果糖治疗；未使用抗凝药或NSAID，也未因基础收缩压在90 mmHg出头而使用β受体阻滞剂。

content.en: Large-volume bright red hematemesis occurred about 45 minutes before arrival, with another episode during transport. Vitals: T 36.8 C, HR 118, BP 88/54, RR 20, SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. He is pale and diaphoretic with dried blood around the mouth. Abdomen is distended with fluid wave and shifting dullness. Caput medusae, spider angiomata, scleral icterus, and 2+ lower-extremity edema are present. He is alert and oriented with no asterixis.
content.zh: 到院前约45分钟出现大量鲜红色呕血，途中再次呕血。生命体征：T 36.8 C，HR 118，BP 88/54，RR 20，鼻导管2 L/min下SpO2 96%。患者苍白、出汗，口周有干血迹。腹部膨隆，有液波震颤和移动性浊音。可见海蛇头样静脉曲张、蜘蛛痣、巩膜黄染和双下肢2+水肿。患者清醒定向，无扑翼样震颤。

content.en: Hgb 8.1 g/dL, Hct 24.3%, platelets 72 ×10³/µL, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, Na 131 mEq/L, K 3.6 mEq/L, BUN 32 mg/dL, creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (baseline 1.0), total bilirubin 3.8 mg/dL, albumin 2.4 g/dL, INR 1.9, lactate 3.4 mmol/L, ammonia 62 µmol/L. Type and screen sent; crossmatch ordered for 4 units PRBC.
content.zh: Hgb 8.1 g/dL，Hct 24.3%，血小板72 ×10³/µL，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，Na 131 mEq/L，K 3.6 mEq/L，BUN 32 mg/dL，肌酐1.3 mg/dL（基础1.0），总胆红素3.8 mg/dL，白蛋白2.4 g/dL，INR 1.9，乳酸3.4 mmol/L，氨62 µmol/L。已送血型筛查；已申请4单位红细胞交叉配血。

content.en: Two 16-gauge IVs are placed. A 500 mL normal saline bolus is started. Orders include octreotide 50 mcg IV bolus then 50 mcg/hr infusion, ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily, pantoprazole infusion, NPO status, NG tube placement, and emergent GI consult. NG tube returns bright red blood with clots. After the bolus, HR 112, BP 92/58, and the patient vomits another 200 mL bright red blood. Point-of-care Hgb is 7.2 g/dL, lactate rises to 4.1 mmol/L, and urine output is 25 mL in the first hour. The provider orders 1 unit PRBC with target Hgb 7-8 g/dL.
content.zh: 置入两条16G外周静脉通路，开始500 mL生理盐水快速输注。医嘱包括奥曲肽50 mcg静推后以50 mcg/hr泵入、头孢曲松1 g IV每日一次、泮托拉唑泵入、禁食、置入胃管和急诊消化科会诊。胃管引出鲜红色血液和小血块。补液后HR 112，BP 92/58，患者再次呕出约200 mL鲜红色血液。床旁Hgb 7.2 g/dL，乳酸升至4.1 mmol/L，第1小时尿量25 mL。医嘱输注1单位红细胞，目标Hgb 7-8 g/dL。

title.en: Stage 2: 90 minutes to 4 hours after arrival
title.zh: 第2阶段：到院后90分钟至4小时

title.en: Stage 2: 90 minutes to 4 hours after arrival
title.zh: 第2阶段：到院后90分钟至4小时

content.en: Emergent EGD under airway protection shows three columns of large distal esophageal varices with active spurting from one varix and a red wale sign on another. Six bands are placed and hemostasis is achieved. In the ICU, HR 96, BP 104/62, RR 16, SpO2 98% on 2 L. Post-transfusion Hgb is 7.8 g/dL, lactate 2.6 mmol/L, urine output 40 mL/hr. He is drowsy but arousable and oriented. No further hematemesis. Small melena is noted. Four-hour labs show creatinine 1.5 mg/dL, INR 2.0, platelets 68 ×10³/µL, and ammonia 78 µmol/L.
content.zh: 气道保护下急诊胃镜显示远端食管三列大型静脉曲张，其中一处活动性喷射出血，另一处有红色征；置入6个套扎环后止血成功。入ICU时HR 96，BP 104/62，RR 16，2 L吸氧下SpO2 98%。输血后Hgb 7.8 g/dL，乳酸2.6 mmol/L，尿量40 mL/hr。患者嗜睡但可唤醒且定向，无再次呕血，可见少量黑便。4小时化验显示肌酐1.5 mg/dL，INR 2.0，血小板68 ×10³/µL，氨78 µmol/L。

content.en: Overnight, the patient becomes confused and somnolent, opens eyes to voice, follows simple commands, believes he is at home, and develops asterixis. Vitals: HR 82, BP 108/66, RR 14, SpO2 97% room air, T 37.9 C. Hgb 7.6 g/dL is stable with no further hematemesis. Labs: creatinine 1.8 mg/dL, urine output 15 mL/hr, ammonia 124 µmol/L, lactate 1.8 mmol/L. Diagnostic paracentesis shows ascitic WBC 620 cells/µL with 78% neutrophils, absolute neutrophil count 484 cells/µL, and SAAG 1.3 g/dL. Orders include lactulose every 2 hours titrated to 3-4 bowel movements/day, rifaximin every 12 hours, holding diuretics, and urgent SBP evaluation/treatment reassessment.
content.zh: 夜间患者出现意识混乱和嗜睡，对声音睁眼，可执行简单指令，但认为自己在家，并出现扑翼样震颤。生命体征：HR 82，BP 108/66，RR 14，室内空气SpO2 97%，T 37.9 C。Hgb 7.6 g/dL稳定，无再次呕血。化验：肌酐1.8 mg/dL，尿量15 mL/hr，氨124 µmol/L，乳酸1.8 mmol/L。诊断性腹腔穿刺显示腹水WBC 620 cells/µL，其中78%为中性粒细胞，绝对中性粒细胞计数484 cells/µL，SAAG 1.3 g/dL。医嘱包括乳果糖每2小时一次并滴定至每日3-4次排便、利福昔明每12小时一次、暂停利尿剂，以及紧急评估/重新评估SBP治疗。

stem.en: Highlight the findings that support the pattern of acute variceal hemorrhage in a decompensated cirrhotic patient.
stem.zh: 请标出支持失代偿性肝硬化患者发生急性静脉曲张出血这一临床模式的发现。

segments.en: Large-volume bright red hematemesis about 45 minutes before arrival.
segments.zh: 到院前约45分钟出现大量鲜红色呕血。

segments.en: Second smaller episode of hematemesis occurred during transport.
segments.zh: 来院途中再次出现少量呕血。

segments.en: HR 118 beats/min.
segments.zh: 心率118次/分。

segments.en: BP 88/54 mmHg.
segments.zh: 血压88/54 mmHg。

segments.en: Pale, diaphoretic appearance with capillary refill of 3 seconds.
segments.zh: 面色苍白、出汗，毛细血管再充盈时间3秒。

segments.en: SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula.
segments.zh: 鼻导管2 L/min吸氧下SpO2为96%。

segments.en: Clear breath sounds bilaterally.
segments.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰。

segments.en: Moderate-to-large ascites with fluid wave and shifting dullness.
segments.zh: 中到大量腹水，有液波震颤和移动性浊音。

segments.en: Caput medusae on the anterior abdominal wall.
segments.zh: 腹前壁可见海蛇头样静脉曲张。

segments.en: Spider angiomata on the upper chest.
segments.zh: 上胸部可见蜘蛛痣。

segments.en: Scleral icterus.
segments.zh: 巩膜黄染。

segments.en: No asterixis and coherent speech.
segments.zh: 无扑翼样震颤，讲话连贯。

segments.en: INR 1.9.
segments.zh: INR 1.9。

segments.en: Platelets 72 ×10³/µL.
segments.zh: 血小板72 ×10³/µL。

segments.en: Albumin 2.4 g/dL.
segments.zh: 白蛋白2.4 g/dL。

segments.en: Glucose 102 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 血糖102 mg/dL。

correct.en: The emergency pattern is massive hematemesis with shock physiology, plus clear evidence of portal hypertension and impaired hepatic synthetic function. Normal oxygenation, clear lungs, normal glucose, and absence of asterixis are useful baselines but do not explain the acute hemorrhage.
correct.zh: 本题的紧急模式是大量呕血伴休克生理表现，同时存在门静脉高压和肝脏合成功能受损的证据。氧合尚可、双肺清晰、血糖正常以及暂时无扑翼样震颤有助于建立基线，但不能解释当前急性出血。

byChoice.en: Large-volume bright red hematemesis about 45 minutes before arrival. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 到院前约45分钟出现大量鲜红色呕血。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Second smaller episode of hematemesis occurred during transport. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 来院途中再次出现少量呕血。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: HR 118 beats/min. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 心率118次/分。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: BP 88/54 mmHg. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 血压88/54 mmHg。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Pale, diaphoretic appearance with capillary refill of 3 seconds. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 面色苍白、出汗，毛细血管再充盈时间3秒。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 鼻导管2 L/min吸氧下SpO2为96%。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

byChoice.en: Clear breath sounds bilaterally. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

byChoice.en: Moderate-to-large ascites with fluid wave and shifting dullness. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 中到大量腹水，有液波震颤和移动性浊音。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Caput medusae on the anterior abdominal wall. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 腹前壁可见海蛇头样静脉曲张。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Spider angiomata on the upper chest. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 上胸部可见蜘蛛痣。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Scleral icterus. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 巩膜黄染。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: No asterixis and coherent speech. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 无扑翼样震颤，讲话连贯。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

byChoice.en: INR 1.9. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: INR 1.9。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Platelets 72 ×10³/µL. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 血小板72 ×10³/µL。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Albumin 2.4 g/dL. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 白蛋白2.4 g/dL。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Glucose 102 mg/dL. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 血糖102 mg/dL。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: Cluster cues instead of reacting to one lab. In cirrhosis, hematemesis plus portal-hypertension stigmata and poor hemostatic reserve points to variceal hemorrhage.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 要把线索组合起来看，不要只盯着单个化验值。肝硬化患者出现呕血，再加门静脉高压体征和止血储备差，应优先想到静脉曲张出血。

glossary.defZh: 门静脉高压导致食管或胃静脉曲张破裂出血。
门静脉系统压力升高，可导致腹水、食管静脉曲张和腹壁静脉曲张。
腹壁浅静脉扩张，是门静脉高压的体征之一。
肝脏合成凝血因子和白蛋白的能力下降，可表现为INR升高和低白蛋白。

stem.en: Complete the clinical judgment statement about the Stage 1 trend.
stem.zh: 请补全关于第1阶段病情趋势的临床判断。

clozeStem.en: The Stage 1 findings indicate {{1}} because the patient has {{2}} and {{3}} despite initial crystalloid resuscitation.
clozeStem.zh: 第1阶段的发现提示 {{1}}，因为患者在初步晶体液复苏后仍有 {{2}} 和 {{3}}。

options.en: expected anxiety after seeing blood
options.zh: 看到出血后的预期焦虑反应

options.en: ongoing hemorrhagic shock with inadequate tissue perfusion
options.zh: 持续性失血性休克并组织灌注不足

options.en: stable recovery after the fluid bolus
options.zh: 补液后已稳定恢复

options.en: a lactate rise from 3.4 to 4.1 mmol/L
options.zh: 乳酸从3.4升至4.1 mmol/L

options.en: a normal glucose of 102 mg/dL
options.zh: 血糖102 mg/dL正常

options.en: clear bilateral breath sounds
options.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰

options.en: only 25 mL urine output in the first hour
options.zh: 第1小时尿量仅25 mL

options.en: hemoglobin now above the target range
options.zh: 血红蛋白已高于目标范围

options.en: oxygen saturation of 97% on nasal cannula
options.zh: 鼻导管吸氧下SpO2为97%

correct.en: The marginal BP response, persistent tachycardia, repeat hematemesis, rising lactate, and oliguria show that perfusion remains inadequate. A hemoglobin of 7.2 g/dL in this context supports single-unit PRBC transfusion to the stated restrictive target, not liberal transfusion.
correct.zh: 血压仅轻微改善、心动过速持续、再次呕血、乳酸升高以及少尿，说明灌注仍不足。在这种情况下血红蛋白7.2 g/dL支持按限制性目标输注1单位红细胞，而不是宽松输血。

byChoice.en: Ongoing hemorrhagic shock is correct because perfusion markers are worsening despite the initial bolus. Anxiety or stable recovery would not explain rising lactate and oliguria.
byChoice.zh: 持续性失血性休克正确，因为初步补液后灌注指标仍在恶化。单纯焦虑或稳定恢复不能解释乳酸升高和少尿。

byChoice.en: The rising lactate is the key perfusion cue. Normal glucose and clear lungs are useful but do not show worsening tissue oxygen debt.
byChoice.zh: 乳酸升高是关键的灌注线索。血糖正常和双肺清晰有参考价值，但不能说明组织缺氧债加重。

byChoice.en: Urine output of 25 mL in the first hour indicates renal hypoperfusion. Oxygenation is not the failing parameter, and the hemoglobin is near the restrictive transfusion threshold rather than above target.
byChoice.zh: 第1小时尿量25 mL提示肾灌注不足。氧合不是当前失败的指标；血红蛋白接近限制性输血阈值，而不是高于目标范围。

testTakingStrategy.en: For shock questions, trend perfusion markers together: mental status, urine output, lactate, HR/BP response, and ongoing losses.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 休克题要把灌注指标放在一起看：意识状态、尿量、乳酸、心率/血压反应以及是否仍在丢失血容量。

glossary.defZh: 组织缺氧或灌注不足时可升高的代谢指标。
尿量减少，常提示肾灌注不足或肾功能受损。
只在较低血红蛋白阈值或有临床需要时输血，以避免过度容量负荷。

stem.en: Which bleeding source should guide the nurse's priority hypothesis and anticipated plan of care before endoscopic confirmation?
stem.zh: 在内镜确认前，护士应以哪一种出血来源作为优先假设并据此预期护理计划？

options.en: Mallory-Weiss tear from forceful retching
options.zh: 剧烈干呕导致的贲门黏膜撕裂

options.en: Lower gastrointestinal bleeding from hemorrhoids
options.zh: 痔疮导致的下消化道出血

options.en: Esophageal variceal hemorrhage related to portal hypertension
options.zh: 门静脉高压相关的食管静脉曲张出血

options.en: Peptic ulcer bleeding from NSAID use
options.zh: NSAID使用导致的消化性溃疡出血

correct.en: Known cirrhosis, portal hypertension, documented esophageal varices, large-volume hematemesis, ascites, caput medusae, and coagulopathy all point to variceal hemorrhage. The nurse should anticipate variceal-specific therapy while endoscopy is being arranged.
correct.zh: 已知肝硬化、门静脉高压、既往食管静脉曲张、大量呕血、腹水、海蛇头样静脉曲张和凝血异常共同指向静脉曲张出血。安排内镜的同时，护士应预期静脉曲张出血的特异性治疗。

byChoice.en: Hemorrhoids cause lower GI bleeding, not large-volume bright red hematemesis.
byChoice.zh: 痔疮导致下消化道出血，不会造成大量鲜红色呕血。

byChoice.en: Peptic ulcer disease remains possible in upper GI bleeding, but this patient denies NSAID use and has a stronger variceal risk pattern.
byChoice.zh: 上消化道出血仍可能来自消化性溃疡，但患者否认NSAID使用，且静脉曲张风险模式更强。

byChoice.en: This is the best hypothesis because the patient has known portal hypertension and prior esophageal varices with massive hematemesis.
byChoice.zh: 这是最佳假设，因为患者有已知门静脉高压和既往食管静脉曲张，并出现大量呕血。

byChoice.en: A Mallory-Weiss tear usually follows forceful retching and is not the priority hypothesis when known varices and portal hypertension are present.
byChoice.zh: 贲门黏膜撕裂通常发生在剧烈干呕后；在已知静脉曲张和门静脉高压存在时，不是优先假设。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use the history that changes management. Prior varices plus cirrhosis turns hematemesis into a presumed variceal bleed until proven otherwise.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 抓住会改变处理方向的病史。既往静脉曲张加肝硬化，使呕血在证实前应按疑似静脉曲张出血处理。

glossary.defZh: 门静脉高压导致食管静脉扩张，破裂时可发生危及生命的呕血。
胃或十二指肠黏膜破损，可导致上消化道出血。
呕吐或干呕后胃食管交界处黏膜撕裂导致出血。

stem.en: The provider orders 1 unit PRBC with a target hemoglobin of 7-8 g/dL. Which concurrent interventions should the nurse implement or anticipate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 医嘱输注1单位浓缩红细胞，目标血红蛋白7-8 g/dL。护士应执行或预期哪些同步干预？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Maintain NPO status and prepare for emergent EGD with band ligation.
options.zh: 维持禁食，准备急诊胃镜及套扎止血。

options.en: Transfuse additional PRBCs until hemoglobin reaches 10 g/dL.
options.zh: 继续输注红细胞直到血红蛋白达到10 g/dL。

options.en: Administer ceftriaxone prophylaxis as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱给予头孢曲松预防性抗感染。

options.en: Position with head of bed elevated and maintain airway readiness.
options.zh: 抬高床头并保持气道准备。

options.en: Give fresh frozen plasma solely to normalize the INR before endoscopy.
options.zh: 仅为在内镜前纠正INR而输注新鲜冰冻血浆。

options.en: Continue the octreotide infusion as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱继续奥曲肽静脉泵入。

correct.en: Octreotide, ceftriaxone, endoscopy readiness, NPO status, and airway protection are concurrent priorities in suspected variceal hemorrhage. The case protocol sets a restrictive PRBC target; routine liberal transfusion or large-volume plasma just to normalize cirrhosis-related INR can worsen volume/portal-pressure problems and delay definitive hemostasis.
correct.zh: 疑似静脉曲张出血时，奥曲肽、头孢曲松、内镜准备、禁食和气道保护是同步优先事项。本病例方案设定限制性红细胞输血目标；常规宽松输血或仅为纠正肝硬化相关INR而大量输注血浆，可能加重容量/门静脉压力问题并延误最终止血。

byChoice.en: Ceftriaxone is ordered for infection/SBP prophylaxis in a cirrhotic patient with GI hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 肝硬化合并消化道出血时，头孢曲松用于感染/SBP预防。

byChoice.en: A hemoglobin target of 10 g/dL is too liberal for this protocol and may increase portal pressure and rebleeding risk.
byChoice.zh: 把血红蛋白目标定到10 g/dL对本方案过于宽松，可能升高门静脉压力并增加再出血风险。

byChoice.en: Active hematemesis creates aspiration risk; positioning and airway readiness are nursing priorities.
byChoice.zh: 活动性呕血有误吸风险；体位和气道准备是护理优先事项。

byChoice.en: Octreotide reduces splanchnic blood flow and is used as a bridge to and after endoscopic therapy.
byChoice.zh: 奥曲肽可减少内脏血流，是内镜治疗前后用于降低静脉曲张出血风险的药物。

byChoice.en: Endoscopic band ligation is the definitive hemostatic intervention for active esophageal variceal bleeding, so NPO and preparation are appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 内镜套扎是活动性食管静脉曲张出血的关键止血措施，因此禁食和准备内镜是正确的。

byChoice.en: Chronic cirrhosis-related INR elevation is not an automatic reason to delay endoscopy for plasma correction; plasma adds volume and can worsen portal-pressure physiology.
byChoice.zh: 慢性肝硬化导致的INR升高并不自动要求为输血浆而推迟内镜；血浆会增加容量，可能加重门静脉压力问题。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several actions are ordered for an unstable bleed, separate concurrent stabilizing actions from harmful attempts to normalize every lab value.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不稳定出血题中有多项医嘱时，要区分同步稳定病情的措施和“纠正每个异常化验值”的有害做法。

glossary.defZh: 可降低内脏血流和门静脉压力的药物，常用于静脉曲张出血。
用橡皮圈结扎出血静脉曲张以达到止血。
含凝血因子的血液制品；不应仅因肝硬化INR升高而常规用于内镜前纠正。

stem.en: For each immediate post-banding nursing action or interpretation, indicate whether it is appropriate now.
stem.zh: 对于内镜套扎后的每项护理行动或判断，请判断当前是否适当。

rows.en: Continue the octreotide infusion per protocol.
rows.zh: 按方案继续奥曲肽泵入。

rows.en: Monitor for true rebleeding: new hematemesis, hemodynamic decline, or falling serial hemoglobin.
rows.zh: 监测真正再出血迹象：再次呕血、血流动力学恶化或连续血红蛋白下降。

rows.en: Treat the small amount of melena alone as proof of active rebleeding.
rows.zh: 仅凭少量黑便就认定为活动性再出血。

rows.en: Stop ceftriaxone because endoscopic hemostasis was achieved.
rows.zh: 因内镜止血成功而停止头孢曲松。

rows.en: Monitor mental status, ammonia trend, urine output, and creatinine.
rows.zh: 监测意识状态、氨水平趋势、尿量和肌酐。

rows.en: Transfuse more PRBCs now because hemoglobin is 7.8 g/dL.
rows.zh: 因血红蛋白7.8 g/dL立即继续输注红细胞。

correct.en: After banding, the hemorrhage markers are improving, but early rebleeding, infection, hepatic encephalopathy, and renal injury remain major risks. Melena alone can reflect digested earlier blood when hemoglobin and hemodynamics are stable.
correct.zh: 套扎后出血指标改善，但早期再出血、感染、肝性脑病和肾损伤仍是主要风险。在血红蛋白和血流动力学稳定时，单独黑便可来自先前出血的消化血液。

byChoice.en: Continuing octreotide is appropriate because vasoactive therapy is commonly continued after hemostasis to reduce early rebleeding risk.
byChoice.zh: 继续奥曲肽适当，因为止血后通常继续血管活性治疗以降低早期再出血风险。

byChoice.en: These are the correct indicators of recurrent bleeding and should be monitored closely.
byChoice.zh: 这些是真正再出血的正确指标，应密切监测。

byChoice.en: Melena alone is not proof of new bleeding when it follows large hematemesis and the hemoglobin and vital signs are stable.
byChoice.zh: 大量呕血后出现黑便，若血红蛋白和生命体征稳定，单独黑便不能证明新出血。

byChoice.en: Antibiotic prophylaxis is not stopped simply because banding controlled the bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 不能仅因套扎控制出血就停止预防性抗生素。

byChoice.en: Rising ammonia and creatinine after the bleed make encephalopathy and renal injury important surveillance targets.
byChoice.zh: 出血后氨和肌酐升高，使肝性脑病和肾损伤成为重要监测目标。

byChoice.en: Hemoglobin 7.8 g/dL is within the stated restrictive target, so more PRBCs are not indicated based on this value alone.
byChoice.zh: 血红蛋白7.8 g/dL在本方案限制性目标范围内，不能仅凭此数值继续输血。

testTakingStrategy.en: After an intervention, evaluate trajectory: what improved, what remains risky, and what finding is expected from earlier events.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 干预后要评估趋势：哪些改善了、哪些仍有风险、哪些发现可由先前事件解释。

glossary.defZh: 已控制的出血再次发生，可表现为新呕血、血压下降、心率上升或血红蛋白下降。
消化后的血液使粪便呈黑色柏油样，可来自先前上消化道出血。
晚期肝病中有效循环血量下降和肾血流改变导致肾功能恶化的过程。

stem.en: At Stage 3, which conclusions or nursing actions are supported by the current data? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段，根据当前资料支持哪些结论或护理行动？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Notify the provider that ascitic PMN count meets the SBP diagnostic threshold and anticipate antibiotic reassessment.
options.zh: 通知医护团队腹水PMN计数达到SBP诊断阈值，并预期重新评估抗生素方案。

options.en: Recognize hepatic encephalopathy and administer lactulose/rifaximin as ordered.
options.zh: 识别肝性脑病，并按医嘱给予乳果糖/利福昔明。

options.en: Continue serial neurological assessments, including orientation, level of consciousness, and asterixis.
options.zh: 继续连续神经系统评估，包括定向力、意识水平和扑翼样震颤。

options.en: Attribute the confusion to residual procedural sedation and defer lactulose until the next routine assessment.
options.zh: 将意识混乱归因于操作后残余镇静，推迟乳果糖至下一次常规评估。

options.en: Closely monitor urine output and creatinine because SBP with AKI raises concern for hepatorenal syndrome.
options.zh: 密切监测尿量和肌酐，因为SBP合并AKI提示肝肾综合征风险。

options.en: Give additional PRBCs to raise hemoglobin above 8 g/dL because the patient looks worse.
options.zh: 因患者看起来更差而追加输注红细胞，使血红蛋白超过8 g/dL。

correct.en: The hemorrhage appears controlled, but the patient has new hepatic encephalopathy, SBP by ascitic PMN count, and worsening renal function. The nursing priority shifts to treating encephalopathy, communicating SBP results, and tracking neurologic and renal trajectories.
correct.zh: 出血似乎已控制，但患者出现新的肝性脑病、腹水PMN计数符合SBP，以及肾功能恶化。护理重点转向治疗脑病、报告SBP结果，并追踪神经和肾功能趋势。

byChoice.en: Confusion, somnolence, asterixis, and ammonia 124 µmol/L support hepatic encephalopathy; lactulose and rifaximin are the ordered therapies.
byChoice.zh: 意识混乱、嗜睡、扑翼样震颤和氨124 µmol/L支持肝性脑病；乳果糖和利福昔明是医嘱治疗。

byChoice.en: Serial neurological assessment shows whether encephalopathy is improving or progressing despite therapy.
byChoice.zh: 连续神经系统评估可判断脑病在治疗后是改善还是进展。

byChoice.en: The stable hemoglobin of 7.6 g/dL and absence of new hematemesis argue against rebleeding; transfusion above target would not treat the current problem.
byChoice.zh: 血红蛋白7.6 g/dL稳定且无再次呕血，不支持再出血；超目标输血不能治疗当前问题。

byChoice.en: Creatinine is rising and urine output is falling in the setting of SBP, which raises concern for hepatorenal syndrome physiology.
byChoice.zh: 在SBP背景下肌酐上升且尿量下降，提示肝肾综合征相关风险。

byChoice.en: The decline occurs more than 12 hours after sedation, after the patient had been oriented, and includes new asterixis and marked hyperammonemia; deferring treatment is unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 意识下降发生在镇静12小时以上之后，且患者曾清醒定向，同时出现新的扑翼样震颤和明显高氨血症；推迟治疗不安全。

byChoice.en: Ascitic PMN 484 cells/µL exceeds the case threshold of 250 cells/µL, so SBP must be communicated and treatment reassessed.
byChoice.zh: 腹水PMN 484 cells/µL超过本病例250 cells/µL阈值，必须报告SBP并重新评估治疗。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a patient worsens after the initial emergency is controlled, ask whether the new data show a complication rather than failure of the first treatment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 初始急症控制后患者恶化时，要判断新资料是否提示并发症，而不是简单认为第一次治疗失败。

glossary.defZh: 肝功能衰竭或门体分流导致毒素积聚，引起意识和神经功能改变。
无明确腹腔感染源的腹水感染，肝硬化腹水患者风险较高。
手腕伸展时出现的不规则扑翼样抖动，常见于肝性脑病。
晚期肝病和门静脉高压背景下发生的功能性肾衰竭。

note: Campaign 17 A/B producer implementation; full parent preimage frozen; independent review pending

title.en: Unfolding case: IV opioid safety after surgery
title.zh: 展开病例：术后静脉阿片类药物安全

summary.en: A postoperative older adult with sleep apnea receives PRN IV opioid medication for severe pain and then develops oversedation cues.
summary.zh: 一名有睡眠呼吸暂停的术后老年患者因重度疼痛接受按需静脉阿片类药物，随后出现过度镇静线索。

content.en: Age 72. Open reduction and internal fixation of hip fracture this morning. Opioid-naive. History of obstructive sleep apnea; home CPAP is at bedside. Order: morphine 2 mg IV every 2 hours PRN severe pain. Current pain 8/10. Respiratory rate 16/min, SpO2 95% on room air, sedation score 1 (awake and alert). Last opioid dose was 5 hours ago.
content.zh: 72 岁。今晨行髋部骨折切开复位内固定术。既往未长期使用阿片类药物。有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停病史；家用 CPAP 在床旁。医嘱：吗啡 2 mg 静脉注射，每 2 小时按需用于重度疼痛。目前疼痛 8/10。呼吸频率 16 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 95%，镇静评分 1（清醒警觉）。上次使用阿片类药物为 5 小时前。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：给药前评估
PRN 吗啡给药前护理评估

content.en: Client reports sharp incisional pain 8/10 and splints the hip when turning. Respiratory rate 16/min, SpO2 95% on room air, blood pressure 132/76 mm Hg. Sedation score 1. Client says, 'I have never taken strong pain medicine before.' CPAP mask is clean and available.
content.zh: 患者诉切口锐痛 8/10，翻身时保护髋部。呼吸频率 16 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 95%，血压 132/76 mm Hg。镇静评分 1。患者说：“我以前从没用过强效止痛药。”CPAP 面罩清洁且可用。

title.en: Stage 2: Thirty minutes after IV morphine
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：静脉给吗啡 30 分钟后

content.en: Morphine 2 mg IV was given at 0900. At 0930, pain is 4/10. Respiratory rate 10/min, SpO2 90% on room air. The client drifts to sleep during conversation and needs repeated verbal stimulation to answer. Sedation score 3 (frequently drowsy, arousable, drifts off during conversation).
content.zh: 0900 静脉给吗啡 2 mg。0930 疼痛 4/10。呼吸频率 10 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 90%。患者交谈中不断入睡，需要反复言语刺激才回答。镇静评分 3（频繁嗜睡，可唤醒，交谈中又睡着）。

title.en: Stage 3: Stabilized and planning ongoing pain control
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：病情稳定并计划后续镇痛
稍后再评估与家属问题

content.en: At 1015 after stimulation, oxygen 2 L/min by nasal cannula, and provider notification, respiratory rate is 14/min and SpO2 is 95%. Sedation score is 1. Pain is 6/10 with turning. The adult child asks, 'Can I press the pain button for Dad if he is sleeping so he stays ahead of the pain?' Unit protocol requires respiratory rate and sedation reassessment 15 minutes after each IV opioid dose.
content.zh: 经过刺激、鼻导管吸氧 2 L/分并通知医护团队后，1015 呼吸频率 14 次/分，SpO2 95%。镇静评分 1。翻身时疼痛 6/10。成年子女问：“如果爸爸睡着了，我能帮他按止痛按钮，让疼痛不要加重吗？”科室流程要求每次静脉使用阿片类药物后 15 分钟复查呼吸频率和镇静情况。

stem.en: Using Stage 1 data, classify each finding as increasing risk for opioid-related respiratory depression or supporting safe PRN opioid administration.
stem.zh: 根据第 1 阶段资料，将每项发现分类为增加阿片类相关呼吸抑制风险，或支持安全按需给药。

correct.en: Opioid-naive status and sleep apnea increase risk, while an acceptable baseline respiratory rate, alert sedation score, severe pain report, and available CPAP support giving the ordered PRN opioid with close reassessment.
correct.zh: 未长期使用阿片类药物和睡眠呼吸暂停会增加风险；基础呼吸频率可接受、镇静评分清醒、重度疼痛以及 CPAP 可用，支持在密切复评下给予按需阿片类药物。

byChoice.en: Lack of opioid tolerance increases sensitivity to respiratory and sedation effects.
byChoice.zh: 缺乏阿片耐受性会增加对呼吸和镇静作用的敏感性。

byChoice.en: Sleep apnea increases risk for hypoventilation after opioids.
byChoice.zh: 睡眠呼吸暂停会增加使用阿片类后低通气风险。

byChoice.en: A normal baseline respiratory rate and alert sedation score do not require holding the dose by themselves.
byChoice.zh: 基础呼吸频率正常且清醒，本身不需要停用该剂量。

byChoice.en: Severe postoperative pain is an appropriate indication for ordered PRN analgesia.
byChoice.zh: 重度术后疼痛是按医嘱给予 PRN 镇痛药的适当指征。

byChoice.en: Available CPAP supports safe sleep-apnea management during recovery.
byChoice.zh: CPAP 可用有助于恢复期间安全管理睡眠呼吸暂停。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate risk factors from current instability; risk calls for closer monitoring, while instability calls for holding and escalating.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分风险因素和当前不稳定。风险提示加强监测；不稳定则需要暂停并升级处理。

glossary.termZh: 未使用过阿片类/无耐受
glossary.defZh: 没有长期规律使用阿片类药物，较容易发生镇静和呼吸抑制。
用于评估患者清醒程度以及阿片类药物安全性的量表。

rows.en: Opioid-naive older adult
rows.zh: 未长期使用阿片类药物的老年患者

rows.en: History of obstructive sleep apnea
rows.zh: 有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停病史

rows.en: Respiratory rate 16/min and sedation score 1
rows.zh: 呼吸频率 16 次/分且镇静评分 1

rows.en: Pain 8/10 with guarding during turning
rows.zh: 翻身时保护动作且疼痛 8/10

rows.en: CPAP available at bedside
rows.zh: CPAP 在床旁可用

columns.zh: 在监测下支持安全给药

stem.en: Stage 2 describes the client's condition 30 minutes after IV morphine.
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段描述静脉给吗啡 30 分钟后的患者情况。

correct.en: A respiratory rate of 10/min, oxygen saturation of 90%, and sedation score 3 after IV opioid indicate oversedation and hypoventilation requiring holding further opioids, stimulation, oxygen per order, and escalation.
correct.zh: 静脉使用阿片类后呼吸频率 10 次/分、氧饱和度 90%、镇静评分 3，提示过度镇静和低通气，需要暂停继续使用阿片类、刺激患者、按医嘱给氧并升级处理。

byChoice.en: The combination of low respiratory rate, decreased oxygen saturation, and frequent drowsiness is not expected pain relief alone.
byChoice.zh: 呼吸频率低、氧饱和度下降和频繁嗜睡的组合，并非单纯预期镇痛。

byChoice.en: The immediate nursing response is to prevent further respiratory depression and activate help rather than give more opioid.
byChoice.zh: 立即护理反应是防止进一步呼吸抑制并寻求协助，而不是再给吗啡类药物。

testTakingStrategy.en: After IV opioids, compare pain relief with respiratory and sedation findings; improved pain does not override respiratory compromise.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 静脉使用阿片类后，要同时比较镇痛效果、呼吸和镇静情况；疼痛改善不能掩盖呼吸受损。

glossary.defZh: 通气不足，可能导致氧饱和度下降和二氧化碳潴留。
药物作用导致过度嗜睡、反应变慢，可能伴随呼吸抑制。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should interpret the findings as {{1}} and should {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应将这些发现判断为 {{1}}，并应 {{2}}。

options.en: possible opioid-related oversedation and hypoventilation
options.zh: 可能为阿片类相关过度镇静和低通气

options.en: acute withdrawal from inadequate analgesia
options.zh: 镇痛不足导致急性戒断

options.en: expected pain relief only
options.zh: 仅为预期镇痛效果

options.en: hold additional opioid doses and stimulate the client while initiating ordered oxygen and escalation
options.zh: 暂停追加阿片类药物，刺激患者，同时开始医嘱氧疗并升级处理

options.en: give the next PRN dose early because pain remains 4/10
options.zh: 因疼痛仍为 4/10 而提前给予下一次 PRN 剂量

options.en: allow the client to sleep because pain improved
options.zh: 因疼痛改善而让患者继续睡眠

stem.en: Place the nursing actions for the Stage 2 change in the correct order.
stem.zh: 将针对第 2 阶段变化的护理行动按正确顺序排列。

correct.en: The sequence starts with immediate airway/breathing support and stopping further opioid exposure, then oxygen and monitoring, escalation and possible reversal, and documentation after the client is stabilized.
correct.zh: 顺序应从立即支持气道/呼吸和停止继续使用阿片类开始，然后给氧和监测，升级处理并可能使用拮抗剂，最后在患者稳定后记录。

byChoice.en: Further opioid exposure should stop once oversedation and low respirations are recognized.
byChoice.zh: 一旦发现过度镇静和呼吸减慢，应停止继续使用阿片类。

byChoice.en: Oxygen and continuous monitoring support oxygenation while help is activated.
byChoice.zh: 给氧和连续监测可在求助过程中支持氧合。

byChoice.en: Provider or rapid-response escalation is needed because reversal or additional orders may be required.
byChoice.zh: 可能需要拮抗剂或额外医嘱，因此需通知提供者或快速反应资源。

byChoice.en: Documentation follows safety interventions and reassessment of response.
byChoice.zh: 记录应在安全干预和疗效复评之后进行。

byChoice.en: Airway and breathing assessment with stimulation addresses the immediate physiologic threat.
byChoice.zh: 刺激并评估气道和呼吸可处理最紧急的生理威胁。

testTakingStrategy.en: For medication-related respiratory compromise, stabilize breathing before paperwork or routine education.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到药物相关呼吸受损时，先稳定呼吸，再做文书或常规宣教。

glossary.defZh: 阿片类药物拮抗剂，用于逆转严重阿片类相关呼吸抑制。
针对病情突然恶化而启动的紧急团队或流程。

options.en: Stop additional opioid administration and call for immediate assistance.
options.zh: 停止追加阿片类药物并立即呼叫协助。

options.en: Document the reassessment findings and the client's response after stabilization.
options.zh: 病情稳定后记录复评结果和患者反应。

options.en: Stimulate the client, raise the head of the bed, and assess airway and breathing.
options.zh: 刺激患者，抬高床头，并评估气道和呼吸。

options.en: Notify the provider or rapid-response resource and prepare naloxone if prescribed or protocol-directed.
options.zh: 通知医护提供者或快速反应资源，并在有医嘱或流程要求时准备纳洛酮。

options.en: Apply oxygen as ordered and attach continuous pulse oximetry.
options.zh: 按医嘱给氧并连接连续脉搏血氧监测。

stem.en: The adult child asks about pressing a pain-control button for the client. Which teaching points should the nurse include? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 成年子女询问是否可以替患者按止痛按钮。护士应包括哪些宣教？选择所有适用项。

correct.en: PCA safety requires that only the alert client activates dosing; family should report oversedation signs and support nonpharmacologic pain relief. Pain improvement does not eliminate respiratory monitoring.
correct.zh: PCA 安全要求只有清醒的患者本人触发给药；家属应报告过度镇静迹象，并支持非药物镇痛。疼痛改善并不取消呼吸监测。

byChoice.en: Family activation can cause dangerous opioid dosing when the client cannot self-assess sedation.
byChoice.zh: 家属代按可能在患者无法自评镇静时导致危险给药。

byChoice.en: Nonpharmacologic measures can lower opioid needs and support comfort.
byChoice.zh: 非药物措施可减少阿片类需求并促进舒适。

byChoice.en: These are warning signs of opioid-related respiratory compromise.
byChoice.zh: 这些是阿片类相关呼吸受损的警示征象。

byChoice.en: Respiratory and sedation monitoring remains necessary after opioid use even when pain improves.
byChoice.zh: 即使疼痛改善，使用阿片类后仍需监测呼吸和镇静。

byChoice.en: Patient-only activation reduces accidental dosing when the client is too sedated.
byChoice.zh: 仅由患者本人按压可减少患者过度镇静时的意外给药。

testTakingStrategy.en: For PCA questions, protect the lockout concept: the client must be awake enough to press the button personally.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到 PCA 题，抓住安全锁定概念：患者必须足够清醒并亲自按压。

glossary.defZh: 患者在安全锁定范围内自行触发止痛药给药的装置。
不用药物帮助缓解疼痛的方法，如体位调整、冷敷或放松。

options.en: A lower pain score means sedation and breathing no longer need monitoring.
options.zh: 疼痛评分降低表示不再需要监测镇静和呼吸。

options.en: Only the client should press a patient-controlled analgesia button when awake enough to do so.
options.zh: 只有患者本人在足够清醒时才应按患者自控镇痛按钮。

options.en: Call the nurse if the client becomes hard to wake, breathes slowly, or snores unusually.
options.zh: 如果患者难以叫醒、呼吸变慢或打鼾异常，应呼叫护士。

options.en: Family members may press the button while the client sleeps to prevent pain.
options.zh: 家属可在患者睡觉时按按钮以预防疼痛。

options.en: Use repositioning, splinting, ice if ordered, and relaxation along with medication.
options.zh: 配合药物使用体位调整、支托、按医嘱冰敷和放松技巧。

stem.en: Unit protocol in Stage 3 requires respiratory rate and sedation reassessment 15 minutes after each IV opioid dose. If an IV opioid dose is given at 1110, at what time should the nurse complete the reassessment? Use 24-hour time.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段的科室流程要求每次静脉使用阿片类药物后 15 分钟复查呼吸频率和镇静情况。如果 1110 给予一次静脉阿片类药物，护士应在什么时间完成复查？请使用 24 小时时间。

correct.en: 1110 plus 15 minutes equals 1125.

byChoice.en: The timing is based on the protocol stated in the stem: reassess 15 minutes after IV opioid administration.
byChoice.zh: 时间依据题干给出的流程：静脉使用阿片类药物后 15 分钟复查。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a timing rule is supplied in the stem, use that rule rather than memorizing a facility-specific policy.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 题干给出时间规则时，应使用该规则，而不是依赖某个机构政策记忆。

glossary.defZh: 干预或给药后再次评估患者状态和反应。
用 0000–2359 表示时间的方式。

title.en: Unfolding case: IV opioid safety after surgery
title.zh: 展开病例：术后静脉阿片类药物安全

summary.en: A postoperative older adult with sleep apnea receives PRN IV opioid medication for severe pain and then develops oversedation cues.
summary.zh: 一名有睡眠呼吸暂停的术后老年患者因重度疼痛接受按需静脉阿片类药物，随后出现过度镇静线索。

content.en: Age 72. Open reduction and internal fixation of hip fracture this morning. Opioid-naive. History of obstructive sleep apnea; home CPAP is at bedside. Order: morphine 2 mg IV every 2 hours PRN severe pain. Current pain 8/10. Respiratory rate 16/min, SpO2 95% on room air, sedation score 1 (awake and alert). Last opioid dose was 5 hours ago.
content.zh: 72 岁。今晨行髋部骨折切开复位内固定术。既往未长期使用阿片类药物。有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停病史；家用 CPAP 在床旁。医嘱：吗啡 2 mg 静脉注射，每 2 小时按需用于重度疼痛。目前疼痛 8/10。呼吸频率 16 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 95%，镇静评分 1（清醒警觉）。上次使用阿片类药物为 5 小时前。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：给药前评估
PRN 吗啡给药前护理评估

content.en: Client reports sharp incisional pain 8/10 and splints the hip when turning. Respiratory rate 16/min, SpO2 95% on room air, blood pressure 132/76 mm Hg. Sedation score 1. Client says, 'I have never taken strong pain medicine before.' CPAP mask is clean and available.
content.zh: 患者诉切口锐痛 8/10，翻身时保护髋部。呼吸频率 16 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 95%，血压 132/76 mm Hg。镇静评分 1。患者说：“我以前从没用过强效止痛药。”CPAP 面罩清洁且可用。

title.en: Stage 2: Thirty minutes after IV morphine
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：静脉给吗啡 30 分钟后

content.en: Morphine 2 mg IV was given at 0900. At 0930, pain is 4/10. Respiratory rate 10/min, SpO2 90% on room air. The client drifts to sleep during conversation and needs repeated verbal stimulation to answer. Sedation score 3 (frequently drowsy, arousable, drifts off during conversation).
content.zh: 0900 静脉给吗啡 2 mg。0930 疼痛 4/10。呼吸频率 10 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 90%。患者交谈中不断入睡，需要反复言语刺激才回答。镇静评分 3（频繁嗜睡，可唤醒，交谈中又睡着）。

title.en: Stage 3: Stabilized and planning ongoing pain control
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：病情稳定并计划后续镇痛
稍后再评估与家属问题

content.en: At 1015 after stimulation, oxygen 2 L/min by nasal cannula, and provider notification, respiratory rate is 14/min and SpO2 is 95%. Sedation score is 1. Pain is 6/10 with turning. The adult child asks, 'Can I press the pain button for Dad if he is sleeping so he stays ahead of the pain?' Unit protocol requires respiratory rate and sedation reassessment 15 minutes after each IV opioid dose. The recorded 0930 reassessment was 15 minutes later than the required 0915 check; the nurse reports the missed check through the unit safety process.
content.zh: 经过刺激、鼻导管吸氧 2 L/分并通知医护团队后，1015 呼吸频率 14 次/分，SpO2 95%。镇静评分 1。翻身时疼痛 6/10。成年子女问：“如果爸爸睡着了，我能帮他按止痛按钮，让疼痛不要加重吗？”科室流程要求每次静脉使用阿片类药物后 15 分钟复查呼吸频率和镇静情况。 记录中的 0930 复评比规定的 0915 检查晚了 15 分钟；护士通过科室安全流程报告此次漏查。

stem.en: Using Stage 1 data, classify each finding as increasing risk for opioid-related respiratory depression or supporting safe PRN opioid administration.
stem.zh: 根据第 1 阶段资料，将每项发现分类为增加阿片类相关呼吸抑制风险，或支持安全按需给药。

correct.en: Opioid-naive status and sleep apnea increase risk, while an acceptable baseline respiratory rate, alert sedation score, severe pain report, and available CPAP support giving the ordered PRN opioid with close reassessment.
correct.zh: 未长期使用阿片类药物和睡眠呼吸暂停会增加风险；基础呼吸频率可接受、镇静评分清醒、重度疼痛以及 CPAP 可用，支持在密切复评下给予按需阿片类药物。

byChoice.en: Lack of opioid tolerance increases sensitivity to respiratory and sedation effects.
byChoice.zh: 缺乏阿片耐受性会增加对呼吸和镇静作用的敏感性。

byChoice.en: Sleep apnea increases risk for hypoventilation after opioids.
byChoice.zh: 睡眠呼吸暂停会增加使用阿片类后低通气风险。

byChoice.en: A normal baseline respiratory rate and alert sedation score do not require holding the dose by themselves.
byChoice.zh: 基础呼吸频率正常且清醒，本身不需要停用该剂量。

byChoice.en: Severe postoperative pain is an appropriate indication for ordered PRN analgesia.
byChoice.zh: 重度术后疼痛是按医嘱给予 PRN 镇痛药的适当指征。

byChoice.en: Available CPAP supports safe sleep-apnea management during recovery.
byChoice.zh: CPAP 可用有助于恢复期间安全管理睡眠呼吸暂停。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate risk factors from current instability; risk calls for closer monitoring, while instability calls for holding and escalating.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分风险因素和当前不稳定。风险提示加强监测；不稳定则需要暂停并升级处理。

glossary.termZh: 未使用过阿片类/无耐受
glossary.defZh: 没有长期规律使用阿片类药物，较容易发生镇静和呼吸抑制。
用于评估患者清醒程度以及阿片类药物安全性的量表。

rows.en: Opioid-naive older adult
rows.zh: 未长期使用阿片类药物的老年患者

rows.en: History of obstructive sleep apnea
rows.zh: 有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停病史

rows.en: Respiratory rate 16/min and sedation score 1
rows.zh: 呼吸频率 16 次/分且镇静评分 1

rows.en: Pain 8/10 with guarding during turning
rows.zh: 翻身时保护动作且疼痛 8/10

rows.en: CPAP available at bedside
rows.zh: CPAP 在床旁可用

columns.zh: 在监测下支持安全给药

stem.en: Stage 2 describes the client's condition 30 minutes after IV morphine.
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段描述静脉给吗啡 30 分钟后的患者情况。

correct.en: A respiratory rate of 10/min, oxygen saturation of 90%, and sedation score 3 after IV opioid indicate oversedation and hypoventilation requiring holding further opioids, stimulation, oxygen per order, and escalation.
correct.zh: 静脉使用阿片类后呼吸频率 10 次/分、氧饱和度 90%、镇静评分 3，提示过度镇静和低通气，需要暂停继续使用阿片类、刺激患者、按医嘱给氧并升级处理。

byChoice.en: The combination of low respiratory rate, decreased oxygen saturation, and frequent drowsiness is not expected pain relief alone.
byChoice.zh: 呼吸频率低、氧饱和度下降和频繁嗜睡的组合，并非单纯预期镇痛。

byChoice.en: The immediate nursing response is to prevent further respiratory depression and activate help rather than give more opioid.
byChoice.zh: 立即护理反应是防止进一步呼吸抑制并寻求协助，而不是再给吗啡类药物。

testTakingStrategy.en: After IV opioids, compare pain relief with respiratory and sedation findings; improved pain does not override respiratory compromise.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 静脉使用阿片类后，要同时比较镇痛效果、呼吸和镇静情况；疼痛改善不能掩盖呼吸受损。

glossary.defZh: 通气不足，可能导致氧饱和度下降和二氧化碳潴留。
药物作用导致过度嗜睡、反应变慢，可能伴随呼吸抑制。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should interpret the findings as {{1}} and should {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应将这些发现判断为 {{1}}，并应 {{2}}。

options.en: possible opioid-related oversedation and hypoventilation
options.zh: 可能为阿片类相关过度镇静和低通气

options.en: acute withdrawal from inadequate analgesia
options.zh: 镇痛不足导致急性戒断

options.en: expected pain relief only
options.zh: 仅为预期镇痛效果

options.en: hold additional opioid doses and stimulate the client while initiating ordered oxygen and escalation
options.zh: 暂停追加阿片类药物，刺激患者，同时开始医嘱氧疗并升级处理

options.en: give the next PRN dose early because pain remains 4/10
options.zh: 因疼痛仍为 4/10 而提前给予下一次 PRN 剂量

options.en: allow the client to sleep because pain improved
options.zh: 因疼痛改善而让患者继续睡眠

stem.en: For the Stage 2 change, classify each action as part of the immediate response, which can proceed concurrently with help, or as documentation after stabilization.
stem.zh: 针对阶段 2 的变化，将各项措施分为可在协助下并行开展的立即处理，或病情稳定后的记录。

correct.en: Stimulate and assess airway and breathing, prevent further opioid exposure, apply ordered oxygen and monitoring, and summon the provider or rapid-response resources as coordinated immediate actions. Prepare reversal when prescribed or protocol-directed. Documentation follows stabilization; airway and ventilation support must not wait for paperwork.
correct.zh: 刺激并评估气道及呼吸、防止继续阿片暴露、按医嘱吸氧和监测、呼叫医护提供者或快速反应资源，均为需协调开展的立即措施。在有医嘱或流程指示时准备拮抗治疗。记录应在病情稳定后完成，不能因文书工作而延误气道及通气支持。

byChoice.en: Further opioid exposure should stop once oversedation and low respirations are recognized.
byChoice.zh: 一旦发现过度镇静和呼吸减慢，应停止继续使用阿片类。

byChoice.en: Oxygen and continuous monitoring support oxygenation while help is activated.
byChoice.zh: 给氧和连续监测可在求助过程中支持氧合。

byChoice.en: Provider or rapid-response escalation is needed because reversal or additional orders may be required.
byChoice.zh: 可能需要拮抗剂或额外医嘱，因此需通知提供者或快速反应资源。

byChoice.en: Documentation follows safety interventions and reassessment of response.
byChoice.zh: 记录应在安全干预和疗效复评之后进行。

byChoice.en: Airway and breathing assessment with stimulation addresses the immediate physiologic threat.
byChoice.zh: 刺激并评估气道和呼吸可处理最紧急的生理威胁。

testTakingStrategy.en: For medication-related respiratory compromise, stabilize breathing before paperwork or routine education.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到药物相关呼吸受损时，先稳定呼吸，再做文书或常规宣教。

glossary.defZh: 阿片类药物拮抗剂，用于逆转严重阿片类相关呼吸抑制。
针对病情突然恶化而启动的紧急团队或流程。

rows.en: Stop additional opioid administration and call for immediate assistance.
rows.zh: 停止追加阿片类药物并立即呼叫协助。

rows.en: Document the reassessment findings and the client's response after stabilization.
rows.zh: 病情稳定后记录复评结果和患者反应。

rows.en: Stimulate the client, raise the head of the bed, and assess airway and breathing.
rows.zh: 刺激患者，抬高床头，并评估气道和呼吸。

rows.en: Notify the provider or rapid-response resource and prepare naloxone if prescribed or protocol-directed.
rows.zh: 通知医护提供者或快速反应资源，并在有医嘱或流程要求时准备纳洛酮。

rows.en: Apply oxygen as ordered and attach continuous pulse oximetry.
rows.zh: 按医嘱给氧并连接连续脉搏血氧监测。

columns.zh: 立即处理；协调并行措施

stem.en: The adult child asks about pressing a pain-control button for the client. Which teaching points should the nurse include? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 成年子女询问是否可以替患者按止痛按钮。护士应包括哪些宣教？选择所有适用项。

correct.en: PCA safety requires that only the alert client activates dosing; family should report oversedation signs and support nonpharmacologic pain relief. Pain improvement does not eliminate respiratory monitoring.
correct.zh: PCA 安全要求只有清醒的患者本人触发给药；家属应报告过度镇静迹象，并支持非药物镇痛。疼痛改善并不取消呼吸监测。

byChoice.en: Family activation can cause dangerous opioid dosing when the client cannot self-assess sedation.
byChoice.zh: 家属代按可能在患者无法自评镇静时导致危险给药。

byChoice.en: Nonpharmacologic measures can lower opioid needs and support comfort.
byChoice.zh: 非药物措施可减少阿片类需求并促进舒适。

byChoice.en: These are warning signs of opioid-related respiratory compromise.
byChoice.zh: 这些是阿片类相关呼吸受损的警示征象。

byChoice.en: Respiratory and sedation monitoring remains necessary after opioid use even when pain improves.
byChoice.zh: 即使疼痛改善，使用阿片类后仍需监测呼吸和镇静。

byChoice.en: Patient-only activation reduces accidental dosing when the client is too sedated.
byChoice.zh: 仅由患者本人按压可减少患者过度镇静时的意外给药。

testTakingStrategy.en: For PCA questions, protect the lockout concept: the client must be awake enough to press the button personally.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到 PCA 题，抓住安全锁定概念：患者必须足够清醒并亲自按压。

glossary.defZh: 患者在安全锁定范围内自行触发止痛药给药的装置。
不用药物帮助缓解疼痛的方法，如体位调整、冷敷或放松。

options.en: A lower pain score means sedation and breathing no longer need monitoring.
options.zh: 疼痛评分降低表示不再需要监测镇静和呼吸。

options.en: Only the client should press a patient-controlled analgesia button when awake enough to do so.
options.zh: 只有患者本人在足够清醒时才应按患者自控镇痛按钮。

options.en: Call the nurse if the client becomes hard to wake, breathes slowly, or snores unusually.
options.zh: 如果患者难以叫醒、呼吸变慢或打鼾异常，应呼叫护士。

options.en: Family members may press the button while the client sleeps to prevent pain.
options.zh: 家属可在患者睡觉时按按钮以预防疼痛。

options.en: Use repositioning, splinting, ice if ordered, and relaxation along with medication.
options.zh: 配合药物使用体位调整、支托、按医嘱冰敷和放松技巧。

stem.en: Unit protocol in Stage 3 requires respiratory rate and sedation reassessment 15 minutes after each IV opioid dose. If an IV opioid dose is given at 1110, at what time should the nurse complete the reassessment? Use 24-hour time.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段的科室流程要求每次静脉使用阿片类药物后 15 分钟复查呼吸频率和镇静情况。如果 1110 给予一次静脉阿片类药物，护士应在什么时间完成复查？请使用 24 小时时间。

correct.en: 1110 plus 15 minutes equals 1125.

byChoice.en: The timing is based on the protocol stated in the stem: reassess 15 minutes after IV opioid administration.
byChoice.zh: 时间依据题干给出的流程：静脉使用阿片类药物后 15 分钟复查。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a timing rule is supplied in the stem, use that rule rather than memorizing a facility-specific policy.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 题干给出时间规则时，应使用该规则，而不是依赖某个机构政策记忆。

glossary.defZh: 干预或给药后再次评估患者状态和反应。
用 0000–2359 表示时间的方式。

note: Campaign 17 A/B producer implementation; full parent preimage frozen; independent review pending

title.zh: 展开病例：儿童口服补液

summary.en: A toddler with vomiting and diarrhea is assessed for dehydration and the parent needs oral rehydration teaching and return precautions.
summary.zh: 一名幼儿出现呕吐和腹泻，需要评估脱水，家长需要口服补液宣教和返诊警示。

content.en: Age 18 months. Weight 11 kg. Vomiting and watery diarrhea for 18 hours after other children at daycare were ill. No blood in stool. Child is alert, cries with tears, has dry lips, capillary refill 2 seconds, and had one wet diaper in 6 hours. Oral rehydration protocol for this clinic: give 75 mL/kg of oral rehydration solution over 4 hours for mild to moderate dehydration.
content.zh: 18 个月。体重 11 kg。日托其他儿童生病后，患儿呕吐和水样腹泻 18 小时。大便无血。患儿清醒，哭时有泪，唇干，毛细血管再充盈 2 秒，6 小时内有 1 次湿尿布。本门诊口服补液流程：轻至中度脱水在 4 小时内给予口服补液盐 75 mL/kg。

content.en: Parent reports five watery stools and three vomiting episodes today. Child is interested in a toy and drinks a few sips from a cup. Temperature 100 °F (37.8 °C). Heart rate 128/min. Mucous membranes are mildly dry. No lethargy, sunken eyes, bilious emesis, or severe abdominal distention is noted.
content.zh: 家长报告今天水样便 5 次、呕吐 3 次。患儿对玩具感兴趣，能从杯子喝几口。体温 100 °F (37.8 °C)。心率 128 次/分。黏膜轻度干燥。未见嗜睡、眼窝凹陷、胆汁性呕吐或严重腹胀。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段：口服补液宣教

content.en: Parent says, 'I gave a sports drink because it has electrolytes, then he vomited after gulping half a cup. Should I stop all fluids until tomorrow?' The nurse prepares oral rehydration solution and a 5-mL syringe.
content.zh: 家长说：“我给了运动饮料，因为里面有电解质，后来他大口喝了半杯就吐了。我是不是应该到明天前都不给喝？”护士准备了口服补液盐和 5 mL 注射器。

content.en: After oral rehydration, child is playful, keeps down small frequent sips, and has another wet diaper. Parent asks which signs mean they should call or return urgently. The nurse reviews continuing oral rehydration solution, resuming age-appropriate foods as tolerated, and avoiding large boluses of sweet drinks.
content.zh: 口服补液后，患儿能玩耍，能保留少量多次饮水，并再次尿湿尿布。家长询问哪些表现意味着需要打电话或紧急返回。护士复习继续口服补液盐、按耐受恢复适龄食物，并避免一次大量饮用甜饮料。

stem.en: Using Stage 1 data, classify each cue as consistent with mild/moderate dehydration suitable for oral rehydration teaching or requiring urgent escalation.
stem.zh: 根据第 1 阶段资料，将每项线索分类为符合可进行口服补液宣教的轻/中度脱水，或需要紧急升级处理。

correct.en: Alert behavior, some urine output, and mild dryness fit oral rehydration teaching. No tears and bilious vomiting are more concerning cues that require escalation.
correct.zh: 清醒、有一定尿量和轻度干燥符合口服补液宣教。哭时无泪和胆汁性呕吐是更令人担忧的线索，需要升级处理。

byChoice.en: Alert interaction suggests the child is not severely lethargic.
byChoice.zh: 能互动提示患儿没有严重嗜睡。

byChoice.en: Reduced urine output indicates dehydration but is still present, supporting close oral rehydration and monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 尿量减少提示脱水，但仍有尿量，支持密切口服补液和监测。

byChoice.en: Absence of tears can indicate more significant dehydration.
byChoice.zh: 无泪可能提示更明显脱水。

byChoice.en: Bilious emesis is not typical simple gastroenteritis teaching and needs urgent evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 胆汁性呕吐不是简单胃肠炎宣教范围，需要紧急评估。

byChoice.en: Mild mucous membrane dryness supports oral rehydration teaching when no red flags are present.
byChoice.zh: 无危险信号时，黏膜轻度干燥支持口服补液宣教。

testTakingStrategy.en: Look for red flags that move a dehydration item from teaching to urgent evaluation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 寻找把脱水题从宣教转为紧急评估的危险信号。

glossary.defZh: 含适当比例糖和电解质、用于补充腹泻呕吐丢失的液体。
带绿色胆汁的呕吐，可能提示肠梗阻等严重问题。

rows.en: Alert and interested in a toy
rows.zh: 清醒且对玩具感兴趣

rows.en: One wet diaper in 6 hours
rows.zh: 6 小时内 1 次湿尿布

rows.en: No tears when crying
rows.zh: 哭时无泪

rows.en: Bilious vomiting
rows.zh: 胆汁性呕吐

rows.en: Mildly dry mucous membranes
rows.zh: 黏膜轻度干燥

stem.en: The clinic protocol in the baseline note is 75 mL/kg of oral rehydration solution over 4 hours. The child weighs 11 kg. How many mL should the nurse teach the parent to offer over 4 hours?
stem.zh: 基础记录中的门诊流程为 4 小时内给予口服补液盐 75 mL/kg。患儿体重 11 kg。护士应教家长 4 小时内给予多少 mL？

correct.en: 75 mL/kg × 11 kg = 825 mL over 4 hours.
correct.zh: 75 mL/kg × 11 kg = 4 小时 825 mL。

byChoice.en: Use the formula explicitly provided in the stem: 75 multiplied by 11.
byChoice.zh: 使用题干明确给出的公式：75 乘以 11。

testTakingStrategy.en: For pediatric fluid calculations, write the formula with units before multiplying.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 儿童补液计算应先写出带单位的公式，再相乘。

glossary.defZh: 按体重计算液体或药物量的单位。
可出现口干、尿量减少等，但无休克或严重精神状态改变。

stem.en: Stage 2 describes vomiting after a large amount of sports drink.
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段描述一次大量饮用运动饮料后呕吐。

correct.en: Oral rehydration solution is preferred because it has appropriate electrolytes and glucose. Small frequent amounts are better tolerated after vomiting than large boluses or withholding fluids for a full day.
correct.zh: 口服补液盐含适当电解质和葡萄糖，因此优先使用。呕吐后少量多次比一次大量或整天禁液更容易耐受。

byChoice.en: ORS is designed for diarrheal fluid losses; sweet drinks can worsen diarrhea or be poorly balanced.
byChoice.zh: 口服补液盐针对腹泻液体丢失设计；甜饮料可能加重腹泻或电解质比例不合适。

byChoice.en: Small frequent volumes reduce vomiting and still replace fluid.
byChoice.zh: 少量多次可减少呕吐，同时补充液体。

testTakingStrategy.en: If vomiting occurs during ORS, reduce the amount per offer rather than stopping all fluids.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 口服补液过程中呕吐时，应减少每次给予量，而不是停止所有液体。

glossary.defZh: 含糖和部分电解质的饮料，但并非婴幼儿腹泻补液首选。
短时间内给予较大液体量。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should teach the parent to use {{1}} and give it {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应教家长使用 {{1}}，并 {{2}} 给予。

options.en: undiluted fruit juice
options.zh: 未稀释果汁

options.en: only plain water for the rest of the day
options.zh: 当天剩余时间只喝白水

options.en: oral rehydration solution
options.zh: 口服补液盐

options.en: as one full cup every hour to finish quickly
options.zh: 每小时一整杯以尽快完成

options.en: only after 24 hours without vomiting
options.zh: 仅在 24 小时不再呕吐后给予

options.en: in small frequent amounts, such as 5 to 10 mL every few minutes after a brief pause
options.zh: 短暂停顿后少量多次给予，例如每隔几分钟 5–10 mL

stem.en: Place the home oral rehydration steps in the order the nurse should teach after the child vomits once.
stem.zh: 将患儿呕吐一次后护士应宣教的居家口服补液步骤按顺序排列。

correct.en: After vomiting, the parent should pause briefly, restart ORS in small amounts, increase as tolerated, resume appropriate foods, and seek care for red flags or failed oral intake.
correct.zh: 呕吐后应短暂停顿，再以少量重启口服补液，按耐受逐渐增加，恢复适当食物，并在危险信号或无法口服时就医。

byChoice.en: A brief pause helps reduce immediate repeat vomiting and supports safety.
byChoice.zh: 短暂停顿有助于减少立即再次呕吐并保障安全。

byChoice.en: Escalation is needed if home oral rehydration fails or red flags appear.
byChoice.zh: 若居家口服补液失败或出现危险信号，需要升级就医。

byChoice.en: Small volumes are more likely to be tolerated.
byChoice.zh: 少量更容易耐受。

byChoice.en: Gradual increases match improving tolerance.
byChoice.zh: 逐渐增加符合耐受改善过程。

byChoice.en: Food can resume as tolerated rather than prolonged fasting.
byChoice.zh: 可按耐受恢复食物，而不是长时间禁食。

testTakingStrategy.en: Teaching sequences often move from immediate tolerance, to gradual progression, to clear return precautions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 宣教顺序常从立即耐受处理，到逐渐推进，再到明确返诊警示。

glossary.defZh: 告诉家属哪些症状需要联系医疗人员或返回就医。
摄入后未明显加重症状或呕吐。

options.en: Pause fluids briefly and keep the child upright or positioned safely.
options.zh: 短暂停止液体，并让患儿保持直立或安全体位。

options.en: Increase the amount gradually as vomiting decreases.
options.zh: 呕吐减少后逐渐增加每次给予量。

options.en: Seek care if red-flag symptoms or inability to keep down fluids develops.
options.zh: 如出现危险信号或无法保留液体，应就医。

options.en: Restart oral rehydration solution in very small amounts.
options.zh: 重新以很少量给予口服补液盐。

options.en: Resume age-appropriate foods as tolerated while continuing fluids.
options.zh: 在耐受情况下恢复适龄食物，同时继续补液。

stem.en: Which parent statements from Stage 3 require the nurse to tell the parent to call or return urgently? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段中，哪些家长陈述需要护士告知其应打电话或紧急返回？选择所有适用项。

correct.en: No urine for a prolonged period, green/bilious vomiting, and bloody stool are red flags. Playfulness and tolerating food are reassuring signs.
correct.zh: 长时间无尿、绿色/胆汁性呕吐和血便是危险信号。能玩耍并能耐受食物是较令人放心的表现。

byChoice.en: Tolerating bland food supports recovery.
byChoice.zh: 能耐受清淡食物支持恢复。

byChoice.en: Blood in stool is not expected uncomplicated viral gastroenteritis teaching.
byChoice.zh: 血便不是单纯病毒性胃肠炎的预期表现。

byChoice.en: No wet diaper suggests worsening hydration status.
byChoice.zh: 没有湿尿布提示脱水可能加重。

byChoice.en: Green vomit can indicate bilious emesis and needs urgent evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 绿色呕吐物可能为胆汁性呕吐，需要紧急评估。

byChoice.en: Playfulness after small sips suggests improvement, not urgent escalation.
byChoice.zh: 少量饮水后能玩耍提示改善，而非紧急升级。

testTakingStrategy.en: Return-precaution options should distinguish worsening hydration or red flags from expected recovery signs.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 返诊警示题要区分脱水恶化/危险信号和预期恢复表现。

glossary.defZh: 婴幼儿尿量的实用观察指标。
大便中有血，可能提示需要进一步评估。

options.en: There is blood in the stool.
options.zh: 大便里有血。

options.en: His vomit is green.
options.zh: 他的呕吐物是绿色的。

options.en: He has no wet diaper for 8 hours.
options.zh: 他 8 小时没有湿尿布。

options.en: He is playful after small sips.
options.zh: 少量喝水后他能玩耍。

options.en: He wants bland food and keeps it down.
options.zh: 他想吃清淡食物且能保留。

title.zh: 展开病例：儿童口服补液

summary.en: A toddler with vomiting and diarrhea is assessed for dehydration and the parent needs oral rehydration teaching and return precautions.
summary.zh: 一名幼儿出现呕吐和腹泻，需要评估脱水，家长需要口服补液宣教和返诊警示。

content.en: Age 18 months. Weight 11 kg. Vomiting and watery diarrhea for 18 hours after other children at daycare were ill. No blood in stool. Child is alert, cries with tears, has dry lips, capillary refill 2 seconds, and had one wet diaper in 6 hours. Oral rehydration protocol for this clinic: give 75 mL/kg of oral rehydration solution over 4 hours for mild to moderate dehydration.
content.zh: 18 个月。体重 11 kg。日托其他儿童生病后，患儿呕吐和水样腹泻 18 小时。大便无血。患儿清醒，哭时有泪，唇干，毛细血管再充盈 2 秒，6 小时内有 1 次湿尿布。本门诊口服补液流程：轻至中度脱水在 4 小时内给予口服补液盐 75 mL/kg。

content.en: Parent reports five watery stools and three vomiting episodes today. Child is interested in a toy and drinks a few sips from a cup. Temperature 100 °F (37.8 °C). Heart rate 128/min. Mucous membranes are mildly dry. No lethargy, sunken eyes, bilious emesis, or severe abdominal distention is noted.
content.zh: 家长报告今天水样便 5 次、呕吐 3 次。患儿对玩具感兴趣，能从杯子喝几口。体温 100 °F (37.8 °C)。心率 128 次/分。黏膜轻度干燥。未见嗜睡、眼窝凹陷、胆汁性呕吐或严重腹胀。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段：口服补液宣教

content.en: Parent says, 'I gave a sports drink because it has electrolytes, then he vomited after gulping half a cup. Should I stop all fluids until tomorrow?' The nurse prepares oral rehydration solution and a 5-mL syringe.
content.zh: 家长说：“我给了运动饮料，因为里面有电解质，后来他大口喝了半杯就吐了。我是不是应该到明天前都不给喝？”护士准备了口服补液盐和 5 mL 注射器。

content.en: After oral rehydration, child is playful, keeps down small frequent sips, and has another wet diaper. Parent asks which signs mean they should call or return urgently. The nurse reviews continuing oral rehydration solution, resuming age-appropriate foods as tolerated, and avoiding large boluses of sweet drinks.
content.zh: 口服补液后，患儿能玩耍，能保留少量多次饮水，并再次尿湿尿布。家长询问哪些表现意味着需要打电话或紧急返回。护士复习继续口服补液盐、按耐受恢复适龄食物，并避免一次大量饮用甜饮料。

stem.en: For a toddler being assessed for oral rehydration, classify each possible finding. Treat each row as a separate possibility, not as an additional finding in this child. For the non-red-flag rows, assume the child remains alert, adequately perfused and able to drink.
stem.zh: 评估幼儿是否适合口服补液时，将每项可能的表现进行分类。各行是独立的可能情况，并非本患儿新增的实际表现。对于没有危险信号的行，假定患儿仍清醒、灌注充分且能饮水。

correct.en: Alert interaction, reduced but present urine output and mild dryness may fit monitored oral rehydration when perfusion and drinking ability are adequate. Reduced responsiveness with poor perfusion requires urgent escalation. Bilious vomiting requires urgent evaluation for an alternative serious cause. These are possible findings; the current chart does not document decreased responsiveness, poor perfusion, or bilious vomiting.
correct.zh: 清醒互动、尿量减少但仍有尿，以及轻度干燥，在灌注和饮水能力充分时可符合严密监测下口服补液。反应减弱伴灌注不良需要紧急升级处理。胆汁性呕吐需要紧急评估其他严重病因。这些是可能的表现；当前病历未记录反应减弱、灌注不良或胆汁性呕吐。

byChoice.en: Alert interaction suggests the child is not severely lethargic.
byChoice.zh: 能互动提示患儿没有严重嗜睡。

byChoice.en: Reduced urine output indicates dehydration but is still present, supporting close oral rehydration and monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 尿量减少提示脱水，但仍有尿量，支持密切口服补液和监测。

byChoice.en: This combination suggests shock or severe dehydration, requiring urgent assessment and resuscitation rather than routine teaching alone.
byChoice.zh: 该组合提示休克或严重脱水，需要紧急评估和复苏，而非仅作常规宣教。

byChoice.en: Bilious emesis is not typical simple gastroenteritis teaching and needs urgent evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 胆汁性呕吐不是简单胃肠炎宣教范围，需要紧急评估。

byChoice.en: Mild mucous membrane dryness supports oral rehydration teaching when no red flags are present.
byChoice.zh: 无危险信号时，黏膜轻度干燥支持口服补液宣教。

testTakingStrategy.en: Look for red flags that move a dehydration item from teaching to urgent evaluation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 寻找把脱水题从宣教转为紧急评估的危险信号。

glossary.defZh: 含适当比例糖和电解质、用于补充腹泻呕吐丢失的液体。
带绿色胆汁的呕吐，可能提示肠梗阻等严重问题。

rows.en: Alert and interested in a toy
rows.zh: 清醒且对玩具感兴趣

rows.en: One wet diaper in 6 hours
rows.zh: 6 小时内 1 次湿尿布

rows.en: Reduced responsiveness with cold, mottled extremities and weak pulses
rows.zh: 反应减弱，四肢冰冷、花斑，脉搏细弱

rows.en: Bilious vomiting
rows.zh: 胆汁性呕吐

rows.en: Mildly dry mucous membranes
rows.zh: 黏膜轻度干燥
