title.en: Unfolding case: home wound care and teach-back
title.zh: 展开病例：居家伤口护理与回示

summary.en: A client with diabetes and a foot ulcer receives home health teaching, but the caregiver initially demonstrates unsafe wound-care understanding.
summary.zh: 一名糖尿病足部溃疡患者接受居家护理宣教，但照护者最初显示出不安全的伤口护理理解。

title.zh: 居家护理转介基础记录

content.en: Age 64. Type 2 diabetes and peripheral neuropathy. Plantar foot ulcer after new shoes. Order: cleanse with normal saline, apply prescribed dressing daily, offload with boot when out of bed, and monitor blood glucose as directed. Last clinic measurement: length 2.8 cm, width 1.8 cm, shallow depth 0.2 cm.
content.zh: 64 岁。2 型糖尿病和周围神经病变。穿新鞋后出现足底溃疡。医嘱：用生理盐水清洁，每日使用处方敷料，离床时穿减压靴，并按指示监测血糖。上次门诊测量：长 2.8 cm，宽 1.8 cm，浅深度 0.2 cm。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：首次居家访视观察

content.en: Spouse says they will do the daily dressing. Supplies are on the kitchen table next to pet food. Spouse begins opening sterile gauze before hand hygiene. Client walks to the bathroom without the offloading boot, saying, 'It only hurts a little because my feet are numb.' Blood glucose log has not been checked for 3 days.
content.zh: 配偶说将负责每日换药。用品放在厨房桌上，旁边是宠物食物。配偶未洗手就开始打开无菌纱布。患者未穿减压靴走去卫生间，说：“因为脚麻，只是有点疼。”血糖记录已 3 天未查看。

content.en: After teaching, spouse states, 'If it looks dirty, I will clean it with hydrogen peroxide and pack the gauze tightly so it closes faster.' The wound has a new foul odor and increased yellow drainage. Periwound skin is warm. Temperature is 100.2 °F (37.9 °C). Client says the boot is uncomfortable and asks whether walking barefoot indoors is acceptable.
content.zh: 宣教后，配偶说：“如果看起来脏，我会用双氧水清洁，并把纱布塞紧，这样能更快闭合。”伤口出现新的恶臭和黄色渗液增多。伤口周围皮肤发热。体温 100.2 °F (37.9 °C)。患者说减压靴不舒服，询问在室内赤脚走路是否可以。

title.en: Stage 3: Follow-up measurement and revised plan
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：随访测量与修订计划

content.en: Current measurement: length 3.2 cm, width 2.1 cm, shallow depth 0.2 cm. Home health nurse re-teaches hand hygiene, clean field setup away from pets, normal-saline cleansing, prescribed dressing placement, offloading boot use, and when to call the wound clinic. Spouse performs a correct return demonstration after coaching.
content.zh: 当前测量：长 3.2 cm，宽 2.1 cm，浅深度 0.2 cm。居家护士重新宣教手卫生、远离宠物建立清洁操作区、生理盐水清洁、放置处方敷料、使用减压靴以及何时联系伤口门诊。经过指导后，配偶正确回示操作。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: Using Stage 1 data, classify each observation as safe wound-care practice or requiring correction.
stem.zh: 根据第 1 阶段资料，将每项观察分类为安全伤口护理做法或需要纠正。

correct.en: Caregiver participation can be safe after teaching, but poor hand hygiene, contaminated setup, lack of offloading, and missing glucose monitoring increase infection and delayed-healing risk.

byChoice.en: Hand hygiene should occur before handling dressing supplies.
byChoice.zh: 接触换药用品前应先进行手卫生。

byChoice.en: Pet-food areas increase contamination risk for wound supplies.
byChoice.zh: 宠物食物区域会增加伤口用品污染风险。

byChoice.en: A trained caregiver can support daily dressing changes.
byChoice.zh: 受过训练的照护者可以支持每日换药。

byChoice.en: Offloading reduces pressure on a neuropathic foot ulcer.
byChoice.zh: 减压可减少神经病变足溃疡受压。

byChoice.en: Glucose control affects wound healing and infection risk.
byChoice.zh: 血糖控制会影响伤口愈合和感染风险。

testTakingStrategy.en: Home-care questions often test whether the environment and return demonstration match the plan, not just whether supplies exist.

glossary.defZh: 通过鞋靴或装置减少伤口部位压力。
周围神经受损导致感觉下降、麻木或疼痛。

rows.en: Opening sterile gauze before hand hygiene
rows.zh: 未进行手卫生就打开无菌纱布

rows.en: Keeping dressing supplies next to pet food
rows.zh: 将换药用品放在宠物食物旁边

rows.en: Planning for a caregiver to perform daily dressing changes after teaching
rows.zh: 计划由照护者在宣教后每日换药

rows.en: Walking without the offloading boot despite neuropathy
rows.zh: 有神经病变仍未穿减压靴行走

rows.en: Blood glucose log not checked for 3 days
rows.zh: 血糖记录 3 天未查看

stem.en: Stage 2 includes the spouse's wound-care teach-back.
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段包含配偶的伤口护理回示。

correct.en: Hydrogen peroxide and tight packing are not the ordered wound-care method and can harm tissue or impair drainage. Failed teach-back requires re-teaching and coached return demonstration.
correct.zh: 双氧水和塞紧纱布并非医嘱伤口护理方法，可能损伤组织或影响引流。回示失败需要重新宣教并指导再次回示。

byChoice.en: The caregiver describes unsafe steps rather than minor wording differences.
byChoice.zh: 照护者描述的是不安全步骤，而非轻微表述差异。

byChoice.en: Re-teaching and return demonstration verify that the caregiver can perform the ordered care safely.
byChoice.zh: 重新宣教和回示可确认照护者能安全执行医嘱护理。

testTakingStrategy.en: A failed teach-back is not a learner failure; it is a signal to change the teaching method and verify again.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 回示失败不是学习者的失败，而是提示需要改变宣教方式并再次确认。

glossary.defZh: 消毒液，某些伤口中可能损伤新生组织，不能替代医嘱清洁方法。
让学习者实际演示护理步骤以确认技能掌握。

clozeStem.en: The spouse's response shows {{1}}, so the nurse should {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 配偶的回答显示 {{1}}，因此护士应 {{2}}。

options.en: teach-back failure with unsafe wound-care steps
options.zh: 回示失败且存在不安全伤口护理步骤

options.en: a harmless preference for different supplies
options.zh: 只是对不同用品的无害偏好

options.en: readiness to independently change the dressing
options.zh: 已准备好独立换药

options.en: stop independent return demonstration, re-teach using the ordered supplies, and coach another return demonstration
options.zh: 停止独立回示，使用医嘱用品重新宣教，并指导再次回示

options.en: skip further teaching and leave written instructions only
options.zh: 跳过进一步宣教，只留下书面说明

options.en: tell the spouse to continue because tight packing speeds healing
options.zh: 告诉配偶继续，因为塞紧纱布可加速愈合

stem.en: Which Stage 2 finding is the strongest reason for the home health nurse to contact the wound-care provider before leaving the home?
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段中哪项发现最能说明居家护士离开前应联系伤口护理提供者？

correct.en: New odor, increased drainage, warmth, and low-grade temperature suggest possible wound infection or deterioration and require provider notification. Teaching and comfort issues still need intervention but are less urgent.
correct.zh: 新的恶臭、渗液增多、发热和低热提示可能伤口感染或恶化，需要通知提供者。宣教和舒适问题也需处理，但紧急性较低。

byChoice.en: Coaching is appropriate but does not address possible infection by itself.
byChoice.zh: 指导是适当的，但本身不能处理可能感染。

byChoice.en: Barefoot walking is unsafe and needs teaching, but infection cues are more urgent.
byChoice.zh: 赤脚走路不安全，需要宣教，但感染线索更紧急。

byChoice.en: These combined wound changes indicate possible infection or worsening requiring escalation.
byChoice.zh: 这些伤口变化组合提示可能感染或恶化，需要升级处理。

byChoice.en: An uncomfortable device needs troubleshooting, but infection signs take priority.
byChoice.zh: 装置不舒适需要解决，但感染迹象优先。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several home-care issues exist, prioritize new objective deterioration over routine teaching needs.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 居家护理有多个问题时，优先处理新的客观恶化，而不是常规宣教需求。

glossary.defZh: 紧邻伤口边缘的皮肤区域。
从伤口流出的液体，量、颜色和气味可提示变化。

options.en: The spouse needs coaching on normal-saline cleansing.
options.zh: 配偶需要生理盐水清洁方面的指导。

options.en: The offloading boot is uncomfortable.
options.zh: 减压靴不舒服。

options.en: The client asks whether walking barefoot indoors is acceptable.
options.zh: 患者询问室内赤脚走路是否可以。

options.en: The wound has a new foul odor, increased yellow drainage, and warm periwound skin.
options.zh: 伤口出现新的恶臭、黄色渗液增多且周围皮肤发热。

stem.en: The baseline wound area was length 2.8 cm × width 1.8 cm. Stage 3 measurement is length 3.2 cm × width 2.1 cm. By how many square centimeters has the wound surface area increased? Round to the nearest hundredth if needed.
stem.zh: 基础伤口面积为长 2.8 cm × 宽 1.8 cm。第 3 阶段测量为长 3.2 cm × 宽 2.1 cm。伤口表面积增加了多少平方厘米？如需要，四舍五入到百分位。

correct.en: Baseline area is 2.8 × 1.8 = 5.04 cm². Current area is 3.2 × 2.1 = 6.72 cm². Increase = 6.72 − 5.04 = 1.68 cm².

byChoice.en: Compare wound area using length times width for each date, then subtract baseline from current.
byChoice.zh: 分别用长乘宽计算两次伤口面积，再用当前面积减去基础面积。

testTakingStrategy.en: For trend calculations, compute each measurement first and then compare; do not subtract length and width separately.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 趋势计算应先分别计算每次测量结果再比较；不要分别相减长和宽。

glossary.defZh: 此处指伤口长度乘以宽度得到的近似面积。
测量值随时间变化的方向和幅度。

stem.en: Place the nurse's teaching actions in the best order during the Stage 3 home visit.
stem.zh: 将第 3 阶段居家访视中的护士宣教行动按最佳顺序排列。

correct.en: The nurse begins by creating a safe setup, then demonstrates ordered care, verifies skill with return demonstration, addresses ongoing adherence barriers, and confirms escalation and follow-up.
correct.zh: 护士先建立安全操作环境，然后示范医嘱护理，通过回示确认技能，处理持续执行障碍，最后确认升级时机和随访。

byChoice.en: Clear call parameters and follow-up help sustain safe care after the visit.
byChoice.zh: 明确联系标准和随访有助于访视后持续安全护理。

byChoice.en: Demonstration shows the correct technique before asking the caregiver to perform it.
byChoice.zh: 先示范正确技术，再请照护者操作。

byChoice.en: Return demonstration verifies actual skill.
byChoice.zh: 回示可确认实际技能。

byChoice.en: Offloading and glucose monitoring barriers affect healing and must be addressed.
byChoice.zh: 减压和血糖监测障碍会影响愈合，必须处理。

byChoice.en: A clean setup and hand hygiene are prerequisites for dressing teaching.
byChoice.zh: 清洁操作区和手卫生是换药宣教的前提。

testTakingStrategy.en: Skill teaching usually moves from safe setup, to demonstration, to return demonstration, to barrier planning.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 技能宣教通常从安全准备，到示范，再到回示，最后处理执行障碍。

glossary.defZh: 用于放置用品并减少污染风险的清洁表面。
在初次护理后继续评估和支持患者计划。

options.en: Have the spouse perform a return demonstration using the actual supplies.
options.zh: 让配偶使用实际用品进行回示操作。

options.en: Confirm when to call the wound clinic and arrange the next follow-up contact.
options.zh: 确认何时联系伤口门诊并安排下一次随访联系。

options.en: Address barriers to offloading boot use and glucose-log checks.
options.zh: 处理减压靴使用和血糖记录检查的障碍。

options.en: Demonstrate cleansing with normal saline and applying the prescribed dressing.
options.zh: 示范用生理盐水清洁并放置处方敷料。

options.en: Set up a clean work area away from pets and food and perform hand hygiene.
options.zh: 在远离宠物和食物处建立清洁操作区并进行手卫生。

title.en: Unfolding case: home wound care and teach-back
title.zh: 展开病例：居家伤口护理与回示

summary.en: A client with diabetes and a foot ulcer receives home health visits for wound assessment and caregiver teaching.
summary.zh: 一名糖尿病足部溃疡患者接受居家护理访视，以评估伤口并开展照护者宣教。

title.zh: 居家护理转介基础记录

content.en: Age 64. Type 2 diabetes and peripheral neuropathy. Plantar foot ulcer after new shoes. Order: cleanse with normal saline, apply prescribed dressing daily, offload with boot when out of bed, and monitor blood glucose as directed. Last clinic measurement: length 2.8 cm, width 1.8 cm, shallow depth 0.2 cm.
content.zh: 64 岁。2 型糖尿病和周围神经病变。穿新鞋后出现足底溃疡。医嘱：用生理盐水清洁，每日使用处方敷料，离床时穿减压靴，并按指示监测血糖。上次门诊测量：长 2.8 cm，宽 1.8 cm，浅深度 0.2 cm。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：首次居家访视观察

content.en: Spouse says they will do the daily dressing. Supplies are on the kitchen table next to pet food. Spouse begins opening sterile gauze before hand hygiene. Client walks to the bathroom without the offloading boot, saying, 'It only hurts a little because my feet are numb.' Blood glucose log has not been checked for 3 days.
content.zh: 配偶说将负责每日换药。用品放在厨房桌上，旁边是宠物食物。配偶未洗手就开始打开无菌纱布。患者未穿减压靴走去卫生间，说：“因为脚麻，只是有点疼。”血糖记录已 3 天未查看。

content.en: After teaching, spouse states, 'If it looks dirty, I will clean it with hydrogen peroxide and pack the gauze tightly so it closes faster.' The wound has a new foul odor and increased yellow drainage. Periwound skin is warm. Temperature is 100.2 °F (37.9 °C). Client says the boot is uncomfortable and asks whether walking barefoot indoors is acceptable.
content.zh: 宣教后，配偶说：“如果看起来脏，我会用双氧水清洁，并把纱布塞紧，这样能更快闭合。”伤口出现新的恶臭和黄色渗液增多。伤口周围皮肤发热。体温 100.2 °F (37.9 °C)。患者说减压靴不舒服，询问在室内赤脚走路是否可以。

title.en: Stage 3: Follow-up measurement and revised plan
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：随访测量与修订计划

content.en: Current measurement: length 3.2 cm, width 2.1 cm, shallow depth 0.2 cm. Home health nurse re-teaches hand hygiene, clean field setup away from pets, normal-saline cleansing, prescribed dressing placement, offloading boot use, and when to call the wound clinic. Spouse performs a correct return demonstration after coaching.
content.zh: 当前测量：长 3.2 cm，宽 2.1 cm，浅深度 0.2 cm。居家护士重新宣教手卫生、远离宠物建立清洁操作区、生理盐水清洁、放置处方敷料、使用减压靴以及何时联系伤口门诊。经过指导后，配偶正确回示操作。

correct.zh: 护士先建立安全操作环境，然后示范医嘱护理，通过回示确认技能，处理持续执行障碍，最后确认升级时机和随访。

byChoice.en: Clear call parameters and follow-up help sustain safe care after the visit.
byChoice.zh: 明确联系标准和随访有助于访视后持续安全护理。

byChoice.en: Demonstration shows the correct technique before asking the caregiver to perform it.
byChoice.zh: 先示范正确技术，再请照护者操作。

byChoice.en: Return demonstration verifies actual skill.
byChoice.zh: 回示可确认实际技能。

byChoice.en: Offloading and glucose monitoring barriers affect healing and must be addressed.
byChoice.zh: 减压和血糖监测障碍会影响愈合，必须处理。

byChoice.en: A clean setup and hand hygiene are prerequisites for dressing teaching.
byChoice.zh: 清洁操作区和手卫生是换药宣教的前提。

testTakingStrategy.en: Skill teaching usually moves from safe setup, to demonstration, to return demonstration, to barrier planning.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 技能宣教通常从安全准备，到示范，再到回示，最后处理执行障碍。

glossary.defZh: 用于放置用品并减少污染风险的清洁表面。
在初次护理后继续评估和支持患者计划。

options.en: Have the spouse perform a return demonstration using the actual supplies.
options.zh: 让配偶使用实际用品进行回示操作。

options.en: Confirm when to call the wound clinic and arrange the next follow-up contact.
options.zh: 确认何时联系伤口门诊并安排下一次随访联系。

options.en: Address barriers to offloading boot use and glucose-log checks.
options.zh: 处理减压靴使用和血糖记录检查的障碍。

options.en: Demonstrate cleansing with normal saline and applying the prescribed dressing.
options.zh: 示范用生理盐水清洁并放置处方敷料。

options.en: Set up a clean work area away from pets and food and perform hand hygiene.
options.zh: 在远离宠物和食物处建立清洁操作区并进行手卫生。

note: Campaign 17 A/B producer implementation; full parent preimage frozen; independent review pending

title.en: Unfolding case: COPD discharge with home oxygen
title.zh: 展开病例：COPD 患者带居家氧疗出院

summary.en: A client with COPD is being prepared for discharge with new home oxygen after hospitalization for an exacerbation.
summary.zh: 一名 COPD 患者因急性加重住院后，准备带新的居家氧疗出院。

content.en: Age 69. COPD. New order: oxygen 2 L/min by nasal cannula with activity and sleep. Lives with spouse in a small apartment. Uses a cane. SpO2 92% on 2 L/min after walking 30 feet.
content.zh: 69 岁。COPD。新医嘱：活动和睡眠时鼻导管吸氧 2 L/分。与配偶住在小公寓。使用手杖。步行 30 英尺后吸氧 2 L/分时 SpO2 为 92%。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：居家安全访谈

content.en: Spouse smokes on the apartment balcony while the sliding door is open. Client reports using petroleum jelly for dry nares. Oxygen tubing would cross the bedroom doorway unless furniture is moved. Client says, 'I set the machine to exactly 2 liters like the prescription says.'
content.zh: 配偶在阳台吸烟，滑动门开着。患者称会用凡士林缓解鼻腔干燥。如果不移动家具，氧气管会横跨卧室门口。患者说：“我会按处方把机器设为 2 升。”

content.en: Client states, 'If I feel short of breath, I can turn it up until I feel better.' Spouse asks whether a water-based nasal lubricant is acceptable. Both agree to move a bedside table so tubing does not cross the doorway.
content.zh: 患者说：“如果我觉得气短，可以把氧气调高，直到舒服为止。”配偶询问是否可以使用水性鼻腔润滑剂。两人同意移动床边桌，使管路不横跨门口。

title.zh: 第 3 阶段：设备准备情况

content.en: Concentrator delivery confirmed for 1600. Portable cylinder: 600 L usable oxygen. Prescribed activity flow: 2 L/min. Backup battery fully charged. Client and spouse complete a return demonstration of tubing placement and oxygen-in-use signage.
content.zh: 制氧机确认 1600 送达。便携氧气瓶：可用氧气 600 L。活动时处方流量：2 L/分。备用电池已充满电。患者和配偶完成管路摆放及正在使用氧气标识的回示演示。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: Using the initial home oxygen referral note, classify each finding as a safety concern or an expected finding for discharge teaching.
stem.zh: 根据初始居家氧疗转介记录，将每项发现归类为安全隐患或出院宣教中的预期发现。

correct.en: Smoking exposure, petroleum products near the cannula, and extension tubing across a walkway increase fire or fall risk. Correct oxygen flow use and a charged concentrator backup are expected safety behaviors.
correct.zh: 吸烟暴露、鼻导管附近使用含油产品以及延长管横跨走道会增加火灾或跌倒风险。按处方氧流量使用和备有充电的制氧机备用电源属于预期的安全行为。

byChoice.en: Active smoking around oxygen is a fire and burn hazard.
byChoice.zh: 在氧气附近吸烟会造成火灾和烧伤危险。

byChoice.en: Petroleum ointment can support combustion near oxygen equipment; water-based products are safer.
byChoice.zh: 含凡士林的软膏在氧气设备附近可能助燃；应使用水性产品。

byChoice.en: Keeping the oxygen at the prescribed flow rate is expected.
byChoice.zh: 按处方流量使用氧气是预期做法。

byChoice.en: Loose tubing across a walking path creates a fall hazard.
byChoice.zh: 管路横在行走通道上会造成跌倒风险。

byChoice.en: A charged backup power plan supports safe equipment use during outages.
byChoice.zh: 有充电备用电源计划有助于停电时安全使用设备。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate oxygen-fire hazards from ordinary equipment teaching; oxygen supports combustion even when it is not flammable itself.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将氧气相关火灾隐患与普通设备宣教分开判断；氧气本身不易燃，但会助燃。

glossary.defZh: 物质与氧反应并产生热和火焰的过程。
通过鼻孔给氧的低流量氧疗装置。

rows.en: Spouse smokes on the apartment balcony while the sliding door is open
rows.zh: 配偶在阳台吸烟，且滑动门开着

rows.en: Client applies petroleum jelly to dry nares before placing the cannula
rows.zh: 患者放置鼻导管前在干燥鼻腔涂凡士林

rows.en: Client sets the concentrator to 2 L/min as prescribed
rows.zh: 患者按处方将制氧机设为 2 L/分

rows.en: Oxygen tubing runs across the bedroom doorway
rows.zh: 氧气管路横跨卧室门口

rows.en: Portable concentrator battery is fully charged before leaving home
rows.zh: 外出前便携制氧机电池已充满电

stem.en: The nurse reviews the Stage 1 teaching session and identifies the discharge issue that must be corrected before the client leaves.
stem.zh: 护士查看第 1 阶段的宣教记录，并判断患者离院前必须纠正的出院问题。

correct.en: The client's statement about turning the oxygen higher during dyspnea shows unsafe self-adjustment. The nurse should reinforce using the prescribed flow rate and calling the provider or emergency services for worsening symptoms.
correct.zh: 患者表示气促时自行调高氧流量，说明存在不安全的自行调节。护士应强化按处方流量使用，并在症状加重时联系医护人员或急救服务。

byChoice.en: The most immediate teaching gap is unsafe self-adjustment of oxygen flow.
byChoice.zh: 最需要纠正的宣教缺口是患者不安全地自行调节氧流量。

byChoice.en: Using the prescribed flow rate and seeking help for worsening dyspnea is safer than changing the liter flow independently.
byChoice.zh: 按处方流量使用氧气，并在气促加重时求助，比自行改变流量更安全。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a home teaching statement includes independent dose or device changes, look for the response that restores the prescribed plan and escalation pathway.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 如果居家宣教反馈中出现自行改变剂量或设备设置，应选择能恢复处方计划并明确升级求助路径的回答。

glossary.defZh: 主观感觉呼吸费力或气不够用。
每分钟给予氧气的流量，通常以 L/min 表示。

clozeStem.en: The priority discharge barrier is {{1}}; the nurse should teach the client to {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 优先处理的出院障碍是 {{1}}；护士应教导患者 {{2}}。

options.en: self-adjusting oxygen flow for shortness of breath
options.zh: 因气短而自行调节氧流量

options.en: using pursed-lip breathing during activity
options.zh: 活动时使用缩唇呼吸

options.en: keeping the concentrator plugged into a grounded outlet
options.zh: 将制氧机插入接地插座

options.en: increase oxygen until the pulse oximeter reads 100%
options.zh: 增加氧流量直到血氧仪显示 100%

options.en: turn off oxygen during all household ambulation
options.zh: 在家中走动时都关闭氧气

options.en: use the prescribed flow and seek help if symptoms worsen
options.zh: 按处方流量使用，症状加重时求助

stem.en: The client is scheduled for discharge with new home oxygen after Stage 2. Place the nurse's actions in the best order.
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段后，患者计划带新的居家氧疗出院。请按最佳顺序排列护士的行动。

correct.en: The nurse first verifies the prescription and equipment plan, then confirms delivery and backup arrangements, assesses caregiver teach-back, and finally documents readiness and unresolved barriers.
correct.zh: 护士应先核对处方和设备计划，然后确认送达与备用安排，再评估照护者回示，最后记录出院准备情况和未解决障碍。

byChoice.en: Verifying the ordered oxygen settings and equipment prevents teaching from being based on an incorrect plan.
byChoice.zh: 先核对氧疗设置和设备，可避免基于错误计划进行宣教。

byChoice.en: Documentation follows assessment and coordination; unresolved barriers should be communicated in the record and handoff.
byChoice.zh: 记录应在评估和协调之后完成；未解决障碍需写入病历并交接。

byChoice.en: Teach-back verifies whether the client and caregiver can perform the safety behaviors at home.
byChoice.zh: 回示可验证患者和照护者是否能在家执行安全措施。

byChoice.en: Equipment delivery and backup power must be confirmed before discharge logistics are considered complete.
byChoice.zh: 出院流程完成前，必须确认设备送达和备用电源安排。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge sequencing, verify the order, arrange the resources, assess learning, then document and hand off unresolved risks.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理出院顺序时，先核对医嘱，再安排资源，再评估学习效果，最后记录并交接未解决风险。

glossary.defZh: 让患者用自己的话或动作展示理解情况的教育方法。
组织人员、设备和随访以支持安全过渡的过程。

options.en: Document discharge readiness and communicate any remaining barriers to the team
options.zh: 记录出院准备情况，并向团队沟通仍存在的障碍

options.en: Confirm home equipment delivery, tubing supply, and backup power plan
options.zh: 确认家用设备送达、管路供应和备用电源计划

options.en: Ask the client and spouse to demonstrate fire-safety and tubing-management steps
options.zh: 请患者和配偶演示防火和管路管理步骤

options.en: Verify the oxygen prescription, target use instructions, and equipment ordered
options.zh: 核对氧疗处方、目标使用说明和已订设备

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: During Stage 3 teach-back, which client statement shows correct understanding of home oxygen safety?
stem.zh: 在第 3 阶段回示中，哪项患者陈述表明其正确理解了居家氧疗安全？

correct.en: Posting oxygen-in-use notices and keeping oxygen away from smoking and flames are appropriate fire-safety steps.
correct.zh: 张贴正在使用氧气的提示，并让氧气远离吸烟和明火，是恰当的防火措施。

byChoice.en: A notice helps responders and visitors recognize the oxygen fire hazard.
byChoice.zh: 提示标识有助于急救人员和访客识别氧气相关火灾风险。

byChoice.en: Tubing should be arranged to prevent tripping, not hidden under rugs.
byChoice.zh: 管路应妥善摆放以防绊倒，不应藏在地毯下。

byChoice.en: Petroleum products should be avoided near the cannula because they may support burning.
byChoice.zh: 鼻导管附近应避免含油产品，因为可能助燃。

byChoice.en: Oxygen should not be used near smoking or open flames.
byChoice.zh: 氧气不应靠近吸烟或明火。

testTakingStrategy.en: Choose the statement that reduces both fire and fall risk without changing the prescribed therapy.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择既降低火灾和跌倒风险，又不改变处方治疗的陈述。

glossary.defZh: 可见火焰来源，如蜡烛、炉火或打火机。
增加绊倒、滑倒或跌倒风险的环境因素。

options.en: I will keep oxygen away from flames and post an oxygen-in-use notice.
options.zh: 我会让氧气远离明火，并张贴正在使用氧气的提示。

options.en: I can sit near someone smoking if my cannula is under my shirt.
options.zh: 如果鼻导管放在衣服下，我可以坐在吸烟的人旁边。

options.en: I should use petroleum jelly daily so my nose does not dry out.
options.zh: 我应该每天用凡士林，避免鼻子干燥。

options.en: I will place extra tubing under throw rugs so no one sees it.
options.zh: 我会把多余管路放在小地毯下面，这样别人看不到。

stem.en: Stage 3 equipment teaching states: The portable cylinder contains 600 L of usable oxygen. The prescribed flow is 2 L/min for activity. How many minutes of oxygen are available for activity? Round to the nearest whole minute.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段设备宣教写明：便携氧气瓶可用氧气量为 600 L。活动时处方流量为 2 L/分。该氧气瓶可供活动使用多少分钟？四舍五入到最接近的整数。

correct.en: Available time equals available volume divided by flow rate: 600 L ÷ 2 L/min = 300 minutes.
correct.zh: 可用时间等于可用容量除以流量：600 L ÷ 2 L/分 = 300 分钟。

byChoice.en: The blank asks for minutes: divide liters available by liters per minute.
byChoice.zh: 该空要求填写分钟数：用可用升数除以每分钟升数。

testTakingStrategy.en: Track the units. Liters divided by liters per minute leaves minutes.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 注意单位。升除以升/分钟，剩下的单位就是分钟。

glossary.defZh: 可携带的氧气供应容器。
每分钟给出的气体或液体体积。

stem.en: The client is scheduled for discharge with new home oxygen after Stage 2. Place the nurse's actions in the best order.
stem.zh: 第 2 阶段后，患者计划带新的居家氧疗出院。请按最佳顺序排列护士的行动。

correct.en: The nurse first verifies the prescription and equipment plan, then confirms delivery and backup arrangements, assesses caregiver teach-back, and finally documents readiness and unresolved barriers.
correct.zh: 护士应先核对处方和设备计划，然后确认送达与备用安排，再评估照护者回示，最后记录出院准备情况和未解决障碍。

byChoice.en: Verifying the ordered oxygen settings and equipment prevents teaching from being based on an incorrect plan.
byChoice.zh: 先核对氧疗设置和设备，可避免基于错误计划进行宣教。

byChoice.en: Documentation follows assessment and coordination; unresolved barriers should be communicated in the record and handoff.
byChoice.zh: 记录应在评估和协调之后完成；未解决障碍需写入病历并交接。

byChoice.en: Teach-back verifies whether the client and caregiver can perform the safety behaviors at home.
byChoice.zh: 回示可验证患者和照护者是否能在家执行安全措施。

byChoice.en: Equipment delivery and backup power must be confirmed before discharge logistics are considered complete.
byChoice.zh: 出院流程完成前，必须确认设备送达和备用电源安排。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge sequencing, verify the order, arrange the resources, assess learning, then document and hand off unresolved risks.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理出院顺序时，先核对医嘱，再安排资源，再评估学习效果，最后记录并交接未解决风险。

glossary.defZh: 让患者用自己的话或动作展示理解情况的教育方法。
组织人员、设备和随访以支持安全过渡的过程。

options.en: Document discharge readiness and communicate any remaining barriers to the team
options.zh: 记录出院准备情况，并向团队沟通仍存在的障碍

options.en: Confirm home equipment delivery, tubing supply, and backup power plan
options.zh: 确认家用设备送达、管路供应和备用电源计划

options.en: Ask the client and spouse to demonstrate fire-safety and tubing-management steps
options.zh: 请患者和配偶演示防火和管路管理步骤

options.en: Verify the oxygen prescription, target use instructions, and equipment ordered
options.zh: 核对氧疗处方、目标使用说明和已订设备

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: During Stage 3 teach-back, which client statement shows correct understanding of home oxygen safety?
stem.zh: 在第 3 阶段回示中，哪项患者陈述表明其正确理解了居家氧疗安全？

correct.en: Posting oxygen-in-use notices and keeping oxygen away from smoking and flames are appropriate fire-safety steps.
correct.zh: 张贴正在使用氧气的提示，并让氧气远离吸烟和明火，是恰当的防火措施。

byChoice.en: A notice helps responders and visitors recognize the oxygen fire hazard.
byChoice.zh: 提示标识有助于急救人员和访客识别氧气相关火灾风险。

byChoice.en: Tubing should be arranged to prevent tripping, not hidden under rugs.
byChoice.zh: 管路应妥善摆放以防绊倒，不应藏在地毯下。

byChoice.en: Petroleum products should be avoided near the cannula because they may support burning.
byChoice.zh: 鼻导管附近应避免含油产品，因为可能助燃。

byChoice.en: Oxygen should not be used near smoking or open flames.
byChoice.zh: 氧气不应靠近吸烟或明火。

testTakingStrategy.en: Choose the statement that reduces both fire and fall risk without changing the prescribed therapy.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择既降低火灾和跌倒风险，又不改变处方治疗的陈述。

glossary.defZh: 可见火焰来源，如蜡烛、炉火或打火机。
增加绊倒、滑倒或跌倒风险的环境因素。

options.en: I will keep oxygen away from flames and post an oxygen-in-use notice.
options.zh: 我会让氧气远离明火，并张贴正在使用氧气的提示。

options.en: I can sit near someone smoking if my cannula is under my shirt.
options.zh: 如果鼻导管放在衣服下，我可以坐在吸烟的人旁边。

options.en: I should use petroleum jelly daily so my nose does not dry out.
options.zh: 我应该每天用凡士林，避免鼻子干燥。

options.en: I will place extra tubing under throw rugs so no one sees it.
options.zh: 我会把多余管路放在小地毯下面，这样别人看不到。

stem.en: Stage 3 equipment teaching states: The portable cylinder contains 600 L of usable oxygen. The prescribed flow is 2 L/min for activity. How many minutes of oxygen are available for activity? Round to the nearest whole minute.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段设备宣教写明：便携氧气瓶可用氧气量为 600 L。活动时处方流量为 2 L/分。该氧气瓶可供活动使用多少分钟？四舍五入到最接近的整数。

correct.en: Available time equals available volume divided by flow rate: 600 L ÷ 2 L/min = 300 minutes.
correct.zh: 可用时间等于可用容量除以流量：600 L ÷ 2 L/分 = 300 分钟。

byChoice.en: The blank asks for minutes: divide liters available by liters per minute.
byChoice.zh: 该空要求填写分钟数：用可用升数除以每分钟升数。

testTakingStrategy.en: Track the units. Liters divided by liters per minute leaves minutes.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 注意单位。升除以升/分钟，剩下的单位就是分钟。

glossary.defZh: 可携带的氧气供应容器。
每分钟给出的气体或液体体积。

note: Campaign 17 A/B producer implementation; full parent preimage frozen; independent review pending

title.en: Unfolding case: unwitnessed fall in long-term care
title.zh: 展开病例：长期护理机构内无人目击跌倒

summary.en: An older adult resident is found on the floor near the bathroom during night shift.
summary.zh: 一名老年住民夜班时在卫生间附近地上被发现。

content.en: Age 84. Uses a walker. History: hypertension, atrial fibrillation, mild cognitive impairment. Medication list includes apixaban and newly prescribed trazodone at bedtime. Baseline orientation: person and place.
content.zh: 84 岁。使用助行器。有高血压、房颤、轻度认知障碍病史。用药包括阿哌沙班和新开的睡前曲唑酮。基线定向力：能辨认本人和地点。

content.en: Resident found on floor next to bathroom doorway. Awake but anxious. States, 'My hip hurts.' No staff witnessed the fall. Bed alarm sounding. Walker is across the room.
content.zh: 住民被发现倒在卫生间门口旁。清醒但焦虑。说：“我的髋部痛。”无工作人员目击跌倒。床旁报警器正在响。助行器在房间另一侧。

content.en: BP 148/86, HR 96 irregular, RR 18, SpO2 95% room air. Oriented to person only. Vomited once. Right pupil 5 mm, left pupil 3 mm. Right leg shortened and externally rotated. 2-cm elbow abrasion without active bleeding.
content.zh: 血压 148/86，心率 96 次/分且不规则，呼吸 18 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 95%。仅能辨认本人。呕吐一次。右瞳孔 5 mm，左瞳孔 3 mm。右腿短缩并外旋。肘部 2 cm 擦伤，无活动性出血。

content.en: Team reviews nighttime toileting pattern, walker placement, lighting, footwear, anticoagulant use, and recent trazodone start. Family asks whether restraints should be used so the resident cannot stand without help.
content.zh: 团队复盘夜间如厕模式、助行器摆放、照明、鞋袜、抗凝药使用以及近期开始曲唑酮。家属询问是否应使用约束，以免住民无人协助时站起。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: Stage 1 describes a resident found on the floor. What should the nurse do first?
stem.zh: 第 1 阶段描述一名长期护理机构住民被发现倒在地上。护士首先应做什么？

correct.en: Before moving the resident, the nurse should assess airway, breathing, circulation, level of consciousness, pain, and obvious injury to prevent worsening an occult injury.
correct.zh: 移动住民前，护士应评估气道、呼吸、循环、意识水平、疼痛和明显损伤，以免加重潜在损伤。

byChoice.en: The incident report is completed after the resident is assessed and care is initiated.
byChoice.zh: 事件报告应在评估住民并开始护理后完成。

byChoice.en: Calling family may be needed later, but it does not replace immediate assessment.
byChoice.zh: 之后可能需要联系家属，但不能替代立即评估。

byChoice.en: Immediate assessment for injury and instability is the safest first nursing action.
byChoice.zh: 立即评估损伤和不稳定情况是最安全的首要护理行动。

byChoice.en: Moving the resident first can worsen an unrecognized fracture or head/neck injury.
byChoice.zh: 先移动住民可能加重未识别的骨折或头颈部损伤。

testTakingStrategy.en: After an unwitnessed fall, do not rush to lift the person. Assess for injury and neurologic change first.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 无人目击跌倒后，不要急着扶起。先评估损伤和神经状态变化。

glossary.defZh: 没有工作人员直接看到发生过程的跌倒。
患者清醒、反应和定向程度。

options.en: Call the family to ask whether the resident has fallen before
options.zh: 打电话给家属询问住民以前是否跌倒过

options.en: Complete the occurrence report before providing further care
options.zh: 先完成事件报告，再继续护理

options.en: Help the resident back to bed and then obtain vital signs
options.zh: 先扶住民回床，再测量生命体征

options.en: Keep the resident still and assess airway, breathing, circulation, pain, and injury
options.zh: 让住民保持不动，并评估气道、呼吸、循环、疼痛和损伤

stem.en: Using Stage 2 data, classify each finding after the fall.
stem.zh: 根据第 2 阶段资料，将跌倒后的每项发现分类。

correct.en: New confusion, vomiting, unequal pupils, and hip pain with shortening/external rotation require urgent escalation. A small superficial abrasion without active bleeding is expected local trauma but still documented.
correct.zh: 新发意识混乱、呕吐、瞳孔不等大以及髋部疼痛伴短缩外旋需要紧急升级处理。小的表浅擦伤且无活动性出血属于局部外伤表现，但仍需记录。

byChoice.en: A change from baseline orientation can indicate head injury, delirium, or another acute problem.
byChoice.zh: 与基线相比定向力改变可能提示头部损伤、谵妄或其他急性问题。

byChoice.en: Vomiting after a fall is a concerning neurologic sign.
byChoice.zh: 跌倒后呕吐是令人担忧的神经系统体征。

byChoice.en: Unequal pupils after a fall require prompt escalation.
byChoice.zh: 跌倒后瞳孔不等大需要立即升级处理。

byChoice.en: Hip pain with shortening and external rotation suggests possible hip fracture.
byChoice.zh: 髋痛伴肢体短缩和外旋提示可能髋部骨折。

byChoice.en: A small abrasion is a local injury to document but is not the urgent change compared with neurologic or fracture cues.
byChoice.zh: 小擦伤需记录，但与神经或骨折线索相比不是紧急变化。

testTakingStrategy.en: Compare each finding with baseline and ask whether it suggests head injury, fracture, or instability.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将每项发现与基线比较，并判断是否提示头部损伤、骨折或不稳定。

glossary.defZh: 意识、瞳孔、运动、感觉或言语等方面的新变化。
肢体向外侧旋转的姿势。

rows.en: Resident is oriented to person only; baseline is oriented to person and place
rows.zh: 住民仅能辨认本人；基线为能辨认本人和地点

rows.en: One episode of emesis after the fall
rows.zh: 跌倒后呕吐一次

rows.en: Right pupil 5 mm and left pupil 3 mm
rows.zh: 右瞳孔 5 mm，左瞳孔 3 mm

rows.en: Right leg appears shortened and externally rotated
rows.zh: 右腿看起来短缩并外旋

rows.en: 2-cm elbow abrasion without active bleeding
rows.zh: 肘部 2 cm 擦伤，无活动性出血

stem.en: The nurse prepares to notify the provider after reviewing the fall assessment.
stem.zh: 护士查看跌倒评估后准备通知医护人员。

correct.en: The combination of neurologic changes and possible hip fracture requires provider notification and continued immobilization until evaluated. The resident should not be ambulated to test weight bearing.
correct.zh: 神经状态变化合并可能髋部骨折需要通知医护人员，并在评估前继续保持制动。不能让住民走路来测试负重能力。

byChoice.en: New neurologic signs are the strongest reason for urgent escalation.
byChoice.zh: 新发神经体征是紧急升级的最重要原因。

byChoice.en: Possible fracture signs require immobilization and provider-directed evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 可能骨折的体征需要制动，并由医护人员进一步评估。

testTakingStrategy.en: When multiple post-fall problems exist, neurologic deterioration and possible fracture both increase urgency.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 跌倒后存在多个问题时，神经恶化和可能骨折都会增加紧急性。

glossary.defZh: 将异常情况及时通知相应医护人员并采取更高级别措施。
限制移动以避免加重损伤。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should report concern for {{1}} and maintain {{2}} until further evaluation.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应报告对 {{1}} 的担忧，并在进一步评估前维持 {{2}}。

options.en: chronic dementia without acute change
options.zh: 无急性变化的慢性痴呆

options.en: intracranial injury and possible hip fracture
options.zh: 颅内损伤和可能髋部骨折

options.en: mild bruising from a witnessed low-risk fall
options.zh: 目击低风险跌倒后的轻微瘀伤

options.en: range-of-motion exercises to reduce stiffness
options.zh: 进行关节活动度练习以减少僵硬

options.en: spinal and limb precautions with the resident still
options.zh: 脊柱和肢体防护，保持住民不动

options.en: ambulation with two staff to assess gait
options.zh: 由两名工作人员协助行走以评估步态

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: After the provider has been notified and transfer is being arranged, place the nurse's ongoing monitoring actions in order.
stem.zh: 已通知医护人员并正在安排转送后，请按顺序排列护士的持续监测行动。

correct.en: The nurse first maintains safety and immobilization, then repeats focused neurologic and pain/vascular checks, prepares concise transfer handoff information, and completes the occurrence report after clinical care and handoff needs are addressed.
correct.zh: 护士先维持安全和制动，然后重复重点神经评估及疼痛/血管检查，准备简明转送交接信息，最后在临床护理和交接需求处理后完成事件报告。

byChoice.en: The occurrence report is not part of the medical record and follows immediate care priorities.
byChoice.zh: 事件报告不属于病历，应在立即护理优先事项之后完成。

byChoice.en: Transfer handoff should include baseline, changes, anticoagulant use, vital signs, and injury findings.
byChoice.zh: 转送交接应包括基线、变化、抗凝药使用、生命体征和损伤发现。

byChoice.en: Maintaining safety and immobilization is ongoing while transfer is arranged.
byChoice.zh: 安排转送期间应持续维持安全和制动。

byChoice.en: Focused reassessment detects deterioration before transport.
byChoice.zh: 重点复评可在转运前发现恶化。

testTakingStrategy.en: In post-event workflows, protect the client, reassess for change, hand off actionable clinical data, then finish safety reporting.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 事件后流程中，先保护患者，再复评变化，交接可行动的临床资料，最后完成安全报告。

glossary.defZh: 向下一位照护者传递关键临床信息的沟通过程。
机构内部用于安全改进的非病历报告。

options.en: Prepare a transfer handoff with baseline status, new findings, medications, and vital signs
options.zh: 准备转送交接，包含基线状态、新发现、用药和生命体征

options.en: Complete the internal occurrence report according to facility procedure
options.zh: 按机构流程完成内部事件报告

options.en: Repeat focused neurologic, pain, distal pulse, movement, and sensation checks
options.zh: 重复重点神经、疼痛、远端脉搏、活动和感觉检查

options.en: Maintain fall precautions and keep the resident still with comfort measures
options.zh: 维持跌倒预防措施，让住民保持不动并给予舒适护理

stem.en: Stage 3 includes an interdisciplinary fall-risk review. Classify each prevention strategy.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段包含跨专业跌倒风险评估。请将每项预防策略分类。

correct.en: Medication review, scheduled toileting, footwear, adequate lighting, and assistive-device access address modifiable fall risks. Restraints are not a routine fall-prevention strategy and may increase harm.
correct.zh: 用药复核、定时如厕、合适鞋袜、充足照明和辅助器具可及性可处理可改变的跌倒风险。约束不是常规跌倒预防策略，并可能增加伤害。

byChoice.en: Sedating or blood-pressure medications can contribute to falls and should be reviewed.
byChoice.zh: 镇静或降压药可能导致跌倒，应复核。

byChoice.en: Scheduled toileting reduces unsupervised attempts to get up.
byChoice.zh: 定时如厕可减少无人协助起身的尝试。

byChoice.en: Non-skid footwear supports safer transfers and ambulation.
byChoice.zh: 防滑鞋袜有助于更安全地转移和行走。

byChoice.en: Restraints should not be used solely to prevent falls.
byChoice.zh: 不能仅为预防跌倒而使用约束。

byChoice.en: Keeping the call light and walker within reach supports asking for help before moving.
byChoice.zh: 将呼叫铃和助行器放在可及处，有助于移动前求助。

testTakingStrategy.en: Favor least-restrictive interventions that address why the resident tries to get up or loses balance.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 优先选择最少限制且能解决住民为何起身或失衡的干预。

glossary.defZh: 在达到安全目标的同时尽量保留患者自主和活动的做法。
可通过护理或环境干预降低的危险因素。

rows.en: Request medication review for newly added nighttime sedative
rows.zh: 请求复核新加的夜间镇静药

rows.en: Offer toileting before usual rest periods
rows.zh: 在平时休息前协助如厕

rows.en: Place non-skid footwear within reach before transfers
rows.zh: 转移前将防滑鞋袜放在可及处

rows.en: Apply a vest restraint whenever the resident is in the chair
rows.zh: 住民坐椅时都使用背心约束

rows.en: Keep call light and walker on the resident's stronger side
rows.zh: 将呼叫铃和助行器放在住民较强侧

columns.zh: 避免作为常规跌倒预防

testTakingStrategy.zh: 无人目击跌倒后，不要急着扶起。先评估损伤和神经状态变化。

glossary.defZh: 没有工作人员直接看到发生过程的跌倒。
患者清醒、反应和定向程度。

options.en: Call the family to ask whether the resident has fallen before
options.zh: 打电话给家属询问住民以前是否跌倒过

options.en: Complete the occurrence report before providing further care
options.zh: 先完成事件报告，再继续护理

options.en: Help the resident back to bed and then obtain vital signs
options.zh: 先扶住民回床，再测量生命体征

options.en: Keep the resident still and assess airway, breathing, circulation, pain, and injury
options.zh: 让住民保持不动，并评估气道、呼吸、循环、疼痛和损伤

stem.en: Using Stage 2 data, classify each finding after the fall.
stem.zh: 根据第 2 阶段资料，将跌倒后的每项发现分类。

correct.en: New confusion, vomiting, unequal pupils, and hip pain with shortening/external rotation require urgent escalation. A small superficial abrasion without active bleeding is expected local trauma but still documented.
correct.zh: 新发意识混乱、呕吐、瞳孔不等大以及髋部疼痛伴短缩外旋需要紧急升级处理。小的表浅擦伤且无活动性出血属于局部外伤表现，但仍需记录。

byChoice.en: A change from baseline orientation can indicate head injury, delirium, or another acute problem.
byChoice.zh: 与基线相比定向力改变可能提示头部损伤、谵妄或其他急性问题。

byChoice.en: Vomiting after a fall is a concerning neurologic sign.
byChoice.zh: 跌倒后呕吐是令人担忧的神经系统体征。

byChoice.en: Unequal pupils after a fall require prompt escalation.
byChoice.zh: 跌倒后瞳孔不等大需要立即升级处理。

byChoice.en: Hip pain with shortening and external rotation suggests possible hip fracture.
byChoice.zh: 髋痛伴肢体短缩和外旋提示可能髋部骨折。

byChoice.en: A small abrasion is a local injury to document but is not the urgent change compared with neurologic or fracture cues.
byChoice.zh: 小擦伤需记录，但与神经或骨折线索相比不是紧急变化。

testTakingStrategy.en: Compare each finding with baseline and ask whether it suggests head injury, fracture, or instability.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将每项发现与基线比较，并判断是否提示头部损伤、骨折或不稳定。

glossary.defZh: 意识、瞳孔、运动、感觉或言语等方面的新变化。
肢体向外侧旋转的姿势。

rows.en: Resident is oriented to person only; baseline is oriented to person and place
rows.zh: 住民仅能辨认本人；基线为能辨认本人和地点

rows.en: One episode of emesis after the fall
rows.zh: 跌倒后呕吐一次

rows.en: Right pupil 5 mm and left pupil 3 mm
rows.zh: 右瞳孔 5 mm，左瞳孔 3 mm

rows.en: Right leg appears shortened and externally rotated
rows.zh: 右腿看起来短缩并外旋

rows.en: 2-cm elbow abrasion without active bleeding
rows.zh: 肘部 2 cm 擦伤，无活动性出血

stem.en: The nurse prepares to notify the provider after reviewing the fall assessment.
stem.zh: 护士查看跌倒评估后准备通知医护人员。

correct.en: The combination of neurologic changes and possible hip fracture requires provider notification and continued immobilization until evaluated. The resident should not be ambulated to test weight bearing.
correct.zh: 神经状态变化合并可能髋部骨折需要通知医护人员，并在评估前继续保持制动。不能让住民走路来测试负重能力。

byChoice.en: New neurologic signs are the strongest reason for urgent escalation.
byChoice.zh: 新发神经体征是紧急升级的最重要原因。

byChoice.en: Possible fracture signs require immobilization and provider-directed evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 可能骨折的体征需要制动，并由医护人员进一步评估。

testTakingStrategy.en: When multiple post-fall problems exist, neurologic deterioration and possible fracture both increase urgency.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 跌倒后存在多个问题时，神经恶化和可能骨折都会增加紧急性。

glossary.defZh: 将异常情况及时通知相应医护人员并采取更高级别措施。
限制移动以避免加重损伤。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should report concern for {{1}} and maintain {{2}} until further evaluation.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应报告对 {{1}} 的担忧，并在进一步评估前维持 {{2}}。

options.en: chronic dementia without acute change
options.zh: 无急性变化的慢性痴呆

options.en: intracranial injury and possible hip fracture
options.zh: 颅内损伤和可能髋部骨折

options.en: mild bruising from a witnessed low-risk fall
options.zh: 目击低风险跌倒后的轻微瘀伤

options.en: range-of-motion exercises to reduce stiffness
options.zh: 进行关节活动度练习以减少僵硬

options.en: spinal and limb precautions with the resident still
options.zh: 脊柱和肢体防护，保持住民不动

options.en: ambulation with two staff to assess gait
options.zh: 由两名工作人员协助行走以评估步态

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: After the provider has been notified and transfer is being arranged, place the nurse's ongoing monitoring actions in order.
stem.zh: 已通知医护人员并正在安排转送后，请按顺序排列护士的持续监测行动。

correct.en: The nurse first maintains safety and immobilization, then repeats focused neurologic and pain/vascular checks, prepares concise transfer handoff information, and completes the occurrence report after clinical care and handoff needs are addressed.
correct.zh: 护士先维持安全和制动，然后重复重点神经评估及疼痛/血管检查，准备简明转送交接信息，最后在临床护理和交接需求处理后完成事件报告。

byChoice.en: The occurrence report is not part of the medical record and follows immediate care priorities.
byChoice.zh: 事件报告不属于病历，应在立即护理优先事项之后完成。

byChoice.en: Transfer handoff should include baseline, changes, anticoagulant use, vital signs, and injury findings.
byChoice.zh: 转送交接应包括基线、变化、抗凝药使用、生命体征和损伤发现。

byChoice.en: Maintaining safety and immobilization is ongoing while transfer is arranged.
byChoice.zh: 安排转送期间应持续维持安全和制动。

byChoice.en: Focused reassessment detects deterioration before transport.
byChoice.zh: 重点复评可在转运前发现恶化。

testTakingStrategy.en: In post-event workflows, protect the client, reassess for change, hand off actionable clinical data, then finish safety reporting.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 事件后流程中，先保护患者，再复评变化，交接可行动的临床资料，最后完成安全报告。

glossary.defZh: 向下一位照护者传递关键临床信息的沟通过程。
机构内部用于安全改进的非病历报告。

options.en: Prepare a transfer handoff with baseline status, new findings, medications, and vital signs
options.zh: 准备转送交接，包含基线状态、新发现、用药和生命体征

options.en: Complete the internal occurrence report according to facility procedure
options.zh: 按机构流程完成内部事件报告

options.en: Repeat focused neurologic, pain, distal pulse, movement, and sensation checks
options.zh: 重复重点神经、疼痛、远端脉搏、活动和感觉检查

options.en: Maintain fall precautions and keep the resident still with comfort measures
options.zh: 维持跌倒预防措施，让住民保持不动并给予舒适护理

stem.en: Stage 3 includes an interdisciplinary fall-risk review. Classify each prevention strategy.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段包含跨专业跌倒风险评估。请将每项预防策略分类。

correct.en: Medication review, scheduled toileting, footwear, adequate lighting, and assistive-device access address modifiable fall risks. Restraints are not a routine fall-prevention strategy and may increase harm.
correct.zh: 用药复核、定时如厕、合适鞋袜、充足照明和辅助器具可及性可处理可改变的跌倒风险。约束不是常规跌倒预防策略，并可能增加伤害。

byChoice.en: Sedating or blood-pressure medications can contribute to falls and should be reviewed.
byChoice.zh: 镇静或降压药可能导致跌倒，应复核。

byChoice.en: Scheduled toileting reduces unsupervised attempts to get up.
byChoice.zh: 定时如厕可减少无人协助起身的尝试。

byChoice.en: Non-skid footwear supports safer transfers and ambulation.
byChoice.zh: 防滑鞋袜有助于更安全地转移和行走。

byChoice.en: Restraints should not be used solely to prevent falls.
byChoice.zh: 不能仅为预防跌倒而使用约束。

byChoice.en: Keeping the call light and walker within reach supports asking for help before moving.
byChoice.zh: 将呼叫铃和助行器放在可及处，有助于移动前求助。

testTakingStrategy.en: Favor least-restrictive interventions that address why the resident tries to get up or loses balance.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 优先选择最少限制且能解决住民为何起身或失衡的干预。

glossary.defZh: 在达到安全目标的同时尽量保留患者自主和活动的做法。
可通过护理或环境干预降低的危险因素。

rows.en: Request medication review for newly added nighttime sedative
rows.zh: 请求复核新加的夜间镇静药

rows.en: Offer toileting before usual rest periods
rows.zh: 在平时休息前协助如厕

rows.en: Place non-skid footwear within reach before transfers
rows.zh: 转移前将防滑鞋袜放在可及处

rows.en: Apply a vest restraint whenever the resident is in the chair
rows.zh: 住民坐椅时都使用背心约束

rows.en: Keep call light and walker on the resident's stronger side
rows.zh: 将呼叫铃和助行器放在住民较强侧

columns.zh: 避免作为常规跌倒预防

note: Campaign 17 A/B producer implementation; full parent preimage frozen; independent review pending

title.en: Postpartum hemorrhage from uterine atony in a grand multiparous client with pregnancy-induced hypertension
title.zh: 妊娠期高血压经产妇因子宫收缩乏力发生的产后出血

summary.en: A 32-year-old G5P5 client is one hour postpartum after a vaginal birth of a 4.2 kg infant. She has pregnancy-induced hypertension treated with labetalol and mild intermittent asthma. She develops heavy bleeding, a boggy displaced fundus, tachycardia, and hypotension relative to her hypertensive baseline.
summary.zh: 一名 32 岁 G5P5 产妇在阴道分娩 4.2 kg 新生儿后 1 小时处于产后恢复期。她有妊娠期高血压，使用拉贝洛尔治疗，并有轻度间歇性哮喘。她出现大量出血、子宫底偏移且松软、心动过速，以及相对高血压基线明显下降的血压。

content.en: G5P5, one hour postpartum after vaginal birth of a 4.2 kg infant. Second stage lasted 3 hours; oxytocin augmentation was used during first stage. Placenta delivered intact and appeared complete. Pregnancy-induced hypertension was diagnosed at 34 weeks and treated with labetalol 200 mg twice daily. History includes mild intermittent asthma. No bleeding disorder, prior PPH, or uterine surgery. Admission BP 148/94 mmHg. Admission Hgb 11.8 g/dL, Hct 35.2%. Blood type O-positive; type and screen sent on admission. Oxytocin 20 units in 1 L LR has been infusing for about 50 minutes after placental delivery.
content.zh: G5P5，阴道分娩 4.2 kg 新生儿后 1 小时。第二产程持续 3 小时；第一产程使用催产素加强宫缩。胎盘娩出完整，检查外观完整。34 周诊断妊娠期高血压，使用拉贝洛尔 200 mg 每日两次。既往有轻度间歇性哮喘。无出血性疾病、既往产后出血或子宫手术史。入院血压 148/94 mmHg。入院 Hgb 11.8 g/dL，Hct 35.2%。血型 O 阳性；入院已送血型筛查。胎盘娩出后已按医嘱输注催产素 20 units 加入 1 L LR，约 50 分钟。

content.en: Client says she feels 'dizzy and wet.' She is pale, diaphoretic, alert, oriented, and anxious. Underpads show a large amount of blood; the perineal pad placed 20 minutes ago is saturated. Vital signs: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 118, BP 90/62 mmHg, RR 22, SpO2 97% on room air. Uterus is two fingerbreadths above the umbilicus, deviated to the right, and boggy; it does not stay firm after massage. Lochia is heavy with dark-red flow and several small clots. Repaired second-degree perineal laceration has no active bleeding and no visible hematoma. Bladder is palpable above the symphysis pubis. Skin is cool and clammy; capillary refill 3 seconds. Estimated blood loss is 600 mL and visibly increasing.
content.zh: 患者说自己“头晕，而且感觉很湿”。她面色苍白、出汗，意识清醒、定向力正常但焦虑。护理垫上有大量血液；20 分钟前更换的会阴垫已饱和。生命体征：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 118，BP 90/62 mmHg，RR 22，室内空气 SpO2 97%。子宫底位于脐上两横指，向右偏移且松软；按摩后不能维持坚硬。恶露量多，暗红色流出并有数个小血块。已缝合的二度会阴裂伤无活动性出血，也未见血肿。耻骨联合上方可触及膀胱。皮肤湿冷；毛细血管再充盈 3 秒。估计失血量 600 mL，并且肉眼可见仍在增加。

content.en: Hgb 11.8 g/dL, Hct 35.2%, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 410 mg/dL, INR 1.0, aPTT 28 sec. Sodium 138 mEq/L, potassium 3.9 mEq/L, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, glucose 92 mg/dL. Urinalysis: 1+ protein, otherwise unremarkable.
content.zh: Hgb 11.8 g/dL，Hct 35.2%，血小板 188 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 410 mg/dL，INR 1.0，aPTT 28 秒。钠 138 mEq/L，钾 3.9 mEq/L，肌酐 0.7 mg/dL，血糖 92 mg/dL。尿检：蛋白 1+，其余无明显异常。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：初始出血处理
第 1 阶段：初始出血处理

content.en: The nurse begins external fundal massage with lower uterine support and calls for assistance. Straight catheterization drains 450 mL of clear urine; the uterus descends to the umbilicus but remains boggy. Oxytocin is confirmed infusing and increased per standing order to infuse the remaining volume over 30 minutes. Two 16-gauge peripheral IVs are placed; warmed LR is hung wide open. Quantitative blood loss is now 800 mL. Vital signs: HR 124, BP 86/58, RR 24, SpO2 96% on room air. The provider is called to bedside.
content.zh: 护士开始在下方支托子宫的同时进行外部子宫底按摩，并呼叫协助。一次性导尿排出清亮尿液 450 mL；子宫下降至脐水平但仍松软。确认催产素正在输注，并按常规医嘱提高速度，在 30 分钟内输完剩余液体。置入两条 16G 外周静脉通路；温热 LR 全速开放。定量失血现为 800 mL。生命体征：HR 124，BP 86/58，RR 24，室内空气 SpO2 96%。已呼叫医师到床旁。

title.en: Stage 2: Persistent atony and medication selection
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：子宫收缩乏力持续及药物选择

title.en: Stage 2: Persistent atony and medication selection
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：子宫收缩乏力持续及药物选择

content.en: Despite massage and increased oxytocin, the uterus intermittently firms then relaxes within seconds. QBL is 1,200 mL. Vital signs: HR 132, BP 80/52, RR 26, SpO2 95% on room air. The client is confused and markedly pale with capillary refill 4 seconds. The provider rules out retained placental fragments and unrepaired cervical/vaginal lacerations. Available uterotonics are methylergonovine 0.2 mg IM, misoprostol 800 mcg rectally, and carboprost 250 mcg IM. Stat labs: Hgb 8.1 g/dL, Hct 24.3%, platelets 162 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 280 mg/dL, INR 1.1, aPTT 30 sec. Type and crossmatch for 2 units PRBC is sent. The unit protocol orders tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 minutes within 3 hours of birth for PPH not responding to first-line uterotonics.
content.zh: 尽管持续按摩并增加催产素输注，子宫仍间歇性变硬后数秒内又松弛。定量失血 1,200 mL。生命体征：HR 132，BP 80/52，RR 26，室内空气 SpO2 95%。患者意识混乱、明显苍白，毛细血管再充盈 4 秒。医师排除胎盘碎片残留及未修补的宫颈/阴道裂伤。可用宫缩药包括甲基麦角新碱 0.2 mg IM、米索前列醇 800 mcg 经直肠给药、卡前列素 250 mcg IM。急查化验：Hgb 8.1 g/dL，Hct 24.3%，血小板 162 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 280 mg/dL，INR 1.1，aPTT 30 秒。已送 2 单位 PRBC 配血。病区方案医嘱：对一线宫缩药反应不佳的产后出血，在分娩后 3 小时内给予氨甲环酸 1 g IV，10 分钟输注。

title.en: Stage 3: Response evaluation after source control
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：止血源控制后的反应评估

title.en: Stage 3: Response evaluation after source control
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：止血源控制后的反应评估

content.en: Misoprostol 800 mcg was given rectally, tranexamic acid 1 g IV was infused over 10 minutes, and the provider performed aggressive bimanual compression. The uterus is now firm at the umbilicus. Lochia is moderate dark red without clots. QBL has plateaued at 1,450 mL with no further active accumulation for 15 minutes. Vital signs: HR 112, BP 94/60, RR 20, SpO2 97% on 2 L nasal cannula. The client is alert and oriented but fatigued and mildly dizzy with repositioning. The first PRBC unit is infusing through a dedicated large-bore IV; a second unit is ordered. Repeat labs: Hgb 7.4 g/dL, Hct 22.1%, platelets 148 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 240 mg/dL, INR 1.2, aPTT 32 sec. Foley output is 25 mL/hr of concentrated amber urine. Fundal checks continue every 15 minutes.
content.zh: 已给予米索前列醇 800 mcg 经直肠给药，氨甲环酸 1 g IV 10 分钟输注，医师进行了积极双手子宫压迫。现在子宫坚硬，位于脐水平。恶露为中等量暗红色，无血块。定量失血停留在 1,450 mL，15 分钟内无进一步活动性增加。生命体征：HR 112，BP 94/60，RR 20，鼻导管 2 L 下 SpO2 97%。患者清醒、定向力正常，但疲乏，变换体位时仍轻度头晕。第 1 单位 PRBC 正通过专用大口径 IV 输注；已医嘱随后输注第 2 单位。复查化验：Hgb 7.4 g/dL，Hct 22.1%，血小板 148 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 240 mg/dL，INR 1.2，aPTT 32 秒。Foley 尿量 25 mL/hr，为浓缩琥珀色尿。继续每 15 分钟检查子宫底。

stem.en: Highlight the assessment findings that require immediate follow-up for postpartum hemorrhage from uterine atony.
stem.zh: 请标出需要立即针对子宫收缩乏力性产后出血进行处理的评估发现。

segments.en: Temperature 98.2 °F (36.8 °C).
Heart rate 118 beats/min.
segments.zh: 心率 118 次/分。

segments.en: Blood pressure 90/62 mmHg, down from her hypertensive admission baseline of 148/94 mmHg.
segments.zh: 血压 90/62 mmHg，低于入院时 148/94 mmHg 的妊娠期高血压基线。

segments.en: SpO2 97% on room air.
segments.zh: 室内空气下 SpO2 97%。

segments.en: The uterus is two fingerbreadths above the umbilicus, deviated to the right, and boggy.
segments.zh: 子宫底位于脐上两横指，向右偏移，触之松软。

segments.en: It does not stay firm after gentle massage.
segments.zh: 轻柔按摩后子宫不能持续变硬。

segments.en: Lochia is heavy with a steady dark-red flow and several small clots.
segments.zh: 恶露量多，持续暗红色流出，并有数个小血块。

segments.en: The repaired second-degree perineal laceration has no active bleeding and no visible hematoma.
segments.zh: 已缝合的二度会阴裂伤无活动性出血，也未见血肿。

segments.en: The bladder is palpable above the symphysis pubis.
segments.zh: 耻骨联合上方可触及膀胱。

segments.en: Skin is cool and clammy with capillary refill of 3 seconds.
segments.zh: 皮肤湿冷，毛细血管再充盈时间为 3 秒。

segments.en: Estimated blood loss is 600 mL and visibly increasing.
segments.zh: 估计失血量为 600 mL，且肉眼可见仍在增加。

segments.en: She denies chest pain or shortness of breath.
segments.zh: 她否认胸痛或气短。

correct.en: The key cues are a boggy displaced uterus that cannot maintain tone, heavy lochia with clots, blood loss already at 600 mL and increasing, tachycardia, hypotension relative to a hypertensive baseline, poor peripheral perfusion, and a palpable bladder that can worsen uterine displacement. Normal temperature and oxygen saturation do not define the problem, and the intact perineal repair helps narrow the source away from a laceration.
correct.zh: 关键线索包括子宫底偏移且松软、不能维持张力，恶露量多伴血块，失血量已达 600 mL 且仍在增加，心动过速，相对于妊娠期高血压基线明显下降的血压，外周灌注差，以及可触及的膀胱充盈（可加重子宫偏移）。体温和血氧正常不能说明当前问题；会阴修补处完整有助于把出血来源从裂伤转向子宫。

byChoice.en: A normal temperature does not define this acute hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 体温正常，不能说明当前急性出血问题。

byChoice.en: Tachycardia is an early sign of volume loss and shock in postpartum hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 心动过速是产后出血导致容量不足和休克的早期表现。

byChoice.en: The absolute BP is low, and the drop from a hypertensive baseline makes the hemodynamic compromise more severe.
byChoice.zh: 血压本身偏低，且相对妊娠期高血压基线明显下降，提示血流动力学受损更严重。

byChoice.en: Normal oxygen saturation does not rule out hemorrhagic shock and is not the defining cue here.
byChoice.zh: 血氧饱和度正常不能排除失血性休克，也不是本题的关键线索。

byChoice.en: A boggy, displaced uterus is the hallmark cue for uterine atony and impaired contraction.
byChoice.zh: 子宫底偏移且松软是子宫收缩乏力、收缩无效的标志性线索。

byChoice.en: Failure to sustain tone after massage shows that atony is ongoing.
byChoice.zh: 按摩后不能维持张力说明子宫收缩乏力仍在持续。

byChoice.en: Heavy lochia with clots supports ongoing uterine bleeding from the placental site.
byChoice.zh: 恶露量多并有血块，支持胎盘附着部位仍在子宫性出血。

byChoice.en: This is relevant because it helps rule away a laceration source, but it is not itself an abnormal hemorrhage cue needing immediate correction.
byChoice.zh: 这一正常发现有助于排除裂伤来源，但它本身不是需要立即处理的异常出血线索。

byChoice.en: A distended bladder can displace the uterus and prevent effective contraction, worsening atony.
byChoice.zh: 膀胱充盈会使子宫偏移并妨碍有效收缩，从而加重子宫收缩乏力。

byChoice.en: Cool clammy skin and delayed capillary refill are peripheral perfusion cues of hypovolemia.
byChoice.zh: 皮肤湿冷和毛细血管再充盈延迟提示低血容量导致外周灌注不足。

byChoice.en: Blood loss of 600 mL after a vaginal birth meets the traditional PPH threshold and is still increasing.
byChoice.zh: 阴道分娩后失血 600 mL 已达到传统产后出血阈值，并且仍在增加。

byChoice.en: Absence of chest pain or dyspnea is reassuring but does not address the hemorrhage source.
byChoice.zh: 无胸痛或气短较为 reassuring，但不能说明出血来源或严重程度。

testTakingStrategy.en: In early postpartum bleeding, first connect uterine tone, lochia, blood-loss amount, and perfusion signs. Compare vital signs with the client's baseline, not just the normal range.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 早期产后出血题先把子宫张力、恶露、失血量和灌注表现联系起来；生命体征要和该患者的基线比较，而不只看正常范围。

glossary.defZh: 产后子宫触之柔软而不是坚硬，提示收缩不良。
产后从子宫经阴道排出的血液和组织。
通过称重或收集血液来测量失血量，而不是仅凭目测估计。

stem.en: Complete the clinical reasoning statement using the available Stage 1 findings.
stem.zh: 根据第 1 阶段可获得的资料，完成临床推理陈述。

correct.en: A boggy uterus that will not maintain tone after massage identifies uterine atony as the primary mechanism. The intact laceration repair argues against a traumatic lower-tract source. Retained tissue is possible early in a PPH workup, but the placenta was inspected as complete and the defining cue is uterine relaxation. Inversion is unlikely because the fundus remains palpable in the abdomen.
correct.zh: 按摩后不能维持张力的松软子宫指向子宫收缩乏力。会阴裂伤修补处完整，不支持下生殖道创伤性出血。胎盘残留在产后出血评估中可以考虑，但胎盘已检查完整，且决定性线索是子宫松弛。子宫底仍可在腹部触及，因此子宫内翻可能性低。

byChoice.en: Correct: the uterus is boggy and does not maintain tone.
byChoice.zh: 正确：子宫松软，不能维持张力。

byChoice.en: A laceration usually causes persistent bleeding with a firm uterus; the repair here is intact and not actively bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 裂伤通常表现为子宫坚硬但仍持续出血；本例修补处完整且无活动性出血。

byChoice.en: Retained tissue can cause atony, but the placenta was documented intact and no retained-fragment cue is present at Stage 1.
byChoice.zh: 胎盘残留可导致子宫收缩不良，但本例胎盘记录为完整，第 1 阶段没有残留组织线索。

byChoice.en: Inversion would usually make the fundus absent from its expected abdominal position or visible/protruding vaginally.
byChoice.zh: 子宫内翻通常表现为腹部预期位置触不到子宫底，或阴道内可见/突出肿块。

byChoice.en: Correct: inability to sustain uterine tone is the central cue for atony.
byChoice.zh: 正确：不能维持子宫张力是收缩乏力的核心线索。

byChoice.en: This helps rule away laceration but is not the best positive evidence for atony.
byChoice.zh: 这有助于排除裂伤，但不是支持子宫收缩乏力的最佳阳性证据。

byChoice.en: Blood type and antibody screen matter for transfusion planning, not identifying the hemorrhage source.
byChoice.zh: 血型和抗体筛查对输血准备重要，但不能判断出血来源。

byChoice.en: Proteinuria supports the hypertensive pregnancy history, not the immediate cause of bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 蛋白尿支持妊娠期高血压病史，但不是当前出血原因。

byChoice.en: Correct: a palpable abdominal fundus makes inversion unlikely.
byChoice.zh: 正确：腹部可触及子宫底，使子宫内翻可能性降低。

byChoice.en: Clots support hemorrhage but do not distinguish inversion from other causes.
byChoice.zh: 血块支持出血，但不能区分子宫内翻和其他原因。

byChoice.en: Oxytocin exposure is relevant to labor history but does not rule out inversion.
byChoice.zh: 催产素使用与产程有关，但不能排除子宫内翻。

byChoice.en: Macrosomia is a risk factor for atony, not a direct rule-out for inversion.
byChoice.zh: 巨大儿是子宫收缩乏力的风险因素，但不是直接排除子宫内翻的依据。

testTakingStrategy.en: For PPH differentials, ask whether the uterus is firm or boggy. Boggy points to tone; firm with bleeding points more toward trauma or tissue.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分产后出血原因时先问子宫是坚硬还是松软。松软指向“张力”问题；子宫坚硬但仍出血则更偏向创伤或组织残留。

glossary.defZh: 产后子宫不能充分收缩以压迫胎盘附着部位血管。
产后子宫翻转内陷的一种罕见急症。
胎盘碎片残留在子宫内，可妨碍子宫收缩并导致出血。

clozeStem.en: The most likely cause of the hemorrhage is {{dd_condition}} because {{dd_best_evidence}}. Uterine inversion is unlikely because {{dd_inversion_ruleout}}.
clozeStem.zh: 最可能的出血原因是 {{dd_condition}}，因为 {{dd_best_evidence}}。子宫内翻的可能性较低，因为 {{dd_inversion_ruleout}}。

options.en: uterine inversion
options.zh: 子宫内翻

options.en: retained placental tissue
options.zh: 胎盘组织残留

options.en: uterine atony
options.zh: 子宫收缩乏力

options.en: cervical or vaginal laceration
options.zh: 宫颈或阴道裂伤

options.en: the boggy fundus briefly firms with massage but immediately relaxes
options.zh: 子宫底松软，按摩后短暂变硬但很快又松弛

options.en: the client is O-positive with a negative antibody screen
options.zh: 患者 O 型 Rh 阳性且抗体筛查阴性

options.en: the urinalysis shows 1+ protein
options.zh: 尿检显示蛋白 1+

options.en: the repaired second-degree laceration is intact
options.zh: 二度裂伤修补处完整

options.en: several small clots are present
options.zh: 可见数个小血块

options.en: the fundus is palpable above the umbilicus
options.zh: 子宫底可在脐上触及

options.en: the infant weighed 4.2 kg
options.zh: 新生儿体重 4.2 kg

options.en: oxytocin was used during labor
options.zh: 产程中使用过催产素

stem.en: The provider orders a second uterotonic. Which medication should the nurse administer from the available unit options?
stem.zh: 医嘱追加第二种宫缩药。护士应从病区可用药物中给予哪一种？

options.en: Administer carboprost tromethamine 250 mcg IM.
options.zh: 给予卡前列素氨丁三醇 250 mcg IM。

options.en: Administer methylergonovine 0.2 mg IM.
options.zh: 给予甲基麦角新碱 0.2 mg IM。

options.en: Administer misoprostol 800 mcg rectally.
options.zh: 给予米索前列醇 800 mcg 经直肠给药。

options.en: Hold all additional uterotonics until the repeat CBC and coagulation panel result.
options.zh: 在复查 CBC 和凝血功能结果出来前暂停所有追加宫缩药。

correct.en: Misoprostol is the safe second-line uterotonic in this client because methylergonovine is contraindicated by pregnancy-induced hypertension and carboprost is unsafe with asthma. Current hemorrhagic hypotension does not remove the methylergonovine contraindication.
correct.zh: 本例中米索前列醇是安全的二线宫缩药，因为妊娠期高血压禁用甲基麦角新碱，哮喘病史使卡前列素不安全。当前因失血导致的低血压并不能解除甲基麦角新碱的禁忌。

byChoice.en: Correct: misoprostol treats atony and avoids the hypertension contraindication of methylergonovine and the asthma risk of carboprost.
byChoice.zh: 正确：米索前列醇可治疗子宫收缩乏力，同时避开甲基麦角新碱的高血压禁忌和卡前列素的哮喘风险。

byChoice.en: Carboprost should be avoided in asthma because it can trigger bronchospasm.
byChoice.zh: 卡前列素应避免用于哮喘患者，因为可诱发支气管痉挛。

byChoice.en: The client is unstable with ongoing hemorrhage; uterotonic treatment must not wait for labs when the atony source is clear.
byChoice.zh: 患者不稳定且仍在出血；当子宫收缩乏力来源明确时，不应等化验结果才使用宫缩药。

byChoice.en: Methylergonovine is contraindicated with pregnancy-induced hypertension because vasoconstriction can cause severe rebound hypertension once volume is restored.
byChoice.zh: 甲基麦角新碱禁用于妊娠期高血压患者，因为补足容量后血管收缩作用可能导致严重反跳性高血压。

testTakingStrategy.en: When medication choices all treat the same problem, screen each option for patient-specific contraindications before choosing the strongest drug.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个药物都能治疗同一问题时，先根据患者个体禁忌证筛选，而不是直接选择作用最强的药。

glossary.defZh: 促进子宫收缩的药物。
一种具有血管收缩作用的宫缩药；高血压相关疾病中不安全。
一种前列腺素类宫缩药，可加重哮喘患者支气管痉挛。

stem.en: Which actions should occur now as part of the coordinated team response? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 此时哪些措施应作为团队协作反应立即进行？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Have another team member send the type and crossmatch specimen immediately.
options.zh: 由另一名团队成员立即送检配血标本。

options.en: Maintain continuous external fundal massage or assist with bimanual compression.
options.zh: 持续进行外部子宫底按摩，或协助双手压迫子宫。

options.en: Stop fundal massage so the primary nurse can draw the laboratory specimens first.
options.zh: 停止子宫底按摩，让责任护士先抽取化验标本。

options.en: Start tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 minutes per the PPH protocol after uterotonic administration is underway.
options.zh: 宫缩药给药开始后，按产后出血方案给予氨甲环酸 1 g IV，10 分钟输注。

options.en: Continue rapid warmed IV fluid resuscitation through large-bore access.
options.zh: 通过大口径静脉通路继续快速输入温热 IV 液体复苏。

options.en: Administer the selected second uterotonic without delay.
options.zh: 立即给予已选择的第二种宫缩药。

correct.en: This is not a rigid ordered sequence. The team must maintain source control with massage/compression and a safe uterotonic while restoring circulating volume, starting ordered TXA within the protocol window, and preparing blood products through another team member. Lab and blood-bank tasks should not interrupt uterine compression.
correct.zh: 这不是严格的单线顺序题。团队必须同时通过按摩/压迫和安全宫缩药控制出血来源，恢复循环容量，在方案时间窗内启动已医嘱的氨甲环酸，并由其他团队成员准备血制品。化验和血库任务不能中断子宫压迫。

byChoice.en: Stopping compression for labs allows the atonic uterus to refill and bleed; team response prevents this delay.
byChoice.zh: 为了抽血而停止压迫会使松软子宫再次充血出血；团队协作可避免这种延误。

byChoice.en: Correct: a second safe uterotonic directly treats the atony causing the hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 正确：安全的第二种宫缩药直接治疗造成出血的子宫收缩乏力。

byChoice.en: Correct: source control must be maintained continuously while the uterus is atonic.
byChoice.zh: 正确：子宫收缩乏力时必须持续维持止血源控制。

byChoice.en: Correct: blood preparation is urgent, but it should be delegated to another team member so massage and resuscitation continue.
byChoice.zh: 正确：备血很紧急，但应由其他团队成员完成，以便持续按摩和复苏。

byChoice.en: Correct: TXA is ordered by protocol for PPH not responding to first-line uterotonics and should not be delayed once source-control actions are underway.
byChoice.zh: 正确：对于一线宫缩药反应不佳的产后出血，方案已医嘱使用氨甲环酸；在止血源控制进行中的同时不应延误。

byChoice.en: Correct: rapid volume resuscitation treats hypotension and poor perfusion while bleeding control proceeds.
byChoice.zh: 正确：在止血同时快速补充容量，以处理低血压和灌注不足。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a hemorrhage item lists many tasks, separate source control and resuscitation from tasks that can be assigned to helpers. Do not convert concurrent priorities into a fake sequence.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 出血题列出多项任务时，先区分“止血源控制和复苏”与可交给他人完成的任务；不要把并行优先事项误当成严格顺序。

glossary.defZh: 一种抗纤溶辅助止血药；不是宫缩药。
在进行进一步治疗时用双手压迫子宫以减少出血。
血库为输注相容血液所做的检测。

stem.en: Classify each Stage 3 finding as evidence of early stabilization or as a finding that still requires close monitoring/continued concern.
stem.zh: 请将第 3 阶段每项发现分类为“早期稳定证据”或“仍需严密监测/持续关注”。

rows.en: Uterus is firm and contracted at the umbilicus.
rows.zh: 子宫坚硬收缩，位于脐水平。

rows.en: Lochia has decreased to moderate dark-red flow without clots.
rows.zh: 恶露减少为中等量暗红色且无血块。

rows.en: Quantitative blood loss has plateaued at 1,450 mL with no new accumulation for 15 minutes.
rows.zh: 定量失血停留在 1,450 mL，15 分钟内无新增积血。

rows.en: Client is alert, oriented, and no longer confused.
rows.zh: 患者清醒、定向力正常，不再意识混乱。

rows.en: Blood pressure has improved from 80/52 to 94/60 mmHg.
rows.zh: 血压从 80/52 mmHg 改善至 94/60 mmHg。

rows.en: Hemoglobin is 7.4 g/dL after crystalloid resuscitation and transfusion has begun.
rows.zh: 晶体液复苏后血红蛋白为 7.4 g/dL，输血已开始。

rows.en: Fibrinogen has trended down from 410 to 280 to 240 mg/dL.
rows.zh: 纤维蛋白原从 410 降至 280 再降至 240 mg/dL。

rows.en: Foley output is 25 mL/hr of concentrated amber urine.
rows.zh: Foley 尿量为 25 mL/hr，呈浓缩琥珀色。

rows.en: Heart rate is improved but remains 112 beats/min.
rows.zh: 心率较前改善但仍为 112 次/分。

correct.en: The case is improving because uterine tone is restored, lochia is reduced, QBL has plateaued, mentation is clear, and BP is trending up. She is not fully stable: hemoglobin remains severely low, fibrinogen is falling, urine output is below 30 mL/hr, and tachycardia persists, so transfusion and close monitoring must continue.
correct.zh: 本例出现改善，因为子宫张力恢复、恶露减少、定量失血停止上升、意识转清、血压回升。但患者尚未完全稳定：血红蛋白仍很低，纤维蛋白原继续下降，尿量低于 30 mL/hr，心动过速持续，因此必须继续输血和严密监测。

byChoice.en: A firm contracted uterus means the bleeding source is controlled for now.
byChoice.zh: 子宫坚硬收缩说明目前出血来源已得到控制。

byChoice.en: Decreased lochia without clots supports improved uterine control of bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 恶露减少且无血块支持子宫对出血控制改善。

byChoice.en: A plateau in measured blood loss is a direct sign that active accumulation has stopped.
byChoice.zh: 定量失血不再上升直接说明活动性积血已停止。

byChoice.en: Clearing mental status indicates improving cerebral perfusion after resuscitation.
byChoice.zh: 意识转清提示复苏后脑灌注改善。

byChoice.en: The BP is still low but improved from the shock-level reading, supporting early stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 血压仍偏低，但较休克时改善，支持早期稳定。

byChoice.en: This confirms major red-cell loss and need for continued transfusion; with controlled bleeding it does not alone prove rebleeding.
byChoice.zh: 这证实红细胞丢失严重，需要继续输血；在出血受控时，它本身不能证明再出血。

byChoice.en: The value remains above the critical 200 mg/dL threshold but the downward trend requires close monitoring for coagulopathy.
byChoice.zh: 数值仍高于 200 mg/dL 临界值，但下降趋势需要严密监测凝血障碍。

byChoice.en: Urine output below 30 mL/hr indicates ongoing renal hypoperfusion from volume deficit.
byChoice.zh: 尿量低于 30 mL/hr 提示容量不足导致肾灌注仍差。

byChoice.en: Persistent tachycardia means physiologic recovery is incomplete even though the trend is better.
byChoice.zh: 持续心动过速说明生理恢复尚未完成，即使趋势已有改善。

testTakingStrategy.en: In evaluation items, separate source control from systemic recovery. A firm uterus tells you bleeding is controlled; urine output, HR, hemoglobin, and fibrinogen tell you whether shock and coagulopathy are resolving.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价类题目要把“出血来源控制”与“全身恢复”分开看。子宫坚硬说明出血受控；尿量、心率、血红蛋白和纤维蛋白原反映休克和凝血状态是否恢复。

glossary.defZh: 尿量减少，成人临床上常以低于 30 mL/hr 作为重要警讯。
一种凝血因子，在严重产科出血中可较早下降。
补液复苏后剩余血液成分被稀释，导致测得浓度下降。

stem.en: Which findings would signal the need to anticipate escalation to intrauterine balloon tamponade or surgical intervention? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 哪些发现提示需要预期升级至宫腔球囊填塞或手术干预？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Quantitative blood loss resumes climbing despite uterotonics and compression.
options.zh: 尽管已使用宫缩药和压迫，定量失血仍继续上升。

options.en: Urine output remains 25 mL/hr but bleeding remains controlled.
options.zh: 尿量仍为 25 mL/hr，但出血保持受控。

options.en: The uterus becomes boggy again with renewed heavy lochia.
options.zh: 子宫再次变松软，并重新出现大量恶露。

options.en: Fibrinogen falls below 200 mg/dL with ongoing bleeding risk.
options.zh: 纤维蛋白原降至 200 mg/dL 以下，并存在持续出血风险。

options.en: Hemoglobin is 7.4 g/dL while the uterus is firm and QBL is plateaued.
options.zh: 子宫坚硬且定量失血停止上升时，血红蛋白为 7.4 g/dL。

options.en: Heart rate improves from 132 to 112 beats/min.
options.zh: 心率从 132 次/分改善至 112 次/分。

correct.en: Escalation is driven by loss of source control or evolving coagulopathy: recurrent bogginess with heavy bleeding, QBL that rises despite uterotonics and compression, or fibrinogen falling below the critical threshold. Low hemoglobin, oliguria, or persistent tachycardia require treatment and monitoring, but when bleeding is controlled they do not by themselves mandate surgical escalation.
correct.zh: 升级处理主要由出血来源失控或凝血障碍进展驱动：子宫再次松软并大量出血、在宫缩药和压迫后定量失血仍上升，或纤维蛋白原低于临界值。低血红蛋白、少尿或持续心动过速需要治疗和监测；但在出血受控时，它们本身不必然要求手术升级。

byChoice.en: Low urine output shows ongoing hypoperfusion and need for resuscitation, but without recurrent bleeding it is not a direct surgical trigger.
byChoice.zh: 尿量低提示灌注不足，需要继续复苏；但若没有再出血，它不是直接手术指征。

byChoice.en: Correct: recurrent atony with renewed heavy bleeding means source control has failed and escalation is needed.
byChoice.zh: 正确：子宫收缩乏力复发并再次大量出血，说明止血源控制失败，需要升级处理。

byChoice.en: Correct: continued measured blood loss despite uterotonics/compression suggests need for balloon tamponade or operative control.
byChoice.zh: 正确：在宫缩药和压迫后定量失血仍上升，提示可能需要球囊填塞或手术止血。

byChoice.en: Improved but persistent tachycardia requires monitoring; it is not an escalation trigger when bleeding is controlled.
byChoice.zh: 心率虽仍偏快但已有改善，需要监测；在出血受控时不是升级处理触发点。

byChoice.en: Correct: fibrinogen below 200 mg/dL during obstetric bleeding is a critical coagulopathy warning and supports escalation of hemorrhage management.
byChoice.zh: 正确：产科出血时纤维蛋白原低于 200 mg/dL 是凝血障碍的重要警讯，支持升级出血处理。

byChoice.en: With a firm uterus and plateaued QBL, the low hemoglobin supports transfusion and reassessment, not surgery by itself.
byChoice.zh: 在子宫坚硬且定量失血停止上升时，低血红蛋白支持输血和复查，本身不等于需要手术。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not treat every abnormal lab or vital sign as a surgical trigger. Escalation follows uncontrolled bleeding, recurrent atony, or coagulopathy crossing a critical threshold.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要把每个异常化验或生命体征都当作手术触发点。升级处理通常取决于出血失控、子宫收缩乏力复发，或凝血指标跨过关键阈值。

glossary.defZh: 将球囊置入子宫腔内，通过压力减少出血。
用于控制严重子宫出血的一种外科压迫缝合。
凝血形成受损，可加重持续出血。

title.en: Postpartum hemorrhage from uterine atony in a grand multiparous client with pregnancy-induced hypertension
title.zh: 妊娠期高血压经产妇因子宫收缩乏力发生的产后出血

summary.en: A 32-year-old G5P5 client is one hour postpartum after a vaginal birth of a 4.2 kg infant. She has pregnancy-induced hypertension treated with labetalol and mild intermittent asthma. She develops heavy bleeding, a boggy displaced fundus, tachycardia, and hypotension relative to her hypertensive baseline.
summary.zh: 一名 32 岁 G5P5 产妇在阴道分娩 4.2 kg 新生儿后 1 小时处于产后恢复期。她有妊娠期高血压，使用拉贝洛尔治疗，并有轻度间歇性哮喘。她出现大量出血、子宫底偏移且松软、心动过速，以及相对高血压基线明显下降的血压。

content.en: G5P5, one hour postpartum after vaginal birth of a 4.2 kg infant. Second stage lasted 3 hours; oxytocin augmentation was used during first stage. Placenta delivered intact and appeared complete. Pregnancy-induced hypertension was diagnosed at 34 weeks and treated with labetalol 200 mg twice daily. History includes mild intermittent asthma. No bleeding disorder, prior PPH, or uterine surgery. Admission BP 148/94 mmHg. Admission Hgb 11.8 g/dL, Hct 35.2%. Blood type O-positive; type and screen sent on admission. Oxytocin 20 units in 1 L LR has been infusing for about 50 minutes after placental delivery.
content.zh: G5P5，阴道分娩 4.2 kg 新生儿后 1 小时。第二产程持续 3 小时；第一产程使用催产素加强宫缩。胎盘娩出完整，检查外观完整。34 周诊断妊娠期高血压，使用拉贝洛尔 200 mg 每日两次。既往有轻度间歇性哮喘。无出血性疾病、既往产后出血或子宫手术史。入院血压 148/94 mmHg。入院 Hgb 11.8 g/dL，Hct 35.2%。血型 O 阳性；入院已送血型筛查。胎盘娩出后已按医嘱输注催产素 20 units 加入 1 L LR，约 50 分钟。

content.en: Client says she feels 'dizzy and wet.' She is pale, diaphoretic, alert, oriented, and anxious. Underpads show a large amount of blood; the perineal pad placed 20 minutes ago is saturated. Vital signs: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 118, BP 90/62 mmHg, RR 22, SpO2 97% on room air. Uterus is two fingerbreadths above the umbilicus, deviated to the right, and boggy; it does not stay firm after massage. Lochia is heavy with dark-red flow and several small clots. Repaired second-degree perineal laceration has no active bleeding and no visible hematoma. Bladder is palpable above the symphysis pubis. Skin is cool and clammy; capillary refill 3 seconds. Estimated blood loss is 600 mL and visibly increasing.
content.zh: 患者说自己“头晕，而且感觉很湿”。她面色苍白、出汗，意识清醒、定向力正常但焦虑。护理垫上有大量血液；20 分钟前更换的会阴垫已饱和。生命体征：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 118，BP 90/62 mmHg，RR 22，室内空气 SpO2 97%。子宫底位于脐上两横指，向右偏移且松软；按摩后不能维持坚硬。恶露量多，暗红色流出并有数个小血块。已缝合的二度会阴裂伤无活动性出血，也未见血肿。耻骨联合上方可触及膀胱。皮肤湿冷；毛细血管再充盈 3 秒。估计失血量 600 mL，并且肉眼可见仍在增加。

content.en: Hgb 11.8 g/dL, Hct 35.2%, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 410 mg/dL, INR 1.0, aPTT 28 sec. Sodium 138 mEq/L, potassium 3.9 mEq/L, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, glucose 92 mg/dL. Urinalysis: 1+ protein, otherwise unremarkable.
content.zh: Hgb 11.8 g/dL，Hct 35.2%，血小板 188 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 410 mg/dL，INR 1.0，aPTT 28 秒。钠 138 mEq/L，钾 3.9 mEq/L，肌酐 0.7 mg/dL，血糖 92 mg/dL。尿检：蛋白 1+，其余无明显异常。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：初始出血处理
第 1 阶段：初始出血处理

content.en: The nurse begins external fundal massage with lower uterine support and calls for assistance. Straight catheterization drains 450 mL of clear urine; the uterus descends to the umbilicus but remains boggy. Oxytocin is confirmed infusing and increased per standing order to infuse the remaining volume over 30 minutes. Two 16-gauge peripheral IVs are placed; warmed LR is hung wide open. Quantitative blood loss is now 800 mL. Vital signs: HR 124, BP 86/58, RR 24, SpO2 96% on room air. The provider is called to bedside.
content.zh: 护士开始在下方支托子宫的同时进行外部子宫底按摩，并呼叫协助。一次性导尿排出清亮尿液 450 mL；子宫下降至脐水平但仍松软。确认催产素正在输注，并按常规医嘱提高速度，在 30 分钟内输完剩余液体。置入两条 16G 外周静脉通路；温热 LR 全速开放。定量失血现为 800 mL。生命体征：HR 124，BP 86/58，RR 24，室内空气 SpO2 96%。已呼叫医师到床旁。

title.en: Stage 2: Persistent atony and medication selection
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：子宫收缩乏力持续及药物选择

title.en: Stage 2: Persistent atony and medication selection
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：子宫收缩乏力持续及药物选择

content.en: Despite massage and increased oxytocin, the uterus intermittently firms then relaxes within seconds. QBL is 1,200 mL. Vital signs: HR 132, BP 80/52, RR 26, SpO2 95% on room air. The client is confused and markedly pale with capillary refill 4 seconds. The provider rules out retained placental fragments and unrepaired cervical/vaginal lacerations. Available uterotonics are methylergonovine 0.2 mg IM, misoprostol 800 mcg rectally, and carboprost 250 mcg IM. Stat labs: Hgb 8.1 g/dL, Hct 24.3%, platelets 162 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 280 mg/dL, INR 1.1, aPTT 30 sec. Type and crossmatch for 2 units PRBC is sent. The unit protocol orders tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 minutes within 3 hours of birth for PPH not responding to first-line uterotonics.
content.zh: 尽管持续按摩并增加催产素输注，子宫仍间歇性变硬后数秒内又松弛。定量失血 1,200 mL。生命体征：HR 132，BP 80/52，RR 26，室内空气 SpO2 95%。患者意识混乱、明显苍白，毛细血管再充盈 4 秒。医师排除胎盘碎片残留及未修补的宫颈/阴道裂伤。可用宫缩药包括甲基麦角新碱 0.2 mg IM、米索前列醇 800 mcg 经直肠给药、卡前列素 250 mcg IM。急查化验：Hgb 8.1 g/dL，Hct 24.3%，血小板 162 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 280 mg/dL，INR 1.1，aPTT 30 秒。已送 2 单位 PRBC 配血。病区方案医嘱：对一线宫缩药反应不佳的产后出血，在分娩后 3 小时内给予氨甲环酸 1 g IV，10 分钟输注。

title.en: Stage 3: Response evaluation after source control
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：止血源控制后的反应评估

title.en: Stage 3: Response evaluation after source control
title.zh: 第 3 阶段：止血源控制后的反应评估

content.en: Misoprostol 800 mcg was given rectally, tranexamic acid 1 g IV was infused over 10 minutes, and the provider performed aggressive bimanual compression. The uterus is now firm at the umbilicus. Lochia is moderate dark red without clots. QBL has plateaued at 1,450 mL with no further active accumulation for 15 minutes. Vital signs: HR 112, BP 94/60, RR 20, SpO2 97% on 2 L nasal cannula. The client is alert and oriented but fatigued and mildly dizzy with repositioning. The first PRBC unit is infusing through a dedicated large-bore IV; a second unit is ordered. Repeat labs: Hgb 7.4 g/dL, Hct 22.1%, platelets 148 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 240 mg/dL, INR 1.2, aPTT 32 sec. Foley output is 25 mL/hr of concentrated amber urine. Fundal checks continue every 15 minutes.
content.zh: 已给予米索前列醇 800 mcg 经直肠给药，氨甲环酸 1 g IV 10 分钟输注，医师进行了积极双手子宫压迫。现在子宫坚硬，位于脐水平。恶露为中等量暗红色，无血块。定量失血停留在 1,450 mL，15 分钟内无进一步活动性增加。生命体征：HR 112，BP 94/60，RR 20，鼻导管 2 L 下 SpO2 97%。患者清醒、定向力正常，但疲乏，变换体位时仍轻度头晕。第 1 单位 PRBC 正通过专用大口径 IV 输注；已医嘱随后输注第 2 单位。复查化验：Hgb 7.4 g/dL，Hct 22.1%，血小板 148 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 240 mg/dL，INR 1.2，aPTT 32 秒。Foley 尿量 25 mL/hr，为浓缩琥珀色尿。继续每 15 分钟检查子宫底。

stem.en: Highlight the assessment findings that require immediate follow-up for postpartum hemorrhage from uterine atony.
stem.zh: 请标出需要立即针对子宫收缩乏力性产后出血进行处理的评估发现。

segments.en: Temperature 98.2 °F (36.8 °C).
Heart rate 118 beats/min.
segments.zh: 心率 118 次/分。

segments.en: Blood pressure 90/62 mmHg, down from her hypertensive admission baseline of 148/94 mmHg.
segments.zh: 血压 90/62 mmHg，低于入院时 148/94 mmHg 的妊娠期高血压基线。

segments.en: SpO2 97% on room air.
segments.zh: 室内空气下 SpO2 97%。

segments.en: The uterus is two fingerbreadths above the umbilicus, deviated to the right, and boggy.
segments.zh: 子宫底位于脐上两横指，向右偏移，触之松软。

segments.en: It does not stay firm after gentle massage.
segments.zh: 轻柔按摩后子宫不能持续变硬。

segments.en: Lochia is heavy with a steady dark-red flow and several small clots.
segments.zh: 恶露量多，持续暗红色流出，并有数个小血块。

segments.en: The repaired second-degree perineal laceration has no active bleeding and no visible hematoma.
segments.zh: 已缝合的二度会阴裂伤无活动性出血，也未见血肿。

segments.en: The bladder is palpable above the symphysis pubis.
segments.zh: 耻骨联合上方可触及膀胱。

segments.en: Skin is cool and clammy with capillary refill of 3 seconds.
segments.zh: 皮肤湿冷，毛细血管再充盈时间为 3 秒。

segments.en: Estimated blood loss is 600 mL and visibly increasing.
segments.zh: 估计失血量为 600 mL，且肉眼可见仍在增加。

segments.en: She denies chest pain or shortness of breath.
segments.zh: 她否认胸痛或气短。

correct.en: The key cues are a boggy displaced uterus that cannot maintain tone, heavy lochia with clots, blood loss already at 600 mL and increasing, tachycardia, hypotension relative to a hypertensive baseline, poor peripheral perfusion, and a palpable bladder that can worsen uterine displacement. Normal temperature and oxygen saturation do not define the problem, and the intact perineal repair helps narrow the source away from a laceration.
correct.zh: 关键线索包括子宫底偏移且松软、不能维持张力，恶露量多伴血块，失血量已达 600 mL 且仍在增加，心动过速，相对于妊娠期高血压基线明显下降的血压，外周灌注差，以及可触及的膀胱充盈（可加重子宫偏移）。体温和血氧正常不能说明当前问题；会阴修补处完整有助于把出血来源从裂伤转向子宫。

byChoice.en: A normal temperature does not define this acute hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 体温正常，不能说明当前急性出血问题。

byChoice.en: Tachycardia is an early sign of volume loss and shock in postpartum hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 心动过速是产后出血导致容量不足和休克的早期表现。

byChoice.en: The absolute BP is low, and the drop from a hypertensive baseline makes the hemodynamic compromise more severe.
byChoice.zh: 血压本身偏低，且相对妊娠期高血压基线明显下降，提示血流动力学受损更严重。

byChoice.en: Normal oxygen saturation does not rule out hemorrhagic shock and is not the defining cue here.
byChoice.zh: 血氧饱和度正常不能排除失血性休克，也不是本题的关键线索。

byChoice.en: A boggy, displaced uterus is the hallmark cue for uterine atony and impaired contraction.
byChoice.zh: 子宫底偏移且松软是子宫收缩乏力、收缩无效的标志性线索。

byChoice.en: Failure to sustain tone after massage shows that atony is ongoing.
byChoice.zh: 按摩后不能维持张力说明子宫收缩乏力仍在持续。

byChoice.en: Heavy lochia with clots supports ongoing uterine bleeding from the placental site.
byChoice.zh: 恶露量多并有血块，支持胎盘附着部位仍在子宫性出血。

byChoice.en: This is relevant because it helps rule away a laceration source, but it is not itself an abnormal hemorrhage cue needing immediate correction.
byChoice.zh: 这一正常发现有助于排除裂伤来源，但它本身不是需要立即处理的异常出血线索。

byChoice.en: A distended bladder can displace the uterus and prevent effective contraction, worsening atony.
byChoice.zh: 膀胱充盈会使子宫偏移并妨碍有效收缩，从而加重子宫收缩乏力。

byChoice.en: Cool clammy skin and delayed capillary refill are peripheral perfusion cues of hypovolemia.
byChoice.zh: 皮肤湿冷和毛细血管再充盈延迟提示低血容量导致外周灌注不足。

byChoice.en: Blood loss of 600 mL after a vaginal birth meets the traditional PPH threshold and is still increasing.
byChoice.zh: 阴道分娩后失血 600 mL 已达到传统产后出血阈值，并且仍在增加。

byChoice.en: Absence of chest pain or dyspnea is reassuring but does not address the hemorrhage source.
byChoice.zh: 无胸痛或气短较为 reassuring，但不能说明出血来源或严重程度。
