生命体征：T 36.4 C，HR 54，BP 92/58，RR 18，室内空气SpO2 94%。家中无可用体重秤。口腔黏膜干燥、皮肤弹性差、眼窝凹陷、毛细血管再充盈4秒。双下肢无水肿。双肺底轻微湿啰音。起身需最大协助。四肢肌力3/5。
骶尾部伤口：约3 cm x 2.5 cm，较出院时更深，创面苍白，周缘浸渍，坐垫上有中等量浆液性渗液。患者称失禁尿裤从前一晚起未更换。
用药证据：呋塞米瓶几乎空了；氯化钾瓶几乎满；胰岛素笔看似未使用；二甲双胍瓶缺少的片数与服用相符。询问用药时间表时，儿子变得防御。

title.zh: 第10天稍后返回的化验结果

content.en:
Fingerstick blood glucose at visit: 268 mg/dL.
Serum labs: sodium 149 mEq/L, potassium 2.9 mEq/L, chloride 98 mEq/L, CO2 30 mEq/L, BUN 48 mg/dL, creatinine 1.8 mg/dL with baseline 1.2, eGFR 28 mL/min/1.73 m2, magnesium 1.4 mEq/L, albumin 2.6 g/dL, prealbumin 11 mg/dL. A1c drawn at discharge was 8.4%.
content.zh:
随访时指尖血糖：268 mg/dL。
血液化验：钠149 mEq/L，钾2.9 mEq/L，氯98 mEq/L，CO2 30 mEq/L，BUN 48 mg/dL，肌酐1.8 mg/dL，基线1.2，eGFR 28 mL/min/1.73 m2，镁1.4 mEq/L，白蛋白2.6 g/dL，前白蛋白11 mg/dL。出院时糖化血红蛋白8.4%。

title.zh: 阶段1 - 居家随访处置

content.en: The nurse recognizes a pattern of dehydration, malnutrition, medication mismanagement, immobility, soiled clothing, worsening pressure injury, and caregiver inability to describe the care plan. The nurse contacts the home health agency supervisor and primary care provider. The provider directs emergency department evaluation for electrolyte derangements, dehydration, and acute kidney injury. The nurse initiates the agency mandatory reporting protocol for suspected elder neglect according to state law and facility policy.
content.zh: 护士识别出脱水、营养不良、用药管理不当、长期不活动、衣物污浊、压力性损伤恶化，以及照护者无法说明照护计划等模式。护士联系居家护理机构主管和初级保健提供者。提供者指示转急诊评估电解质紊乱、脱水和急性肾损伤。护士按照州法律和机构政策启动机构关于疑似老年人疏忽照护的强制报告流程。

title.en: Stage 2 - Emergency department, about 3 hours later
title.zh: 阶段2 - 约3小时后急诊

content.en:
The client is more lethargic, oriented only to person, and reports muscle weakness and palpitations. Vitals: T 36.2 C, HR 48, BP 88/52, RR 20, SpO2 93% room air. Telemetry shows sinus bradycardia with prominent U waves and flattened T waves; ECG confirms prolonged QT interval.
Orders: 500 mL normal saline bolus; potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL NS IV over 1 hour through a peripheral line; ED protocol limits peripheral potassium to 10 mEq/hr and no more than 10 mEq/100 mL. Magnesium sulfate 2 g IV over 1 hour. Hold furosemide and carvedilol pending stabilization. Fingerstick glucose every 4 hours with low-dose correction insulin per sliding scale; standing glargine held by provider order until intake and clinical picture stabilize. Repeat labs after potassium infusion. Home health APS referral is active; ED social worker begins parallel assessment.
content.zh:
患者更加嗜睡，仅能说出自己是谁，并诉肌无力和心悸。生命体征：T 36.2 C，HR 48，BP 88/52，RR 20，室内空气SpO2 93%。心电监护示窦性心动过缓，明显U波和T波低平；12导联心电图证实QT间期延长。
医嘱：0.9%氯化钠500 mL快速补液；氯化钾10 mEq加入100 mL NS，经外周静脉1小时输注；急诊方案规定外周补钾不超过10 mEq/hr，浓度不超过10 mEq/100 mL。硫酸镁2 g静脉1小时输注。呋塞米和卡维地洛暂缓，待血流动力学稳定。每4小时测指尖血糖，并按滑动量表给予低剂量纠正胰岛素；提供者医嘱在进食和临床情况稳定前暂缓常规甘精胰岛素。补钾后复查化验。居家护理已启动APS转介；急诊社工同步评估。

title.en: Stage 3 - Six hours after ED arrival
title.zh: 阶段3 - 急诊到达后6小时

title.en: Response to initial treatment and ongoing plan
title.zh: 初始治疗反应与后续计划

content.en:
After normal saline, IV potassium, and IV magnesium: sodium 146 mEq/L, potassium 3.4 mEq/L, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m2, magnesium 1.8 mEq/L, blood glucose 198 mg/dL. Vitals: T 36.6 C, HR 62, BP 100/64, RR 18, SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. Telemetry now shows normal sinus rhythm; U waves have resolved and QT interval has shortened. Client is more alert and takes small sips. Urine output over 4 hours is 120 mL.
Provider orders additional potassium replacement per facility protocol and continued IV fluids at 100 mL/hr. Wound care documents worsened stage II sacral injury, 3 cm x 2.5 cm with pale base, consistent with sustained pressure and poor nutrition. Pressure redistribution mattress and repositioning every 2 hours are initiated. APS referral remains active; a care conference is being arranged to evaluate discharge safety. Because eGFR dropped to 28 mL/min/1.73 m2 during the acute kidney injury, metformin is discontinued and will not be resumed unless renal function is reassessed and the provider clears it.
content.zh:
补充0.9%氯化钠、静脉补钾和静脉补镁后：钠146 mEq/L，钾3.4 mEq/L，肌酐1.6 mg/dL，eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m2，镁1.8 mEq/L，血糖198 mg/dL。生命体征：T 36.6 C，HR 62，BP 100/64，RR 18，鼻导管2 L氧气下SpO2 96%。心电监护现为正常窦性心律；U波消失，QT间期缩短。患者更清醒，可少量饮水。4小时尿量120 mL。
提供者按机构方案开立继续补钾和100 mL/hr维持静脉输液。伤口护理护士记录骶尾部II期压力性损伤恶化，3 cm x 2.5 cm，创面苍白，符合持续受压和营养不良。已使用减压床垫，并启动每2小时翻身。APS转介仍在进行；正在安排护理会议评估出院安全。由于急性肾损伤期间eGFR曾降至28 mL/min/1.73 m2，二甲双胍已停用；除非重新评估肾功能且提供者批准，否则不恢复使用。

stem.en: At the first home visit, classify each finding according to whether it supports suspected elder neglect by the responsible caregiver or is primarily a medical finding that still requires follow-up.
stem.zh: 在第一次居家随访时，将每项发现分类为支持怀疑主要照护者存在老年人疏忽照护，或主要属于仍需跟进的医学发现。

rows.en: No blood glucose log or daily weights despite discharge teaching
rows.zh: 出院教育后仍没有血糖记录或每日体重记录

rows.en: Soiled incontinence brief reportedly unchanged since the previous evening
rows.zh: 据患者称失禁尿裤从前一晚起未更换

rows.en: Potassium bottle nearly full and insulin pen appears unused
rows.zh: 氯化钾瓶几乎满，胰岛素笔看似未使用

rows.en: Mild cognitive impairment documented 6 months earlier
rows.zh: 6个月前记录有轻度认知障碍

rows.en: Sacral pressure injury is larger with maceration and drainage
rows.zh: 骶尾部压力性损伤增大，并有浸渍和渗液

rows.en: Sodium is 149 mEq/L and BUN is 48 mg/dL
rows.zh: 钠149 mEq/L，BUN 48 mg/dL

columns.zh: 支持疑似疏忽照护模式

columns.en: Medical finding requiring follow-up but not specific to neglect by itself
columns.zh: 需医学跟进，但单独看并非特异性疏忽证据

correct.en: The pattern of omitted monitoring, unchanged soiled brief, medication evidence inconsistent with the prescribed regimen, and a worsened pressure injury after prolonged sitting supports suspected neglect. Cognitive impairment and abnormal labs require care, but by themselves they do not prove neglect; they become concerning when integrated with caregiver failures and environmental evidence.
correct.zh: 未进行监测、失禁尿裤长时间未更换、用药证据与医嘱不符，以及长期坐位后压力性损伤加重，这些共同支持疑似疏忽照护。认知障碍和异常化验需要处理，但单独不能证明疏忽；当它们与照护者未履行照护任务和环境证据结合时才更令人担忧。

byChoice.en: Missing logs after specific discharge teaching show that ordered monitoring tasks were not carried out.
byChoice.zh: 在已有明确出院教育后仍缺少记录，说明医嘱监测任务没有落实。

byChoice.en: An unchanged soiled brief indicates failure to provide basic hygiene and skin protection.
byChoice.zh: 失禁尿裤未更换提示未提供基本清洁和皮肤保护。

byChoice.en: The bottle and pen evidence suggests omitted potassium and insulin, directly supporting medication mismanagement.
byChoice.zh: 药瓶和胰岛素笔证据提示漏用氯化钾和胰岛素，直接支持用药管理不当。

byChoice.en: Mild cognitive impairment increases vulnerability but is a client condition, not proof that the caregiver failed to provide care.
byChoice.zh: 轻度认知障碍增加脆弱性，但这是患者自身状况，不能单独证明照护者未提供照护。

byChoice.en: A worsening pressure injury with drainage is consistent with poor repositioning, hygiene, and nutrition in this care context.
byChoice.zh: 压力性损伤加重并有渗液，在本照护情境下符合翻身减压、清洁和营养不足。

byChoice.en: Hypernatremia and elevated BUN support dehydration, but the lab values alone do not identify the cause as neglect.
byChoice.zh: 高钠和BUN升高支持脱水，但化验值本身不能单独说明原因就是疏忽照护。

testTakingStrategy.en: Look for a pattern across client condition, environment, caregiver behavior, and objective evidence rather than treating each cue in isolation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要孤立看每个线索，要把患者状况、环境、照护者行为和客观证据合并判断是否形成模式。

glossary.defZh: 照护者未能提供必要的食物、卫生、药物、安全或医疗照护。
核对患者实际用药与医嘱是否一致的过程。
局部皮肤或深部组织因持续受压或剪切力导致的损伤。

stem.en: Which medication-related problem is the most immediate safety priority at the first home visit?
stem.zh: 第一次居家随访时，哪一项用药相关问题是最紧急的安全优先事项？

options.en: Carvedilol should be doubled because the client no longer has leg edema
options.zh: 因患者下肢不再水肿，应将卡维地洛加倍

options.en: Metformin appears to have been taken as prescribed, so the client should receive an extra dose to lower the glucose
options.zh: 二甲双胍似乎按医嘱服用，因此应额外服用一次以降低血糖

options.en: The unused insulin pen explains the hyperglycemia, so glucose correction is more urgent than the potassium result
options.zh: 未使用的胰岛素笔解释了高血糖，因此纠正血糖比处理钾值更紧急

options.en: Furosemide appears to have been given while potassium chloride was likely omitted, contributing to severe hypokalemia with bradycardia and hypotension
options.zh: 呋塞米似乎已服用，而氯化钾很可能漏用，导致严重低钾并伴心动过缓和低血压

correct.en: The nearly empty furosemide bottle with a nearly full potassium bottle, potassium 2.9 mEq/L, bradycardia, hypotension, and later ECG changes point to immediate cardiac risk from hypokalemia. Hyperglycemia from missed insulin is important, but the potassium deficit with hemodynamic and conduction risk is the priority to escalate for provider-directed treatment and monitoring.
correct.zh: 呋塞米瓶几乎空、氯化钾瓶几乎满，加上钾2.9 mEq/L、心动过缓、低血压以及随后出现的心电图改变，提示低钾带来的即时心脏风险。漏用胰岛素导致高血糖也重要，但伴血流动力学和传导风险的低钾更需要优先升级处理并按提供者医嘱监测治疗。

byChoice.en: This integrates the medication evidence with the vital signs and lab result to identify a potentially lethal electrolyte problem.
byChoice.zh: 此项把用药证据、生命体征和化验结果结合起来，识别出可能致命的电解质问题。

byChoice.en: Missed insulin and glucose 268 mg/dL require management, but they do not outweigh severe hypokalemia with cardiac instability cues.
byChoice.zh: 漏用胰岛素和血糖268 mg/dL需要处理，但不比伴心脏不稳定线索的严重低钾更紧急。

byChoice.en: Extra metformin is not a nursing action and would be unsafe in acute kidney injury with reduced eGFR.
byChoice.zh: 额外给予二甲双胍不是护理独立措施，而且在急性肾损伤和eGFR降低时不安全。

byChoice.en: Changing beta-blocker doses is not a nursing action, and bradycardia/hypotension argue against increasing carvedilol.
byChoice.zh: 调整β受体阻滞剂剂量不是护士独立行为，而且心动过缓和低血压提示不应增加卡维地洛。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several problems exist, prioritize the one most likely to cause rapid deterioration: unstable vital signs plus a dangerous electrolyte abnormality outrank a moderate glucose elevation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 多个问题同时存在时，优先处理最可能迅速恶化的问题：不稳定生命体征加危险电解质异常，高于中度血糖升高。

glossary.defZh: 血清钾低于正常范围，可导致肌无力和心律失常。
如呋塞米，可增加尿量并促进钾排泄。
心率低于预期范围，可能降低心输出量。

stem.en: After completing the first home assessment, which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 完成第一次居家评估后，哪些护理措施是合适的？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Document objective findings, medication evidence, caregiver statements, and notifications made
options.zh: 记录客观发现、用药证据、照护者陈述以及已通知的对象

options.en: Teach the son again and leave the client at home because no one has confirmed neglect yet
options.zh: 再次教育儿子，并因尚未确认疏忽照护而让患者留在家中

options.en: Wait to report until the nurse can prove the son intentionally caused harm
options.zh: 等到护士能证明儿子故意造成伤害后再报告

options.en: Initiate the agency mandatory reporting process for suspected elder neglect according to state law and facility policy
options.zh: 按照州法律和机构政策启动机构关于疑似老年人疏忽照护的强制报告流程

options.en: Notify the home health agency supervisor and primary care provider about the acute findings and suspected neglect
options.zh: 向居家护理机构主管和初级保健提供者报告急性发现和疑似疏忽照护

options.en: Arrange emergency department evaluation as directed for electrolyte derangements, dehydration, and acute kidney injury
options.zh: 按指示安排急诊评估电解质紊乱、脱水和急性肾损伤

correct.en: The client has acute clinical instability that exceeds home health capability and a pattern that meets the threshold for suspected neglect. The nurse should escalate clinically, arrange emergency evaluation as ordered, follow mandatory reporting policy, and document objective findings and communications. Proof of intent is not required to report suspicion.
correct.zh: 患者存在超出居家护理能力的急性临床不稳定，同时表现出达到疑似疏忽照护报告门槛的模式。护士应进行临床升级处理，按医嘱安排急诊评估，遵循强制报告政策，并记录客观发现和沟通内容。报告疑似情况不需要证明故意伤害。

byChoice.en: Teaching alone is inadequate because the client has acute instability and an unsafe care pattern.
byChoice.zh: 仅再次教育不足以处理问题，因为患者已有急性不稳定和不安全照护模式。

byChoice.en: The hypotension, bradycardia, AKI, dehydration, and severe hypokalemia require ED-level evaluation and monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 低血压、心动过缓、急性肾损伤、脱水和严重低钾需要急诊级别评估和监测。

byChoice.en: Objective documentation supports continuity of care, legal reporting, and interdisciplinary follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 客观记录有助于护理连续性、法律报告和跨专业跟进。

byChoice.en: The nurse reports suspected neglect through the designated process; the report is not delayed until neglect is proven.
byChoice.zh: 护士通过指定流程报告疑似疏忽照护；不应等到完全证实后才报告。

byChoice.en: Mandatory reporting is based on suspicion according to policy and law, not proof of intent by the caregiver.
byChoice.zh: 强制报告依据政策和法律下的疑似情况，而不是照护者故意伤害的证明。

byChoice.en: Supervisor and provider notification addresses both agency chain of command and the acute medical needs.
byChoice.zh: 通知主管和提供者同时满足机构汇报链和急性医疗需要。

testTakingStrategy.en: In abuse or neglect questions, separate treatment of acute medical instability from protective reporting duties; both may need to happen.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到虐待或疏忽照护题时，要区分急性医学不稳定的处理和保护性报告义务；两者可能都需要执行。

glossary.defZh: 法律或机构政策要求专业人员报告疑似虐待或疏忽的义务。
调查和协助处理成人虐待、疏忽或剥削风险的社会服务系统。
在机构内按规定层级升级报告问题的流程。

stem.en: In the emergency department, the provider orders potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL NS over 1 hour through a peripheral IV. Which nursing actions are appropriate before and during administration? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在急诊，提供者开立氯化钾10 mEq加入100 mL NS，经外周静脉1小时输注。给药前和给药过程中哪些护理措施合适？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Use an infusion pump for the potassium infusion
options.zh: 使用输液泵输注氯化钾

options.en: Continue to monitor rhythm, repeat labs as ordered, and assess for signs of overcorrection
options.zh: 继续监测心律、按医嘱复查化验，并评估是否出现纠正过度的迹象

options.en: Confirm that magnesium replacement is being administered as ordered
options.zh: 确认镁剂补充正按医嘱执行

options.en: Give the dose by IV push because the potassium is severely low
options.zh: 因钾严重偏低而静脉推注该剂量

options.en: Monitor the peripheral IV site for pain, infiltration, or phlebitis
options.zh: 监测外周静脉部位是否疼痛、渗漏或静脉炎

options.en: Verify continuous telemetry is active before starting the infusion
options.zh: 开始输注前确认持续心电监护已开启

correct.en: The order matches the ED protocol stated in the case: 10 mEq/hr and 10 mEq/100 mL through a peripheral line, using an infusion pump with continuous telemetry. The nurse also monitors the IV site, rhythm, and follow-up labs. Magnesium repletion supports potassium correction when magnesium is low. IV push potassium is unsafe.
correct.zh: 该医嘱符合病例中列出的急诊方案：外周静脉10 mEq/hr，浓度10 mEq/100 mL，使用输液泵并持续心电监护。护士还需监测静脉部位、心律和后续化验。低镁时补镁有助于纠正低钾。静脉推注氯化钾不安全。

byChoice.en: An infusion pump controls the rate and reduces the risk of rapid potassium administration.
byChoice.zh: 输液泵可控制速度，降低钾输注过快的风险。

byChoice.en: Peripheral potassium can irritate veins; site monitoring helps detect infiltration or phlebitis early.
byChoice.zh: 外周补钾可刺激静脉；监测穿刺部位可及早发现渗漏或静脉炎。

byChoice.en: Low magnesium can make potassium correction difficult; the ordered magnesium replacement is part of safe electrolyte management.
byChoice.zh: 低镁会使低钾难以纠正；医嘱补镁是安全管理电解质的一部分。

byChoice.en: Telemetry is required by the stated ED protocol and is appropriate because hypokalemia affects cardiac conduction.
byChoice.zh: 病例中的急诊方案要求心电监护；低钾影响心脏传导，因此需要监护。

byChoice.en: IV push potassium can cause life-threatening arrhythmias and is not appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 静脉推注钾可导致危及生命的心律失常，不合适。

byChoice.en: Follow-up monitoring detects response to treatment and signs of excessive potassium replacement.
byChoice.zh: 后续监测可发现治疗反应以及补钾过度迹象。

testTakingStrategy.en: For high-alert IV electrolytes, check the prescribed concentration, route, rate-control device, monitoring, and follow-up labs before focusing on less urgent tasks.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理高警示静脉电解质时，先核对浓度、途径、速度控制设备、监测和复查化验，再考虑次要任务。

glossary.defZh: 用于补充钾的药物，静脉给药需严格控制速度和监测。
持续观察心律和传导变化的监测方式。
血清钾过高，可导致严重心律失常。
补充镁以纠正低镁，并帮助稳定钾平衡。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the nurse reviews the provider order to discontinue metformin because the client's eGFR dropped to 28 mL/min/1.73 m2 during the acute kidney injury. Which interpretation is best?
stem.zh: 在阶段3，护士复核提供者因患者急性肾损伤期间eGFR降至28 mL/min/1.73 m2而停用二甲双胍的医嘱。哪项理解最恰当？

options.en: The order is appropriate; metformin should remain held until renal function is reassessed and the provider determines whether it is safe to resume
options.zh: 该医嘱合适；二甲双胍应继续暂停，直到重新评估肾功能并由提供者判断是否可安全恢复

options.en: The nurse should restart metformin because the repeat eGFR improved to 33 mL/min/1.73 m2
options.zh: 护士应重新开始二甲双胍，因为复查eGFR已改善至33 mL/min/1.73 m2

options.en: Metformin is the priority medication to treat the client's acute hypokalemia
options.zh: 二甲双胍是治疗患者急性低钾的优先药物

options.en: Metformin should be continued because the client has taken it chronically
options.zh: 因患者长期服用二甲双胍，所以应继续使用

correct.en: The client had acute kidney injury with eGFR 28 mL/min/1.73 m2, and metformin accumulation in significant renal impairment increases lactic acidosis risk. Even though the repeat eGFR improved to 33, the nurse should not independently restart it; renal function must be reassessed and provider clearance is required.
correct.zh: 患者出现急性肾损伤，eGFR曾为28 mL/min/1.73 m2；在明显肾功能受损时二甲双胍蓄积会增加乳酸性酸中毒风险。即使复查eGFR改善至33，护士也不应自行恢复用药；需要重新评估肾功能并由提供者批准。

byChoice.en: Metformin lowers glucose; it does not treat hypokalemia.
byChoice.zh: 二甲双胍用于降糖，并不治疗低钾。

byChoice.en: This recognizes both the below-threshold eGFR during AKI and the need for provider-directed reassessment before resumption.
byChoice.zh: 此项同时识别了急性肾损伤期间eGFR低于安全阈值，以及恢复用药前需由提供者重新评估。

byChoice.en: Chronic use does not override acute kidney injury and renal-safety precautions.
byChoice.zh: 长期使用不能凌驾于急性肾损伤和肾功能安全注意事项之上。

byChoice.en: A single partial improvement does not authorize the nurse to restart a held medication without provider clearance.
byChoice.zh: 单次部分改善不能授权护士在无提供者批准下恢复已停用药物。

testTakingStrategy.en: For medication-safety questions, compare the drug with current organ function and ask whether the nurse has authority to resume or alter it independently.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到用药安全题时，将药物与当前器官功能相对照，并判断护士是否有权独立恢复或调整该药。

glossary.defZh: 反映肾脏滤过功能的指标，常用于判断药物肾脏安全性。
常用口服降糖药，肾功能明显下降时需谨慎或停用。
乳酸积聚导致的代谢性酸中毒，可危及生命。
短时间内肾功能下降，可能影响药物清除。

stem.en: At Stage 3, which findings show that continued monitoring or interdisciplinary planning is still needed before discharge back to the same home environment? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，哪些发现表明在出院回到同一家庭环境前仍需继续监测或跨专业计划？选择所有适用项。

options.en: U waves resolved and the QT interval shortened
options.zh: U波消失，QT间期缩短

options.en: Blood pressure and heart rate improved after treatment
options.zh: 治疗后血压和心率改善

options.en: APS referral and safe-discharge care conference are still in progress
options.zh: APS转介和安全出院护理会议仍在进行中

options.en: Potassium improved to 3.4 mEq/L but remains below the usual normal range
options.zh: 钾改善至3.4 mEq/L，但仍低于通常正常范围

options.en: Creatinine remains above the client's baseline after initial fluids
options.zh: 初始补液后肌酐仍高于患者基线

options.en: The pressure injury is still worsened and nutrition markers are low
options.zh: 压力性损伤仍然恶化，营养指标偏低

correct.en: The client is improving, but improvement is not resolution. Potassium remains low, kidney function has not returned to baseline, the wound and nutrition deficits need active treatment, and the protective services/discharge-safety process is unresolved. Resolved U waves and improved vital signs are reassuring response cues, not reasons to stop planning.
correct.zh: 患者正在改善，但改善不等于问题完全解决。钾仍偏低，肾功能尚未回到基线，伤口和营养缺陷仍需积极处理，保护服务和出院安全流程尚未完成。U波消失和生命体征改善是令人放心的治疗反应线索，而不是停止计划的理由。

byChoice.en: Resolution of U waves and QT shortening indicate improvement in the acute cardiac effect of hypokalemia.
byChoice.zh: U波消失和QT间期缩短提示低钾的急性心脏影响正在改善。

byChoice.en: Creatinine 1.6 mg/dL remains above the 1.2 mg/dL baseline, so kidney recovery and medication safety need follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐1.6 mg/dL仍高于1.2 mg/dL基线，因此肾功能恢复和用药安全需继续跟进。

byChoice.en: A worsened pressure injury with low albumin/prealbumin requires wound care, nutrition support, and pressure relief planning.
byChoice.zh: 压力性损伤恶化并伴白蛋白/前白蛋白低，需要伤口护理、营养支持和减压计划。

byChoice.en: A potassium of 3.4 mEq/L is improved but still requires monitoring and ordered replacement.
byChoice.zh: 钾3.4 mEq/L虽有改善，但仍需监测并按医嘱补充。

byChoice.en: The client should not be sent back to the same unsafe pattern without interdisciplinary assessment of discharge safety.
byChoice.zh: 在未跨专业评估出院安全前，不应让患者回到同样不安全的照护模式。

byChoice.en: Improved heart rate and blood pressure are positive response findings, but they do not by themselves identify an unresolved discharge barrier.
byChoice.zh: 心率和血压改善是积极反应，但本身并不代表未解决的出院障碍。

testTakingStrategy.en: In outcome-evaluation items, distinguish response to treatment from full readiness for discharge; persistent physiologic, wound, nutrition, and safety risks still matter.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做结局评估题时，要区分治疗有反应和完全可出院；持续存在的生理、伤口、营养和安全风险仍然重要。

glossary.defZh: 跨专业团队为患者离院后的安全照护、随访和资源安排所做的计划。
包括护理、医生、社工、营养、伤口护理等不同专业人员的团队。
反映营养和炎症状态的血清蛋白，低值会影响伤口愈合。
持续观察心律变化以发现传导异常或心律失常。

note: Campaign 17 A/B producer implementation; full parent preimage frozen; independent review pending

title.en: Tuberculosis rule-out in a newly admitted patient with chronic cough and immunosuppression
title.zh: 新入院免疫抑制患者因慢性咳嗽接受结核病排查

summary.en: A 47-year-old man is admitted for evaluation of a 6-week productive cough with occasional blood-streaked sputum, drenching night sweats, 7 kg weight loss, and fatigue. He takes methotrexate and chronic prednisone for rheumatoid arthritis and works as a long-haul bus driver with frequent travel through crowded, poorly ventilated buses. He is placed in an airborne infection isolation room while tuberculosis is evaluated.
summary.zh: 一名47岁男性因持续6周的咳嗽入院评估，咳少量黄痰并偶有血丝，伴盗汗、体重下降7公斤和乏力。他因类风湿关节炎长期使用甲氨蝶呤和泼尼松，并从事长途客车驾驶，常处于拥挤、通风不良的车厢环境。因需排查结核病，患者被安置在空气传播隔离病房。

content.en: History: persistent productive cough for about 6 weeks, occasional blood-streaked sputum, night sweats 3-4 times/week, 7 kg (15 lb) unintentional weight loss over 2 months, progressive fatigue, mild exertional shortness of breath. No known HIV diagnosis; HIV antigen/antibody test ordered. No prior tuberculin skin test or IGRA. Medications: methotrexate 15 mg PO weekly, prednisone 7.5 mg PO daily for 2 years, amlodipine 5 mg PO daily, omeprazole 20 mg PO daily. The patient has never received BCG vaccine.
content.zh: 病史：咳嗽咳痰约6周，偶有痰中带血，每周盗汗3-4次，2个月内非自愿体重下降7公斤（15磅），乏力加重，活动后轻度气短。无已知HIV诊断；已医嘱检测HIV抗原/抗体。既往未做过结核菌素皮肤试验或IGRA。用药：甲氨蝶呤15 mg口服每周一次，泼尼松7.5 mg口服每日一次已2年，氨氯地平5 mg口服每日一次，奥美拉唑20 mg口服每日一次。患者从未接种过卡介苗。

content.en: Vital signs: T 38.3 C (101.0 F), HR 92/min, BP 118/74 mm Hg, RR 20/min, SpO2 95% on room air. Height 178 cm, weight 64 kg, BMI 20.2. The patient appears thin and fatigued with temporal wasting. Cervical and supraclavicular lymph nodes are small, firm, and non-tender bilaterally. Right upper posterior chest percussion is dull with bronchial breath sounds and coarse crackles over the right upper lobe. The patient is alert, oriented, and cooperative.
content.zh: 生命体征：体温100.9 °F (38.3 °C)，心率92次/分，血压118/74 mm Hg，呼吸20次/分，室内空气SpO2 95%。身高178 cm，体重64 kg，BMI 20.2。患者消瘦、疲乏，有颞部消瘦。双侧颈部和锁骨上淋巴结小、质硬、无压痛。右上后胸部叩诊浊音，右上肺可闻支气管样呼吸音和粗湿啰音。患者清醒、定向力正常、配合。

title.zh: 医嘱、实验室资料和影像

content.en: Orders: airborne infection isolation precautions; three sputum specimens for AFB smear and mycobacterial culture, collected 8-24 hours apart with at least one early-morning specimen; chest radiograph; QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus; CBC; CMP; ESR; HIV antigen/antibody test; high-calorie, high-protein dietary consult. Baseline labs: WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 11.4 g/dL, hematocrit 34.2%, platelets 410 ×10³/µL, sodium 136 mEq/L, potassium 4.1 mEq/L, BUN 14 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, AST 42 U/L, ALT 48 U/L, ESR 68 mm/hr. Chest radiograph: right upper lobe infiltrate with a 2.3 cm cavitary lesion; no pleural effusion; no hilar lymphadenopathy.
content.zh: 医嘱：空气传播隔离；采集3份痰标本做抗酸杆菌涂片和分枝杆菌培养，间隔8-24小时，至少1份为清晨标本；胸片；QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus；全血细胞计数；综合代谢面板；红细胞沉降率；HIV抗原/抗体检测；高热量、高蛋白饮食会诊。基线实验室结果：WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白11.4 g/dL，血细胞比容34.2%，血小板410 ×10³/µL，钠136 mEq/L，钾4.1 mEq/L，BUN 14 mg/dL，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，AST 42 U/L，ALT 48 U/L，ESR 68 mm/hr。胸片：右上肺浸润影，伴2.3 cm空洞性病灶；无胸腔积液；无肺门淋巴结肿大。

title.en: Stage 1: Admission evening through first 16 hours
title.zh: 阶段1：入院当晚至最初16小时

title.en: Stage 1: Admission evening through first 16 hours
title.zh: 阶段1：入院当晚至最初16小时

content.en: The first sputum specimen is collected at 2100 after the nurse coaches the patient to rinse with water, take several deep breaths, and cough deeply into a sterile container. The second specimen is collected at 0530 the next morning. The patient has drenching night sweats and a temperature spike to 102 °F (38.9 °C). Airborne precautions are documented: AIIR door closed, negative-pressure indicator functioning, staff wear N95 respirators before entering, and the patient wears a surgical/procedure mask during brief transport to radiology. A nursing assistant asks whether she can enter the room wearing a standard surgical mask just to take vital signs quickly. QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus returns positive. HIV antigen/antibody test returns negative.
content.zh: 21:00采集第1份痰标本，护士指导患者先用清水漱口、深呼吸数次，再深咳入无菌容器。次日05:30采集第2份痰标本。患者夜间大量盗汗，体温升至102 °F (38.9 °C)。护理记录显示空气传播隔离严格执行：AIIR房门关闭，负压指示器正常，工作人员进入前佩戴N95呼吸防护口罩，患者短暂转运至放射科时佩戴外科/医用口罩。一名护理助理询问，是否可以只戴普通外科口罩进入房间快速测量生命体征。QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus结果阳性；HIV抗原/抗体检测阴性。

content.en: The third sputum specimen is collected at 1400, more than 8 hours after the second specimen. The first two AFB smears return positive. NAAT is positive for Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex. Infectious disease starts isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol. Pyridoxine is ordered with isoniazid. Baseline visual acuity and red-green color discrimination testing are ordered before the first ethambutol dose. Rheumatology recommends holding methotrexate due to immunosuppressive and hepatotoxic overlap and writes a prednisone taper. The local public health department has been notified and begins contact investigation planning.
content.zh: 14:00采集第3份痰标本，距离第2份标本超过8小时。前2份AFB涂片结果阳性。核酸扩增检测提示结核分枝杆菌复合群阳性。感染病科启动异烟肼、利福平、吡嗪酰胺和乙胺丁醇治疗。异烟肼同时医嘱吡哆醇。首次给予乙胺丁醇前，医嘱进行基线视力和红绿色觉检查。风湿科建议因免疫抑制和肝毒性重叠暂停甲氨蝶呤，并开具泼尼松逐渐减量方案。当地公共卫生部门已获通知，并开始规划接触者调查。

content.en: After three doses of the four-drug TB regimen, the patient reports nausea. Temperature is 100 °F (37.8 °C). Labs at 48 hours: AST 58 U/L, ALT 72 U/L. The third AFB smear returns positive. The patient asks whether he is contagious forever and whether his apartment neighbors are at risk. He expresses guilt about exposing others and hopelessness about his finances and health.
content.zh: 患者已接受3剂四联抗结核治疗后诉恶心。体温100 °F (37.8 °C)。48小时实验室结果：AST 58 U/L，ALT 72 U/L。第3份AFB涂片阳性。患者询问自己是否会一直有传染性，以及公寓邻居是否有风险。他对可能暴露他人感到内疚，并对经济状况和健康感到绝望。

content.en: The patient is tolerating meals better and cough is less frequent. Repeat labs: AST 86 U/L, ALT 104 U/L, total bilirubin 1.8 mg/dL. The infectious disease provider states that if the next ALT exceeds 120 U/L (3 times the facility upper limit of normal) with any hepatotoxicity symptoms, the hepatotoxic agents will be held. Discharge planning distinguishes diagnostic sputum collection, discontinuation of inpatient airborne precautions, and safe discharge home. Three negative smears are not automatic discharge criteria, and a positive smear does not automatically require indefinite hospitalization if public-health and home-isolation criteria are met.
content.zh: 患者进食耐受改善，咳嗽减少。复查实验室结果：AST 86 U/L，ALT 104 U/L，总胆红素1.8 mg/dL。感染病科医嘱说明：如果下一次ALT超过120 U/L（为本机构正常上限的3倍）且出现任何肝毒性症状，将暂停肝毒性药物。出院计划明确区分诊断性痰标本采集、停止住院空气传播隔离、以及安全居家出院。3次阴性涂片并不自动等于可以出院；若符合公共卫生和居家隔离标准，涂片阳性也不自动意味着必须无限期住院。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: At Stage 1, the nursing assistant asks whether she may enter the AIIR wearing only a standard surgical mask to take vital signs quickly. Which response by the nurse is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 在阶段1，护理助理询问是否可以只戴普通外科口罩进入AIIR快速测量生命体征。护士最合适的回应是什么？

options.en: You may enter with a surgical mask because the exposure will be brief.
options.zh: 可以只戴外科口罩进入，因为接触时间很短。

options.en: Ask the patient to cover his mouth with tissues so staff can use droplet precautions instead.
options.zh: 请患者用纸巾遮住口鼻，这样工作人员可以改用飞沫隔离措施。

options.en: Do not enter unless you are wearing the required fit-tested N95 respirator for this airborne isolation room.
options.zh: 除非佩戴本空气传播隔离房间要求的、经密合性测试的N95呼吸防护口罩，否则不要进入。

options.en: A surgical mask is acceptable if the patient also wears a surgical mask while you are in the room.
options.zh: 如果患者在你进入房间时也戴外科口罩，那么你戴外科口罩即可。

correct.en: The patient is in airborne infection isolation for suspected or confirmed infectious TB. Staff entering the AIIR need the required respiratory protection; a standard surgical mask is for patient source control during transport and does not replace staff N95 protection.
correct.zh: 患者因疑似或确诊具有传染性的结核病接受空气传播隔离。进入AIIR的工作人员需要规定的呼吸防护；普通外科口罩用于患者转运时的源头控制，不能替代工作人员的N95防护。

byChoice.en: Brief exposure does not remove the airborne-precaution requirement for staff entering the room.
byChoice.zh: 接触时间短并不能取消工作人员进入房间时的空气传播隔离防护要求。

byChoice.en: Covering the mouth may reduce secretion spread but does not change suspected TB from airborne precautions to droplet precautions.
byChoice.zh: 遮住口鼻可减少分泌物播散，但不能把疑似结核病的空气传播隔离改为飞沫隔离。

byChoice.en: Required N95 protection matches the documented AIIR precautions and protects staff from airborne droplet nuclei.
byChoice.zh: 佩戴规定的N95防护符合AIIR隔离要求，可保护工作人员避免吸入空气传播微粒。

byChoice.en: The patient's surgical mask is used for source control during transport; it does not make a surgical mask adequate for staff inside the AIIR.
byChoice.zh: 患者佩戴外科口罩是转运时的源头控制；这并不代表工作人员在AIIR内只戴外科口罩就足够。

testTakingStrategy.en: For isolation questions, separate protection for staff from source control for the patient. TB is airborne, so staff entering the room require respirator-level protection.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到隔离题时，要区分工作人员防护和患者源头控制。结核病按空气传播处理，工作人员进入房间需要呼吸防护级别的防护。

glossary.defZh: 用于空气传播病原体的隔离房间，通常需保持负压。
能过滤微小空气颗粒的呼吸防护用品，需按机构政策进行密合性测试。
通过给患者戴口罩等方式减少病原体从患者向外播散。

stem.en: At Stage 1, the patient asks, 'Does my coworker need to be tested for TB?' Which response best supports safe care coordination?
stem.zh: 在阶段1，患者问：“我的同事需要接受结核病检测吗？”哪项回应最能支持安全的照护协调？

options.en: Your coworker does not need testing unless they have symptoms.
options.zh: 除非你的同事有症状，否则不需要检测。

options.en: Anyone who has ever ridden with you in the bus must immediately start tuberculosis medications.
options.zh: 任何曾经坐过你车的人都必须立即开始抗结核药物治疗。

options.en: Give me your coworker's phone number and I will personally tell them to come to the hospital for testing today.
options.zh: 把你同事的电话号码给我，我会亲自通知他们今天来医院检测。

options.en: I will explain that the public health team will conduct a contact investigation and determine who needs evaluation based on exposure details.
options.zh: 我会说明公共卫生团队会进行接触者调查，并根据暴露细节决定谁需要评估。

correct.en: Contact investigation is coordinated through public health and is based on exposure duration, proximity, ventilation, and individual risk. The nurse should explain the process and coordinate, not independently decide who does or does not need testing.
correct.zh: 接触者调查由公共卫生部门协调，并根据暴露时间、距离、通风情况和个体风险来判断。护士应解释流程并协助协调，而不是自行决定谁需要或不需要检测。

byChoice.en: Exposure does not automatically mean immediate TB medications; contacts require risk-based evaluation first.
byChoice.zh: 有暴露并不自动意味着必须立即服用抗结核药；接触者需先进行基于风险的评估。

byChoice.en: This response gives accurate process information and preserves public health's role in contact investigation.
byChoice.zh: 此回应提供准确的流程信息，并保留公共卫生部门在接触者调查中的职责。

byChoice.en: The nurse should not independently direct individual contacts outside the formal contact investigation process.
byChoice.zh: 护士不应绕过正式接触者调查流程，私自指挥个别接触者就医检测。

byChoice.en: Testing decisions are not limited to symptomatic contacts; asymptomatic exposed contacts may still need evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 检测决策并不只限于有症状的接触者；无症状但有暴露的人也可能需要评估。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a public health process is involved, choose the answer that explains and coordinates the process without overstepping the nurse's role.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到涉及公共卫生流程的题目，选择能解释并协调流程、但不超越护士职责的答案。

glossary.defZh: 公共卫生部门追踪并评估可能暴露于传染病患者的人群。
与感染源接触到可能导致感染风险的情况。
关注人群层面疾病预防、监测和控制的卫生系统职能。

stem.en: At Stage 2, ethambutol is prescribed as part of the initial four-drug TB regimen. Which nursing action is essential before the first dose?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，乙胺丁醇被纳入初始四联抗结核方案。首次给药前哪项护理措施最重要？

options.en: Teach the patient that orange urine is the dose-limiting toxicity of ethambutol.
options.zh: 告知患者橙色尿液是乙胺丁醇的剂量限制性毒性。

options.en: Hold ethambutol until all three AFB cultures are finalized.
options.zh: 等到3份AFB培养全部最终报告后再给乙胺丁醇。

options.en: Verify that baseline visual acuity and red-green color discrimination testing are documented.
options.zh: 确认已记录基线视力和红绿色觉检查。

options.en: Administer the drug only if the patient has received BCG vaccine.
options.zh: 只有患者接种过卡介苗时才给予该药。

correct.en: Ethambutol can cause optic neuritis, so baseline visual acuity and color discrimination testing create a reference point for detecting drug-related visual changes. The case order specifically requires this testing before the first dose.
correct.zh: 乙胺丁醇可导致视神经炎，因此基线视力和色觉检查可作为发现药物相关视觉变化的参照。病例医嘱也明确要求首次给药前进行这些检查。

byChoice.en: BCG vaccination status does not determine whether ethambutol can be given in the ordered regimen.
byChoice.zh: 卡介苗接种史并不决定医嘱方案中是否可以使用乙胺丁醇。

byChoice.en: This is the essential baseline safety assessment for ethambutol in this case.
byChoice.zh: 这是本病例中使用乙胺丁醇前必需的基线安全评估。

byChoice.en: Orange body fluid discoloration is classically associated with rifampin teaching, not the ethambutol dose-limiting toxicity being tested here.
byChoice.zh: 体液橙色改变通常是利福平相关教学点，而不是本题考查的乙胺丁醇剂量限制性毒性。

byChoice.en: The case has positive smears and NAAT; waiting for finalized cultures is not the stated prerequisite before ordered initial therapy.
byChoice.zh: 病例已有涂片阳性和NAAT阳性；等待培养最终报告并不是医嘱初始治疗前的条件。

testTakingStrategy.en: Link each anti-TB medication to its key safety monitoring. Ethambutol points to vision and red-green color discrimination.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将每种抗结核药物与关键安全监测相联系。乙胺丁醇对应视力和红绿色觉监测。

glossary.defZh: 一线抗结核药之一，需要监测视力和色觉变化。
视神经炎症，可出现视力下降或色觉改变。
区分颜色的能力，乙胺丁醇用药前后可用于监测变化。

stem.en: At Stage 2, complete the statement explaining why the patient's long-term prednisone is tapered rather than stopped abruptly.
stem.zh: 在阶段2，补全句子，说明为什么患者长期使用的泼尼松要逐渐减量而不是突然停药。

clozeStem.en: The prednisone is tapered rather than abruptly stopped because chronic exogenous corticosteroid use can suppress the {{1}}, and abrupt discontinuation may precipitate {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 泼尼松需要逐渐减量而不是突然停药，因为长期外源性糖皮质激素使用可抑制 {{1}}，突然停药可能诱发 {{2}}。

options.en: renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system
options.zh: 肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统

options.en: parasympathetic nervous system
options.zh: 副交感神经系统

options.en: hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis
options.zh: 下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴

options.en: adrenal insufficiency or adrenal crisis
options.zh: 肾上腺功能不全或肾上腺危象

options.en: thyrotoxic crisis
options.zh: 甲状腺危象

options.en: serotonin syndrome
options.zh: 血清素综合征

correct.en: The patient has taken prednisone daily for two years. Chronic corticosteroid therapy can suppress endogenous adrenal response through the HPA axis, so abrupt cessation can cause adrenal insufficiency or crisis. A taper is the safer ordered approach.
correct.zh: 患者已每日服用泼尼松2年。长期糖皮质激素治疗可通过HPA轴抑制机体自身肾上腺反应，因此突然停药可能导致肾上腺功能不全或危象。按医嘱逐渐减量更安全。

byChoice.en: The HPA axis is the physiologic pathway suppressed by chronic exogenous corticosteroid therapy.
byChoice.zh: HPA轴是长期外源性糖皮质激素治疗会抑制的生理通路。

byChoice.en: Adrenal insufficiency or crisis is the danger the taper is intended to prevent after chronic prednisone use.
byChoice.zh: 长期使用泼尼松后逐渐减量的目的，是预防肾上腺功能不全或肾上腺危象。

testTakingStrategy.en: For chronic steroids, think suppression and taper. Do not pair long-term prednisone with abrupt discontinuation unless directed by a specific emergency plan.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到长期使用类固醇，要想到“抑制”和“逐渐减量”。除非有特定紧急方案，不要把长期泼尼松与突然停药配对。

glossary.defZh: 一种糖皮质激素，长期使用后通常需要逐渐减量。
下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴，调节皮质醇反应。
严重急性肾上腺功能不足，可危及生命。

stem.en: At Stage 4, the patient's AST is 86 U/L, ALT is 104 U/L, and total bilirubin is 1.8 mg/dL. The infectious disease provider states that hepatotoxic agents will be held if the next ALT exceeds 120 U/L with any hepatotoxicity symptoms. Which nursing action is most appropriate now?
stem.zh: 在阶段4，患者AST为86 U/L，ALT为104 U/L，总胆红素1.8 mg/dL。感染病科医嘱说明：若下一次ALT超过120 U/L并伴有任何肝毒性症状，将暂停肝毒性药物。此时护士最合适的措施是什么？

options.en: Continue the medications as ordered, assess for hepatotoxicity symptoms, notify the provider of the upward trend as appropriate, and obtain the repeat labs as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱继续用药，评估肝毒性症状，适当通知医师肝酶上升趋势，并按医嘱复查实验室指标。

options.en: Ignore the laboratory trend because mild nausea is expected during early TB therapy.
options.zh: 忽略实验室趋势，因为抗结核治疗早期轻度恶心是预期反应。

options.en: Independently hold isoniazid, rifampin, and pyrazinamide immediately because ALT has risen above admission baseline.
options.zh: 因ALT高于入院基线，立即自行暂停异烟肼、利福平和吡嗪酰胺。

options.en: Give acetaminophen for discomfort and delay repeat liver tests until discharge.
options.zh: 给予对乙酰氨基酚缓解不适，并将肝功能复查推迟到出院时。

correct.en: The provider has defined an objective action threshold for this patient. The ALT is rising but has not reached the stated hold threshold, so the nurse should continue the prescribed regimen while monitoring symptoms and labs closely and communicating the trend.
correct.zh: 医嘱已为该患者设定明确的处理阈值。ALT正在上升，但尚未达到医嘱规定的暂停阈值，因此护士应按处方继续治疗，同时密切监测症状和实验室指标，并沟通趋势变化。

byChoice.en: Holding the drugs independently before the stated threshold risks interrupting effective TB therapy without meeting the case protocol.
byChoice.zh: 在未达到病例医嘱阈值前自行停药，可能中断有效抗结核治疗，且不符合本病例方案。

byChoice.en: Delaying repeat labs contradicts the provider's monitoring plan, and adding hepatically metabolized medications without considering liver status may be unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 推迟复查与医嘱监测计划相矛盾；在未考虑肝脏状况时增加经肝代谢药物可能不安全。

byChoice.en: The trend should not be ignored; rising AST, ALT, and bilirubin require continued assessment and timely follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 不能忽略趋势；AST、ALT和胆红素上升需要持续评估和及时随访。

byChoice.en: This follows the stated protocol while maintaining close surveillance for hepatotoxicity.
byChoice.zh: 此做法遵循病例中的医嘱阈值，同时保持对肝毒性的密切监测。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a case gives a protocol threshold, use that threshold exactly. Avoid both premature independent action and passive failure to monitor.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 病例给出方案阈值时，要精确使用该阈值。既不要过早自行处理，也不要被动不监测。

glossary.defZh: 药物或其他因素导致的肝细胞损伤或肝功能异常。
肝细胞损伤时常升高的肝酶。
胆汁色素；升高可提示肝胆系统问题或红细胞分解增加。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the patient feels guilty, hopeless, and worried about whether he is contagious forever. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，患者感到内疚、绝望，并担心自己是否会永远具有传染性。哪些护理措施合适？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Tell the patient he is no longer contagious because he has already received three doses of therapy.
options.zh: 告诉患者，因为他已经接受3剂治疗，所以已不再具有传染性。

options.en: Assess the patient's guilt, hopelessness, coping, and any thoughts of self-harm.
options.zh: 评估患者的内疚感、绝望感、应对方式以及是否有自伤想法。

options.en: Request social work or case-management support for financial concerns and treatment-access barriers.
options.zh: 为经济问题和治疗可及性障碍申请社会工作或个案管理支持。

options.en: Coordinate with public health and assess home-isolation concerns such as whether high-risk individuals live in the home.
options.zh: 与公共卫生部门协调，并评估居家隔离相关问题，例如家中是否有高风险人群。

options.en: Explain that a positive AFB smear means he must stay hospitalized until every smear is negative.
options.zh: 解释AFB涂片阳性意味着他必须一直住院，直到所有涂片都转阴。

options.en: Provide accurate, non-guaranteed teaching that infectiousness usually decreases with effective therapy and that isolation decisions will be guided by the care team and public health.
options.zh: 提供准确但不做绝对保证的教育：有效治疗后传染性通常会下降，隔离相关决定将由医疗团队和公共卫生部门指导。

correct.en: The patient's distress can undermine adherence and safety. Appropriate care includes assessing mood and safety, giving accurate conditional teaching, involving social work/case management, and coordinating public health and home-isolation planning. The nurse should avoid false guarantees about infectiousness or discharge requirements.
correct.zh: 患者的痛苦可能影响依从性和安全。合适的照护包括评估情绪和安全、提供准确且有条件的教育、让社会工作/个案管理介入，并协调公共卫生和居家隔离计划。护士应避免对传染性或出院要求作出不真实的保证。

byChoice.en: This addresses fear while avoiding an absolute promise; ongoing isolation decisions depend on clinical response and public health criteria.
byChoice.zh: 此做法能回应恐惧，同时避免绝对承诺；后续隔离决定取决于临床反应和公共卫生标准。

byChoice.en: Three doses do not justify guaranteeing that the patient is noninfectious; this false reassurance could increase transmission risk.
byChoice.zh: 仅接受3剂治疗不足以保证患者已无传染性；这种错误安慰可能增加传播风险。

byChoice.en: Public health coordination and home-risk assessment support safe isolation and discharge planning.
byChoice.zh: 公共卫生协调和居家风险评估有助于安全隔离和出院计划。

byChoice.en: The case explicitly distinguishes positive smear status from an automatic requirement for indefinite hospitalization if safe outpatient isolation criteria can be met.
byChoice.zh: 病例明确区分涂片阳性和“必须无限期住院”；若能满足安全门诊隔离标准，涂片阳性并不自动要求一直住院。

byChoice.en: Financial and access barriers are relevant because TB treatment success depends on adherence and follow-up support.
byChoice.zh: 经济和就医可及性障碍很重要，因为结核治疗成功依赖依从性和随访支持。

byChoice.en: Hopelessness warrants structured psychosocial and safety assessment, including self-harm screening when appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 绝望感需要结构化心理社会和安全评估，适当时包括自伤风险筛查。

testTakingStrategy.en: For psychosocial NCLEX items, combine emotional safety, accurate teaching, and concrete resource coordination. Reject answers that give false certainty.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到心理社会类NCLEX题，要结合情绪安全、准确信息和具体资源协调。排除给出虚假确定性的选项。

glossary.defZh: 患者按治疗计划服药、复诊和配合监测的程度。
由指定人员观察患者服药，以支持结核治疗完成和依从性。
患者在家中采取措施减少传染病传播风险。
协调资源、随访和服务以帮助患者完成治疗计划。

title.en: Tuberculosis rule-out in a newly admitted patient with chronic cough and immunosuppression
title.zh: 新入院免疫抑制患者因慢性咳嗽接受结核病排查

summary.en: A 47-year-old man is admitted for evaluation of a 6-week productive cough with occasional blood-streaked sputum, drenching night sweats, 7 kg weight loss, and fatigue. He takes methotrexate and chronic prednisone for rheumatoid arthritis and works as a long-haul bus driver with frequent travel through crowded, poorly ventilated buses. He is placed in an airborne infection isolation room while tuberculosis is evaluated.
summary.zh: 一名47岁男性因持续6周的咳嗽入院评估，咳少量黄痰并偶有血丝，伴盗汗、体重下降7公斤和乏力。他因类风湿关节炎长期使用甲氨蝶呤和泼尼松，并从事长途客车驾驶，常处于拥挤、通风不良的车厢环境。因需排查结核病，患者被安置在空气传播隔离病房。

content.en: History: persistent productive cough for about 6 weeks, occasional blood-streaked sputum, night sweats 3-4 times/week, 7 kg (15 lb) unintentional weight loss over 2 months, progressive fatigue, mild exertional shortness of breath. No known HIV diagnosis; HIV antigen/antibody test ordered. No prior tuberculin skin test or IGRA. Medications: methotrexate 15 mg PO weekly, prednisone 7.5 mg PO daily for 2 years, amlodipine 5 mg PO daily, omeprazole 20 mg PO daily. The patient has never received BCG vaccine.
content.zh: 病史：咳嗽咳痰约6周，偶有痰中带血，每周盗汗3-4次，2个月内非自愿体重下降7公斤（15磅），乏力加重，活动后轻度气短。无已知HIV诊断；已医嘱检测HIV抗原/抗体。既往未做过结核菌素皮肤试验或IGRA。用药：甲氨蝶呤15 mg口服每周一次，泼尼松7.5 mg口服每日一次已2年，氨氯地平5 mg口服每日一次，奥美拉唑20 mg口服每日一次。患者从未接种过卡介苗。

content.en: Vital signs: T 38.3 C (101.0 F), HR 92/min, BP 118/74 mm Hg, RR 20/min, SpO2 95% on room air. Height 178 cm, weight 64 kg, BMI 20.2. The patient appears thin and fatigued with temporal wasting. Cervical and supraclavicular lymph nodes are small, firm, and non-tender bilaterally. Right upper posterior chest percussion is dull with bronchial breath sounds and coarse crackles over the right upper lobe. The patient is alert, oriented, and cooperative.
content.zh: 生命体征：体温100.9 °F (38.3 °C)，心率92次/分，血压118/74 mm Hg，呼吸20次/分，室内空气SpO2 95%。身高178 cm，体重64 kg，BMI 20.2。患者消瘦、疲乏，有颞部消瘦。双侧颈部和锁骨上淋巴结小、质硬、无压痛。右上后胸部叩诊浊音，右上肺可闻支气管样呼吸音和粗湿啰音。患者清醒、定向力正常、配合。

title.zh: 医嘱、实验室资料和影像

content.en: Orders: airborne infection isolation precautions; three sputum specimens for AFB smear and mycobacterial culture, collected 8-24 hours apart with at least one early-morning specimen; chest radiograph; QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus; CBC; CMP; ESR; HIV antigen/antibody test; high-calorie, high-protein dietary consult. Baseline labs: WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 11.4 g/dL, hematocrit 34.2%, platelets 410 ×10³/µL, sodium 136 mEq/L, potassium 4.1 mEq/L, BUN 14 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, AST 42 U/L, ALT 48 U/L, ESR 68 mm/hr. Chest radiograph: right upper lobe infiltrate with a 2.3 cm cavitary lesion; no pleural effusion; no hilar lymphadenopathy.
content.zh: 医嘱：空气传播隔离；采集3份痰标本做抗酸杆菌涂片和分枝杆菌培养，间隔8-24小时，至少1份为清晨标本；胸片；QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus；全血细胞计数；综合代谢面板；红细胞沉降率；HIV抗原/抗体检测；高热量、高蛋白饮食会诊。基线实验室结果：WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白11.4 g/dL，血细胞比容34.2%，血小板410 ×10³/µL，钠136 mEq/L，钾4.1 mEq/L，BUN 14 mg/dL，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，AST 42 U/L，ALT 48 U/L，ESR 68 mm/hr。胸片：右上肺浸润影，伴2.3 cm空洞性病灶；无胸腔积液；无肺门淋巴结肿大。

title.en: Stage 1: Admission evening through first 16 hours
title.zh: 阶段1：入院当晚至最初16小时

title.en: Stage 1: Admission evening through first 16 hours
title.zh: 阶段1：入院当晚至最初16小时

content.en: The first sputum specimen is collected at 2100 after the nurse coaches the patient to rinse with water, take several deep breaths, and cough deeply into a sterile container. The second specimen is collected at 0530 the next morning. The patient has drenching night sweats and a temperature spike to 102 °F (38.9 °C). Airborne precautions are documented: AIIR door closed, negative-pressure indicator functioning, staff wear N95 respirators before entering, and the patient wears a surgical/procedure mask during brief transport to radiology. A nursing assistant asks whether she can enter the room wearing a standard surgical mask just to take vital signs quickly. QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus returns positive. HIV antigen/antibody test returns negative.
content.zh: 21:00采集第1份痰标本，护士指导患者先用清水漱口、深呼吸数次，再深咳入无菌容器。次日05:30采集第2份痰标本。患者夜间大量盗汗，体温升至102 °F (38.9 °C)。护理记录显示空气传播隔离严格执行：AIIR房门关闭，负压指示器正常，工作人员进入前佩戴N95呼吸防护口罩，患者短暂转运至放射科时佩戴外科/医用口罩。一名护理助理询问，是否可以只戴普通外科口罩进入房间快速测量生命体征。QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus结果阳性；HIV抗原/抗体检测阴性。

content.en: The third sputum specimen is collected at 1400, more than 8 hours after the second specimen. The first two AFB smears return positive. NAAT is positive for Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex. Infectious disease starts isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol. Pyridoxine is ordered with isoniazid. Baseline visual acuity and red-green color discrimination testing are ordered before the first ethambutol dose. Rheumatology recommends holding methotrexate due to immunosuppressive and hepatotoxic overlap and writes a prednisone taper. The local public health department has been notified and begins contact investigation planning.
content.zh: 14:00采集第3份痰标本，距离第2份标本超过8小时。前2份AFB涂片结果阳性。核酸扩增检测提示结核分枝杆菌复合群阳性。感染病科启动异烟肼、利福平、吡嗪酰胺和乙胺丁醇治疗。异烟肼同时医嘱吡哆醇。首次给予乙胺丁醇前，医嘱进行基线视力和红绿色觉检查。风湿科建议因免疫抑制和肝毒性重叠暂停甲氨蝶呤，并开具泼尼松逐渐减量方案。当地公共卫生部门已获通知，并开始规划接触者调查。

content.en: After three doses of the four-drug TB regimen, the patient reports nausea. Temperature is 100 °F (37.8 °C). Labs at 48 hours: AST 58 U/L, ALT 72 U/L. The third AFB smear returns positive. The patient asks whether he is contagious forever and whether his apartment neighbors are at risk. He expresses guilt about exposing others and hopelessness about his finances and health.
content.zh: 患者已接受3剂四联抗结核治疗后诉恶心。体温100 °F (37.8 °C)。48小时实验室结果：AST 58 U/L，ALT 72 U/L。第3份AFB涂片阳性。患者询问自己是否会一直有传染性，以及公寓邻居是否有风险。他对可能暴露他人感到内疚，并对经济状况和健康感到绝望。

content.en: The patient is tolerating meals better and cough is less frequent. Repeat labs: AST 86 U/L, ALT 104 U/L, total bilirubin 1.8 mg/dL. The infectious disease provider states that if the next ALT exceeds 120 U/L (3 times the facility upper limit of normal) with any hepatotoxicity symptoms, the hepatotoxic agents will be held. Discharge planning distinguishes diagnostic sputum collection, discontinuation of inpatient airborne precautions, and safe discharge home. Three negative smears are not automatic discharge criteria, and a positive smear does not automatically require indefinite hospitalization if public-health and home-isolation criteria are met.
content.zh: 患者进食耐受改善，咳嗽减少。复查实验室结果：AST 86 U/L，ALT 104 U/L，总胆红素1.8 mg/dL。感染病科医嘱说明：如果下一次ALT超过120 U/L（为本机构正常上限的3倍）且出现任何肝毒性症状，将暂停肝毒性药物。出院计划明确区分诊断性痰标本采集、停止住院空气传播隔离、以及安全居家出院。3次阴性涂片并不自动等于可以出院；若符合公共卫生和居家隔离标准，涂片阳性也不自动意味着必须无限期住院。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: At Stage 1, the nursing assistant asks whether she may enter the AIIR wearing only a standard surgical mask to take vital signs quickly. Which response by the nurse is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 在阶段1，护理助理询问是否可以只戴普通外科口罩进入AIIR快速测量生命体征。护士最合适的回应是什么？

options.en: You may enter with a surgical mask because the exposure will be brief.
options.zh: 可以只戴外科口罩进入，因为接触时间很短。

options.en: Ask the patient to cover his mouth with tissues so staff can use droplet precautions instead.
options.zh: 请患者用纸巾遮住口鼻，这样工作人员可以改用飞沫隔离措施。

options.en: Do not enter unless you are wearing the required fit-tested N95 respirator for this airborne isolation room.
options.zh: 除非佩戴本空气传播隔离房间要求的、经密合性测试的N95呼吸防护口罩，否则不要进入。

options.en: A surgical mask is acceptable if the patient also wears a surgical mask while you are in the room.
options.zh: 如果患者在你进入房间时也戴外科口罩，那么你戴外科口罩即可。

correct.en: The patient is in airborne infection isolation for suspected or confirmed infectious TB. Staff entering the AIIR need the required respiratory protection; a standard surgical mask is for patient source control during transport and does not replace staff N95 protection.
correct.zh: 患者因疑似或确诊具有传染性的结核病接受空气传播隔离。进入AIIR的工作人员需要规定的呼吸防护；普通外科口罩用于患者转运时的源头控制，不能替代工作人员的N95防护。

byChoice.en: Brief exposure does not remove the airborne-precaution requirement for staff entering the room.
byChoice.zh: 接触时间短并不能取消工作人员进入房间时的空气传播隔离防护要求。

byChoice.en: Covering the mouth may reduce secretion spread but does not change suspected TB from airborne precautions to droplet precautions.
byChoice.zh: 遮住口鼻可减少分泌物播散，但不能把疑似结核病的空气传播隔离改为飞沫隔离。

byChoice.en: Required N95 protection matches the documented AIIR precautions and protects staff from airborne droplet nuclei.
byChoice.zh: 佩戴规定的N95防护符合AIIR隔离要求，可保护工作人员避免吸入空气传播微粒。

byChoice.en: The patient's surgical mask is used for source control during transport; it does not make a surgical mask adequate for staff inside the AIIR.
byChoice.zh: 患者佩戴外科口罩是转运时的源头控制；这并不代表工作人员在AIIR内只戴外科口罩就足够。

testTakingStrategy.en: For isolation questions, separate protection for staff from source control for the patient. TB is airborne, so staff entering the room require respirator-level protection.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到隔离题时，要区分工作人员防护和患者源头控制。结核病按空气传播处理，工作人员进入房间需要呼吸防护级别的防护。

glossary.defZh: 用于空气传播病原体的隔离房间，通常需保持负压。
能过滤微小空气颗粒的呼吸防护用品，需按机构政策进行密合性测试。
通过给患者戴口罩等方式减少病原体从患者向外播散。

stem.en: At Stage 1, the patient asks, 'Does my coworker need to be tested for TB?' Which response best supports safe care coordination?
stem.zh: 在阶段1，患者问：“我的同事需要接受结核病检测吗？”哪项回应最能支持安全的照护协调？

options.en: Your coworker does not need testing unless they have symptoms.
options.zh: 除非你的同事有症状，否则不需要检测。

options.en: Anyone who has ever ridden with you in the bus must immediately start tuberculosis medications.
options.zh: 任何曾经坐过你车的人都必须立即开始抗结核药物治疗。

options.en: Give me your coworker's phone number and I will personally tell them to come to the hospital for testing today.
options.zh: 把你同事的电话号码给我，我会亲自通知他们今天来医院检测。

options.en: I will explain that the public health team will conduct a contact investigation and determine who needs evaluation based on exposure details.
options.zh: 我会说明公共卫生团队会进行接触者调查，并根据暴露细节决定谁需要评估。

correct.en: Contact investigation is coordinated through public health and is based on exposure duration, proximity, ventilation, and individual risk. The nurse should explain the process and coordinate, not independently decide who does or does not need testing.
correct.zh: 接触者调查由公共卫生部门协调，并根据暴露时间、距离、通风情况和个体风险来判断。护士应解释流程并协助协调，而不是自行决定谁需要或不需要检测。

byChoice.en: Exposure does not automatically mean immediate TB medications; contacts require risk-based evaluation first.
byChoice.zh: 有暴露并不自动意味着必须立即服用抗结核药；接触者需先进行基于风险的评估。

byChoice.en: This response gives accurate process information and preserves public health's role in contact investigation.
byChoice.zh: 此回应提供准确的流程信息，并保留公共卫生部门在接触者调查中的职责。

byChoice.en: The nurse should not independently direct individual contacts outside the formal contact investigation process.
byChoice.zh: 护士不应绕过正式接触者调查流程，私自指挥个别接触者就医检测。

byChoice.en: Testing decisions are not limited to symptomatic contacts; asymptomatic exposed contacts may still need evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 检测决策并不只限于有症状的接触者；无症状但有暴露的人也可能需要评估。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a public health process is involved, choose the answer that explains and coordinates the process without overstepping the nurse's role.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到涉及公共卫生流程的题目，选择能解释并协调流程、但不超越护士职责的答案。

glossary.defZh: 公共卫生部门追踪并评估可能暴露于传染病患者的人群。
与感染源接触到可能导致感染风险的情况。
关注人群层面疾病预防、监测和控制的卫生系统职能。

stem.en: At Stage 2, ethambutol is prescribed as part of the initial four-drug TB regimen. Which nursing action is essential before the first dose?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，乙胺丁醇被纳入初始四联抗结核方案。首次给药前哪项护理措施最重要？

options.en: Teach the patient that orange urine is the dose-limiting toxicity of ethambutol.
options.zh: 告知患者橙色尿液是乙胺丁醇的剂量限制性毒性。

options.en: Hold ethambutol until all three AFB cultures are finalized.
options.zh: 等到3份AFB培养全部最终报告后再给乙胺丁醇。

options.en: Verify that baseline visual acuity and red-green color discrimination testing are documented.
options.zh: 确认已记录基线视力和红绿色觉检查。

options.en: Administer the drug only if the patient has received BCG vaccine.
options.zh: 只有患者接种过卡介苗时才给予该药。

correct.en: Ethambutol can cause optic neuritis, so baseline visual acuity and color discrimination testing create a reference point for detecting drug-related visual changes. The case order specifically requires this testing before the first dose.
correct.zh: 乙胺丁醇可导致视神经炎，因此基线视力和色觉检查可作为发现药物相关视觉变化的参照。病例医嘱也明确要求首次给药前进行这些检查。

byChoice.en: BCG vaccination status does not determine whether ethambutol can be given in the ordered regimen.
byChoice.zh: 卡介苗接种史并不决定医嘱方案中是否可以使用乙胺丁醇。

byChoice.en: This is the essential baseline safety assessment for ethambutol in this case.
byChoice.zh: 这是本病例中使用乙胺丁醇前必需的基线安全评估。

byChoice.en: Orange body fluid discoloration is classically associated with rifampin teaching, not the ethambutol dose-limiting toxicity being tested here.
byChoice.zh: 体液橙色改变通常是利福平相关教学点，而不是本题考查的乙胺丁醇剂量限制性毒性。

byChoice.en: The case has positive smears and NAAT; waiting for finalized cultures is not the stated prerequisite before ordered initial therapy.
byChoice.zh: 病例已有涂片阳性和NAAT阳性；等待培养最终报告并不是医嘱初始治疗前的条件。

testTakingStrategy.en: Link each anti-TB medication to its key safety monitoring. Ethambutol points to vision and red-green color discrimination.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将每种抗结核药物与关键安全监测相联系。乙胺丁醇对应视力和红绿色觉监测。

glossary.defZh: 一线抗结核药之一，需要监测视力和色觉变化。
视神经炎症，可出现视力下降或色觉改变。
区分颜色的能力，乙胺丁醇用药前后可用于监测变化。

stem.en: At Stage 2, complete the statement explaining why the patient's long-term prednisone is tapered rather than stopped abruptly.
stem.zh: 在阶段2，补全句子，说明为什么患者长期使用的泼尼松要逐渐减量而不是突然停药。

clozeStem.en: The prednisone is tapered rather than abruptly stopped because chronic exogenous corticosteroid use can suppress the {{1}}, and abrupt discontinuation may precipitate {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 泼尼松需要逐渐减量而不是突然停药，因为长期外源性糖皮质激素使用可抑制 {{1}}，突然停药可能诱发 {{2}}。

options.en: renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system
options.zh: 肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统

options.en: parasympathetic nervous system
options.zh: 副交感神经系统

options.en: hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis
options.zh: 下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴

options.en: adrenal insufficiency or adrenal crisis
options.zh: 肾上腺功能不全或肾上腺危象

options.en: thyrotoxic crisis
options.zh: 甲状腺危象

options.en: serotonin syndrome
options.zh: 血清素综合征

correct.en: The patient has taken prednisone daily for two years. Chronic corticosteroid therapy can suppress endogenous adrenal response through the HPA axis, so abrupt cessation can cause adrenal insufficiency or crisis. A taper is the safer ordered approach.
correct.zh: 患者已每日服用泼尼松2年。长期糖皮质激素治疗可通过HPA轴抑制机体自身肾上腺反应，因此突然停药可能导致肾上腺功能不全或危象。按医嘱逐渐减量更安全。

byChoice.en: The HPA axis is the physiologic pathway suppressed by chronic exogenous corticosteroid therapy.
byChoice.zh: HPA轴是长期外源性糖皮质激素治疗会抑制的生理通路。

byChoice.en: Adrenal insufficiency or crisis is the danger the taper is intended to prevent after chronic prednisone use.
byChoice.zh: 长期使用泼尼松后逐渐减量的目的，是预防肾上腺功能不全或肾上腺危象。

testTakingStrategy.en: For chronic steroids, think suppression and taper. Do not pair long-term prednisone with abrupt discontinuation unless directed by a specific emergency plan.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到长期使用类固醇，要想到“抑制”和“逐渐减量”。除非有特定紧急方案，不要把长期泼尼松与突然停药配对。

glossary.defZh: 一种糖皮质激素，长期使用后通常需要逐渐减量。
下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴，调节皮质醇反应。
严重急性肾上腺功能不足，可危及生命。

stem.en: At Stage 4, the patient's AST is 86 U/L, ALT is 104 U/L, and total bilirubin is 1.8 mg/dL. The infectious disease provider states that hepatotoxic agents will be held if the next ALT exceeds 120 U/L with any hepatotoxicity symptoms. Which nursing action is most appropriate now?
stem.zh: 在阶段4，患者AST为86 U/L，ALT为104 U/L，总胆红素1.8 mg/dL。感染病科医嘱说明：若下一次ALT超过120 U/L并伴有任何肝毒性症状，将暂停肝毒性药物。此时护士最合适的措施是什么？

options.en: Continue the medications as ordered, assess for hepatotoxicity symptoms, notify the provider of the upward trend as appropriate, and obtain the repeat labs as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱继续用药，评估肝毒性症状，适当通知医师肝酶上升趋势，并按医嘱复查实验室指标。

options.en: Ignore the laboratory trend because mild nausea is expected during early TB therapy.
options.zh: 忽略实验室趋势，因为抗结核治疗早期轻度恶心是预期反应。

options.en: Independently hold isoniazid, rifampin, and pyrazinamide immediately because ALT has risen above admission baseline.
options.zh: 因ALT高于入院基线，立即自行暂停异烟肼、利福平和吡嗪酰胺。

options.en: Give acetaminophen for discomfort and delay repeat liver tests until discharge.
options.zh: 给予对乙酰氨基酚缓解不适，并将肝功能复查推迟到出院时。

correct.en: The provider has defined an objective action threshold for this patient. The ALT is rising but has not reached the stated hold threshold, so the nurse should continue the prescribed regimen while monitoring symptoms and labs closely and communicating the trend.
correct.zh: 医嘱已为该患者设定明确的处理阈值。ALT正在上升，但尚未达到医嘱规定的暂停阈值，因此护士应按处方继续治疗，同时密切监测症状和实验室指标，并沟通趋势变化。

byChoice.en: Holding the drugs independently before the stated threshold risks interrupting effective TB therapy without meeting the case protocol.
byChoice.zh: 在未达到病例医嘱阈值前自行停药，可能中断有效抗结核治疗，且不符合本病例方案。

byChoice.en: Delaying repeat labs contradicts the provider's monitoring plan, and adding hepatically metabolized medications without considering liver status may be unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 推迟复查与医嘱监测计划相矛盾；在未考虑肝脏状况时增加经肝代谢药物可能不安全。

byChoice.en: The trend should not be ignored; rising AST, ALT, and bilirubin require continued assessment and timely follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 不能忽略趋势；AST、ALT和胆红素上升需要持续评估和及时随访。

byChoice.en: This follows the stated protocol while maintaining close surveillance for hepatotoxicity.
byChoice.zh: 此做法遵循病例中的医嘱阈值，同时保持对肝毒性的密切监测。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a case gives a protocol threshold, use that threshold exactly. Avoid both premature independent action and passive failure to monitor.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 病例给出方案阈值时，要精确使用该阈值。既不要过早自行处理，也不要被动不监测。

glossary.defZh: 药物或其他因素导致的肝细胞损伤或肝功能异常。
肝细胞损伤时常升高的肝酶。
胆汁色素；升高可提示肝胆系统问题或红细胞分解增加。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the patient feels guilty, hopeless, and worried about whether he is contagious forever. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，患者感到内疚、绝望，并担心自己是否会永远具有传染性。哪些护理措施合适？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Tell the patient he is no longer contagious because he has already received three doses of therapy.
options.zh: 告诉患者，因为他已经接受3剂治疗，所以已不再具有传染性。

options.en: Assess the patient's guilt, hopelessness, coping, and any thoughts of self-harm.
options.zh: 评估患者的内疚感、绝望感、应对方式以及是否有自伤想法。

options.en: Request social work or case-management support for financial concerns and treatment-access barriers.
options.zh: 为经济问题和治疗可及性障碍申请社会工作或个案管理支持。

options.en: Coordinate with public health and assess home-isolation concerns such as whether high-risk individuals live in the home.
options.zh: 与公共卫生部门协调，并评估居家隔离相关问题，例如家中是否有高风险人群。

options.en: Explain that a positive AFB smear means he must stay hospitalized until every smear is negative.
options.zh: 解释AFB涂片阳性意味着他必须一直住院，直到所有涂片都转阴。

options.en: Provide accurate, non-guaranteed teaching that infectiousness usually decreases with effective therapy and that isolation decisions will be guided by the care team and public health.
options.zh: 提供准确但不做绝对保证的教育：有效治疗后传染性通常会下降，隔离相关决定将由医疗团队和公共卫生部门指导。

correct.en: The patient's distress can undermine adherence and safety. Appropriate care includes assessing mood and safety, giving accurate conditional teaching, involving social work/case management, and coordinating public health and home-isolation planning. The nurse should avoid false guarantees about infectiousness or discharge requirements.
correct.zh: 患者的痛苦可能影响依从性和安全。合适的照护包括评估情绪和安全、提供准确且有条件的教育、让社会工作/个案管理介入，并协调公共卫生和居家隔离计划。护士应避免对传染性或出院要求作出不真实的保证。

byChoice.en: This addresses fear while avoiding an absolute promise; ongoing isolation decisions depend on clinical response and public health criteria.
byChoice.zh: 此做法能回应恐惧，同时避免绝对承诺；后续隔离决定取决于临床反应和公共卫生标准。

byChoice.en: Three doses do not justify guaranteeing that the patient is noninfectious; this false reassurance could increase transmission risk.
byChoice.zh: 仅接受3剂治疗不足以保证患者已无传染性；这种错误安慰可能增加传播风险。

byChoice.en: Public health coordination and home-risk assessment support safe isolation and discharge planning.
byChoice.zh: 公共卫生协调和居家风险评估有助于安全隔离和出院计划。

byChoice.en: The case explicitly distinguishes positive smear status from an automatic requirement for indefinite hospitalization if safe outpatient isolation criteria can be met.
byChoice.zh: 病例明确区分涂片阳性和“必须无限期住院”；若能满足安全门诊隔离标准，涂片阳性并不自动要求一直住院。

byChoice.en: Financial and access barriers are relevant because TB treatment success depends on adherence and follow-up support.
byChoice.zh: 经济和就医可及性障碍很重要，因为结核治疗成功依赖依从性和随访支持。

byChoice.en: Hopelessness warrants structured psychosocial and safety assessment, including self-harm screening when appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 绝望感需要结构化心理社会和安全评估，适当时包括自伤风险筛查。

testTakingStrategy.en: For psychosocial NCLEX items, combine emotional safety, accurate teaching, and concrete resource coordination. Reject answers that give false certainty.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到心理社会类NCLEX题，要结合情绪安全、准确信息和具体资源协调。排除给出虚假确定性的选项。

glossary.defZh: 患者按治疗计划服药、复诊和配合监测的程度。
由指定人员观察患者服药，以支持结核治疗完成和依从性。
患者在家中采取措施减少传染病传播风险。
协调资源、随访和服务以帮助患者完成治疗计划。

note: Campaign 17 A/B producer implementation; full parent preimage frozen; independent review pending

title.en: Advance directive clarification and code status escalation in metastatic lung cancer with acute respiratory decline.
title.zh: 伴有急性呼吸衰退的转移性肺癌中的预立医疗指示澄清和抢救状态升级。

summary.en: Mr. Harold Jeffries is a 55-year-old man admitted five days ago to a medical-surgical unit with progressive dyspnea and right-sided pleural effusion secondary to metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (stage IV). He is receiving palliative carboplatin-based chemotherapy. Current orders include supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula titrated to maintain SpO₂ > 92%. The attending is a pulmonologist currently in the OR; the covering provider is a hospitalist. The medical record contains no advance directive, POLST, or healthcare power of attorney. The code status is 'Full Code' (default). His daughter Keisha is the emergency contact. At 0700, he states unprompted: 'I've been thinking about this all night. I don't want to be kept alive by machines. If something happens, I don't want them to put a tube down my throat... I just want to be comfortable.'
summary.zh: Harold Jeffries 先生是一位 55 岁的男性，五天前因转移性非小细胞肺癌（IV期）继发的进行性呼吸困难和右侧胸腔积液收治于内外科病房。他正在接受以卡铂为基础的姑息性化疗。目前的医嘱包括通过鼻导管吸氧以维持 SpO₂ > 92%。主治医生是目前在手术室的呼吸科医生；代班医生是住院医师。病历中没有预立医疗指示、维持生命治疗医生医嘱（POLST）或医疗委托书。抢救状态为“全面抢救 (Full Code)”（默认）。他的女儿 Keisha 是紧急联系人。在 0700，他自发地说道：“我整晚都在想这件事。我不想靠机器维持生命。如果发生什么事，我不想他们把管子插进我喉咙里……我只想舒舒服服的。”

title.zh: 初步评估与实验室检查 (0700)

content.en:
Vital Signs:
Temperature: 98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
Heart rate: 92 bpm
Blood pressure: 118/72 mmHg
Respiratory rate: 20 breaths/min
SpO₂: 93% on 3 L nasal cannula

Assessment:
Alert, oriented to person, place, time, situation.
Conversational, assesses with full decision-making capacity.
Respirations mildly labored with accessory muscle use at rest.
Diminished breath sounds over right lower/middle lung fields.
Scattered expiratory wheezes in left lung.
Pain: 3/10, right-sided chest wall ache.
Speaks in full sentences.

Labs (0530):
WBC: 3.8 ×10³/µL
Hemoglobin: 10.4 g/dL
Platelets: 112 ×10³/µL
BUN: 18 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL
Albumin: 2.6 g/dL
LDH: 680 U/L
content.zh:
生命体征：
体温：98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
心率：92 次/分
血压：118/72 mmHg
呼吸频率：20 次/分
SpO₂：3 L鼻导管吸氧下 93%

评估：
清醒，对人物、地点、时间和情况定向力良好。
能够交谈，经评估具有完全的决策能力。
静息时呼吸轻度费力，伴有辅助呼吸肌参与。
右下/中肺野呼吸音减弱。
左肺散在呼气相哮鸣音。
疼痛：3/10，右侧胸壁钝痛。
能说完整的句子。

实验室检查 (0530)：
白细胞：3.8 ×10³/µL
血红蛋白：10.4 g/dL
血小板：112 ×10³/µL
尿素氮：18 mg/dL
肌酐：0.9 mg/dL
白蛋白：2.6 g/dL
乳酸脱氢酶：680 U/L

content.en: After Mr. Jeffries clarifies he does not want endotracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, or CPR (but accepts oxygen and comfort meds), the nurse documents his verbatim statements and capacity. At 0745, the attending's office states he is scrubbing for a case and unavailable until 1400. The covering hospitalist, Dr. Reeves, is paged and responds at 0800: 'I am rounding on the other side of the hospital. I'll see him around 1100.' The code status remains Full Code.
content.zh: 在 Jeffries 先生明确表示他不希望进行气管插管、机械通气或心肺复苏（但接受吸氧和舒适药物）后，护士记录了他的原话及其决策能力。在 0745，主治医生的办公室表示他正在为手术刷手，直到 1400 才有空。代班住院医师 Reeves 医生被呼叫，并在 0800 回复：“我正在医院另一边查房。我大概 1100 会去看他。”抢救状态仍然是全面抢救 (Full Code)。

content.en:
At 0930, portable CXR shows a large recurrent right-sided pleural effusion with mediastinal shift and a new left pleural effusion.
At 0945, patient becomes acutely dyspneic. SpO₂ 88% on 3 L. Nurse increases O₂ to 6 L face mask; SpO₂ improves to 90%. 
At 0950, nurse pages Dr. Reeves about the acute respiratory failure and wishes against intubation. Dr. Reeves replies he will come 'as soon as I can.'
At 1030, SpO₂ is 89% on 6 L face mask, RR 30, HR 118, BP 102/64. Patient says between breaths: 'Please... don't let them... put a tube in me.' Nurse switches to non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min; SpO₂ rises to 91%.
content.zh:
在 0930，床旁胸片显示右侧胸腔积液大量复发伴纵隔移位，并出现新的左侧胸腔积液。
在 0945，患者出现急性呼吸困难。3 L吸氧下 SpO₂ 为 88%。护士将氧气增加到 6 L 面罩；SpO₂ 升至 90%。
在 0950，护士就急性呼吸衰竭和患者拒绝插管的意愿呼叫 Reeves 医生。Reeves 医生回复说他会“尽快”赶来。
在 1030，6 L面罩吸氧下 SpO₂ 为 89%，呼吸频率 30，心率 118，血压 102/64。患者喘息着说：“求你……别让他们……给我插管。”护士换用 15 L/min 的非重复呼吸面罩；SpO₂ 升至 91%。

content.en: At 1100, the nurse activates the rapid response team (RRT). The RRT arrives. Dr. Anand (critical care fellow) speaks directly to Mr. Jeffries: 'We may need to talk about a breathing tube. Can you tell me what you would want?' Mr. Jeffries responds: 'No tube. No machines. Comfortable.' Dr. Anand enters a DNAR/DNI order. By 1130, social work completes the advance directive with the daughter, palliative care consult is placed, and comfort measures (morphine, non-rebreather) are effective.
content.zh: 在 1100，护士启动了快速反应小组 (RRT)。RRT 到达。Anand 医生（重症监护专科医师）直接对 Jeffries 先生说：“我们可能需要谈谈呼吸管的事。你能告诉我你想要什么吗？”Jeffries 先生回答：“不要管子。不要机器。舒服点。”Anand 医生下达了不复苏/不插管 (DNAR/DNI) 的医嘱。到了 1130，社会工作者与女儿完成了预立医疗指示，请了姑息治疗会诊，并且舒适措施（吗啡、非重复呼吸面罩）有效。

stem.en: At 0700, what is the nurse's priority action in response to Mr. Jeffries's statement?
stem.zh: 在 0700，针对 Jeffries 先生的陈述，护士的首要行动是什么？

options.en: Assess and document his decision-making capacity and verbatim statements in the medical record.
options.zh: 评估并记录他的决策能力，并将他的原话记录在病历中。

options.en: Acknowledge his feelings with empathy and mention it to the provider during rounds.
options.zh: 带着同理心认可他的感受，并在查房时向有权限的医嘱开立者提及此事。

options.en: Assure the patient that the healthcare team will not intubate him.
options.zh: 向患者保证医疗团队不会为他插管。

options.en: Immediately enter a temporary DNAR/DNI order pending the provider's evaluation.
options.zh: 在等待有权限的医嘱开立者评估期间，立即下达临时的 DNAR/DNI 医嘱。

correct.en: The nurse must actively listen, assess and document that the patient has decision-making capacity, document his verbatim statements immediately, explain honestly that a provider order is required, and begin the escalation process. Documentation creates a contemporaneous legal and clinical record that protects the patient's autonomy if he later loses capacity.
correct.zh: 护士必须积极倾听，评估并记录患者具有决策能力，立即记录他的原话，如实解释需要有权限的医嘱开立者下达医嘱，并开始升级流程。文件记录创建了同期的法律和临床记录，在患者随后丧失能力时保护其自主权。

byChoice.en: This is the correct priority action. It provides a clinical foundation for formal evaluation and protects the patient's voice.
byChoice.zh: 这是正确的首要行动。它为正式评估提供了临床基础，并保护了患者的意愿。

byChoice.en: The nurse cannot guarantee this outcome without a valid DNAR/DNI provider order.
byChoice.zh: 在没有有效的 DNAR/DNI 医生医嘱的情况下，护士无法保证这一结果。

byChoice.en: Delaying documentation and escalation prolongs the period where a code event would trigger unwanted interventions. Verbal acknowledgment without documentation is inadequate advocacy.
byChoice.zh: 延迟记录和上报延长了在此期间如果发生代码事件将触发不想要的干预的风险。没有文件记录的口头认可是不充分的倡导。

byChoice.en: Nurses cannot unilaterally change a code status or write a DNAR/DNI order; this is strictly a provider-only action.
byChoice.zh: 护士不能单方面更改抢救状态或下达 DNAR/DNI 医嘱；这严格来说是有权限的医嘱开立者专属的操作。

testTakingStrategy.en: Identify the action that legally and ethically safeguards the patient's autonomy within the nurse's scope of practice.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 找出在护士执业范围内在法律和伦理上保障患者自主权的行动。

stem.en: At 0800, after Dr. Reeves indicates he will visit the patient around 1100, which action is most appropriate for the nurse?
stem.zh: 在 0800，当 Reeves 医生表示他将在 1100 左右探视患者后，护士最合适的行动是什么？

options.en: Document the conversation, inform the charge nurse, and plan to re-escalate if the patient's condition changes or the provider does not arrive.
options.zh: 记录对话内容，通知护士长，并计划在患者病情改变或医生未到达时再次上报。

options.en: Inform the patient that his code status has been updated to DNAR/DNI since the provider acknowledged the message.
options.zh: 通知患者由于有权限的医嘱开立者已确认消息，他的抢救状态已更新为 DNAR/DNI。

options.en: Immediately escalate to the nursing supervisor and the administrator on call to demand an earlier evaluation.
options.zh: 立即上报给护理主管和值班行政人员，要求提早进行评估。

options.en: Accept the provider's plan but avoid documenting the delay to maintain interprofessional respect.
options.zh: 接受有权限的医嘱开立者的计划，但避免记录该延误以保持跨专业尊重。

correct.en: At 0800, the patient is stable, so the risk of an unwanted code is present but not imminent. The appropriate nursing action is to document the provider's response, notify the charge nurse for safety planning, and plan follow-up if the patient deteriorates.
correct.zh: 在 0800，患者情况稳定，所以不想要的抢救风险存在但并不紧迫。合适的护理行动是记录有权限的医嘱开立者的回复，通知护士长进行安全规划，并计划在患者病情恶化时跟进。

byChoice.en: A provider simply acknowledging a message does not constitute a valid DNAR/DNI order.
byChoice.zh: 有权限的医嘱开立者仅仅确认一条消息并不构成有效的 DNAR/DNI 医嘱。

byChoice.en: This correctly weighs the urgency of the code status gap against the patient's current stability.
byChoice.zh: 这正确地权衡了抢救状态缺口的紧迫性与患者目前的稳定性。

byChoice.en: Undocumented communication cannot be verified. Respect for the provider does not override the nurse's duty to create a transparent clinical record.
byChoice.zh: 未记录的交流无法被核实。对有权限的医嘱开立者的尊重不能凌驾于护士创建透明临床记录的责任之上。

byChoice.en: Because the patient is currently stable and not in acute distress, immediate escalation to administration is premature.
byChoice.zh: 因为患者目前稳定且没有处于急性窘迫状态，立即上报给行政管理层为时过早。

testTakingStrategy.en: Consider the current clinical stability of the patient when determining the level of escalation needed.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在确定需要上报的级别时，请考虑患者目前的临床稳定性。

stem.en: By 1030, Mr. Jeffries remains hypoxemic and increasingly fatigued despite escalation of oxygen, and his code status remains 'Full Code.' Which action is correct?
stem.zh: 到了 1030，尽管增加了吸氧量，Jeffries 先生仍然存在低氧血症且越来越疲劳，其抢救状态仍为“全面抢救 (Full Code)”。哪项行动是正确的？

options.en: Communicate the refusal immediately, activate the rapid response team/chain of command, and ensure an authorized provider evaluates capacity and enters orders.
options.zh: 立即沟通拒绝意愿，启动快速反应小组/指挥链，并确保有权限的医嘱开立者评估其能力并下达医嘱。

options.en: Physically assist the rapid response team in forcing intubation since Full Code is in the chart.
options.zh: 既然病历中是全面抢救，就在快速反应小组强行插管时提供物理协助。

options.en: Unilaterally change the code status to DNAR/DNI based on the patient's prior statements.
options.zh: 根据患者先前的陈述单方面将抢救状态更改为 DNAR/DNI。

options.en: Withhold PRN morphine due to the risk of respiratory depression in a hypoxemic patient.
options.zh: 因低氧血症患者有呼吸抑制风险而停用按需使用的吗啡。

correct.en: A conscious, capacitated patient has the right to actively refuse medical interventions. The nurse must immediately communicate this refusal to the responding team, escalate urgently, continue treating within orders, and get a provider evaluation. The nurse cannot unilaterally change the code status.
correct.zh: 清醒且有能力的患者有权积极拒绝医疗干预。护士必须立即向响应小组传达这一拒绝意愿，紧急上报，在医嘱范围内继续治疗，并获得有权限的医嘱开立者的评估。护士不能单方面更改抢救状态。

byChoice.en: This is the correct action that balances the legal default (Full Code order) with the ethical duty to honor a capacitated patient's active refusal.
byChoice.zh: 这是平衡了法律默认状态（全面抢救医嘱）与尊重有能力患者主动拒绝的伦理责任的正确行动。

byChoice.en: Forcing intubation on an actively refusing capacitated patient is wrong. The nurse's role is to communicate the refusal, not to force an unwanted procedure.
byChoice.zh: 对主动拒绝且有能力的患者强行插管是错误的。护士的角色是沟通拒绝意愿，而不是强行执行不想要的程序。

byChoice.en: Changing code status is strictly a provider-only action.
byChoice.zh: 更改抢救状态严格来说是医生专属的操作。

byChoice.en: Morphine is the standard of care for dyspnea in advanced cancer. Withholding it causes unnecessary suffering. The principle of double effect supports its use.
byChoice.zh: 吗啡是晚期癌症呼吸困难的标准治疗。停用会引起不必要的痛苦。双重效应原则支持其使用。

testTakingStrategy.en: Distinguish between actions within the RN scope and those requiring a provider, especially during ethical dilemmas involving patient autonomy.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分在注册护士范围内的行动和需要医生的行动，特别是在涉及患者自主权的伦理困境期间。

stem.en: At 1100, the nurse activates the rapid response team (RRT). What is essential to include in the handoff?
stem.zh: 在 1100，护士启动了快速反应小组 (RRT)。交接中必须包括什么？

options.en: The unresolved code status, the patient's expressed wishes against intubation, his assessed capacity, and the escalation history.
options.zh: 未解决的抢救状态、患者明确表示反对插管的意愿、其经评估的能力以及上报历史。

options.en: Only the clinical data, assuming the RRT physician will review the nursing notes in the chart.
options.zh: 仅包括临床数据，假设 RRT 医生会查阅病历中的护理记录。

options.en: A recommendation that the RRT stand down because the patient has verbally refused treatment.
options.zh: 因为患者已口头拒绝治疗，建议 RRT 撤退。

options.en: A request for the RRT nurse to immediately administer procedural sedation for intubation.
options.zh: 要求 RRT 护士立即给予程序性镇静以进行插管。

correct.en: The handoff must prominently feature the unresolved code status, the patient's clear refusal of intubation, capacity assessment, and escalation history. This information directly determines what the RRT can and should do.
correct.zh: 交接必须突出未解决的抢救状态、患者明确拒绝插管、能力评估和上报历史。这些信息直接决定了 RRT 可以和应该做什么。

byChoice.en: The RRT is needed because the patient requires emergency provider evaluation and symptom management (e.g., dyspnea), and the provider can formally enter the DNAR/DNI order.
byChoice.zh: 由于患者需要紧急的医生评估和症状管理（例如呼吸困难），并且有权限的医嘱开立者可以正式下达 DNAR/DNI 医嘱，因此需要 RRT。

byChoice.en: The RRT operates under time pressure and will default to the charted code status without proactive communication.
byChoice.zh: RRT 在时间压力下运作，如果没有主动沟通，将默认采用病历上的抢救状态。

byChoice.en: The patient is actively refusing intubation; preparing sedation for the procedure directly violates his autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 患者正在主动拒绝插管；为该程序准备镇静剂直接侵犯了他的自主权。

byChoice.en: This ensures the patient's voice reaches the decision-makers during a time-critical emergency.
byChoice.zh: 这确保了在争分夺秒的紧急情况下，患者的意愿能够传达给决策者。

testTakingStrategy.en: Choose the handoff approach that provides a complete picture of both clinical acuity and ethical constraints.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择既能提供临床危重程度又能提供伦理限制全貌的交接方法。

stem.en: At 1130, after the DNAR/DNI order is entered, which actions evaluate the effectiveness of the advocacy process? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在 1130，下达 DNAR/DNI 医嘱后，哪些行动可以评估倡导流程的有效性？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Verifying the DNAR/DNI order is correctly entered in the electronic health record.
options.zh: 核实 DNAR/DNI 医嘱已正确输入电子健康病历中。

options.en: Ensuring the code status is visually confirmed per policy (e.g., wristband, door sign).
options.zh: 确保按照政策通过视觉确认抢救状态（例如腕带、门标）。

options.en: Notifying the healthcare proxy of the clinical deterioration and advance directive.
options.zh: 将临床恶化情况和预立医疗指示通知医疗代理人。

options.en: Filing an incident report regarding the system vulnerability caused by the delayed provider response.
options.zh: 针对因医生延迟回复而引起的系统漏洞提交事件报告。

options.en: Writing a single retrospective note at the end of the shift summarizing the events.
options.zh: 在交班结束时写一份单一的回顾性记录总结事件。

correct.en: Evaluating the advocacy process involves ensuring the order is properly implemented in all systems (EHR, wristbands), the family/proxy is informed, and recognizing system failures (like delayed provider response) for quality improvement.
correct.zh: 评估倡导流程包括确保在所有系统（EHR、腕带）中正确执行了医嘱，通知了家属/代理人，并识别出系统故障（如有权限的医嘱开立者延迟回复）以进行质量改进。

byChoice.en: Visual identifiers are essential fail-safes during emergencies.
byChoice.zh: 视觉标识是紧急情况下的基本失效保护机制。

byChoice.en: Reporting system-level gaps is vital for institutional quality improvement and future patient safety.
byChoice.zh: 报告系统级漏洞对于机构质量改进和未来的患者安全至关重要。

byChoice.en: Crucial to ensure any responding team recognizes the new code status.
byChoice.zh: 这对于确保任何响应小组都能识别新的抢救状态至关重要。

byChoice.en: The proxy must be aware of the patient's condition and the updated care plan.
byChoice.zh: 代理人必须了解患者的病情及更新的护理计划。

byChoice.en: Documentation must be contemporaneous (done in real-time), not retrospective, to serve its clinical, legal, and ethical functions.
byChoice.zh: 文件记录必须是同期的（实时完成），而不是回顾性的，以发挥其临床、法律和伦理功能。

testTakingStrategy.en: Select choices that represent thorough loop-closure for safety, communication, and system improvement.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择那些体现了在安全、沟通和系统改进方面彻底闭环的选择。

title.en: Advance directive clarification and code status escalation in metastatic lung cancer with acute respiratory decline.
title.zh: 伴有急性呼吸衰退的转移性肺癌中的预立医疗指示澄清和抢救状态升级。

summary.en: Mr. Harold Jeffries is a 55-year-old man admitted five days ago to a medical-surgical unit with progressive dyspnea and right-sided pleural effusion secondary to metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (stage IV). He is receiving palliative carboplatin-based chemotherapy. Current orders include supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula titrated to maintain SpO₂ > 92%. The attending is a pulmonologist currently in the OR; the covering provider is a hospitalist. The medical record contains no advance directive, POLST, or healthcare power of attorney. The code status is 'Full Code' (default). His daughter Keisha is the emergency contact. At 0700, he states unprompted: 'I've been thinking about this all night. I don't want to be kept alive by machines. If something happens, I don't want them to put a tube down my throat... I just want to be comfortable.'
summary.zh: Harold Jeffries 先生是一位 55 岁的男性，五天前因转移性非小细胞肺癌（IV期）继发的进行性呼吸困难和右侧胸腔积液收治于内外科病房。他正在接受以卡铂为基础的姑息性化疗。目前的医嘱包括通过鼻导管吸氧以维持 SpO₂ > 92%。主治医生是目前在手术室的呼吸科医生；代班医生是住院医师。病历中没有预立医疗指示、维持生命治疗医生医嘱（POLST）或医疗委托书。抢救状态为“全面抢救 (Full Code)”（默认）。他的女儿 Keisha 是紧急联系人。在 0700，他自发地说道：“我整晚都在想这件事。我不想靠机器维持生命。如果发生什么事，我不想他们把管子插进我喉咙里……我只想舒舒服服的。”

title.zh: 初步评估与实验室检查 (0700)

content.en:
Vital Signs:
Temperature: 98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
Heart rate: 92 bpm
Blood pressure: 118/72 mmHg
Respiratory rate: 20 breaths/min
SpO₂: 93% on 3 L nasal cannula

Assessment:
Alert, oriented to person, place, time, situation.
Conversational, assesses with full decision-making capacity.
Respirations mildly labored with accessory muscle use at rest.
Diminished breath sounds over right lower/middle lung fields.
Scattered expiratory wheezes in left lung.
Pain: 3/10, right-sided chest wall ache.
Speaks in full sentences.

Labs (0530):
WBC: 3.8 ×10³/µL
Hemoglobin: 10.4 g/dL
Platelets: 112 ×10³/µL
BUN: 18 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL
Albumin: 2.6 g/dL
LDH: 680 U/L
content.zh:
生命体征：
体温：98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
心率：92 次/分
血压：118/72 mmHg
呼吸频率：20 次/分
SpO₂：3 L鼻导管吸氧下 93%

评估：
清醒，对人物、地点、时间和情况定向力良好。
能够交谈，经评估具有完全的决策能力。
静息时呼吸轻度费力，伴有辅助呼吸肌参与。
右下/中肺野呼吸音减弱。
左肺散在呼气相哮鸣音。
疼痛：3/10，右侧胸壁钝痛。
能说完整的句子。

实验室检查 (0530)：
白细胞：3.8 ×10³/µL
血红蛋白：10.4 g/dL
血小板：112 ×10³/µL
尿素氮：18 mg/dL
肌酐：0.9 mg/dL
白蛋白：2.6 g/dL
乳酸脱氢酶：680 U/L
